### Crypto Battle Royale
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/treasury-battle-royale-e0f9) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/Pvayush/treasury-sandbox.git) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/mFm9lRgwFMw) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-ETHDenver%202026-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://ethdenver2026.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-3-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Automated Treasury Battles on Blockchain

![Solidity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Solidity-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Crypto Battle Royale tackles a key challenge in DeFi: most users only interact with Uniswap as a simple swap interface, missing the complex mechanics underneath that drive real profit and risk. Concepts like fee tier optimization, concentrated liquidity dynamics, impermanent loss, and MEV extraction are invisible to the average trader. This makes learning advanced trading strategies difficult and risky with real capital.

By gamifying trading, Crypto Battle Royale allows users to safely experience Uniswap-native strategies in a competitive environment. Players compete against autonomous AI agents and a passive LP baseline, seeing in real-time how strategies like arbitrage, liquidity depth analysis, and sandwich prediction affect outcomes. The game’s on-chain staking ensures transparency and security, while the elimination rounds and leaderboards make risk-reward dynamics visible and understandable. Overall, it makes learning advanced DeFi trading safer, faster, and interactive.

**Challenges we ran into**

One of the biggest challenges was integrating AI trading decisions with live Uniswap trades. AI signals needed to translate into on-chain swaps without breaking gas constraints or exceeding slippage limits. To overcome this, I built a pre-transaction simulation layer using the Uniswap Trading API’s quote endpoint and a gas buffer, ensuring all trades could execute safely.

Synchronizing multiple human and AI portfolios in real-time was another hurdle. Calculating risk-adjusted returns while keeping front-end updates smooth required building a battle engine that batches updates and leverages React Query caching.

On-chain elimination logic was tricky as well. Designing a fair, trustless method to eliminate players and distribute the pool required adding timeouts and emergency refunds, ensuring funds were fully secure and only reachable by legitimate winners.

Finally, testing MEV and arbitrage strategies on Sepolia was difficult due to limited liquidity and sparse historical data. Implementing a speed-up mode with historical price replay allowed rapid testing of AI interactions and edge-case scenarios without waiting for live rounds.

**Use of AI tools and agents**

AI agents are central to Crypto Battle Royale. Market strategy agents like Momentum Alpha, Mean Reversion, and Volatility Breakout simulate common trading styles, providing humans with benchmarks and learning opportunities. The passive HODL Benchmark represents the minimum performance to beat.

Uniswap-native attack agents such as Liquidity Sniper, MEV Sandwich, and Pool Arbitrage exploit protocol mechanics, including thin liquidity, predicted trades, and cross-pool fee discrepancies. These agents create realistic competitive pressure, forcing players to adapt and learn defensive strategies against common on-chain threats.

All agents follow a TradingAgent interface that produces TradeDecision outputs. Decisions feed directly into the Uniswap Trading API pipeline, are executed, and portfolios are marked to market. Every three rounds, risk-adjusted performance determines eliminations, creating a dynamic environment where AI and human strategies continuously interact.

**ETHERSPACE**

Crypto Battle Royale sits at the intersection of DeFi, on-chain education, and gamified trading, making it a unique entry point into Ethereum for both newcomers and experienced users. While most DeFi applications focus on swaps, staking, or yield farming, our project turns the protocol itself into a competitive playground. Players interact directly with Uniswap V3 mechanics, fee tiers, and liquidity positions, but in a safe, on-chain environment, gaining hands-on experience with advanced Ethereum-native financial primitives.

By integrating smart contracts on Sepolia, the Uniswap Trading API, and autonomous AI agents, we demonstrate the possibilities of programmable, interactive finance. Our battle arenas showcase how Ethereum’s composable ecosystem allows complex financial logic to be executed transparently and trustlessly, while also providing a learning-first approach to protocol-level risks such as MEV, impermanent loss, and arbitrage opportunities.

**Killer App for the Agentic Society (OpenClaw)**

Crypto Battle Royale exemplifies a killer app for an agentic society by giving participants a direct, hands-on role in decision-making and strategy execution on-chain. By integrating autonomous AI agents, human participants, and live DeFi mechanics, the platform lets users observe, interact with, and respond to the consequences of their actions in real time, reflecting the core principle of agentic systems: empowered actors driving outcomes through transparent rules and feedback loops. On Hedera or OpenClaw, these mechanics could leverage fast, low-cost consensus and secure tokenized interactions, allowing participants to deploy strategies, execute trades, and receive rewards with high confidence in settlement finality.

The game’s autonomous agents also demonstrate agentic behavior at scale, executing independent strategies while adapting to human decisions and market conditions. This creates a living, interactive environment where participants not only compete but learn the effects of allocation, risk management, and emergent behavior. The live leaderboard, elimination rounds, and automated payouts provide visible consequences for action, mirroring governance and collaborative decision-making frameworks in decentralized communities.

Overall, Crypto Battle Royale functions as a playable laboratory for agentic society principles, showing how humans and autonomous systems can coexist, compete, and collaborate on-chain. By combining transparent rules, adaptive AI, and interactive feedback, the app becomes a demonstration of empowered participants shaping their environment, which is the essence of a killer app for agentic ecosystems like Hedera/OpenClaw.

**Base Self-Sustaining Autonomous Agents**

In Crypto Battle Royale, self-autonomous agents are designed to operate independently within the trading arena without direct human input. Each agent implements a standard TradingAgent interface that outputs a TradeDecision every round. These decisions include which tokens to buy or sell, the allocation percentages, and any slippage or risk constraints. Once a decision is generated, it is fed into the Uniswap Trading API pipeline, where quotes are fetched, gas is estimated, and transactions are signed and executed automatically on-chain.

The agents fall into two main categories. Market strategy agents simulate traditional trading behaviors such as momentum, mean reversion, or volatility breakout, providing a baseline for human players to compete against. Uniswap-native attack agents exploit protocol-specific mechanics, like pool depth analysis, cross-fee-tier arbitrage, and MEV sandwich strategies. These agents observe opponent allocations and historical price data, adapting their trades dynamically to maximize performance.

**Integrate the Uniswap API in your platform**

Crypto Battle Royale is fundamentally a protocol-native experience built on Uniswap, designed to educate, engage, and empower users with the mechanics of Uniswap V3. While most users interact with the protocol only through simple swaps, our platform surfaces fee tier optimization, concentrated liquidity, impermanent loss, and arbitrage opportunities in a gamified, risk-controlled environment. This aligns directly with the Uniswap Foundation’s goal of expanding understanding, accessibility, and utility of the protocol.

By leveraging the Uniswap Trading API and on-chain smart contracts, Crypto Battle Royale demonstrates real-world use cases of Uniswap primitives: routing across fee tiers, LP position modeling, and MEV-aware trading. Human participants see the direct consequences of their decisions alongside AI agents that simulate both market trends and protocol-specific attacks, creating a living sandbox of Uniswap’s capabilities.

Moreover, the project contributes to the ecosystem by:

Lowering the barrier to learning Uniswap mechanics — Players experience advanced strategies without risking significant capital, making the protocol more approachable.

Showcasing composable and transparent on-chain design — All entry stakes, eliminations, and payouts are handled via smart contracts, demonstrating secure, trustless interaction with Uniswap.

Promoting innovative experimentation — Gamified competition incentivizes users to explore and optimize strategies that are native to Uniswap, reinforcing the value of liquidity provision, arbitrage, and MEV mitigation.

In essence, Crypto Battle Royale is not just a game — it’s a proof-of-concept for interactive, educational, and high-engagement use of Uniswap, making it an ideal project for the Uniswap Foundation to support as it aligns with broader goals of adoption, education, and ecosystem growth.

**Evolving Nouns Builder Protocol Infrastructure & Governance UX**

Crypto Battle Royale complements the Nouns Builder ecosystem by providing a highly interactive, on-chain experience that demonstrates the potential of NFT-native governance, community engagement, and composable infrastructure. While Nouns Builder focuses on decentralized project funding, DAO creation, and collaborative decision-making, our platform adds a playable, gamified layer where participants interact with complex protocol mechanics in a transparent and trustless way. This experiential approach can inform better UX design, governance mechanics, and incentive structures within Nouns Builder projects.

By leveraging on-chain smart contracts and a modular architecture, Crypto Battle Royale showcases how real-time feedback, eliminations, and reward distribution can be handled securely and automatically. This is directly relevant to Nouns Builder as it explores DAOs with dynamic participation, treasury management, and proposal execution. Players learn how allocation decisions, risk management, and automated rules affect outcomes, creating analogies for community voting, treasury deployment, and governance token utility.

The project contributes to Nouns Builder by:

Informing UX improvements. Interactive visualizations of portfolio performance, leaderboards, and real-time results provide lessons in intuitive user interfaces for DAO participants.

Modeling governance dynamics. Elimination rules and AI-driven competition demonstrate how transparent, automated mechanisms can drive fair outcomes and incentivize engagement.

Extending infrastructure possibilities. Integrating AI agents, on-chain staking, and modular smart contracts highlights composable patterns that can be adopted for Nouns Builder projects.

Crypto Battle Royale is a practical example of how gamified, protocol-native interactions can improve participation, decision-making, and infrastructure design, making it a relevant and valuable experiment for the Nouns Builder ecosystem.

**Governance UX & Community Tooling**

Crypto Battle Royale provides a hands-on demonstration of how on-chain systems can enhance governance, user experience, and community tooling. The game’s elimination mechanics, leaderboards, and automated reward distribution create a transparent and trustless environment that mirrors DAO governance, showing how clear rules and real-time feedback can guide fair decision-making. Its interactive dashboards, strategy cards, and performance charts make complex DeFi concepts immediately understandable, offering lessons in UX design that can improve comprehension and engagement for users participating in governance or treasury decisions. On the community side, the live battle arenas encourage collaboration, observation, and shared learning, creating a social feedback loop that can inform tools for proposal debate, collective strategy, and incentive alignment. By combining protocol-native mechanics, gamified interaction, and AI-driven competition, the project illustrates how decentralized communities can experience, learn, and iterate on governance, interface design, and collaborative tooling in a safe and engaging environment.

### CivicLens

**The problem it solves**

What Can You Use **CivicLens** For?
**For Municipal Officials & Engineers**

Instant issue reporting: Click a photo and the system auto-detects location, issue type, and assigns it to the right ward.

Automatic prioritization: Life-threatening hazards (open manholes, deep potholes) are flagged and handled first.

Accurate cost estimation: AI estimates repair cost, materials, and manpower from images.

Predictive maintenance: Identify weak roads and drainage 30–90 days in advance to avoid disasters.

**Result:** Faster response, safer streets, better planning, lower costs.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

For **Citizens**

Easy reporting: Report potholes, broken lights, or hazards using just a photo.

Real-time tracking: Track complaint status from report to completion.

Safety-first repairs: Dangerous issues near homes and schools are fixed first.

Full transparency: See before–after photos and know where tax money is spent.

Result: Safer neighborhoods and zero follow-ups or office visits.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

For **Contractors**

Clear work orders: Know exactly what to fix, by when, and how much you’ll be paid.

Faster payments: Upload completion photo → AI verifies → Payment released automatically.

Fair system: Quality work gets rewarded; delays trigger penalties.

Result: Faster payments, no corruption, no guesswork.

 For State Governments

State-wide deployment: Manage multiple cities from a single dashboard.

Data-driven decisions: Identify problem hotspots and plan long-term infrastructure upgrades.

Corruption prevention: Blockchain-backed records ensure tamper-proof audits.

**Result:** Smarter governance, safer cities, and major cost savings.

**Challenges we ran into**

Challenges We Ran Into
1. AI Model Accuracy for Indian Infrastructure
The Problem:
Model trained on Western datasets failed on Indian roads couldn't detect debris-covered manholes, confused potholes with puddles. Accuracy: only 52%.
Solution:

Created custom dataset of 3,000+ Indian street images
Fine-tuned YOLOv8 on local conditions (monsoon, mixed infrastructure)
Trained specifically on edge cases
Result: 87% accuracy achieved


2. GPS Inaccuracy in Dense Areas
The Problem:
GPS off by 50-100m in crowded neighborhoods wrong ward assignments, duplicate reports, engineers can't find issues.
Solution:

Combined GPS + network + Wi-Fi positioning
Added 25m geofencing buffers
Used AI to detect landmarks in photos for validation
Result: Accuracy improved to ±12m


3. Blockchain Too Slow for Real-Time
The Problem:
Public Ethereum took 15-45 seconds per transaction too slow for 1000+ daily issues.
Solution:

Switched to Hyperledger Fabric (private blockchain)
Batched non-critical updates, instant for emergencies
Off-chain cache with blockchain sync
Result: <2 seconds response time, 10,000+ transactions/day


4. Fake "After" Photos
The Problem:
Contractors uploaded old photos or reused images to fake completion.
Solution:

EXIF metadata verification (timestamp, GPS)
Image similarity detection (perceptual hashing)
GPS proximity check (±15m)
AI before-after comparison
Result: Fake attempts dropped to near zero


5. Low User Adoption
The Problem:
Older engineers resisted change "too complex," preferred paper, feared digital tracking. Only 23% adoption.
Solution:

Simplified to 3 taps: Open → Photo → Submit
Added Gujarati/Hindi interfaces
Offline mode for field areas
Hands-on training + champion engineers
Result: 78% adoption in 3 weeks


6. Monsoon Data Spikes
The Problem:
Reports jumped from 50/day to 800/day system crashed, 5-hour AI processing delays.
Solution:

Auto-scaling cloud infrastructure
Priority queue (emergencies first)
Distributed GPU processing
Redis cache + PostgreSQL optimization
Result: Handles 2,000+ concurrent submissions


7. Inaccurate Cost Estimates
The Problem:
AI wildly off estimated ₹5,000 for ₹25,000 repair. Didn't account for regional costs or complexity.
Solution:

Added 15+ parameters (depth, location, materials, accessibility)
Integrated municipal procurement rates by city
Historical learning from actual costs
Provide range with confidence score
Result: 81% accuracy within ±20%


8. Poor Image Quality
The Problem:
64% of photos unusable blurry, dark, too far, blocked by shadows.
Solution:

Real-time quality check with retake prompt
Auto-enhancement (brightness, contrast)
Guided capture mode with on-screen overlay
Flash suggestions in low light
Result: 94% usable images

### SymptoCare: AI for Health Risk Guidance

> When symptoms are unclear, clarity saves lives.

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![npm](https://img.shields.io/badge/npm-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![scikit-learn](https://img.shields.io/badge/scikit--learn-333333?style=flat-square) ![Git](https://img.shields.io/badge/Git-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

The Problem It Solves:

People often struggle to decide whether their symptoms are serious enough to seek medical care, leading to two dangerous outcomes: unnecessary panic-driven hospital visits or, more critically, delayed treatment for life-threatening conditions that initially appear mild or unclear.

This system helps solve that problem by providing early, explainable health risk awareness—especially in situations where symptoms are underestimated, atypical, or difficult to describe.

What People Can Use This System For:

- Understanding symptom urgency
Determine whether current symptoms are likely low risk, moderate concern, or potentially dangerous, without attempting medical diagnosis.

- Avoiding dangerous delays in care
Identify situations where symptoms may feel mild but statistically indicate silent or high-risk medical emergencies.

- Receiving clear, explainable guidance
Understand why a certain risk level is assigned through human-readable explanations rather than opaque scores.

- Evaluating consequences of inaction
Learn what may happen if symptoms are ignored, helping users make informed and timely decisions.

How It Makes Existing Healthcare Tasks Easier and Safer
🧠 Reduces Symptom Neglect

Detects when users may be unintentionally downplaying symptoms and escalates risk accordingly.

🚨 Identifies Silent Emergencies

Flags atypical or low-symptom presentations of serious conditions that traditional symptom checkers often miss.

🗣️ Removes Input Barriers with Voice

Allows users to speak symptoms naturally, making the system usable during stress, physical discomfort, or emergencies.

🌐 Breaks Language Barriers

Supports English, Hindi, and Marathi, enabling non-English speakers to access AI-based health guidance in their native language.

👵 Improves Accessibility

Helps elderly users, low-literacy users, and people with physical disabilities who struggle with typed input.

🔍 Builds Trust Through Explainability

Explains reasoning transparently, increasing confidence and reducing repeated uncertainty-driven self-checking.

Who Benefits Most:

- Individuals unsure whether symptoms require urgent attention

- Elderly users and caregivers

- Non-English speakers and regional-language users

- Users in high-stress or emergency situations

- Communities with limited access to immediate medical advice

**Challenges we ran into**

One of the primary challenges during development was achieving reliable prediction precision, especially when users provided partial, vague, or overlapping symptom inputs. Early versions of the model produced confident classifications even when symptom information was sparse, which risked over- or under-estimating medical urgency.

To address this, we shifted from relying solely on a single predicted class to incorporating probability-based risk scoring. Instead of treating predictions as binary outcomes, the system now evaluates the degree of symptom alignment with known high-risk patterns. As the number and relevance of matching symptoms increase, the corresponding probability score for a given condition or risk level increases proportionally.

This probabilistic approach allowed the system to:

Better handle uncertainty and incomplete inputs

Reduce false confidence in edge cases

Provide more nuanced, explainable risk assessments

By grounding predictions in symptom-to-risk probability distributions rather than rigid classifications, we significantly improved the robustness and trustworthiness of the system’s outputs—especially in real-world scenarios where perfect data is rarely available.

**Ethereum Track**

1. On-Chain Proof of Risk Assessment (Without Exposing Data)

The system can generate a cryptographic hash of:

- Timestamped symptom inputs
- Risk level output
- Model version used

This hash can be:
- Anchored on Ethereum
- Used as a verifiable proof that an assessment occurred at a specific time

This enables:
- Accountability in emergency escalation
- Trust when sharing results with doctors or caregivers
- No sensitive data stored on-chain — privacy preserved

2. Decentralized Health Identity (Optional Extension)

- Users can optionally link assessments to a wallet-based health identity:
- No centralized login required
- User owns their assessment history
- Selective sharing with doctors or family
- Ethereum enables self-sovereign identity, which aligns strongly with ethical healthcare data ownership.

3. Incentivizing Early Action Through Smart Contracts

- Smart contracts can be used to:
- Reward users for timely medical follow-up
- Encourage preventive behavior
- Support NGO or public-health–funded incentive programs
- This transforms AI risk detection into actionable outcomes, not just insights.

4. Decentralized Governance & Model Transparency (Advanced)

Ethereum can support:
- On-chain verification of model versions
- Community oversight of risk thresholds
- Transparent governance for ethical AI updates

This is especially valuable in healthcare, where trust and accountability matter as much as accuracy.

![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![SocketJs](https://img.shields.io/badge/SocketJs-333333?style=flat-square) ![React.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/React.js-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Modern compute-intensive applications face a compute scarcity crisis due to expensive, centralized hardware, while millions of consumer devices with powerful GPU's remain idle. 
We aim to unlock this unused gpus by allowing it to share its computation power to other devices.

**Challenges we ran into**

1. A key challenge was handling donor disconnections during live LLM requests. Since workers are browser tabs, they can drop anytime, which initially caused stuck jobs. I solved it by adding clear job states, timeout/retry handling, and real-time status updates in the UI so requests either recover automatically or fail cleanly with feedback.

2. Another challenge was first-response latency. WebLLM model loading on donor browsers made initial requests feel slow. I solved it by warming up the model at donor connect time and reusing the loaded engine, which reduced cold-start delays and made response times more consistent.

![Solidity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Solidity-333333?style=flat-square) ![Leaflet](https://img.shields.io/badge/Leaflet-333333?style=flat-square) ![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![TensorFlow](https://img.shields.io/badge/TensorFlow-333333?style=flat-square) ![PyTorch](https://img.shields.io/badge/PyTorch-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Framer](https://img.shields.io/badge/Framer-333333?style=flat-square) ![React.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/React.js-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

During disasters, communication breaks down, information becomes unreliable, and help is delayed. Existing solutions are fragmented and often stop working when networks fail, leading to panic, poor coordination, aid diversion, and families being separated.

Resilio addresses this with a single, unified platform that supports people throughout a disaster. Users can access critical guidance, send SOS messages, communicate with others nearby, and reconnect with family members, while NGOs and governments coordinate relief efforts and track aid transparently. By replacing multiple disconnected tools with one reliable system, Resilio makes disaster response faster, safer, and more effective.

**Challenges we ran into**

During development, one of the main challenges we faced was designing for a very diverse user base. Our initial interface was too text-heavy, which made it difficult to use quickly, especially for first-time users or people under stress. We solved this by shifting to a more visual, icon-first design with simpler and more intuitive interactions. Another challenge was integrating multiple components into a single smooth experience, as small inconsistencies caused issues during testing. Through regular integration testing and by simplifying component boundaries, we were able to stabilize the system and move forward with confidence.

**Open Innovation**

Resilio fits the Open Innovation track by combining multiple emerging technologies into a single offline-first disaster platform that solves a critical, real-world problem at scale and beyond traditional domain boundaries.

**The problem it solves**

# CLI-OS — Simplifying the Command Line

## The Problem
Traditional Linux/Unix terminals are difficult to use because they require:
- Memorizing cryptic commands and flags  
- Writing complex syntax  
- Navigating file systems without guidance  
- Learning steep editors like Vim or Nano  

## The Solution
**CLI-OS** lets users interact with the terminal using **natural language**.

**Examples:**
- “Show all files including hidden ones” → `ls -la`
- “Find Python files modified in the last 7 days” → `find . -name "*.py" -mtime -7`
- “Backup my documents” → `tar -czf backup.tar.gz ~/Documents/`

## Why CLI-OS
- **Accessible** — usable by non-technical users  
- **Efficient** — no command memorization  
- **Educational** — teaches real Linux commands  
- **Universal** — runs in any browser  

**CLI-OS bridges human intent and Linux power—making the terminal simple for everyone.**

**Challenges we ran into**

# CLI-OS — Development Challenges

## Understanding User Intent
Translating free-form natural language into accurate Linux commands is non-trivial.  
Ambiguous or incomplete user inputs can lead to multiple valid interpretations.

## Command Safety & Validation
Automatically generating shell commands introduces risks:
- Preventing destructive commands (`rm -rf /`)
- Handling permission-sensitive operations
- Ensuring safe execution in sandboxed environments

## Edge Cases & Context Awareness
Linux commands often depend on context:
- Current directory and environment variables
- File permissions and OS differences
- Handling unexpected outputs or errors gracefully

## Mapping to Correct Syntax
Many Linux tasks have multiple command variations. Selecting the **most efficient and correct** command requires deep system knowledge.

## Performance & Responsiveness
Parsing natural language and generating commands must remain fast to preserve the terminal’s real-time feel.

## Balancing Simplicity with Power
Making the interface simple for beginners while still supporting advanced workflows is a constant design tradeoff.

**Building CLI-OS requires bridging human language, system safety, and Unix precision—without compromising user trust or control.**

**Emerging Technologies**

We have used emerging technologies such as shadcn/ui, Natural language processing and Grafana Datasets for training AI models, hence it comes under Emerging technologies. Also we have developed our  enncryption protocols that have given it another boost. We are revolutionizing encryption and making the future of secure Operating Systems.

**The problem it solves**

# The Problem It Solves

Let's be honest: Most people know they should save money, avoid impulse spending, or stick to financial goals. But knowing something and actually doing it are two very different things.

Traditional finance apps:
- Only track spending after it has already happened
- Show charts and alerts but don't prevent bad decisions
- Rely entirely on self-control, which is unreliable and inconsistent

There is no real incentive to not spend impulsively, and no trustless way to prove good financial behavior without exposing sensitive data.

# What Our Project Does

Our project changes the incentive structure.

Instead of punishing bad spending after the fact, it:
- Rewards restraint
- Makes discipline verifiable
- Keeps user data private

By using blockchain and zero-knowledge logic, users can:
- Set personal spending rules (limits, cooldowns, no-spend windows)
- Prove they followed those rules without revealing transaction details
- Earn on-chain rewards for disciplined behavior

The focus is not on tracking mistakes, but on rewarding consistency.

# What People Can Use It For

- Reducing impulsive spending by enforcing self-imposed rules
- Saving toward goals with provable commitment
- Maintaining financial privacy while still earning rewards
- Gamifying discipline through streaks, challenges, and incentives
- Creating trustless accountability without sharing raw financial data

In short, it makes responsible financial behavior easier, safer, and more motivating.

**Challenges we ran into**

# Challenges We Ran Into

## Designing ZK-Friendly Logic

What seems simple in a traditional backend becomes surprisingly complex in zero-knowledge systems.

- Conditional logic is expensive
- Small assumptions can break proofs silently
- Even basic validations require careful constraint design

**How we solved it:** We simplified the logic layer, separated rule validation from reward distribution, and redesigned flows specifically for ZK constraints instead of adapting Web2 logic directly.

## Implementing Fair On-Chain Rewards

We wanted rewards to be:
- Transparent
- Non-exploitable
- Based on consistent behavior

Challenges included:
- Avoiding predictable randomness
- Preventing users from gaming incentives
- Balancing fairness with simplicity

**How we solved it:** We introduced controlled randomness, cooldown periods, and proof-based eligibility so rewards reflect long-term discipline rather than one-off actions.

## Managing Feature Creep

As the project evolved, new ideas kept coming up:
- Punishments
- Social accountability
- Future-self messaging
- Additional gamification layers

While exciting, this risked bloating the core system.

**How we solved it:** We locked the core loop early:

```
Rule → Proof → Reward
```

Any feature that didn't directly strengthen this loop was moved to future scope.

## Making Finance Feel Engaging Without Losing Credibility

Finance tools are often boring, while crypto tools can be overwhelming. Striking the right balance was a challenge.

**How we solved it:** We focused on clear UX, friendly language, and light gamification while keeping the underlying mechanics serious and secure.

**Ethereum Track**

This project is a native Ethereum application for decentralized coordination and incentive enforcement, not just a reward mechanism.

At its core, the project solves a coordination problem:

**How can groups incentivize real actions, verify them fairly, and distribute rewards without relying on a central authority?**

Ethereum acts as the neutral execution and settlement layer that guarantees:

- Rules cannot be changed arbitrarily
- Outcomes cannot be manipulated
- Rewards are distributed exactly as agreed


The Core Architecture (Main Point)

The system has three tightly coupled layers:

1. Ethereum as the Trust and Enforcement Layer

- All critical logic lives on Ethereum smart contracts:
- Reward rules are encoded immutably
- State transitions are deterministic and verifiable
- Incentives are enforced automatically
- Once deployed, no individual, team, or platform can override outcomes.

2. Hive Mind as the Decentralized Validation Layer

- The Hive Mind provides collective intelligence for decision-making:
- Multiple participants validate or evaluate actions
- No single validator has control
- Honest behavior is economically incentivized
- Ethereum finalizes Hive Mind outcomes, ensuring that collective decisions are executed trustlessly.

3. Cryptoeconomic Incentives as the Alignment Layer

Ethereum-native incentives ensure participants act honestly:

-  Rewards and penalties are enforced on-chain
-  Malicious or low-quality behavior is economically disincentivized
-  Validators are aligned with long-term system integrity
-  This converts subjective human judgment into objective, enforceable outcomes.


Why This Cannot Be Built Outside Ethereum

- This system fundamentally requires Ethereum because:
- Web2 systems cannot provide credible neutrality
- Centralized platforms can alter rules or censor outcomes
- Off-chain logic lacks public verifiability

Ethereum uniquely provides:

- Permissionless participation
- Public auditability
- Immutable incentive logic
- Composability with the broader Ethereum ecosystem

Without Ethereum, the Hive Mind has no enforcement power.
Without the Hive Mind, Ethereum has no human-context awareness.
Together, they form a complete decentralized coordination system.

**What This Enables** (Real Use Cases)

- Decentralized reward systems
- Community-governed incentive programs
- Trustless task verification
- Crowd-validated outcomes
- Transparent reputation and accountability systems
- All of these rely on Ethereum to turn social consensus into executable code.

Why This Strongly Aligns With the Ethereum Track

- This project directly embodies Ethereum’s core thesis:
- Trust minimization
- Decentralized coordination
- Smart contract–enforced incentives
- Open, permissionless infrastructure
- It treats Ethereum not as a payment rail, but as a global coordination computer that enforces collective decisions at scale.

**The problem it solves**

## Problem & Motivation

DeFi yield data looks simple on the surface, but in practice it is **noisy, fragmented, and hard to trust in real time**. Raw APY values change every block, differ across chains, and provide no context around risk or stability. Most existing tools either expose this raw data directly or rely on opaque processing, making it difficult for developers and users to reason about yield behavior.

APY Engine was built to solve this gap.

### What the System Does

ABY Engine continuously indexes on-chain lending data (currently Aave v3) across multiple EVM chains and converts it into **clean, consistent, and explainable yield analytics**. Instead of exposing raw rates, the engine applies deterministic smoothing, trend detection, and risk adjustments to produce metrics that are easier to compare and safer to consume.

### Why It’s Different

| Problem | APY Engine Approach |
|-------|--------------------|
| Highly volatile APYs | Time-aware EMA smoothing |
| No risk context | Volatility & liquidity stress metrics |
| Chain fragmentation | Unified multi-chain view |
| Hard-to-use data | Frontend-ready public API |

```mermaid
flowchart LR
On-chain --> Normalize --> Engine --> API --> Dashboard

**Challenges we ran into**

## Challenges & Hurdles Faced

Building ABY Engine involved several practical and conceptual challenges, especially while moving from an idea to a production-ready system.

The first major hurdle was **understanding DeFi yield mechanics themselves**. Concepts like APY, liquidity rates, compounding behavior, and protocol-specific representations (such as ray units in Aave) required deep research before any meaningful analytics could be built.

The second challenge was **engine design over-engineering**. Early versions of the engine included *decision* and *confidence* states inside the core logic. While theoretically interesting, they added unnecessary complexity, reduced clarity, and made the engine harder to reason about. After testing, this section was removed in favor of a simpler, more deterministic core.

A significant portion of development time went into **testing and debugging the engine**. Many logical bugs only surfaced during long manual simulations and edge-case testing, leading to multiple refinements in state handling and time-based calculations.

Another major hurdle was **on-chain data ingestion and API exposure**. Fetching live blockchain data, normalizing it, and serving it reliably as a public API required careful research. This was ultimately solved by refining the indexing layer and deploying the service on Render as a long-running backend.

We also encountered a **CORS configuration issue** that initially prevented the API from being publicly accessible, which was resolved through backend fixes. Finally, there were several frontend integration challenges, all of which were gradually addressed through iteration and testing.

**Web3/Defi Track**

## Why This Project Fits the Problem Statement

The core requirement of the problem statement was to build a **real-time APY tracking and comparison platform** for DeFi protocols. ABY Engine was designed specifically as an **APY analytics engine**, not a generic yield aggregator, which makes it a direct fit for this track.

The system continuously indexes **on-chain APY data** from Aave v3 for the required stable assets (USDC, USDT, USDE, crvUSD) across multiple EVM chains. Instead of exposing raw, highly volatile APY values, the engine processes them in real time and produces **smoothed, trend-aware, and risk-adjusted APY metrics** that are easier to compare across markets.

APY Engine satisfies the backend requirements by providing a **scalable, low-latency service** that ingests data continuously and exposes a clean public API for developers. The architecture is intentionally designed to support **live updates (WebSockets/SSE)** and additional protocols in the future without changing the core APY engine.

A frontend dashboard was built on top of this API to **compare APYs across markets in real time**, fulfilling the visualization requirement. Finally, the system is **hosted, production-ready, and reliable**, running as a long-lived service on cloud infrastructure, directly meeting the “brownie points” criteria of the problem statement.

**The problem it solves**

DeFi users and developers rely heavily on **yield data (APY)** to make decisions, but most existing tools suffer from one or more of these problems:

* Yields are **not real-time** and update with delays
* Data is often **aggregated off-chain**, reducing transparency
* Users only see **static APY snapshots**, not how yields are changing
* Developers lack **simple APIs** to programmatically access live yield data

This makes it difficult to:

* React quickly to yield changes
* Compare stablecoin opportunities accurately
* Build automated strategies or analytics on top of reliable yield data

###  How RateFlow Helps

**RateFlow** is a **real-time DeFi yield intelligence platform** that directly streams **on-chain yield data** from the Aave v3 protocol and turns it into actionable insights.

With RateFlow, users and developers can:

*  **Track live supply and borrow APYs** for stablecoins like USDC and USDT
*  See **real-time yield changes** instead of delayed snapshots
*  Instantly know the **best yield opportunity right now** via recommendations
*  Access yield data programmatically using a **public API**
*  Build dashboards, bots, or analytics using **API-first architecture**

Unlike traditional dashboards, RateFlow focuses on **yield intelligence**, not just yield display making DeFi decision-making **faster, clearer, and more transparent**.

**Challenges we ran into**

Building a real-time, production-ready Web3 system came with several non-trivial challenges.

---

### 🔹 1. On-chain Data Complexity & Accuracy

**Challenge:**
Fetching yield data directly from Aave v3 contracts involves dealing with raw on-chain values, precision handling, and protocol-specific rate calculations. Small mistakes can lead to incorrect APY values.

**How I solved it:**

* Used official Aave v3 contract interfaces
* Carefully normalized on-chain values using correct decimals
* Cross-verified outputs with Aave’s documentation and dashboards
* Ensured no mock or hardcoded data was used

This ensured the yields shown are **accurate and trustless**.

---

### 🔹 2. Real-Time Updates Without Overloading RPCs

**Challenge:**
Continuously fetching on-chain data can easily overload RPC providers or introduce latency.

**How I solved it:**

* Implemented a controlled polling mechanism
* Indexed and cached yield data in the backend
* Used **WebSockets** to push updates to the frontend instead of repeated client polling

This achieved **low-latency updates** while remaining efficient and scalable.

---

### 🔹 3. Strict TypeScript Errors in Production Builds

**Challenge:**
The project worked locally, but production builds failed due to **strict TypeScript checks**, especially because some assets (USDE, CevUSD) intentionally do not have yield data yet.

**How I solved it:**

* Refined shared interfaces to correctly model optional and unavailable data
* Added proper null-safety handling instead of disabling strict checks
* Ensured frontend and backend stayed type-safe via a shared contract layer

This improved both **code quality and system reliability**.

---

### 🔹 4. Frontend ↔ Backend Integration Issues (CORS & Environment Config)

**Challenge:**
After deployment, the frontend could not fetch data from the backend despite the backend working correctly.

**How I solved it:**

* Diagnosed CORS misconfiguration blocking requests from the Vercel domain
* Updated backend CORS handling to support dynamic production origins
* Fixed environment variable handling specific to Create React App (`REACT_APP_` prefix)

This ensured seamless communication between deployed services.

---

### 🔹 5. Making the System “Hackathon-Ready”

**Challenge:**
Balancing real-world architecture with hackathon time constraints.

**How I solved it:**

* Focused on **one protocol (Aave v3)** but designed the system to be protocol-agnostic
* Prioritized correctness, real-time behavior, and clarity over feature bloat
* Built a system that is **production-ready**, not just demo-ready

---

##  Final Outcome

Despite these challenges, RateFlow successfully delivers:

* Real-time on-chain yield tracking
* A scalable backend with WebSocket support
* A clean public API for developers
* A modern, deployed, production-grade system

These challenges ultimately strengthened the project and made it more robust, transparent, and realistic.

**Web3/Defi Track**

RateFlow is fundamentally a **Web3-native financial intelligence platform** built on top of **on-chain data and decentralized protocols**.

**Architecture**

The core problem we address - **lack of real-time, transparent yield information in DeFi** - can only be solved using Web3 primitives. RateFlow directly interacts with **Aave v3 smart contracts on Ethereum**, fetching yield, utilization, and liquidity data straight from the blockchain instead of relying on off-chain aggregators or centralized APIs.

###  How Web3 is essential to RateFlow

* **On-chain data ingestion:**
  All yield metrics are derived directly from Ethereum smart contracts, ensuring transparency, verifiability, and trustless data access.

* **Decentralized protocol integration:**

* **API-first Web3 infrastructure:**

###  Why this belongs in the Web3 track

RateFlow is not just a dashboard - it is **Web3 infrastructure**.
The frontend is only one consumer of a backend that acts as a **real-time indexing and intelligence layer for DeFi protocols**.

Without Web3:

* There would be no trustless yield data
* No smart contract-level transparency

By leveraging blockchain data directly, RateFlow demonstrates how Web3 enables **open, composable, and transparent financial systems**, making it a strong fit for the Web3 track.

**The problem it solves**

MiniApp Deployed URL: https://base.app/app/cypher-apps.vercel.app

Pitch Deck: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1ZfNqbbKr9JPLwCwvGqe2agTIt0UQzsLl/view?usp=sharing


**Cypher** is a non-custodial crypto wallet that provides cash-level privacy on the blockchain through Stealth Address technology.

### Privacy Problems in Traditional Crypto

1. **Public wallet addresses expose everything**
   - Anyone can see your balance, transaction history, and spending patterns
   - Addresses can be tracked and linked to your identity
   - No financial privacy whatsoever

2. **Long, complex addresses are hard to share**
   - Addresses like *0x742d35Cc6634C0532925a3b844Bc9e7595f0bEb* are difficult to remember and share
   - High risk of typos when copy-pasting
   - Not user-friendly for everyday use

3. **Transaction history is permanently public**
   - Every transaction is recorded on the blockchain forever
   - Can be analyzed to track patterns and relationships
   - No way to "delete" your transaction history

### How Cypher Solves These Problems

**1. Stealth Address Technology**
- Each transaction uses a cryptographically generated one-time address
- Your main wallet address is never exposed on the blockchain
- Transactions cannot be traced back to your main wallet
- Cash-level privacy: recipients can see their transactions, but outsiders cannot link them together

**2. Username-Based System**
- Use a username like *@yourname* instead of long addresses
- Easy to remember and share
- Works just like an email or social media handle
- Real-time validation to ensure username availability

**3. Private Transaction Flow**
- Send crypto to usernames without knowing the recipient's address
- System automatically generates stealth addresses
- Recipients can see incoming transactions without revealing identity
- Transactions cannot be tracked by third parties

### What People Can Use It For

**Business & Commerce**
- Accept payments without exposing your wallet address
- Protect your business financial information
- Receive payments with an easy-to-remember username

**Personal Finance**
- Send money to friends/family privately
- Protect your financial privacy from blockchain analysis
- Avoid transaction pattern tracking

**Content Creators & Freelancers**
- Accept payments from followers without exposing addresses
- Easy-to-share username for social profiles
- Privacy for income and transactions

**Privacy-Conscious Users**
- Untraceable transactions
- Financial privacy on public blockchains
- Full control over your transaction data

### How It Makes Existing Tasks Easier/Safer

**Easier:**
- ✅ Share username *@yourname* instead of long addresses
- ✅ Real-time username validation
- ✅ Simple send/receive interface
- ✅ Automatic stealth address generation
- ✅ Transaction history with privacy indicators

**Safer:**
- ✅ Main wallet address never exposed
- ✅ Each transaction uses a unique stealth address
- ✅ Non-custodial (you control your keys)
- ✅ No transaction linking or tracking
- ✅ Cash-level privacy on public blockchain

**Built on Base L2:**
- Lower transaction fees
- Faster confirmations
- Ethereum security with L2 efficiency

Cypher enables everyday crypto use with the same privacy as cash, while maintaining the transparency and security of blockchain technology.

**Challenges we ran into**

## Challenges I Ran Into

### 1. **Stealth Address Generation and Key Management**

**The Problem:**
Generating stealth addresses that are cryptographically secure and ensuring proper key derivation for each transaction.

**The Challenge:**
- Generating unique ephemeral keys for each transaction
- Computing shared secrets using ECDH (Elliptic Curve Diffie-Hellman)
- Ensuring the recipient can derive the same stealth address using their viewing key
- Managing viewing keys and spending keys securely

**The Solution:**
- Implemented proper ECDH key exchange using secp256k1 curve
- Generated ephemeral key pairs for each transaction
- Used keccak256 hash of shared secret to derive stealth address
- Stored viewing keys securely in encrypted localStorage

---

### 2. **Stealth Address Announcement and Discovery**

**The Problem:**
Recipients need to discover their stealth addresses from on-chain announcements without exposing their main wallet address.

**The Challenge:**
- Scanning blockchain events to find announcements for user's stealth addresses
- Matching ephemeral public keys with user's viewing key to compute stealth addresses
- Handling multiple stealth addresses per user
- Efficiently scanning large block ranges

**The Solution:**
- Implemented event scanning from Blockscout API
- Computed all possible stealth addresses from viewing key and ephemeral public keys
- Used announcement contract events to link transactions to stealth addresses
- Added caching mechanism to avoid redundant blockchain queries

---

### 3. **Balance Aggregation Across Stealth Addresses**

**The Problem:**
Users receive funds at different stealth addresses, but need to see a unified balance across all their stealth addresses.

**The Challenge:**
- Discovering all stealth addresses associated with a viewing key
- Fetching balances from multiple addresses efficiently
- Aggregating balances from main wallet and all stealth addresses
- Handling cases where stealth addresses haven't been used yet

**The Solution:**
- Scanned announcement events to discover all stealth addresses
- Implemented parallel balance fetching for main address and stealth addresses
- Aggregated balances using BigInt for precision
- Cached discovered stealth addresses to reduce redundant scans

---

### 4. **Transaction Type Detection (SEND vs RECEIVE)**

**The Problem:**
Determining whether a transaction is a SEND or RECEIVE when scanning stealth address announcements.

**The Challenge:**
- Announcement events don't explicitly indicate transaction direction
- Need to compare sender address with user's address
- Handling cases where sender information might be missing
- Differentiating between stealth address transactions and regular transactions

**The Solution:**
- Used Blockscout API to get transaction sender (`tx.from.hash`)
- Compared sender address with user's main wallet address
- For RECEIVE: sender is different from user
- For SEND: sender matches user's address
- Added fallback logic for missing sender information

---

### 5. **Username to Stealth Address Resolution**

**The Problem:**
When sending to a username, need to retrieve the recipient's viewing key from registry contract to generate their stealth address.

**The Challenge:**
- Querying registry contract for viewing key by username
- Handling cases where username doesn't exist
- Generating stealth address from viewing key before sending
- Ensuring the generated stealth address is unique for each transaction

**The Solution:**
- Implemented registry contract interaction to fetch viewing keys
- Generated stealth address on-the-fly using recipient's viewing key
- Used ephemeral key generation to ensure uniqueness
- Added error handling for invalid usernames or missing viewing keys

---

### 6. **Stealth Address Privacy Preservation**

**The Problem:**
Ensuring that stealth addresses cannot be linked back to the main wallet address or to each other.

**The Challenge:**
- Each stealth address must appear independent on-chain
- No direct connection between stealth addresses and main address
- Ephemeral keys must be truly random and unique
- Viewing keys must not reveal spending keys

**The Solution:**
- Used cryptographically secure random number generation for ephemeral keys
- Implemented proper key separation (viewing keys vs spending keys)
- Ensured each transaction uses a unique ephemeral key
- No on-chain link between stealth addresses and main wallet

---

### Key Takeaways

1. Stealth address generation requires proper cryptographic implementation of ECDH
2. Key management is critical - viewing keys and spending keys must be stored securely
3. Discovery mechanism must efficiently scan and match announcements to user's stealth addresses
4. Balance aggregation requires careful handling of multiple addresses
5. Privacy depends on proper key generation and no on-chain linking
6. Transaction direction detection requires comparing addresses from multiple data sources

**The problem it solves**

## 1️⃣ The Problem It Solves

### Indonesia's Donation Crisis

Donation and crowdfunding in Indonesia face critical trust issues that prevent people from giving:

**🔴 Lack of Transparency**
Traditional donation platforms operate as "black boxes" - donors send money but have no visibility into where funds actually go. There's no way to verify if 100% of donations reach recipients.

**🔴 Rampant Fraud**
Fake campaigns and imposters regularly exploit disasters and health emergencies. Scammers create lookalike campaigns claiming to help victims, stealing from both donors and real beneficiaries.

**🔴 No Accountability**
Intermediary organizations are difficult to audit. By the time misuse is discovered, funds have already disappeared through multiple opaque handoffs.

**🔴 Poor Coordination**
Donors can't see real-time totals or coordinate effectively. Multiple campaigns for the same cause fragment support, while some campaigns are over-funded and others get nothing.

**🔴 High Platform Fees**
Traditional platforms take 5-10% in fees, reducing the impact of every donation.

### How DeRelief Solves This

**DeRelief** is a fully transparent crowdfunding platform built on Base blockchain using IDRX stablecoin:

- **💎 100% Onchain Transparency** - Every single transaction is permanently recorded on the blockchain. Anyone can verify fund flows using BaseScan.

- **🔗 Direct Transfers** - Donations go directly from donor wallet to verified campaign recipients. No middlemen, no hidden transfers.

- **📊 Real-time Progress** - Live tracking of campaign progress. See exactly how much has been raised and from how many donors in real-time.

- **💰 Minimal Fees** - Base L2 offers near-zero transaction costs (~$0.001), meaning 99.9%+ of donations reach the cause.

- **🇮🇩 IDRX Integration** - Using the Indonesian Rupiah stablecoin makes crypto donations familiar and accessible to local users.

### Real Impact

DeRelief brings the power of blockchain to social good:
- First-time crypto users get a meaningful first transaction (donating to real causes)
- Disaster response becomes faster with immediate, transparent fund collection
- Trust returns to the donation ecosystem through cryptographic proof

> *"Every donation onchain, every aid transparent."*

**Challenges we ran into**

## 2️⃣ Challenges I Ran Into

> **Context:** DeRelief was built using AI-assisted development ("vibe coding") - I directed AI to build while learning Web3 concepts along the way. This approach came with its own unique challenges.

### Challenge 1: Navigating the Web3 Maze from Absolute Zero

**Problem:** I started this project with zero Web3 experience. My biggest hurdle wasn't just technical; it was the ambiguity of the ecosystem. I was deeply confused by terms like **"Mini App"**—initially not knowing if I was building a mobile app, a frame, or a standalone site. Furthermore, as a solo builder, I didn't have months to master **Solidity** syntax from scratch. The barrier to entry felt massive for someone who just wanted to build a transparent donation tool.

**How I Overcame It:**
- **AI-Led Architecture:** Instead of spending weeks on Solidity syntax, I focused on being the **"Architect."** I directed AI to build the smart contract logic based on my functional requirements, while I focused on verifying the logic and the flow of funds.
- **Concept Translation:** I used AI as a "Concept Translator" to help me understand how a standard web application transforms into an ecosystem-ready app on Base.
- **AI-Assisted Integration:** I directed the AI to help bridge the complex Web3 pieces—integrating OnchainKit, wagmi, and viem—allowing me to build a professional-grade interface without getting bogged down in boilerplate middleware code.
- **Learning by Verifying:** I verified every AI-generated function by testing on Base Sepolia and checking transactions on BaseScan, ensuring the code behaved exactly as intended even without being a Solidity expert.

**Outcome:** I successfully built and deployed a functional onchain crowdfunding platform on Base Mainnet, moving from absolute confusion to a live product in record time.

### Challenge 2: The "100x" Decimal Mystery (IDRX Error)

**Problem:** During initial testing, I encountered a significant 100x discrepancy in fund reporting. Specifically, a donation of 1,000 IDRX was being recorded and displayed as 100,000 in the total progress. This math error made the crowdfunding data look inflated and inaccurate, which directly undermined the project's goal of absolute transparency. 

**The Discovery:** This was my introduction to how decimals work in smart contracts. Most tokens use 18 decimals, but **IDRX uses only 2 decimals**. The AI-generated code was fetching the raw value from the blockchain (where 1,000 IDRX is stored as `100,000` base units) but forgot to divide it by 10^2 for the display. 

**How I Overcame It:**
- **Discrepancy Investigation:** I spotted a 100x math error during evaluation—1,000 IDRX was being reported as 100,000. I immediately investigated the discrepancy by challenging the default 18-decimal assumptions in the code.
- **Directing the Correction:** Once I identified the decimal mismatch, I directed the AI to implement specific scaling logic using `parseUnits(amount, 2)` and custom division-by-100 formatting tailored for the IDRX token.
- **Validation through Vibe Coding:** This experience taught me that effective AI collaboration requires the human to act as a rigorous QA lead, spotting logical inconsistencies that "default" AI assumptions might overlook.

**Outcome:** I fixed the display bug and gained a deep understanding of how to bridge "Contract Units" with "Human Units"—a crucial skill for any Web3 developer.

### Challenge 3: Farcaster Mini-App Integration (Midpoint Blocker)

**Problem:** Understanding the transition from a standalone web app on Base to a fully integrated Farcaster Mini-App. I am currently navigating the ambiguity of the technical requirements—specifically the `farcaster.json` manifest and SDK hooks—and debating whether full deployment to the Farcaster ecosystem is a prerequisite for the current Base tracks.

**How I Overcame It:**
- *[Ongoing]*

**Outcome:**
- *In Progress for Final Submission.*

DeRelief transforms isolated individual donations into **coordinated social action**. This solves the "lack of social context" in traditional blockchain transactions, making giving a collaborative, purposeful movement.

**The problem it solves**

## The Problem It Solves

Traditional prenuptial agreements are expensive ($500–$5,000), slow (6–24 months through legal processes), and inaccessible to most couples. They are also vulnerable to asset concealment, document forgery, and lack of automatic enforcement when agreements are breached.

### How SmartVow Solves It

- Affordable Protection — Create legally-binding digital prenuptial agreements for approximately $5 on Base L2, without lawyers.
- Automated Enforcement — Assets are locked in an on-chain Escrow Vault and automatically redistributed when a verified breach occurs (e.g., infidelity, domestic violence, financial misconduct).
- Transparent Asset Registry — All assets (property, vehicles, investments) are registered as NFTs with clear Personal or Joint ownership, preventing concealment or manipulation.
- AI-Powered Mediation — Gemini AI helps draft fair clauses and acts as a neutral mediator for breach verification.
- Immutable Marriage Records — Vows are minted as soulbound-style NFTs, creating permanent, tamper-proof on-chain certificates.

### Who Benefits

- Engaged couples
- Married partners seeking asset transparency
- Domestic abuse survivors needing automatic financial protection
- Anyone who wants enforceable agreements without expensive legal processes

### Result

Legal protection that is up to 100x cheaper, executes in minutes instead of months, and is transparent, tamper-proof, and automatically enforceable.

**Challenges we ran into**

## Challenges I Ran Into

### 1. Human Language to Smart Contract Logic  
Converting subjective promises like *“I promise to be faithful”* into executable smart contract logic was challenging.  
**Solution:** I used **Gemini AI** with structured JSON output to translate natural language into precise contract parameters such as condition types, penalty percentages, and escrow amounts that the SmartVow contract can execute.

### 2. Syncing On-Chain and Off-Chain Data  
Keeping `localStorage`, blockchain state, and the UI in sync across multiple views (Dashboard, Vault, History) initially caused data inconsistencies.  
**Solution:** I made the blockchain the **single source of truth**. All balances and asset data are now fetched directly from smart contracts using functions like `getVaultBalances()` and `getAllVisibleAssets()`.

### 3. Partner Asset Visibility  
Implementing **“Harta Bersama” (Joint Property)**, where both partners can view shared assets, required custom contract logic.  
**Solution:** I built a `getAllVisibleAssets()` function in the `AssetNFT` contract that returns both individually owned assets and joint assets shared with the partner.

### 4. Escrow Flow Complexity  
Designing the **Personal Vault → Shared Vault → Escrow** flow with proper locking mechanisms was technically complex.  
**Solution:** Partner A locks the escrow during vow creation via `createVowAndLockEscrow()`, while Partner B only needs to pay gas to sign and activate the agreement using `signAndActivateOnly()`.

### 5. Gas Fee Accessibility  
High transaction fees could limit adoption.  
**Solution:** I deployed the system on **Base Sepolia L2**, reducing costs significantly. Minting NFTs and creating agreements now costs approximately **0.002 ETH (~$5)**, compared to **$500+** for traditional legal processes.

### 6. UX vs Technical Complexity  
Marriage is deeply emotional, while blockchain systems can feel cold and impersonal.  
**Solution:** I balanced technical complexity with thoughtful UX design, including a premium interface, AI-generated asset visuals, and features like the **Marriage Certificate NFT**, making the digital experience feel meaningful and respectful.

**Base Track**

## SmartVow is Built Natively for the Base Track

### 1. Native Base L2 Deployment  
All smart contracts (**SmartVow**, **AssetNFT**, **MarriageCertificateNFT**) are deployed on **Base Sepolia**.  
We leverage Base’s low gas fees to make on-chain prenuptial agreements economically viable — minting costs around **0.002 ETH (~$5)** compared to **$500+** for traditional legal services.

### 2. Solving Real UX Challenges  
SmartVow directly addresses the **“Poor Onboarding”** and **“Limited Accessibility”** challenges highlighted in the Base Track:

- **Complex legal processes** → simplified through AI-powered clause generation  
- **Intimidating blockchain UX** → replaced with a premium, intuitive interface that feels familiar to non-crypto users  
- **Expensive legal protection** → made accessible to retail users at minimal cost  

### 3. Real-World Utility for Indonesian Users  
Rather than focusing on speculative DeFi, SmartVow brings **Digital Vital Records** to Base:  
prenuptial agreements, asset registries, and marriage certificates.  
This demonstrates Base as infrastructure for **everyday legal and personal security**, not just financial speculation.

### 4. On-Chain Identity & Immutability  

- **Marriage certificates** minted as soulbound-style NFTs on Base  
- **Asset ownership** (*Harta Pribadi / Harta Bersama*) permanently recorded on-chain  
- **Escrow Vault** with automatic redistribution — trustless execution without intermediaries  

### 5. Mass Adoption Ready  
Built with **OnchainKit principles**: fast transactions, minimal fees, and a user-friendly experience.  
SmartVow positions Base as a **“Layer of Trust”** for modern Indonesian society beyond DeFi.

**IDRX Integration Ready** — The architecture supports stablecoin integration for the Shared Vault, enabling real **Rupiah-denominated asset protection** for Indonesian couples.

![Solidity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Solidity-333333?style=flat-square) ![OpenZeppelin](https://img.shields.io/badge/OpenZeppelin-333333?style=flat-square) ![MetaMask](https://img.shields.io/badge/MetaMask-333333?style=flat-square) ![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Remix (IDE)](https://img.shields.io/badge/Remix%20(IDE)-333333?style=flat-square) ![OnchainKit](https://img.shields.io/badge/OnchainKit-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

PixelWar bridges the gap between Web2 speed and Web3 security, solving the conflict between user experience and trust.



What it enables:

•Wagering: Players enjoy smooth, real-time gameplay off-chain, eliminating the lag and gas costs usually found in fully on-chain games. 

•Trustless Security: Instead of depositing funds to a centralized server, wagers are locked in a smart contract escrow. This ensures funds are safe and cannot be tampered with by the developers.


•Instant Settlement: Winners receive their payout automatically via smart contract immediately after the match, removing the need for manual withdrawals or trust in the platform.

In short: It allows players to compete in fast, high-quality games while keeping their money safe and decentralized on the Base blockchain.

**Challenges we ran into**

Building a game on a fully immutable Smart Contract forced us to rethink how our app handles blockchain’s strict rule without touching the contract itself.

1. Surviving Smart Contract Reverts

During testing, failed payout transactions used to crash our Node.js server, disconnecting all players.
Solution: Wrapped all blockchain writes in try–catch. Now, errors are logged and the game state resets safely no crashes, no chaos.

2. Deployment Sync Nightmares

Rolling out our Next.js app on cloud caused “Failed to find Server Action” errors when clients hit mismatched builds.
Solution: Enforced atomic builds and strict frontend-backend version locks using pnpm. Deployment became seamless.

3. Making Hard Contracts Play Nice

Blockchain is rigid: win or lose. Real-time gameplay is messy players disconnect, wallets lag, transactions fail.
Solution: Built a verification layer on the server. Only clean, verified game states trigger on-chain payouts, saving gas and ensuring fairness.

**Base Track**

Base provides the ideal foundation for this hybrid model because: 

1. Low-cost
transactions (~$0.01) enable frictionless staking and instant payouts 

2. OnchainKit & Smart Wallet for one-click onboarding, even for non-crypto native users 

3. Consumer-first & mobile-ready ecosystem, aligned with the Base Mini-App vision With Base, PixelWar becomes a prime example of a fast, intuitive, and scalable consumer-grade onchain application.

correctly between the front-end and the back-end without any errors.

looks premium, the subscription system runs smoothly, and all technical parts are perfectly
connected.

**The problem it solves**

## 🛡️ Arisan Aman: Decentralizing Trust in Social Savings

In Indonesia, **Arisan** is a cultural cornerstone of social saving, yet it remains tethered to manual, high-risk processes. **Arisan Aman** moves this tradition onto **Base**, replacing "social promises" with immutable smart contracts.

### 🚀 How Arisan Aman Makes Life Easier & Safer

#### 1. 🛑 Elimination of "Runaway" Risk

* **The Problem:** In traditional Arisan, a member or organizer (*penyelenggara*) can disappear with the pot, leaving others with no recourse.
* **The Solution:** All funds are locked in non-custodial smart contracts on **Base**. The system—not a person—governs the distribution, ensuring the winner receives their payout automatically and transparently.

#### 2. ⚡ Frictionless Automated Collections

* **The Problem:** Chasing 30 different people for manual transfers via WhatsApp is a nightmare for organizers.
* **The Solution:** Integrated with **IDRX**, our platform allows for automated, one-click contributions. No more "reminding" members or verifying manual bank screenshots; the blockchain acts as the ultimate source of truth.

#### 3. 📈 Verifiable Onchain Reputation

* **The Problem:** Good Arisan participants get no "credit" for years of perfect payments.
* **The Solution:** Our **Reputation Registry** tracks payment history. Every successful cycle builds a user’s onchain creditworthiness, potentially unlocking future DeFi opportunities or higher-tier Arisan circles.

#### 4. 🔍 Radical Transparency

* **The Problem:** Members often doubt if the "random draw" for the winner was actually fair or if there are hidden fees.
* **The Solution:** Every transaction, participant, and winner-selection is visible on the **Base Explorer**. You don't have to "trust" the organizer; you just have to verify the code.

#### 5. 🌏 Borderless Social Finance

* **The Problem:** You are usually limited to your physical neighborhood or office.
* **The Solution:** By using **Base**, Arisan Aman allows trusted communities—scattered across Indonesia or the globe—to save together. Whether you are in Jakarta or Jayapura, if you have a wallet and IDRX, you are in.

---

### 🛠️ Key Technical Advantages

* **🔵 Base L2:** High-speed transactions with fees so low they don't eat into the savings pot.
* **🇮🇩 IDRX Integration:** Participants save in a currency they understand (Rupiah-pegged), removing crypto volatility.
* **🏗️ Factory Architecture:** Anyone can deploy a secure, custom Arisan group for their community in seconds.

**Challenges we ran into**

## 🚧 Challenges We Ran Into

Building a social-financial hybrid onchain presented unique hurdles, particularly in balancing traditional Indonesian customs with blockchain logic.

### 1. ⚖️ The "Late Payment" Paradox

* **The Hurdle:** In traditional Arisan, people are occasionally late due to real-life issues. However, smart contracts are rigid. We struggled with how to handle late contributions without breaking the "Pot" for the winner.
* **The Fix:** We implemented a **Grace Period** logic in our smart contracts linked to the **Reputation Registry**. If a user pays within the grace period, the cycle continues, but their onchain reputation score takes a minor hit, mimicking the social accountability of a real-life circle.

### 2. 🧩 Gas Fee Optimization for Micro-Transactions

* **The Hurdle:** Since Arisan often involves small, frequent contributions, even low gas fees can add up over a 12-month cycle.
* **The Fix:** By deploying on **Base**, we leveraged its ultra-low fee structure. We further optimized the **Arisan Factory** to minimize state changes, ensuring that joining a group or claiming a payout costs only a few cents, making it viable for retail users.

### 3. 🏦 Integrating IDRX with Smart Contract Logic

* **The Hurdle:** Ensuring seamless interaction between the **IDRX token** and our custom logic for distribution required precise decimal handling to ensure no "dust" was left in the contract after a winner claimed the pot.
* **The Fix:** We conducted extensive testing on **Base Sepolia** using a Mock IDRX token, refining our math logic to ensure 100% of the collected pool is distributed accurately to the winner every single cycle.

---

## 💡 How Arisan Aman Makes Life Easier & Safer

### 1. 🤖 Automated Collection & Distribution

* **Before:** Manual collection, chasing late payments via chat, and risky physical cash handling.
* **With Arisan Aman:** Instant distribution on payout day via smart contracts. No physical meetings required.
* **Example:** An office arisan with 30 members saves roughly **2 hours per month** per person in coordination and collection time.

### 2. 🌍 Flexible Participation

* **Before:** Geographic constraints; you had to be physically present at meetings or live in the same neighborhood.
* **With Arisan Aman:** Join from anywhere in Indonesia. Participate in multiple circles (family, office, hobbyists) simultaneously with adjustable contribution levels.
* **Example:** A Jakarta-based worker can participate in their hometown arisan in Sumatra and a hobbyist arisan globally at the same time.

### 3. 📅 Intelligent Scheduling & Logic

* **Before:** Manual calendars, forgotten dates, and awkward "Who's next?" disputes.
* **With Arisan Aman:** Smart scheduling based on group preferences. The contract transparently dictates the order, and onchain events trigger notifications.
* **Example:** The system ensures a transparent, tamper-proof payout order that everyone can verify before the first payment is even made.

### 4. 📒 Permanent Digital Record Keeping

* **Before:** Handwritten notebooks, lost records, and disputes over who has paid what.
* **With Arisan Aman:** A permanent digital ledger on **Base**. Instant payment history and immutable proof of participation.
* **Example:** A small business owner can use their perfect Arisan Aman payment history as an informal "Onchain CV" to prove financial discipline.

### 5. 🔗 Seamless Currency Integration

* **Before:** Constant switching between cash, bank transfers, and e-wallets, leading to reconciliation headaches.
* **With Arisan Aman:** Direct utility through **IDRX**. Contributions stay in a stable, Rupiah-pegged format, ensuring the value of the "Pot" is exactly what members expect.
* **Example:** Funds are settled instantly onchain; winners receive their IDRX payout at the exact moment the cycle closes.

**Base Track**

Arisan Aman is designed to solve the deep-rooted "Lack of Social Coordination" and "Poor Onboarding" challenges outlined in the Base Track mission. By migrating the traditional Indonesian arisan—a system inherently built on social trust—to the Base L2 network, we replace manual, fragmented coordination with transparent, smart-contract-governed logic. Our application utilizes Base’s high-speed and low-cost infrastructure to ensure that monthly contributions and distributions are accessible to everyday users, effectively turning a complex social ritual into a streamlined onchain process.

We directly address the "Limited Accessibility for Retail Users" by integrating IDRX, ensuring that participants interact with a familiar, stable currency pegged to the Indonesian Rupiah. This integration lowers the psychological and technical barriers to entry, allowing users to experience the benefits of DeFi without the volatility typically associated with crypto. By leveraging the IDRX Mock Token and Debt NFT system on Base Sepolia, we provide a tangible bridge between traditional financial habits and the future of digital assets, making Web3 utility immediate and understandable.

The technical architecture of Arisan Aman prioritizes a "Plug-and-Play UX" through the use of an Arisan Factory and Reputation Registry. This allows any group—from office colleagues to local hobbyists—to deploy their own secure savings circle with a few clicks. By moving the "trust" component from a fallible human organizer to a transparent, immutable ledger on Base, we eliminate the risks of absconding funds and "Trust & Safety Issues" that have plagued traditional groups for generations, fulfilling the track's goal of elevating the onchain user experience.

Finally, Arisan Aman is a "real, functional product" that drives significant "Ecosystem Impact" by onboarding non-technical retail users to Base. Our solution does not just ideate; it provides a working MVP with a permanent digital audit trail and automated distribution. By gamifying savings and building a verifiable onchain reputation through our registry, we are not just building a tool, but a foundational layer for social finance in Indonesia, perfectly aligned with Base’s mission to bring the next million users onchain.
