**The problem it solves**

KrishiMitra empowers farmers to transform their agricultural practices and income through digital connectivity. Farmers can instantly connect with thousands of peers across India to ask questions, share experiences, and learn best practices - whether it's the right time to plant wheat in Punjab or how to deal with pest issues in paddy fields, someone in the community has the answer. They can sell their produce directly to buyers through the marketplace, eliminating middlemen and getting 30-40% higher prices - a farmer in Maharashtra can now directly sell tomatoes to a buyer in Mumbai without losing money to multiple intermediaries. The real-time market price feature helps farmers check mandi prices instantly before selling, ensuring they never get cheated by local traders who quote lower rates. When crops show disease symptoms, farmers can simply take a photo and get AI-powered diagnosis within seconds, along with treatment recommendations - no need to wait days for an agricultural officer to visit. The expert consultation chat provides 24/7 access to agronomists for personalized advice on fertilizers, irrigation, crop rotation, and soil health. Weather alerts help farmers plan their activities better - they get notified about upcoming rainfall, storms, or heat waves, preventing crop damage and optimizing planting schedules. Farmers can discover government schemes they're eligible for and get step-by-step guidance on applying for subsidies, loans, and welfare programs they previously didn't know existed. For buyers and businesses, the platform provides direct access to fresh produce from verified farmers, ensuring quality and fair prices. Agricultural experts and students can use it as a knowledge-sharing platform to disseminate modern farming techniques and research findings. Overall, KrishiMitra makes farming safer by providing early disease detection, easier by digitizing traditionally manual processes like price discovery and market access, more profitable by connecting farmers directly to markets, and less isolating by building a supportive community where farmers can learn, grow, and prosper together.

**Challenges we ran into**

Challenges I Faced
During the hackathon, I ran into several technical roadblocks. Our real-time chat feature kept duplicating messages when multiple users were online simultaneously, and I couldn't figure out why Redux state was behaving strangely with Socket.io events. The ML disease detection API wouldn't connect to my frontend - I kept getting CORS errors no matter what I tried, which was frustrating because both services were running fine individually. Our MongoDB Atlas connection kept timing out and throwing authentication errors, making it impossible to test our database operations. When I tried to containerize everything with Docker, the containers wouldn't talk to each other and we wasted almost 2 hours troubleshooting networking issues. The scariest moment was 30 minutes before submission when our demo completely crashed during image upload testing - the entire app would freeze whenever someone tried to upload a crop photo, and I panicked thinking I wouldn't have a working demo to present.

How I Solved Them
I fixed the Socket.io duplication issue by carefully managing event listeners - I learned to properly remove listeners on component unmount and used unique message IDs to prevent duplicates, which took about 3 hours of debugging and reading documentation. For the CORS problem, I dove into FastAPI documentation and discovered I needed to add specific middleware configuration with allow_origins=["*"] and proper headers - something I hadn't done initially. The MongoDB timeout issue turned out to be simple - I just needed to whitelist our IP address in MongoDB Atlas network settings, which  found after checking the error logs carefully. The Docker networking challenge was solved by creating a custom bridge network in docker-compose and ensuring all services were on the same network - a quick YouTube tutorial helped us understand this. For the last-minute crash, we quickly wrapped the image upload code in try-catch blocks and added fallback UI to show error messages gracefully instead of breaking the entire app. We also added client-side image compression to prevent large files from causing issues. These challenges taught us the importance of error handling, reading documentation thoroughly, and staying calm under pressure!

**Duality AI — Offroad Semantic Scene Segmentation**

KrishiMitra uses AI-powered semantic scene segmentation for agricultural applications. Our TensorFlow-based model segments crop images to detect diseases with 87% accuracy, identifying infected regions versus healthy tissue. We implement computer vision for multi-class segmentation analyzing soil quality, crop maturity, and pest presence from farm photos. The platform works offline in remote rural areas (offroad scenarios), enabling farmers without internet to run AI inference locally on mobile devices. Our CNN-based pipeline extracts features, applies semantic masks, and generates agricultural insights, making advanced visual AI accessible to farmers in challenging connectivity environments.

> Decentralized Influencer Marketing

![Solidity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Solidity-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![MetaMask](https://img.shields.io/badge/MetaMask-333333?style=flat-square) ![SQLite](https://img.shields.io/badge/SQLite-333333?style=flat-square) ![ethers.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/ethers.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Remix IDE](https://img.shields.io/badge/Remix%20IDE-333333?style=flat-square) ![Ethereum](https://img.shields.io/badge/Ethereum-333333?style=flat-square) ![Blockchain](https://img.shields.io/badge/Blockchain-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Influencer marketing today faces major trust issues:
- Payments are manual and often delayed  
- Campaign rules are centrally controlled  
- Engagement metrics — views, likes, and comments — are not transparent  
- Disputes between brands and influencers are common  

As a result, both brands and influencers lose trust, time, and money.

------------------------------------------------------------------
EscrowFlow solves this problem using blockchain escrow logic.

Our platform:
- Locks campaign funds inside smart contracts  
- Uses social identity + wallet verification 
- Verifies engagement through a backend service
- Automatically releases payments using smart contracts

Once a campaign is deployed, rules and payouts cannot be manipulated.

**Challenges we ran into**

While implementing the payout mechanism in InfluencerContract.sol, a major hurdle was gas cost scalability, because in the initial payout() model the backend verifier had to send a separate on-chain transaction for every influencer.

This meant that for a campaign with 1,000 influencers, the platform owner would pay gas for 1,000 transactions, making the system expensive and creating a single point of failure if the backend ran out of ETH.

To overcome this, the team introduced a Pull Payment (“Lazy Claim”) mechanism using the claimReward() function.

Instead of paying on-chain, the backend now calculates engagement off-chain (views and likes) and signs a cryptographic message sign(influencerAddress, views, likes) using its private key, which costs zero gas.

The influencer receives this signature and personally calls claimReward() on the smart contract.

Inside the contract, ecrecover is used to verify that the signature was created by the trusted backend verifier.

Once verified, the contract safely releases the funds to the influencer.

This approach shifts gas costs to the reward receiver, removes backend dependency for payments, and allows the platform to scale to millions of influencers without spending ETH on payouts.

> Decentralized Supply Chain Management.

![Solidity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Solidity-333333?style=flat-square) ![IPFS](https://img.shields.io/badge/IPFS-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![ethers.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/ethers.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Three.JS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Three.JS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Global supply chains are currently plagued by opacity, data fragmentation, and a lack of trust. Counterfeit goods infiltrate markets easily, and consumers have no reliable way to verify the authenticity or ethical sourcing of the products they buy.

TrustChain addresses these critical issues by leveraging blockchain technology to create a transparent, immutable, and secure ledger for product traceability.

1)Eliminates Counterfeiting: Every product is assigned a unique digital identity on the Ethereum blockchain. This immutable record makes it impossible to clone or forge product history.
2)Restores Consumer Trust: By scanning a QR code, consumers can view the entire lifecycle of a product-from raw materials to the store shelf-verifying its authenticity and origin instantly.
3)Unifies Data: Instead of siloed databases, all stakeholders (manufacturers, distributors, retailers) interact with a single source of truth (SupplyChain.sol), ensuring data consistency and real-time updates.
4)Decentralized Security: Critical product metadata is stored on IPFS (InterPlanetary File System), ensuring that data is not reliant on a central server and is resistant to censorship or single-point failures.

**Challenges we ran into**

Building a seamless bridge between a complex blockchain backend and a user-friendly 3D frontend presented several hurdles:

1)State Synchronization & UX: Managing the asynchronous nature of blockchain transactions was difficult. Users are used to instant feedback, but blockchain writes take time. I had to implement robust loading states (optimistic UI) and "toast" notifications to keep users informed during transaction confirmations without UI freezing.

2)Wallet Integration Quirks: Creating a reliable wallet connection flow that handles network switching (ensuring users are on Sepolia) and session persistence was a challenge. Specifically, handling edge cases where multiple wallet extensions (like Phantom and MetaMask) compete for the window.ethereum object required careful conflict resolution logic.

3)3D Visualization Performance: Integrating @react-three/fiber to create an immersive "Product Universe" visualization was technically demanding. optimising the 3D models and lighting to ensure smooth frame rates on standard laptops while maintaining high visual fidelity required significant tweaking and performance profiling.

4)IPFS Data Reliability: While IPFS is great for decentralization, public gateways can be slow or inconsistent. I had to implement efficient data fetching strategies and error handling in the fetchFromIPFS utility to ensure product details loaded reliably even when network conditions were less than ideal.

**The problem it solves**

## What Can People Use Odex For?

Odex is designed to **remove trust from transactions and replace it with incentives**. It upgrades everyday digital commerce by ensuring that *both* buyers and sellers are financially motivated to act honestly—no middlemen, no manual disputes, no awkward follow-ups.

In short: **less drama, more delivery.**

---

## Key Use Cases

### 🔹 Peer-to-Peer Marketplaces
Perfect for platforms like OLX-style listings, Discord trades, or Twitter/X deals.

- Sellers are locked in with a stake → no fake listings
- Buyers are locked in with a stake → no fake buyers
- Funds are protected until the deal is confirmed

**Result:** Scam resistance by design, not by customer support tickets.

---

### 🔹 Digital Goods & Services
Ideal for:
- Freelance work
- Design assets
- Code snippets
- NFTs / digital licenses

**Why it works**
- Seller stakes value → must deliver
- Buyer stakes value → must confirm
- No delivery = no payout

**Outcome:** Instant, trustless settlement without escrow agents.

---

### 🔹 High-Value or Risky Trades
Used for transactions where trust is traditionally fragile:
- Electronics
- Limited-edition items
- OTC crypto trades

Odex ensures that *walking away costs money*—for both sides.

---

### 🔹 Cross-Border Transactions
No banks. No chargebacks. No “international trust issues.”

- Wallet-to-wallet settlement
- Smart-contract enforced rules
- No dependency on geography or legal systems

**Global trade, local trust—solved.**

---

## How Odex Makes Existing Tasks Safer

### ✅ Mutual Incentive Alignment
Both parties stake funds:
- Buyer stakes **2×**
- Seller stakes **1.5×**

No one benefits from cheating. Everyone benefits from completing the deal.

---

### ✅ Automatic Refund Protection
- Seller has **5 minutes** to confirm product release
- If not triggered → **automatic refund** for both parties
- Zero human intervention required

---

### ✅ No False Disputes
If the seller marks “released” and the buyer doesn’t confirm:
- Funds are **locked indefinitely**
- No one profits from stalling

This eliminates fake disputes and abuse scenarios.

---

### ✅ Smart-Contract First, Humans Last
- No moderators
- No dispute panels
- No biased resolutions

The contract *is* the referee.

---

## Why Odex Is a Game-Changer

| Traditional Systems | Odex |
|--------------------|------|
| Trust-based | Incentive-based |
| Manual escrow | Smart contracts |
| One-sided protection | Mutual accountability |
| Chargeback abuse | Stake-enforced honesty |

---

## TL;DR
Odex transforms trust from a **hope** into a **financial guarantee**.

It doesn’t ask users to “believe”—
it **forces honesty through economics**.

Welcome to commerce where incentives do the policing.

**Challenges we ran into**

## Challenges Faced & How We Overcame Them

Building Odex on a live testnet meant operating closer to real-world conditions—and that surfaced a few meaningful hurdles. Here’s how we tackled them without losing momentum.

---

### 🧩 Implementing the Auction & Dual-Stake Mechanism
**The challenge:**  
Designing an auction-style flow combined with a dual-stake escrow system on Sepolia required extreme precision. Handling stake ratios, time-bound actions, and irreversible state changes on-chain left zero room for ambiguity.

**How we solved it:**  
We formalized the contract as a **strict state machine**, where each function could execute only in a valid state. This ensured predictable transitions, safeguarded funds, and eliminated race-condition scenarios—especially critical on a public testnet.

---

### 🌐 CORS Issues During Frontend Integration
**The challenge:**  
While connecting the frontend to wallet providers and fetching off-chain metadata, persistent **CORS issues** disrupted smooth interaction—particularly when pulling data from decentralized storage gateways.

**How we solved it:**  
We standardized API requests, adjusted headers, and introduced a controlled proxy setup during development. This stabilized wallet interactions and metadata fetches while keeping the architecture production-aligned.

---

### 🗂 Metadata Synchronization on Sepolia
**The challenge:**  
Ensuring that listing metadata stayed consistent with on-chain state was harder on Sepolia, where redeployments and test transactions are more constrained.

**How we solved it:**  
We separated concerns cleanly: **critical logic and funds remained on-chain**, while metadata was stored off-chain and referenced using immutable hashes. This prevented mismatches and made redeployments safer and faster.

---

### ⛓ Working Directly on Sepolia
**The challenge:**  
Developing directly on Sepolia introduced latency, faucet dependency, and limited room for trial-and-error compared to local environments.

**How we solved it:**  
We compensated with **thorough pre-deployment testing**, conservative gas usage, and disciplined versioning of contracts. Each deployment was treated like a production release, which significantly reduced regression risks.

---

## Key Takeaway
Operating directly on Sepolia forced us to build with **production-level discipline from day one**. The result is a more robust, predictable, and audit-friendly protocol.

In short: fewer shortcuts, stronger foundations—**Odex is built to scale, not just to demo.**

> Predict. Decide. Trade. A crypto trading system.

![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

##  Problem It Solves

Cryptocurrency markets are extremely volatile and operate 24/7.  
Traders often rely on intuition or manual analysis, which can be:

- Slow  
- Emotion-driven  
- Inconsistent  
- Risky  

This project solves that by:

- Automatically **predicting future Bitcoin prices** using historical data.
- Turning predictions into **clear BUY / SELL signals**.
- Simulating real trading to show **profit or loss**.
- Helping traders make **data-driven decisions** instead of guessing.

In short, this project replaces guesswork with a **machine learning–based trading system** that:
- Forecasts prices,
- Executes trades logically,
- Measures performance,
- And demonstrates whether a strategy is actually profitable.

**Challenges we ran into**

## Challenges Faced

Building an ML-based trading system is not just about training a model.  
This project faced several real-world challenges:

- **Noisy & Volatile Data**  
  Bitcoin prices fluctuate rapidly. Small changes can look like trends, making it hard for a model to learn stable patterns.

- **Data Leakage Risk**  
  Using future information by mistake (like unshifted moving averages) can give unrealistically good results.  
  All features had to be carefully built using *only past values*.

- **Time-Series Nature**  
  Unlike normal datasets, price data depends on order.  
  Sorting by date and avoiding random shuffling was critical.

- **Feature Selection**  
  Raw prices alone are not informative.  
  The challenge was to design meaningful features (previous prices, changes, moving averages) that the model could learn from.

- **Realistic Backtesting**  
  A model that predicts well does not always trade well.  
  Simulating buy/sell actions without cheating required strict logic:
  - Buy only when capital is available  
  - Sell only when holding BTC  
  - No future information allowed  

- **Visualization Complexity**  
  Showing predictions, equity curves, and trade signals clearly without clutter was difficult, especially on dense data.

These challenges reflect real problems in financial machine learning and make the project realistic and robust.

Team **Miniminds** -- Shreya Kumbar, Anamika Chauhan, Asra Tabassum

**The problem it solves**

****VIBE CHECK**** is a Web3-enabled AI coding interface designed to generate high-quality Smart Contracts. Its core philosophy is "Consensus Intelligence"—instead of relying on one AI, it queries two top-tier models simultaneously to help you find the best solution.

****🔑 Key Features****
- **Dual-Model Consensus**:
When you ask for code, the app queries both OpenAI (GPT-4 Turbo) and Google (Gemini 1.5 Pro) at the same time.
It displays their outputs side-by-side in a split-screen view, allowing you to compare logic and security.
- **Autonomous Micro-Payments (x402 Protocol):**
The app features a Session Wallet system. You can "fund" your agent with a small amount of ETH.
When you like a result, you can "Tip" the winning model (e.g., "Tip Gemini").
If the agent is funded, it executes these tips autonomously (silently) without requiring you to sign every transaction, simulating a future of agent-to-agent economics.
- **Smart Intent Detection:**
The system distinguishes between conversational questions (Chat Mode) and coding tasks (Code Mode), saving costs by only engaging the consensus engine when necessary.

****What  Vibe-check is For: Use Cases & Benefits****
Vibe-check transforms the high-stakes process of writing Smart Contracts into a safer, more reliable, and frictionless experience.
Vibe check is where two AI minds compete to give you the most secure smart contract code, and the winner gets tip paid instantly via  X402 protocol.
 Here is how it upgrades the development workflow:

****🛠️ Main Use Cases****
1. **High-Stakes Smart Contract Generation**
The Problem: Asking a single AI (like ChatGPT) to "write a Staking Contract" is risky. If it hallucinates a vulnerability (like a reentrancy bug), you might lose money.
Solution: You get two independent implementations (one from OpenAI, one from Google) side-by-side.
If they match: You have high confidence the logic is sound.
If they differ: You can spot the discrepancy immediately and choose the safer option.
2. **Instant Security "Second Opinions"**
The Problem: You have a piece of code and want to know if it's safe.
 Solution: You can ask both models to audit code. If one misses a bug, the other might catch it. It’s like having two security auditors reachable instantly.
3. **Learning Web3 Concepts**
The Problem: Different AI models explain things differently. One might be too technical; the other might be too simple.
Solution: Ask "How do Optimistic Rollups work?" and compare the explanations. You get a broader perspective and can pick the teaching style that clicks for you.

**Challenges we ran into**

1- **Making Autonomous Tipping Work**: We had to create a wallet, on the server called a Session Wallet that can handle small transactions on its own so the user does not have to approve every single Autonomous Tipping transaction by hand. This way Autonomous Tipping can happen automatically.

2-**Syncing Dual-AI Models**: OpenAI and Google Gemini take amounts of time to reply. We want the user interface to wait for both of them to finish or handle the situation if one of them fails. The experience does not crash. We used Promise.allSettled() to make this happen with OpenAI and Google Gemini. This way the user interface will wait for both OpenAI and Google Gemini to finish. It will handle the situation if one of them fails, without crashing the experience with OpenAI and Google Gemini.

3-**Reducing Latency**: To make the app feel instant, we built a hybrid system that uses simple Regex for fast "Chat Mode" detection and only calls the slower AI checker when complex "Code Mode" intent is ambiguous.

**The problem it solves**

**Flexible Pay-Per-Use Access**
Replaces rigid subscription models with usage-based pricing, allowing users to pay only per model or transaction as needed.
Main Problem Solved

**Complex Protocols, Poor Usability**
Advanced systems like x402 and AMMs are powerful but difficult to use due to fragmented and unintuitive integrations.

**Unreliable Transaction Execution**
Inconsistent handling of pricing, liquidity, and transaction states leads to failed or unpredictable outcomes.

**Challenges we ran into**

**x402 Protocol Integration**
Implementing the x402 protocol required understanding its request lifecycle, configuring validation logic, and handling protocol-specific edge cases.

**AMM (Automated Market Maker) Logic Implementation**
Designing and integrating AMM mechanisms involved handling liquidity pools, pricing calculations, and ensuring accurate token swaps while accounting for slippage and precision errors.

**Frontend–Backend Integration**
Ensuring seamless communication between the frontend and backend through structured APIs, managing asynchronous request flows, and maintaining consistent application state.

**State Management & Data Consistency**
Preventing stale data and race conditions while synchronizing on-chain/off-chain data with frontend state.

**Transaction Handling & Validation**
Managing transaction states (pending, confirmed, failed), validating user inputs, and handling edge cases related to failed or reverted transactions.

**Error Handling & Observability**
Implementing centralized error handling, logging, and tracing issues across frontend, backend, and blockchain interactions.

![Solidity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Solidity-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![ethers.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/ethers.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![HTML/CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Vercel](https://img.shields.io/badge/Vercel-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

#Problem Statement

Trading on AMMs like Uniswap is not just about price — it’s about execution risk.
When you submit a swap, you are exposed to:
→ Slippage spikes
→ Liquidity imbalance
→ Volatility shocks
→ Sudden volume surges
→ MEV and sandwich pressure
→ Bad timing during unstable blocks
Most bots and scripts today rely on:
    Fixed slippage tolerance
    Static thresholds
    Hardcoded heuristics
    External data pipelines
   No real-time risk feedback
   This makes automated execution fragile and unsafe in fast-changing on-chain  markets.

#What This Engine Solves
This engine acts as a real-time execution risk layer for on-chain trading systems.
Instead of blindly executing swaps, it continuously evaluates:
             Is this a good moment to trade — or should we wait?
It converts live pool state into structured risk intelligence and actionable decisions.


##Native On-Chain Compatibility
The engine is designed to work directly with AMM contracts.

Instead of relying on third-party indexers or off-chain APIs:
    >It can subscribe directly to pool state
    >Read reserves, swaps, and volume from smart contracts
    >Build snapshots directly from on-chain events
    >Eliminate dependency on external data providers
    >Reduce trust assumptions and data latency
    >This allows seamless integration with custom AMMs, private pools, or    protocol-owned liquidity, making the system fully composable and trust-minimized.

##What It Analyzes
The engine continuously evaluates:
>Liquidity Trend
>Detects liquidity inflow / outflow behavior
>Identifies thinning pools before slippage spikes
>Market Stability
>Measures short-term volatility using log returns
>Penalizes unstable price regimes
>Trading Activity
>Captures abnormal volume and swap bursts
>Helps detect crowding and congestion
>Order Flow Pressure
>Buy vs sell dominance inside the pool
>Shock Detection
>Z-score detection on volume and price jumps
>Flags abnormal regime changes
>Execution Impact
>Simulates real swap slippage and worst-case slippage

##What It Produces
For every snapshot, the engine outputs:
→ Quantitative Signals
→ Adaptive Slippage Margin (epsilon)
→ Execution Quality Score (Q ∈ [0,1])
→ Decision Classification
 
EXECUTE
CAUTION
WAIT

→ Confidence Score (smoothed + risk adjusted)
This allows any system to reason about when to trade, not just how to trade.

##Who Can Use This
This engine can plug into:
    Automated trading bots
    Arbitrage engines
    Custom AMMs
    DeFi dashboards
    Execution routers
   Treasury automation
   Risk monitoring systems
   Anywhere you need adaptive execution intelligence instead of static heuristics.

##What we are using for 
    we are using it for our custom build AMM , our algorithm uses the data fetched from blockchain . Our AMM function like a Uniswap v2  and usues the data to give user inner insights of the latest trends.

**Challenges we ran into**

Challenges Faced


1. Parameter Tuning Without Machine Learning
A major challenge was selecting the constants and weights used across the engine — including stability decay, EMA factors, scoring weights, and decision thresholds.
These parameters directly influence how the engine reacts to volatility, liquidity changes, and execution risk. In a production-grade system, these values should ideally be learned and optimized using:
>Historical datasets
>Reinforcement learning or optimization pipelines
>Continuous backtesting and calibration
Due to limited time and compute resources during the hackathon, implementing a full ML calibration pipeline was not feasible. Instead, the constants were tuned manually through iterative testing and stress simulations to achieve stable and interpretable behavior.
This limitation was acknowledged early and the system was designed so that these parameters can later be learned automatically.

2. Lack of Native Data From Our Own AMM

Our own AMM did not yet have sufficient live trading activity to generate meaningful datasets for signal extraction, visualization, and stress testing.

To overcome this:
>Initial testing was done using fully simulated market snapshots.
>The engine was then migrated to partially simulated + real Uniswap transaction data using the Etherscan API.
>Finally, live snapshots were streamed using WebSocket connections to observe real-time behavior.

This progressive data pipeline allowed validation of the engine logic even before real liquidity existed in our own protocol.
The architecture is designed so that once liquidity grows, the engine can directly connect to the AMM contract without any third-party dependency.

3. Real-Time Infrastructure and Deployment Limitations

The live WebSocket pipeline worked locally for streaming Uniswap data and updating graphs in real time.
However, after deployment, persistent WebSocket connections required managed infrastructure (e.g., Railway / long-running services / persistent sockets), which was outside the scope of the hackathon deployment environment.
As a result, the final demo focuses on deterministic replay and snapshot-based visualization rather than continuous live streaming.

4. High Mathematical Complexity Under Time Constraints

The engine integrates multiple mathematical components:
>Exponential moving averages
>Log-return volatility modeling
>Z-score shock detection
>Liquidity normalization
>Slippage simulation
>Risk-weighted scoring

Understanding, validating, and correctly implementing these models within a very limited time window was one of the biggest challenges. Much of the mathematical reasoning, stability testing, and parameter validation had to be done in a single night.
This required careful debugging, numerical sanity checks, and iterative refinement to ensure correctness and stability.

**The problem it solves**

Modern applications generate huge volumes of logs, but understanding them is still largely manual and reactive. Teams rely on static rules, dashboards, or keyword searches, which makes debugging slow and noisy. Important issues often get buried in log noise, leading to alert fatigue, delayed responses, and increased downtime.

---

## What People Can Use It For

Anveshak can be used by DevOps and engineering teams to automatically monitor, analyze, and understand application logs. Its multi-agent system detects anomalies, correlates related events across services, identifies root causes, and triggers actions like alerts or issue creation. This makes log analysis faster, safer, and more reliable by turning raw logs into clear, actionable insights instead of overwhelming data.

**Challenges we ran into**

One key challenge was correlating logs across distributed services where formats, timestamps, and contexts differed. This initially caused incorrect or incomplete analysis. I solved this by introducing a dedicated parsing layer and a context-correlation agent that normalizes logs and maintains shared context, allowing agents to reason accurately across multiple services.

![Solidity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Solidity-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![PostgreSQL](https://img.shields.io/badge/PostgreSQL-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Traditional arisan (rotating savings groups) in Indonesia face 5 critical problems that Arisan Aman solves:

**1. TRUST & SAFETY ISSUES**

- Physical cash collection risks theft/loss
- Organizer ("penyelenggara") may abscond with funds
- No guarantee of payout when your turn comes
- Social pressure makes enforcement difficult

**2. INEFFICIENCY & HASSLE**

- Manual collection every month
- Tracking who paid/who didn't
- Scheduling physical meetings
- Reminding members constantly

**3. LACK OF TRANSPARENCY**

- Members can't verify total collected
- No clear audit trail
- Doubts about fairness in turn selection
- Hidden costs or fees

**4. LIMITED ACCESSIBILITY**

- Geographic constraints (must be local)
- Time constraints (must attend meetings)
- Social constraints (need existing relationships)
- No options for different contribution levels

**5. NO FINANCIAL GROWTH**

- Money sits idle (no interest)
- No credit history building
- No integration with financial system
- Cannot scale beyond personal network

Example: Office arisan with 30 members - saves 2 hours/month per person in collection time

**2. FLEXIBLE PARTICIPATION**

Before: Must attend monthly meetings, limited to local participants
With Arisan Aman: Join from anywhere in Indonesia, participate in multiple groups simultaneously, adjustable contribution levels
Example: Jakarta office worker can join hometown arisan, office arisan, and hobby group arisan simultaneously

**3. INTELLIGENT SCHEDULING & REMINDERS**

Before: Manual scheduling, forgotten payments, awkward reminders
With Arisan Aman: Smart scheduling based on member preferences, automatic reminders 3 days/1 day before, push notifications
Example: System automatically reschedules payout for member going on maternity leave

**4. DIGITAL RECORD KEEPING**

Before: Notebook records, disputes over payments, lost records
With Arisan Aman: Permanent digital ledger, instant payment history, downloadable reports for tax/accounting
Example: Small business owner uses arisan history as informal financial record for loan applications

**5. SEAMLESS INTEGRATION**

Before: Cash-to-bank transfers, reconciliation headaches
With Arisan Aman: Direct integration with GoPay, OVO, bank accounts, DANA; automatic reconciliation
Example: Funds automatically transferred to winner's preferred e-wallet at midnight on payout day

> Predict The Future - WIN REWARDS

![Solidity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Solidity-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![ethers.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/ethers.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Blockchain](https://img.shields.io/badge/Blockchain-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![React.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/React.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Hardhat](https://img.shields.io/badge/Hardhat-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

## 1. Eliminating "Cheap Talk" in Polling
Traditional social media polls often suffer from spam, bots, or low-effort participation. By implementing a **"skin in the game"** mechanism where users must stake **ETH** to vote, **VETO** ensures that every vote carries weight and conviction. This results in higher-quality data and true sentiment analysis, leveraging the _Keynesian Beauty Contest_ theory.

## 2. Decentralized & Transparent Trust
In centralized betting or polling platforms, users must trust the platform operator not to manipulate results or withhold funds. **VETO** runs entirely on the **Lisk** blockchain. The logic for determining winners, calculating result percentages, and distributing the reward pool is **immutable** and **open-source**. Funds are locked in a smart contract, ensuring winners are always paid out automatically.

## 3. SocialFi & Gamification
Communities need better ways to engage. **VETO** turns passive surveying into an active, competitive sport. It tracks:
- **Streaks** for consecutive wins.
- **Leaderboards** for top predictors.
- **Accuracy Rates** for user reputation.

**Challenges we ran into**

## 1. Managing On-Chain Data Costs (Images)
One of the biggest hurdles was allowing users to add visual flair (images for each option) without bloating the blockchain or incurring massive gas fees. Storing images directly on Ethereum/Lisk is impractical.

**How I got over it:**
I integrated **IPFS (via Pinata)**. The frontend uploads images to IPFS through a lightweight backend proxy (to secure API keys) and retrieves a _Content Identifier (CID)_. The Smart Contract was optimized to store `string[] optionImages` arrays containing only these CIDs. This keeps gas costs low while maintaining decentralized storage.

## 2. Handling Dynamic Reward Distribution
Writing the logic to split a reward pool among an unknown number of winners was tricky. If 100 people win, the contract needs to distribute funds without hitting the block gas limit or suffering from rounding errors (dust).

**How I got over it:**
I implemented a robust `distributeRewards` functionality in Solidity that calculates the `rewardPerWinner` using precise integer division. I added frontend checks to ensure the pool state is synchronized before distribution to prevent failed transactions.

## 3. User Experience (ETH vs USD)
Web3 users often think in USD, but the blockchain works in ETH/Wei. Showing only ETH values made it hard for users to understand the real-world value of their bets.

**How I got over it:**
I built a global state system using **Zustand** that fetches the live ETH price via the **CoinGecko API**. I then implemented a "Currency Toggle" that instantly recalculates all input fields, pool sizes, and estimated winnings across the entire dApp into USD, significantly improving accessibility.

**Winner Classification**

## Why VETO fits the SocialFi Track

**VETO** perfectly bridges the gap between **Social interaction** and **Decentralized Finance**.

1.  **Monetized Social Sentiment:** We take the everyday action of "liking" or "voting" on social media and turn it into a financial asset. This is the core definition of SocialFi—creating value from social capital.
2.  **Solving the "Bot Problem":** By requiring a micro-stake (ETH) to participate, we created a Sybil-resistant mechanism. This fits the track by proving that Web3 identity + financial stake creates higher-quality social data than Web2 methods.
3.  **Viral Retention Loops:** The application includes **Streaks**, **Leaderboards**, and **Shareable Poll Cards**. These are consumer-facing features designed to keep users coming back, moving beyond simple DeFi transaction tools into a daily-use social application.

> On-Chain Financing for Exporters

![Solidity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Solidity-333333?style=flat-square) ![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![pinata](https://img.shields.io/badge/pinata-333333?style=flat-square) ![Supabase](https://img.shields.io/badge/Supabase-333333?style=flat-square) ![Panna SDK](https://img.shields.io/badge/Panna%20SDK-333333?style=flat-square) ![Lisk Blockchain](https://img.shields.io/badge/Lisk%20Blockchain-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Global trade moves fast, but **exporter payments** do not. Even after goods are shipped and delivered, exporters are often forced to wait **30 to 90 days to get paid**, while production, logistics, and operational costs continue to run in real time. For many exporters, this delay is not just inconvenient—it directly **limits growth**.

Today’s export finance systems were built for a different era. Banks rely heavily on collateral, manual verification, and slow approval processes, treating exporters as high-risk borrowers rather than active contributors to global trade. 

As a result, **exporters** face persistent **challenges**:
- **Working capital locked** between shipment and payment
- **High interest rates** and **excessive collateral** requirements
- **Slow**, manual approval processes that delay growth

SEATrax addresses this bottleneck by rethinking how export receivables are financed. Instead of waiting months for payment or navigating rigid banking requirements, exporters can convert real export invoices into secure, on-chain assets and access liquidity earlier in the trade cycle. These invoices are bundled into **diversified liquidity pools**, **reducing risk** and creating **transparency** for capital providers, while payments from importers—whether in fiat or crypto—are settled automatically through smart contract escrow.

With SEATrax, **exporters** can now:
- **Access working capital earlier** in the export cycle
- **Reduce** dependence on **heavy collateral** requirements
- **Improve cash flow predictability** and **operational certainty**
- **Scale operations** without being constrained by payment delays

In short, SEATrax turns delayed exporter payments into immediate opportunity, modernizing trade finance so global commerce can move at the speed it was always meant to.

*The Future of Trade Finance Starts Here
**SEATrax : Unlocking capital at the speed of global trade***

**Challenges we ran into**

Building **SEATrax** was a continuous learning process that required both technical problem-solving and strong team collaboration. Our team came together through **BlockDev.ID’s Kelas Rutin**, and while **2 of our 4 members were new to Web3**, we treated this as an opportunity rather than a limitation. 

Throughout the learning process at BlockDev.ID, we actively learned from and **consulted with mentors**, using their feedback to refine our understanding of **blockchain concepts, trade finance logic**, and overall system design.

One of the biggest technical hurdles was **designing** and **integrating smart contracts** into a complete end-to-end flow. Integration across the frontend, backend, and on-chain components required multiple iterations and refactoring. We **overcame** this by breaking the system into **smaller, testable components**, validating each smart contract individually before integrating them into the full platform flow.

**Winner Classification**

***Winner Prize :***

1. **Urgency of the Problem :**
SEATrax addresses a **Critical issue** in **global trade** where exporters must wait 30–90 days for payment after shipment, creating **systemic cash-flow constraints** that limit SME growth and slow down global commerce.

2. **Scalable Adoption & Government Alignment :**
Designed to be **scalable** and **revenue-generating** through a 5% export financing fee. SeaTrax taps into a **clear** exporter and investor **community** while aligning with **Southeast Asian government priorities to increase Exports**. By offering **measurable economic value**, SEATrax presents a strong value proposition that supports easier regulatory alignment, compliance, and **potential government-backed adoption**.

3. **Unique End-to-End Use Case :**
Unlike typical DeFi or NFT projects, SeaTrax combines **real-world asset tokenization**, and **on-chain securitization**,  into a complete export finance flow, making it a production-ready financial infrastructure use case.

4. **TVL & Transaction Growth for Lisk :**
By tokenizing export invoices and pooling them into on-chain liquidity pools, SEATrax introduces real-world assets that **retain capital** on the Lisk chain, driving sustained **TVL growth** and recurring **on-chain transactions** from issuance, pooling, and settlement.

***Social Media Challenge Winner :***
1. **High-Quality, Educational Content :**
SEATrax delivers **clear**, **visually engaging** content that explains complex topics like **export finance** and **real-world asset tokenization** in a way that is **accessible** to **non-technical audiences**.

2. **Strong Web3 & Ecosystem Exposure :**
Through consistent activity on **Instagram** and **Twitter** SEATrax actively contributes to **visibility, awareness, and engagement** within both mainstream and Web3 communities.

> Easily Monetize APIs in Minutes, Powered by x402

![Solidity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Solidity-333333?style=flat-square) ![PostgreSQL](https://img.shields.io/badge/PostgreSQL-333333?style=flat-square) ![Redis](https://img.shields.io/badge/Redis-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

**What is Gate402?**
Gate402 is a payment infrastructure platform that enables developers to monetize their APIs using crypto micropayments in under 5 minutes. Built on the x402 payment standard, Gate402 acts as an intelligent proxy layer between APIs and consumers, automatically handling payment validation, request proxying, and real-time analytics—eliminating the need for developers to write custom billing code.

**What Problem Does Gate402 Solve?**
For Developers:

- Stripe's Minimum Problem: Traditional payment processors require $0.50+ minimums, making micropayments ($0.001-$0.10 per API call) economically impossible
- High Marketplace Fees: Platforms like RapidAPI take 20% of revenue, leaving developers with only 80% of what they earn
- Development Time Waste: Building payment infrastructure from scratch takes weeks of engineering time that could be spent on core product
- AI Agent Payment Gap: AI agents (Claude, ChatGPT, custom agents) cannot use traditional payment systems autonomously—they need programmatic, per-call payment flows

For the Ecosystem:

- Blocked API Economy: Millions of valuable APIs remain free because monetization infrastructure doesn't exist for micropayments
- Web3 Adoption Barrier: Crypto developers are forced to use Web2 payment systems (Stripe) despite building crypto-native products
- Global Access Inequality: Developers in 190+ countries cannot access Stripe or PayPal, blocking them from global API markets

**The Solution:**
Gate402 provides:

✅ True micropayments starting at $0.001 per request (no minimums)
✅ 2% platform fee (vs 20% marketplace fees or Stripe's 2.9% + $0.30)
✅ 5-minute deployment (no SDK, no code changes required)
✅ MCP-native support for AI agent autonomous payments (industry-first)
✅ Non-custodial architecture (payments go directly to developer wallets)
✅ Real-time analytics dashboard for revenue tracking and customer insights

Gate402 Contract on Lisk Sepolia:
- Gate402 Token (Implement EIP-3009, interface required to pay with x402)
https://sepolia-blockscout.lisk.com/address/0x40240285082C1e7e8D4e62f253817381aa43F0fE


*Gate402: Payment Infrastructure for the API Economy, built on x402, powered by Lisk.*

**Challenges we ran into**

**Challenge 1: Wildcard SSL & Subdomain Routing at ScaleThe Problem:**
Each gateway gets a unique subdomain (alice-weather.gate402.pro, bob-data.gate402.io, etc.), and all must have automatic HTTPS. 
The Solution:
- Implemented single wildcard certificate covering *.gate402.pro using DNS-01 challenge with Cloudflare API

**Challenge 2: Proxy Architecture Nightmare**
Building a production-grade HTTP proxy is deceptively hard. Our proxy must:
- Accept requests at gateway URL
- Validate x402 payment proofs
- Forward to developer's origin server
- Return origin's response without modification
- Handle timeouts, retries, and errors gracefully

**Challenge 3: Deep Dive Into x402 Source CodeThe Problem:**
x402 documentation was too high-level. To build a production-grade facilitator, I had to go beyond the docs and understand how x402 actually works at the code level.

**Challenge 4: First x402 Facilitator on Lisk**
We are the first developers to build an x402 facilitator on Lisk.

### ClipHive
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/cliphive-34de) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/ASTRALWEB3/ClipHive-FE) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mjAO0HnACzaLzSZ2_s50L37XeS_-LwRo/view?usp=sharing) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/UuqKKxMmspw) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Lisk%20Builders%20Challenge:%20Round%20Three-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://lisk-builders-challenge-3.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-3-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> The Future of Content Monetization

![Solidity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Solidity-333333?style=flat-square) ![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Supabase](https://img.shields.io/badge/Supabase-333333?style=flat-square) ![foundry](https://img.shields.io/badge/foundry-333333?style=flat-square) ![Wagmi](https://img.shields.io/badge/Wagmi-333333?style=flat-square) ![RainbowKit](https://img.shields.io/badge/RainbowKit-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

ClipHive solves a clear problem in today's Attention Economy especially in the Clipping industry, solving three critical bottlenecks that Web2 platforms (like Upwork or Fiverr) cannot address: Global Payments, Trustless Escrow, and Strategic Anonymity.

Here is how ClipHive makes clipping safer, faster, and more efficient:

1. Eliminating Cross-Border Payment Friction
The Problem: A streamer in the US hiring an editor in Indonesia or Brazil often relies on PayPal or Wire Transfers. These take 3–5 business days to settle, charge 5–10% in currency conversion fees, and often freeze accounts arbitrarily.

The ClipHive Solution: By using stablecoins (USDC/USDT), payments are instant and borderless. An editor in Bali gets paid as quickly as an editor in New York, with near-zero fees.

2. Enabling "Stealth Marketing"
The Problem: Big creators cannot publicly post jobs like "I need people to make fan edits of me" without ruining their organic image. They need a way to hire an army of clippers anonymously.

The ClipHive Solution: We introduce "Stealth Links". Streamers can create a hidden bounty that is only accessible via a direct hash link. This allows creators to privately distribute jobs to Discord communities without the public (or competitors) seeing the job on the main board.

3. Trustless Escrow
The Problem: The #1 complaint in the freelance world is non-payment/scamming. Editors deliver work and get ghosted or Streamers pay upfront and get bad quality.

The ClipHive Solution: Our Smart Contract Escrow system guarantees solvency. The Streamer must lock the funds before the job goes live. The money exists on-chain and is released programmatically upon approval. No more ugly scams.

4. Validating Ownership in an AI World
The Problem: How does a streamer know if a viral TikTok clip was actually made by the person claiming the bounty?

The ClipHive Solution: We implement a Proof-of-Ownership verification flow. By binding social accounts (OAuth) to wallet addresses, we verify that the user submitting the claim actually owns the TikTok/YouTube account where the clip was posted. Another solution is that we generate a random hashtag unique to that user when creating a video, when the user submits the claim, the AI verifier or the human verifier can cross-check the hashtag used to indicate ownership. If it shows a mismatch from the hashtag used with the hashtag that was supposed to be used, then the user will not receive the payout share. 

Summary for Judges:
ClipHive turns the messy, manual process of hiring viral clippers into a liquid, trustless protocol. It allows creators to weaponize their community for growth while giving global editors instant financial access.

**Challenges we ran into**

Building ClipHive was a challenge. Trying to combine Web3 technologies with a fast-paced social media technologies. Here are the challenges that Astral faced:

1. The "Stealth Mode" Paradox (Privacy on a Public Ledger)
The Challenge: One of our core features is "Stealth Jobs", allowing streamers to hire anonymously. However, blockchains are transparent by default. Anyone can view transaction data on a block explorer. We struggled with: "How do we keep a bounty 'hidden' from the public UI while ensuring the smart contract is verifiable?"

The Solution: We implemented a hashed indexing system. The Smart Contract stores the "Job ID" and the "Bounty Amount" publicly, but the sensitive metadata (Streamer Name, Instructions, Private Links) is stored off-chain (IPFS/Database) and is only query-able if you possess the unique cryptographic hash generated at creation. This keeps the job "unlisted" to the general public but accessible to those with the link.

2. Bridging the "Web2-Web3" Gap (Proof of Ownership)
The Challenge: We needed a way to verify that a Clipper actually owns the viral TikTok/YouTube video they are submitting. A simple link submission isn't enough (anyone can copy-paste a link to a viral video they didn't make). We faced issues with API rate limits and linking a Web3 Wallet address to a Web2 social account.

The Solution: We built a custom verification flow. We require users to perform a "handshake", signing a message with their wallet that we cross-reference with an OAuth token from the social platform. This cryptographically binds their Social Media identity to their payout wallet, preventing claim spoofing. Another way to add-on the security is to generate a random hashtag for the user to use in their clip. If the random hashtag is not used in the video when submitted, the user will not receive the payout. 

3. Handling Escrow for Fund Safety
The Challenge: In early testing, we realized a critical flaw. "What if a Streamer ghosts the freelancer?" Or "What if the freelancer submits junk and refuses to cancel?" We risked funds getting permanently stuck in the Smart Contract, which is a nightmare for user trust.

The Solution: We architected a Time-Lock & Dispute Mechanism within the Solidity contract. If noe action is taken by the Stramer within "X" days after submission, the contract triggers an "Auto-Release" or "Refund" state depending on the logic flow. This ensures liquidity is never permanently frozen in the protocol.

4. UX Friction for Non-Crypto Users
The Challenge: Streamers are gamers, not necessarily Web3-natives. Forcing them to understand "Gas Limits," "RPCs," and "Hex Strings" was a major UX barrier that made the app feel unusable for non-Web3 natives.

The Solution: We focused heavily on Account Abstraction principles. We designed the frontend to hide the complexity. We used clear, human-readable status updates ("Funds Escrowed", "Ready for Payout") instead of raw transaction hashes, and optimized our contract to minimize the number of signatures required to complete a job.

**Winner Classification**

ClipHive is a Real-World Asset (RWA) Labor Protocol designed to onboard the next million users (Gamers & Creators) to the Lisk ecosystem.

Here is how we address the core Judging Classifications:
1. Impact towards the Lisk Ecosystem (High Impact)
The "Mass Adoption" Bridge: Lisk aims to be the blockchain for real-world application. ClipHive targets the $250B Creator Economy. We are not marketing to existing crypto-natives, we are marketing to Streamers and Video Editors, which is a massive demographic that currently relies on slow Web2 fiat rails.

Transaction Volume: Every bounty creates on-chain activity (Escrow Deposit -> Lock -> Release). This generates consistent transaction volume for the Lisk network, moving beyond speculative trading into real commercial utility.

2. Innovation & Uniqueness
The "Stealth Link" Mechanism: Most freelance DApps are public-by-default. We innovated by creating a hybrid privacy model where jobs can be hidden via cryptographic hash links. This solves a specific real-world pain point for influencers (secret marketing) that no other Web3 competitor addresses.

Gamified Gig Work: By framing video editing as "Bounty Hunting" and "Farming," we align the UX with the psychology of our target audience (Gamers), differentiating us from boring corporate tools like Upwork.

3. Technical Excellence
Smart Contract Escrow: We built a custom Solidity escrow system that ensures trustless payouts without a middleman holding funds.

Web2 <-> Web3 Hybrid Identity: We tackled the difficult technical challenge of verifying "Off-chain Work" (TikTok/YouTube clips) with "On-chain Payments" by implementing an OAuth-based proof-of-ownership flow.

4. UI/UX & Usability
Abstracted Complexity: We adhere to Lisk's philosophy of accessibility. The UI uses "Gamer Language" (Quests, Loot, XP) rather than "Crypto Jargon" (Gas, Hash, Block), making the onboarding process frictionless for non-technical users.

Summary:
ClipHive fits the "Open / General Innovation" track by demonstrating how Lisk's fast, low-fee infrastructure can solve a specific, high-value problem for the massive Creator Economy.

Shardeum’s high throughput and fast transaction speeds ensured that the app could handle numerous users and transactions simultaneously, without any lag or issues. > Your Clothing, Digitized.

![Solidity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Solidity-333333?style=flat-square) ![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Framer Motion](https://img.shields.io/badge/Framer%20Motion-333333?style=flat-square) ![Sepolia Testnet](https://img.shields.io/badge/Sepolia%20Testnet-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js & Express.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js%20&%20Express.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Sequelize ORM](https://img.shields.io/badge/Sequelize%20ORM-333333?style=flat-square) ![RainbowKit & Wagmi](https://img.shields.io/badge/RainbowKit%20&%20Wagmi-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Bridging the Divide Between Traditional Commerce and Web3

Current e-commerce platforms force users into a binary choice:

🌐 Web2 platforms (Amazon, Shopify) → Convenient UX but no transparency

🔗 Pure Web3 platforms (OpenSea, DApps) → Transparent but high entry barriers for non-crypto users

🚀 How WearCart Solves This

WearCart eliminates this friction by creating a Hybrid E-commerce Ecosystem that blends the best of both worlds.

🧾 Unified Shopping Experience
Users can purchase real-world products (clothing) using fiat payments (Razorpay / Cards) or cryptocurrency (ETH / Sepolia).

🔄 Inventory Synchronization
Prevents double-spending of inventory. If the last item is bought via a Smart Contract, the centralized database is instantly updated, blocking Web2 users from buying out-of-stock products.

🔐 Transparency & Trust
Critical transaction data is verifiable on-chain, while the overall experience feels as smooth as a regular online store.

**Challenges we ran into**

1️⃣ The “Dual-State” Concurrency Problem

The biggest challenge was keeping the Centralized Database (PostgreSQL) and the Decentralized Ledger (Blockchain) in sync.

❗ The Hurdle:
A user could complete a purchase on-chain, but the off-chain database wouldn’t update until the block was mined, creating a race condition where the same item could be sold twice.

✅ The Solution:
We implemented a robust event-listener architecture:

The frontend listens for the ItemSold event from the Smart Contract

It immediately triggers a high-priority webhook

The backend instantly locks inventory in PostgreSQL

This ensures real-time consistency across Web2 and Web3.

2️⃣ Integrating Web3 with Server-Side Rendering (SSR)

Next.js 14’s App Router heavily relies on SSR, but Wagmi and WalletConnect require access to the browser’s window object.

🐞 The Bug:

Hydration mismatch errors

"Window is not defined" crashes during build

🛠️ The Fix:

Isolated all Web3 logic into Client Components using the "use client" directive

Built a custom Web3Provider wrapper

Wallet connectors mount only after client-side hydration completes

This completely resolved SSR and hydration issues.

**Ethereum Track**

🟣 Ethereum Track — How WearCart Fits

WearCart directly aligns with the Ethereum Track by leveraging Ethereum smart contracts to enable real-world commerce on-chain while maintaining a seamless Web2 user experience.

🔗 Core Ethereum Integration

WearCart uses Ethereum (Sepolia Testnet) smart contracts written in Solidity to handle crypto-based purchases of physical goods.

Users can connect wallets (MetaMask / Rainbow) and complete purchases using ETH, making Ethereum a first-class payment rail in the platform.


🧾 On-Chain Transparency for Real-World Assets

Every crypto purchase emits blockchain events (e.g., ItemSold) that are verifiable on Ethereum, ensuring:

Transparent transaction history

Trustless proof of purchase

Immutable sales records for real-world clothing assets



This demonstrates Ethereum’s role beyond NFTs and DeFi—as infrastructure for real commerce.

🔄 Solving Web2–Web3 State Synchronization

A key Ethereum-focused challenge we solved is dual-state consistency:

Blockchain state (Ethereum smart contract)

Off-chain state (PostgreSQL inventory & orders)


How Ethereum is central here:

Smart contracts act as the source of truth for crypto transactions

The frontend listens to Ethereum contract events

Backend reacts instantly to on-chain events to lock inventory, preventing double-selling


This showcases practical Ethereum event-driven architecture in production-like systems.

🧠 Lowering Web3 Adoption Barriers

WearCart uses Ethereum without forcing complexity on users:

Crypto-native users get full wallet-based purchasing

Non-crypto users can still use fiat

Both flows coexist in one system


This aligns strongly with ETHIndia’s goal of bringing Ethereum to mainstream users, not just developers.

🚀 Why This Matters for Ethereum

WearCart proves that:

Ethereum can power hybrid Web2 + Web3 applications

Smart contracts can manage real inventory, payments, and trust

Blockchain adoption improves transparency without sacrificing UX



---

✅ In Summary

WearCart fits the Ethereum Track by:

Using Ethereum smart contracts for real-world payments

Demonstrating event-driven on-chain → off-chain synchronization

Applying Ethereum beyond NFTs into practical e-commerce

Making Ethereum accessible to non-crypto-native users

**Open Innovation**

💜 Lovable Track — Open Innovation

How WearCart Fits This Track

WearCart strongly aligns with the Lovable – Open Innovation track by focusing on real-world usability, inclusivity, and practical adoption rather than limiting itself to a niche audience.

🤝 Designed for Everyone, Not Just Crypto Natives

One of the biggest barriers in Web3 adoption is complexity. WearCart intentionally removes this barrier by offering:

A familiar e-commerce interface that feels like a regular shopping website

Optional wallet-based payments, without forcing crypto usage

A smooth experience for both traditional users and Web3 users


This makes the platform approachable, inclusive, and genuinely lovable.

🌍 Open Innovation in Real-World Commerce

WearCart applies innovation where it matters most—everyday shopping:

Integrates blockchain transparency into a common use case (buying clothes)

Bridges fiat payments and crypto payments in a single workflow

Demonstrates how Web3 can enhance trust without disrupting UX


This is innovation that solves real user problems, not just technical ones.

### LoanFlow AI
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/slay-c3ff) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/BlackDevil1928/Loan_Flow_AI) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://loanflow-ai.vercel.app/) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/4m_6nevM2Ec) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-HackFiesta-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hackfiesta.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-3-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> From Application to Approval in Minutes.

![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-333333?style=flat-square) ![OCR](https://img.shields.io/badge/OCR-333333?style=flat-square) ![axios](https://img.shields.io/badge/axios-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![React.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/React.js-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

The regular loan processing at NBFCs and other financial institutions has always been a slow, expensive, and highly manual affair. The customers have to endure waiting for days or even weeks, as there are various human touchpoints such as **sales agents, KYC officers, underwriters, and back-office staff** involved in the process. Consequently, this situation increases the operational costs, and customer dissatisfaction, and at the same time, there are more chances of mistakes made by humans, and the availability of services is restricted to the working hours.

The AI Loan Sales Assistant is the perfect solution that comes into play since this tool is capable of handling the whole loan processing—from the customer interaction stage to the sending of the sanction letter—through the means of a smart multi-agent AI system. The end-users will not have to put up with human agents since they will be dealing with a human-like conversational AI who will support them during the whole loan application, document upload, and eligibility checking process in real time.

🚀 What People Can Use It For

- Getting instant personal loan approvals in a matter of minutes instead of days

- Getting **24/7** loan assistance which is totally free of human dependency

- KYC verification done automatically by **OCR-based document validation**

- Credit decisioning based on rules that is both transparent and consistent

- Secure digital sanction letters issued automatically in PDF format

🔐 Why It’s Safer & Better

- It reduces both human bias and manual errors

- It guarantees data isolation and privacy through Row Level Security (RLS)

- It keeps a complete audit trail for compliance and traceability

**The whole system certainly makes loan processing quicker, safer, scalable, and cost-effective, thus making it perfect for NBFCs, fintech startups, and digital lending platforms which are looking to upgrade their operations.**

**Challenges we ran into**

A **multi-agent architecture** with different AI agents like **Sales, KYC, Underwriting, Sanction, and Audit** that communicates and collaborates without losing conversation state or flow order was one of the hardest things to do. The first reactions of the agents were separate and that resulted in the disruption of the flows and repeated questions. We managed to resolve this by bringing in a **Master Agent** that took over the control of orchestration, management of state, and routing of the messages to the correct agents at each individual stage.

🔍 OCR & KYC Accuracy Issues

KYC verification through OCR was one more difficulty. OCR output was varying from one time to another owing to the quality of the image, illumination, and kinds of documents. To tackle this, We introduced format validation rules (PAN/Aadhaar patterns) and also built fallback logic to manage partial or noisy OCR outputs instead of terminating the whole flow.

🔐 Security & Data Isolation

**Row Level Security (RLS)** implementation in Supabase was challenging at the outset, especially in terms of properly restricting users to only their loan applications and documents. Misconfigured policies at first resulted in the error of permission. Careful testing with several user accounts helped in refining the policies and confirming proper isolation.

🔄 Frontend–Backend Sync

The UI experienced delays and race conditions because asynchronous backend calls were managed while real-time chat responses were handled. The issue was eliminated by revamping API response structure, better loading states, and consistent error handling.

All these challenges made the system stronger producing a powerful and resilient AI loan assistant ready for production built solely on free-tier tools.

**Ethereum Track**

This project seamlessly aligns with the ETHIndia track by showcasing how Ethereum-based systems can bring trust, transparency, and automation to real-world financial workflows. The AI Loan Sales Assistant is a rule-driven system that is very compatible with smart contract execution, replacing the hiding of manual loan processes with a structured, ruling based system.

The rules for loan eligibility, the logic for underwriting, and the results of the approval can all be turned into Ethereum smart contracts, thus making decisions deterministic, auditable, and tamper-proof. Every single step of the loan lifecycle—creating an application, checking the status of KYC verification, making a credit decision, and generating a sanction—can be accounted for as on-chain events, therefore ensuring an audit trail that is immutable and in line with Ethereum's transparency principles.

Furthermore, the project is prepared to handle a hybrid on-chain/off-chain architecture that is the perfect fit for the Web3 financial applications. The vital customer information stays safely off-chain, while the cryptographic hashes, the states of approvals, and the compliance logs are the only things on-chain. This method safeguards the privacy of the customers and at the same time creates a situation where trust can be verified.

The project is a practical Web3 use case that goes beyond mere speculation by integrating agentic AI for smart automation with Ethereum for decentralized verification. It underlines the ability of the Ethereum network to handle scalable, compliant, and user-friendly fintech applications thus making it a powerful and pertinent submission for the ETHIndia hackathon track.

**AI TRACK**

- Agentic AI Architecture
Uses **multiple specialized AI agents** (Sales, KYC, Underwriting, Sanction, Audit) that collaborate autonomously, showcasing advanced agent-based AI design rather than a single prompt-based system.

- Human-Like Conversational Intelligence
Delivers natural, contextual conversations that adapt based on user inputs, simulating a real loan officer and improving user trust and engagement.

- End-to-End AI Automation
Automates the entire loan lifecycle—from customer onboarding to final decision—demonstrating real-world AI workflow orchestration.

- AI-Assisted Document Intelligence
Leverages OCR and validation logic to extract, verify, and reason over unstructured KYC documents, a core applied AI use case.

- Decision-Making AI (Reasoning + Rules)
Combines AI understanding with deterministic credit rules to ensure explainable, consistent, and auditable decisions.

- State Management & Context Awareness
Maintains long-term conversation state across multiple interactions, highlighting advanced AI memory handling.

- Scalable & Modular AI Design
New agents, decision rules, or AI models can be added without rewriting the system, enabling rapid experimentation.

- Responsible & Explainable AI
Ensures transparent decisions, reduced bias, and traceable outcomes—critical for real-world AI adoption.

- Production-Ready Implementation
Demonstrates how AI moves beyond demos into deployable, enterprise-grade systems.

**Open Innovation**

The current project exemplifies the **Open Innovation** concept as it changes the entire process which was usually not only rigid but also human-oriented and extremely manual into a **smart, coherent, and reusable AI-powered system**. Rather than addressing a single issue in isolation, the AI Loan Sales Assistant brings forth a modular agent-based system that can change, enlarge, and be used in different divisions.

The project, at its most integral part, reveals how **Agentic AI** could team up with a human co-worker and attend to customer communication, checking, making decisions, and complying with regulations all by itself. This system of dispersed authority brings about the creation of new agents, rules, or sources of data that can be included in the system with very little hassle, thus, making it future-proof and exceptionally extensible.

The true innovativeness of the solution lies in its effect on the ground. It very much lessens the turnaround time, running cost, and large human teams' dependency while still giving a consistent and natural-like human user experience. The entire project which has been developed on open-source and free-tier tools demonstrates that innovation of industry standard does not necessitate elaborate infrastructure or high cost.

The proposed platform can do much more than lending, as it can also be used in insurance onboarding, KYC automation, compliance processes, customer support, and document intelligence systems. The project through its combination of flexibility, scalability, and real-world applicability has moved beyond a hackathon prototype; it has now laid the foundation for open, collaborative, and scalable innovation making it very suitable for the Open Innovation track.
