# Here's a reference to our pitch deck as well :
 https://www.canva.com/design/DAG-B8zsP_4/lZp36lBl0cJtmgl1ZGG4lg/view?utm_content=DAG-B8zsP_4&utm_campaign=designshare&utm_medium=link2&utm_source=uniquelinks&utlId=h05c8203c95

#  The Problem It Solves

Proof-of-Commitment turns staking, governance, and treasury management into a conviction-weighted system that rewards time, sustains token value, and keeps DAO control attack-resistant. The SDK is live on npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@proof-of-commitment/sdk

---

## Core Fixes (short version)

- **Conviction > Capital**: Tiered multipliers (1.0x-2.0x) give long-term stakers outsized voting power while short-term whales stay neutralized.
- **Deflationary flywheel**: Stake/unstake/claim fees feed a buyback-and-burn loop, keeping rewards sustainable instead of inflationary.
- **Attack resistance**: Snapshots, staking locks, timelocks, and soulbound commitment NFTs block flash-loan voting, vote renting, and rushed executions.
- **On-chain reputation**: Each stake mints a dynamic NFT that proves commitment terms, tier, and penalty schedule so partners can verify alignment instantly.
- **DAO-owned treasury**: Commitment-weighted voting governs fees, burns, penalties, and treasury actions with built-in quorum/threshold safety defaults.

---

## Why it matters

- **Token holders** get fair governance, verifiable reputation, and a deflationary asset instead of inflation-driven losses.
- **DAOs and protocols** gain a governance stack built to withstand flash-loan games while funding itself through protocol activity.
- **Everyday DeFi users** can choose commitment windows (7-365 days), exit early with transparent penalties, and watch progress via NFT visuals.

---

## Differentiators at a glance

| Problem | Legacy DeFi | Proof-of-Commitment |
|---------|-------------|---------------------|
| Governance | Capital-weighted | Time-weighted tiers |
| Economics | Inflation spiral | Revenue-funded burns |
| Security | Flash-loanable | Snapshot + lock stack |
| Commitment Proof | None | Dynamic soulbound NFT |
| Treasury | Centralized | DAO-controlled w/ timelock |

---

## Built for shipping

- Contracts, front-end, and analytics connect through the Proof-of-Commitment SDK (`@proof-of-commitment/sdk`) so builders can integrate staking, governance, and telemetry with one TypeScript wrapper.
- The package exports focused entry points (`staking`, `governance`, `analytics`, `nft`) and works with modern viem-based stacks, making it easy to drop conviction-weighted governance into any Lisk dApp.

**Challenges we ran into**

#  Challenges I Ran Into

Market research showed a glaring gap: most “staking + governance” stacks couldn’t prove long-term commitment or fund their own deflation. Shipping Proof-of-Commitment meant redesigning tokenomics, multi-contract deployments, and frontend/web3 glue from scratch.

---

## 1. Turning a Market Gap into a Revenue Model

- **What broke**: The inherited “mint rewards forever” playbook would have nuked token value within weeks.
- **Research sprint**: Modeled emergency-burn penalties, halving curves, and capped supplies before landing on a protocol-fee flywheel that pays for its own burns.
- **Fix**: 0.5% stake / 1% unstake / 1% claim fees route into a treasury, and `buybackAndBurn()` lets the DAO retire supply on demand. Twenty targeted tests prove fees accrue correctly and burns never overshoot balances.
- **Why it matters**: Governance power now rides on commitment, while holders see real deflation tied to actual usage—not promises.

---

## 2. Orchestrating the Lisk Sepolia Stack

- **Pain point**: Staking protocol and DAO depend on each other, so a naive deploy bricked ownership wiring.
- **Approach**: Split the process into two phases—deploy token, NFT, and protocol first; deploy DAO second; then link them via `setDAOGovernance()` and NFT ownership transfers. Each step logs addresses into JSON consumed by the frontend and SDK.
- **Result**: Reproducible Hardhat scripts publish the entire suite, emit metadata for clients, and keep re-deploys safe even under network hiccups.

---

## 3. Verifying + Integrating Across the Stack

- **Blockscout quirks**: Verification needed a custom runner that retries when the explorer falsely claims a contract is “already verified,” while keeping constructor args and compiler settings perfectly aligned.
- **Frontend sync**: The admin dashboard initially mixed ethers v6 syntax with our v5 dependency. Audit swapped every provider/signer parse call back to v5 equivalents so governance actions (burns, fee updates) finally executed.
- **Developer experience**: These fixes feed the public TypeScript SDK (`@proof-of-commitment/sdk`), so anyone integrating from the npm package inherits the verified addresses, ABIs, and conviction-weighted flows without reliving the debugging tour.

---

# Proof-of-Commitment Protocol  
### Track Fit: “Level up your Idea, Build a Real-World Venture” — Lisk Builders Challenge Round 3

## Why This Project Fits the Track
- **Founder Mindset from Day 0**: Ships a complete staking+governance protocol with a built-in revenue flywheel, sustainable tokenomics, and a clear commercialization plan (treasury fees, buyback & burn, NFT reputation).
- **Real Venture, Not Just a Demo**: Includes audited smart contracts on Lisk Sepolia, a production-ready Next.js dApp, and a TypeScript SDK so ecosystems and partners can integrate immediately.
- **Southeast Asia Relevance**: Targets community-owned DeFi primitives that local DAOs/startups can fork or plug into, strengthening the regional on-chain economy.

## Problem → Opportunity
- **Governance inequity**: Capital-rich whales overrun community decisions; small but committed holders are sidelined.
- **Inflation death spiral**: Reward-only staking models implode as supply outpaces demand.
- **Governance exploits**: Flash-loan voting, last-minute staking, and vote renting break trust.
- **Lack of on-chain reputation**: No verifiable commitment layer for DAOs and partners.

## Our Solution
1. **Time-Weighted Voting Power**: Tiered multipliers (1.0x–2.0x) reward conviction, not just capital. See [PROBLEM_IT_SOLVES.md](PROBLEM_IT_SOLVES.md).
2. **Revenue-Funded Deflation**: Stake/unstake/claim fees flow to treasury, fuel buyback-and-burn, and keep supply pressure $<0$ (deflationary).
3. **Commitment NFTs**: Soulbound ERC721s encode stake amount, duration, tier, and penalty schedule—verifiable alignment on-chain.
4. **Attack-Resistant Governance**: Snapshots, voting locks, execution timelocks, and DAO-controlled parameters prevent flash-loan or last-minute attacks.
5. **Full-Stack Delivery**: Hardhat contracts, React-admin console, hooks-based web3 UX, and an SDK for third-party builders.

## Real-World Venture Readiness
- **Business Model**: Treasury fees (0.5–1%) + emergency penalties convert usage into sustainable revenue; DAO decides when to burn vs. reinvest.
- **Market Entry Plan**: Launch as an open staking primitive for SEA DAOs, then license the SDK/NFT commitment layer to consumer apps, DeFi protocols, and community treasuries.
- **Scalability**: Modular contracts + SDK let partners embed commitment-weighted governance in any Lisk-native product.
- **Partnership Hooks**: Commitment NFTs double as reputation badges for accelerators, incubators, and cross-DAO collaborations.

**The problem it solves**

**ArtaPay: Gasless & Seamless Stablecoin Payments**
Despite the growth of Web3, crypto payments remain too complex for real-world adoption. We identified and solved three critical barriers that prevent users from using crypto for daily transactions:
**1. The Gas Fee Barrier (Solved via Account Abstraction)**
**Problem:** New users are forced to hold native tokens (ETH or Lisk) just to send Stablecoins. If a user has 100 USDC but 0 ETH, they are stuck. This is a massive friction point for onboarding.
**Solution:** ArtaPay utilizes a Custom Paymaster (ERC-4337). Users pay gas fees directly using the stablecoin they are transferring (e.g., IDRX or USDC). No ETH is required in the user's wallet.

**2. Currency Mismatch & Fragmented Liquidity**
**Problem:** In cross-border scenarios, users often hold local currencies (e.g., IDRX/Rupiah), but merchants demand global currencies (e.g., USDC). Manual swapping on DEXs is slow, expensive, and confusing for non-technical users.
**Solution:** We built an Auto-Swap Engine powered by a custom StableSwap AMM. Users can pay with any supported token they hold, and the protocol automatically swaps it to the merchant's desired token in a single transaction.

**3. High-Friction UX**
**Problem:** The standard "Approve → Swap → Sign" flow is tedious and destroys the "scan-and-go" experience expected in digital payments.
**Solution:** By bundling transactions via Gelato Relay, ArtaPay offers a "One-Click Pay" experience. Users simply scan a QR code and sign once. The protocol handles gas payments, swapping, and transfers in the background.

Key Features:
- Gasless Transactions: Native gas abstraction on Lisk Sepolia.
- Multi-Currency Support: Unified support for 7 global stablecoins (USDC, USDT, IDRX, JPYC, EUROC, MXNT, CNHT).
- Social Login: Seamless onboarding using Privy (Email/Socials), removing the need to manage seed phrases immediately.

**ArtaPay brings a true "Cash-like" payment experience to the Lisk Network, enabling global payments with local settlement.**

**Challenges we ran into**

**1. The "Custom Paymaster vs. Bundler" Battle**

* **The Problem:** We decided to build a **Custom Paymaster** from scratch (instead of using a standard preset) to handle stablecoin payments. However, connecting it to the ERC-4337 Bundler was a nightmare. We kept getting opaque error codes (like "AA33" or "AA23") because the Bundler rejected our custom logic for validating userOp.
* **The Solution:** We had to deeply debug the paymasterAndData encoding. We iteratively refined our validatePaymasterUserOp function to ensure it returned the correct context and validationData exactly as the EntryPoint expected, finally getting the Bundler to accept our transactions.

**2. Gas Price Volatility & The 5% Safety Guard**

* **The Problem:** We charge users in Stablecoins (e.g., IDRX), but the network charges us in ETH. Since gas prices on Lisk can spike in seconds, there was a risk: we might collect 500 IDRX from the user, but end up paying 600 IDRX worth of ETH for gas—losing money on the transaction.
* **The Solution:** We couldn't just use a static fee. We implemented a **5% Gas Slippage Guard (Markup)** in our calculation logic. This buffer covers sudden gas price spikes between the moment the user signs and the moment the transaction is mined, ensuring the protocol stays solvent.

**3. Securing the "Free Gas" from Abuse**

* **The Problem:** Since we sponsor gas, malicious actors could bypass our frontend and call our Paymaster contract directly to drain our ETH balance for their own transactions. Simple on-chain whitelisting was too rigid and expensive to update.
* **The Solution:** We moved the security check off-chain. We implemented a **Backend (BE) Verifier**. The Paymaster contract now requires a cryptographic signature generated by our backend. The backend only issues this signature after verifying the user's identity and request validity, effectively blocking any direct contract abuse.

**Winner Classification**

**ArtaPay fits perfectly into the "Stablecoins & Localized Payments" theme.**

The hackathon challenges builders to create a **"Real-World Venture"** for the Southeast Asian ecosystem. ArtaPay answers this by bridging the gap between local users (holding local stablecoins like **IDRX**) and global merchants on the Lisk Network.

We align with the track by:

1. **Solving Real Problems:** We remove the "Gas Fee" and "Currency Mismatch" barriers, making stablecoins usable for daily payments in SE Asia.
2. **Clear Revenue Model:** As required by the "Founder's Challenge," ArtaPay is built with sustainability in mind, generating revenue through **Platform Fees (0.5%)**, **Swap Fees**, and **Gas Markups**.
3. **Consumer App Focus:** We utilize Account Abstraction to deliver a seamless, "cash-like" UX that is ready for mass adoption.

> Customize Your Safety. Maximize Your Yield.

![Solidity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Solidity-333333?style=flat-square) ![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

The problem Yilnes solves
- The Problem: DeFi is High Yield, But High Anxiety. For users in Southeast Asia, accessing stable, institutional-grade finance is difficult. While DeFi offers high yields, the barrier to entry is fear.
- Risk of Principal Loss: The biggest hesitation for retail investors isn't "low yield," it's the fear of losing their initial deposit due to smart contract exploits or protocol defaults.
- Complexity of RWAs: Real World Assets (like Tokenized Treasuries from Ondo or Private Credit from Goldfinch) are the gold standard for stability, but they are often gated behind complex UIs or high minimums.
- Passive Reserve Growth: Most yield aggregators only build insurance funds by taxing profits after they are earned. If a hack happens on Day 1, the reserve is empty, and users arerekt.

The Solution: Yilnes – Institutional Yields, Principal Protected. Yilnes is a specialized RWA (Real World Asset) Yield Aggregator built on Lisk that introduces a novel Upfront Premium Coverage model.
- Upfront Safety Reserve: Unlike competitors that tax yield, Yilnes uses a "Nexus Mutual-style" logic where users pay a small premium immediately upon deposit based on their coverage duration (e.g., 90 days). This ensures the Safety Reserve has immediate liquidity to cover losses from the very first minute.
- Customizable Coverage: Users use a slider to choose their protection period (28 days to 365 days). Shorter terms pay higher premiums; longer terms get loyalty rates.
- Institutional Access on Lisk: We aggregate yields from top-tier RWA protocols (Ondo, Maple, Centrifuge) and bring them to the Lisk ecosystem, utilizing Lisk's low fees to make "micro-insurance" viable for everyday users.

Revenue Model (Founder's Challenge): Yilnes earns revenue through:
1. Spread on Premiums: A portion of the insurance premium goes to the Protocol Treasury.
2. Unclaimed Yields: Yields generated by the Safety Reserve itself (which is deployed into low-risk strategies) compound the protocol's value.

**Challenges we ran into**

The Pivot: Yield Tax vs. Upfront Premium Initially, we built the protocol using a standard "Performance Fee" model, where 10% of a user's profit was deducted to fund the insurance pool.
- The Hurdle: We realized this failed the "Day 1 Hack" scenario. If the protocol was exploited early, the reserve would be empty because no one had claimed yields yet.
- The Solution: We completely refactored the Smart Contract and Frontend logic to an Upfront Premium model. We had to implement complex time-weighted math (Principal * Rate * Duration / 365) in both Solidity and the React frontend to calculate costs in real-time as users moved the slider. This makes the protocol robust from the first deposit.

Handling "Expired" Coverage Building the logic for what happens when a user's chosen coverage period ends was tricky.

- The Hurdle: We didn't want to lock user funds or force-withdraw them when coverage expired.
- The Solution: We implemented a "Grace Period" state in the UI. If a user stays past their covered date, their dashboard badges change from "Premium Coverage" (Green) to "Uninsured" (Yellow), and they stop paying premiums but also lose protection. This required precise timestamp handling between the client (Wagmi/Viem) and the Lisk blockchain.

**Winner Classification**

- Main Track - DeFi & Financial Inclusion
- Social Media Challenge

### Flec
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/flec-f1d8) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/orgs/Flec-labs/repositories) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://drive.google.com/file/d/16QvkOnfkij-L3OBia8DmLtzoaYdKUceY/view?usp=sharing) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/-KtcwKEYUyI) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Lisk%20Builders%20Challenge:%20Round%20Three-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://lisk-builders-challenge-3.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-2-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Programmable work agreements

![Solidity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Solidity-333333?style=flat-square) ![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![AI/ML](https://img.shields.io/badge/AI/ML-333333?style=flat-square) ![WebSocket](https://img.shields.io/badge/WebSocket-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Global freelance work today relies heavily on trust, but trust is fragile.

Work agreements, progress tracking, and payments all live in separate systems.
Agreements are written in PDFs or chats, progress is tracked in tools like Notion or Trello, and payments are handled manually through banks or payroll platforms.

This fragmentation creates serious problems:

- **Freelancers** often experience delayed or withheld payments even after completing their work
- **Companies** struggle to verify progress and enforce agreements fairly
- Payments depend on **manual approvals** or **platform-controlled processes**
- There is **no reliable way to enforce execution** when one party stalls or acts in bad faith
- Disputes escalate because **agreements cannot execute themselves**

As a result, both sides are forced to rely on human trust or intermediaries, leading to higher costs, delays, and failed collaborations, especially in cross-border work.

Existing solutions only address parts of this problem:

- **Payroll tools** focus on moving money but leave agreements and execution off-system.
- **Freelance platforms** act as intermediaries, holding funds and making subjective decisions, which introduces high fees, centralized control, and platform dependency.

**None of these solutions make the agreement itself enforceable.**

FLEC solves this by introducing **programmable work agreements.**
Instead of treating agreements as documents and payments as separate actions, FLEC turns the agreement into **the system that controls execution.**

With FLEC, rules are defined upfront, funds are locked in escrow, and payments are released automatically based on those rules. Execution no longer depends on promises, manual follow-ups, or platform discretion, but on **predefined logic that both parties can verify.**

#### Target users

FLEC is designed for teams and individuals who collaborate globally and face recurring trust and payment risks:

- **Freelancers** working across borders who need guaranteed, timely payments
- **Remote-first startups** hiring international contributors and contractors
- **Small to mid-sized digital agencies** managing multiple freelance projects
- **Web3 and tech teams** working with distributed contributors

These users need enforceable agreements without relying on expensive intermediaries or complex legal processes.

#### Key features

FLEC provides a focused set of features built around **execution, trust, and clarity**:

- **Programmable work agreements**
Agreements are created as rule-based contracts defining scope, payment type, deadlines, and execution logic.
- **Onchain escrow and fund locking**
Funds are locked upfront in a non-custodial escrow and cannot be withdrawn unilaterally.
- **Flexible payment models**
Supports one-time payments, milestone-based projects, and recurring payroll.
- **Automatic and rule-based execution**
Payments are released automatically upon approval or based on predefined timeout rules, reducing stalling and follow-ups.
- **Transparent activity, proof of work, and audit trail**
Submissions can be encrypted, with hashes and timestamps recorded to provide verifiable proof of delivery without exposing sensitive content.
- **Dispute lock and arbitration**
In case of disputes, funds can be frozen under a dispute status to prevent unilateral actions. By default, disputes can be resolved through a trusted external arbitrator provided by the protocol. Companies and freelancers can also choose or specify their own arbitrator at agreement creation. In the future, FLEC plans to introduce a DAO-based arbitration layer for decentralized and transparent dispute resolution.
- **Integrated chat with AI RAG support**
FLEC includes a built-in communication channel between companies and freelancers. AI RAG is used to surface relevant agreement terms, milestones, deadlines, and prior submissions during conversations. This helps reduce ambiguity, miscommunication, and scope disputes without making subjective decisions or judgments.

Together, these features allow freelance collaboration to move from trust-based coordination to rule-based execution, with clearer communication and fewer disputes.

#### Business model
FLEC operates as a protocol-level execution layer for work agreements.

Revenue is generated through a **1.5% execution fee per agreement**, charged once when funds are locked into escrow. The fee is paid upfront by the company and deducted at agreement creation.

To keep pricing fair and predictable:

- Minimum fee: **$1 per agreement**
- Maximum fee: **$500 per agreement**

The execution fee covers agreement deployment, automated execution, and protocol usage. FLEC does not take custody of funds beyond escrow execution and does not charge recurring subscription fees.

This model aligns revenue with actual usage while remaining significantly cheaper and more transparent than traditional freelance platforms or payroll services.

**Challenges we ran into**

### Challenges we ran into

Building FLEC involved several technical and product challenges, especially around scope definition, usability, and trust minimization.

**1. Defining a focused MVP scope**  
There were many tempting features to add, such as freelancer marketplaces, built-in discovery, fiat on-ramps, and complex compliance flows. To keep the product focused and shippable within the hackathon timeframe, we intentionally limited the MVP by focusing on programmable work agreements with escrowed execution. Non-essential features were deferred to future iterations or planned as integrations.

**2. Making onchain systems usable for non-crypto users**  
Smart contracts and wallets introduce friction for users unfamiliar with Web3.  We addressed this by designing a Web2-like interface and abstracting blockchain interactions behind the product flow.

**3. Designing enforceable agreements without becoming an arbitrator**  
One of the main challenges was defining how agreements could be enforced without FLEC acting as a judge. We addressed this by making the smart contract purely rule-based, locking funds upfront and executing only what was predefined. Disputes are handled through a dispute lock and external arbitrators instead of subjective platform decisions.

**4. Balancing flexibility and simplicity in payment logic**  
Supporting one-time payments, milestones, and recurring payroll increased contract complexity and edge cases. We solved this by unifying all payment types under a single lifecycle model and extensively testing state transitions using Foundry.

**5. Preventing stalling and ghosting scenarios**  
Manual approvals can lead to one party stalling the process indefinitely.  
To mitigate this, we introduced configurable approval timeouts that allow automatic execution based on agreed rules.

**6. Reducing ambiguity in communication**  
Miscommunication often leads to disputes even when agreements exist. To reduce this, we integrated an in-app chat with AI RAG support that surfaces relevant agreement terms, milestones, and deadlines directly in conversations.

**Winner Classification**

FLEC addresses a real and widely experienced problem in global freelance work: the lack of enforceable agreements and reliable execution across borders.

Instead of building another marketplace or payment tool, FLEC introduces a new primitive: programmable work agreements. By locking funds upfront and enforcing execution through smart contracts, FLEC removes the need for blind trust, reduces disputes, and ensures fair outcomes for both freelancers and companies.

The project demonstrates strong technical execution on Lisk through onchain escrow, rule-based state transitions, and non-custodial fund management, while remaining accessible to non-crypto users via a Web2-like interface and clear user flows.

FLEC is designed with a focused MVP scope, a sustainable business model, and a clear path to adoption, making it a practical solution that can be deployed and used beyond the hackathon.

These qualities position FLEC as a project that combines real-world impact, technical depth, and long-term viability, aligning well with the goals of the Winner Classification track.

> Build your mind. Stake your time.

![Solidity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Solidity-333333?style=flat-square) ![OpenZeppelin](https://img.shields.io/badge/OpenZeppelin-333333?style=flat-square) ![Kotlin](https://img.shields.io/badge/Kotlin-333333?style=flat-square) ![React Native](https://img.shields.io/badge/React%20Native-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

# The Problem: The "No-Consequence" Loop
In today's digital landscape, our focus is the product being bought and sold. Most productivity tools (timers, blockers, forest-planting apps) fail because they rely entirely on **passive willpower**. 
- **The "Cheat" Factor:** It is too easy to just "close the app" and scroll TikTok without any real penalty.
- **The Lack of Stakes:** There is no skin in the game. If you fail a study session, you've lost nothing but time—something we've been conditioned to undervalue.
- **The Isolation:** Productivity is often a lonely battle with no social or community upside for being disciplined.

# The Solution: Tsumi
Tsumi transforms focus into a **high-stakes protocol**. By combining **decentralized finance (DeFi)** with **native mobile monitoring**, it creates a system where discipline is literally profitable.

## 1. Financial Accountability (Loss Aversion)
Tsumi uses the psychological principle of **Loss Aversion**. Humans are twice as motivated to avoid a loss as they are to achieve a gain. By staking **ETH**, the user creates a tangible consequence for distraction.
- **Old Way:** "I should study." (Fails easily).
- **Tsumi Way:** "If I open Instagram in the next hour, I lose $20." (Focuses immediately).

## 2. Automated Enforcement (The "Anti-Cheat")
Unlike other apps that rely on "honor systems," Tsumi uses **Native Android Monitoring**.
- It detects the exact moment a "forbidden" app is opened.
- It triggers an automatic **slashing event** on the blockchain. 
- This makes the task of staying focused **safer** from our own impulses by removing the "choice" to ignore the timer.

## 3. The Flywheel
Standard apps keep your data or subscription fee regardless of your success. Tsumi redistributes failure into community success.
- **25% of slashed funds** go to a **Monthly Leaderboard Pool**.
- This creates a community incentive: the most disciplined users are directly rewarded by those who couldn't stay focused.

# What can people use it for?

## The "Deep Work" Student
Pre-med or Law students who need 4-hour blocks of uninterrupted study. They stake ETH to ensure they don't break their flow to check a group chat.

## The Remote Worker
Digital nomads and WFH professionals who struggle with "home distractions." Tsumi creates a clear "Work-to-Earn" boundary during their 9-to-5.

## The Dopamine Detox
Individuals looking to break phone addiction. By gradually increasing their "un-slashed" focus time, they rebuild their neural pathways for long-term concentration.

## Competitive Productivity
High-performers who want to prove their discipline. Users can compete to see who can accumulate the most "Focus Hours" and win the monthly redistribution prize.

**Challenges we ran into**

My primary hurdle was the "App Blocking" wall. I struggled to find a reliable way to enforce focus without violating OS security sandboxes. After researching Accessibility Services and iOS Screen Time APIs which proved too intrusive or required long approval times. I overcame this by implementing the Android UsageStatsManager API, coupled with a custom "Permission Bridge" and a "Violation Overlay" logic. This shifted my approach from an unreliable hard block to an active monitoring system that intercepts forbidden apps and triggers a slashing event if the user breaks their session, successfully bridging the gap between native OS behavior and blockchain staking.

### LokaPay
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/lokapay-9f13) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://lokapay.xyz) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/Y6E7t3iWCLM) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Lisk%20Builders%20Challenge:%20Round%20Three-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://lisk-builders-challenge-3.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-2-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Accept Global, Settle Local.

![Solidity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Solidity-333333?style=flat-square) ![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![PostgreSQL](https://img.shields.io/badge/PostgreSQL-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

**LokaPay addresses the multi-billion dollar friction in Indonesia's tourism economy by solving three critical pain points:**

1. The 5% "Invisible Tax" (High Transaction Costs): International tourists lose significant value through currency conversion (FX) spreads and cross-border card fees. Simultaneously, local merchants are charged high MDR (Merchant Discount Rates) by traditional banks. LokaPay slashes these costs by bypassing traditional SWIFT/banking rails, utilizing Lisk L2 for near-zero transaction fees.

2. The Settlement Dead-Zone (T+1 to T+3 Delays): Small-to-Medium Enterprises (SMEs) in tourism hotspots like Bali depend on daily cash flow. Traditional international settlements take 24–72 hours. LokaPay provides instant on-chain verification, allowing the merchant to see "Paid" status immediately, with IDR settlement triggered significantly faster than traditional banking systems.

3. The Regulatory Dead-End (Compliance Firewall): In Indonesia, the law (UU No. 7 Year 2011) strictly mandates that all domestic payments must be made in Rupiah (IDR). Most crypto payment projects fail here because they try to make merchants accept tokens directly. LokaPay solves this by acting as a technical bridge: the tourist pays in USDT, but the merchant receives 100% IDR. This ensures the venture is legally viable and **ready for immediate market adoption.**

**Challenges we ran into**

**The Issue**: If the merchant had to handle private keys or USDT-to-IDR exchanges, they wouldn't use the app. If the merchant received USDT directly, they would be in violation of Indonesian Law.

**The Solution**: I engineered a Hybrid Orchestration Layer. I separated the Payment Event (On-chain via Lisk L2) from the Settlement Event (Off-chain via Bank Gateway). By using a backend worker to monitor the Lisk Blockchain, we sweeping the USDT from the temporary address into the secured LokaPay vault. This keeps the complexity hidden from the merchant while staying 100% compliant.

**LokaPay: Accept Global, Settle Local. Built to scale, designed to comply.**

**Winner Classification**

LokaPay is a market ready venture bridging the global crypto economy with Indonesia’s retail sector. By leveraging Lisk L2, we eliminate the predatory 5% 'friction tax' and T+1 settlement delays through a seamless, gasless experience.

Our unique 'Compliance Firewall' solves the ultimate legal barrier, ensuring every transaction adheres to Indonesian currency laws by settling 100% IDR to merchants while tourists pay in USDT. LokaPay isn't just a dApp; it is a legally viable, scalable financial bridge built to turn global liquidity into local growth. **We accept global, but we settle local.**

[Immanuel Janis](https://github.com/immanueljanis)

**The problem it solves**

# Vouch: Decentralized Escrow Infrastructure for Social Commerce

## The Problem Vouch Solves

Social commerce in Southeast Asia happens inside private chats — Instagram DMs, WhatsApp, Facebook and TikTok messages. However, these platforms were never designed for secure transactions.

As a result:
- Buyers are afraid to pay first
- Sellers are afraid to ship first
- Scams are common and difficult to resolve
- Existing solutions force users into centralized marketplaces with high fees and lock-in
- There is no neutral, trustless escrow layer for transactions that happen directly inside chats

## What is Vouch?

Vouch is a decentralized escrow infrastructure for social commerce, built on the Lisk network.

Vouch turns a simple payment link into an on-chain escrow contract that securely holds funds until both buyer and seller fulfill their obligations.

Without becoming a marketplace, Vouch brings marketplace-level trust to Instagram, WhatsApp, and TikTok transactions — directly inside DMs.

## Who Can Use Vouch?

Vouch is designed for real people doing real social commerce, including:
- Instagram sellers
- WhatsApp merchants
- TikTok live sellers
- Individual resellers and small businesses

**No blockchain knowledge is required. No account registration is needed. If you can send a link, you can use Vouch.**

## Use Cases

Vouch focuses on one core use case done extremely well: **Secure DM-Based Transactions**

- Selling physical goods via Instagram or WhatsApp
- High-trust transactions between strangers
- One-off sales without marketplace onboarding

*Future extensions may include digital goods and service escrow, but the current focus is simple, secure social commerce payments.*

## How Vouch Makes Transactions Safer

### Decentralized Escrow Protection

- **Smart Contract Escrow**: All funds are locked in a Lisk smart contract
- **Non-Custodial**: No backend or company can steal or freeze funds
- **Automatic Release**: Funds are released only when conditions are met
- **Timeout Enforcement**: Auto-release or auto-refund if a party is inactive

The smart contract — not the backend — is the final authority.

### On-Chain Identity & Transparency

- **Wallet = Identity**: Sellers and buyers are identified by their wallets
- **Immutable Escrow History**: All escrow events are recorded on-chain
- **Public Verification**: Anyone can verify escrow status independently
- **No Impersonation**: Sellers must sign escrow creation on-chain

### Hybrid Fiat + Crypto Safety

- **Crypto Payments**: USDC or IDRX Lisk, fully on-chain
- **Fiat Payments**: QRIS / VA via Xendit
- **Unified Escrow Logic**: Regardless of payment method, escrow rules remain on-chain
- **Oracle-Style Backend**: Backend only verifies fiat payments, never controls funds

## How Vouch Makes Transactions Easier

### Web2-Friendly User Experience

- No login
- No registration
- Mobile-first interface
- Familiar payment language
- Clean, non-crypto UI

Users interact with Vouch the same way they already sell online — through chats.

### Simple, Shareable Flow

1. Seller creates escrow link
2. Pastes link into DM
3. Buyer pays
4. Seller ships
5. Buyer confirms
6. Funds are released

**No extra apps. No marketplace onboarding. No platform lock-in.**

### Flexible Payment Methods

- Pay with USDC and IDRX on Lisk
- Pay with QRIS / Virtual Account
- Supports local payment behavior in Southeast Asia
- One escrow flow for all payment types

## Why Blockchain is Essential

Vouch does not use blockchain as a buzzword.

Blockchain is required because:
- Escrow rules must be neutral
- Funds must be non-custodial
- Outcomes must be deterministic
- Trust must not rely on a company or backend

*If the backend disappears, escrow funds remain safe on-chain.*


## Final Statement

Vouch does not try to replace marketplaces.

It replaces the missing trust layer in social commerce — where millions of transactions already happen every day.

**Trust your DMs.**

**Challenges we ran into**

## Challenges We Ran Into

Building Vouch required careful balance between decentralization and real-world payment constraints.

### Key Challenges
- Designing an escrow system that works with both fiat and crypto
- Ensuring sellers cannot be impersonated during escrow creation
- Keeping the flow simple enough for non-technical users
- Avoiding over-engineering while maintaining security guarantees

### Our Solutions
- Making the seller the on-chain escrow creator
- Treating fiat payments as verified inputs, not custody
- Keeping the smart contract as the single source of truth

**Winner Classification**

Vouch fits the Winner Classification track by solving a real, high-frequency problem in Southeast Asia: trustless payments in social commerce.

Millions of transactions happen daily inside Instagram DMs, WhatsApp, Facebook and TikTok chats, yet these platforms lack any native escrow or buyer–seller protection. This results in rampant scams, payment disputes, and low trust on both sides.

Vouch introduces a decentralized escrow layer that works alongside existing chat platforms without changing user behavior. Buyers and sellers simply share a Vouch payment link in their chat. Funds are locked in a smart contract, released only when the buyer confirms item delivery.

Our solution combines:
- **Clear real-world utility** (protecting P2P social commerce transactions)
- **Strong product execution** (simple Web2 UX with Web3 trust guarantees)
- **On-chain innovation** (smart contract escrow as the source of truth)

Vouch demonstrates how blockchain can quietly power safer everyday transactions, making it a strong contender for winner-level impact and execution.

**The problem it solves**

# Unirivo: Solving the Friction in Collaborative Innovation

Unirivo is a comprehensive project incubation hub designed to address the systemic barriers that prevent ideas from becoming reality. By integrating AI-driven management with Blockchain security, Unirivo solves the following critical problems in the modern creative and technical economy.

---

## 1. The Trust and Security Gap (IP Protection)
**The Problem:** Many creators are hesitant to share their innovative ideas for fear of intellectual property theft. Traditional collaboration platforms offer no legal protection at the point of entry, leaving founders vulnerable during the initial "pitching" phase.
**The Unirivo Solution:** Unirivo implements a mandatory, automated "No-Reveal" security gate. Before a user can view sensitive project details or join the team, they must sign a legally binding NDA within the platform. This creates a secure environment where founders can disclose details to potential talent without anxiety.

## 2. Inefficient Talent Acquisition and Vetting
**The Problem:** Finding the right collaborators is a time-consuming manual process. Reviewing resumes often fails to reveal a candidate's actual communication style or technical depth, and manual interviewing is a significant bottleneck for solo founders.
**The Unirivo Solution:** Unirivo uses AI to automatically scout talent based on the specific skill requirements of a project. It further streamlines vetting via an automated AI-voice interview system. The AI evaluates candidates in real-time based on role-specific criteria, ensuring only qualified and compatible members join the project.

## 3. The Management and Execution Trap
**The Problem:** Most independent or "passion" projects fail due to a lack of structure. Without a dedicated project manager, teams struggle with vague milestones, disorganized task distribution, and technical blockers that bring progress to a halt.
**The Unirivo Solution:** The platform acts as an AI Project Manager. It automatically generates actionable milestones and manages the task board to keep the team focused. Additionally, the community feature—backed by AI troubleshooting—ensures that technical issues are resolved instantly, preventing the project from stalling.

## 4. Unverifiable Proof of Contribution
**The Problem:** Traditional resumes rely on self-reported experience, which is often difficult for employers to verify. Conversely, contributors to small or private projects often have no official record of their hard work once the project ends.
**The Unirivo Solution:** Unirivo leverages the Solana Blockchain to issue encrypted Contribution Certificates. These are immutable, tamper-proof records of the specific tasks and milestones a user completed. This transforms "work experience" into a verifiable digital asset, providing workers with high-integrity proof of their skills.

## 5. Community Isolation
**The Problem:** Builders often work in silos, losing out on the collective intelligence of other creators. When teams hit a wall, they have nowhere to turn for specialized advice without hiring expensive consultants.
**The Unirivo Solution:** Unirivo fosters a "builders-helping-builders" ecosystem. Through the community feature, users can raise issues that the AI can answer immediately based on the project's context, or the wider community can provide peer support, creating a collaborative knowledge base for all users.

**Challenges we ran into**

# Technical Challenges and Solutions

---

## 1. Context Management in AI-Driven Project Planning

### The Challenge
As projects progressed, the volume of chat logs and task metadata grew beyond the standard context window limits of Google Gemini and Groq. Attempting to feed the entire project history into the AI for milestone generation resulted in high latency, increased token costs, and a loss of focus on the most recent project requirements.

### The Solution
I implemented a tiered retrieval system using the Mastra AI Framework. The system performs periodic summarization of project activities, which are stored as "Project States" in MongoDB. When a user requests new milestones or task updates, the system only injects the current project state and the most recent relevant interactions. This ensures the AI remains highly accurate and responsive without being overwhelmed by historical data.

---

## 2. Latency in AI-Voice Interview Feedback Loops

### The Challenge
A critical feature of Unirivo is the AI-driven voice interview. Initially, there was a significant delay between the user's spoken response and the AI's next technical question. This "response gap" made the interaction feel disjointed and hindered the assessment of candidate communication skills.

### The Solution
To address this, I moved to a streaming architecture. Using Groq's LLaMA 3.3 for rapid text generation and a low-latency Speech-to-Text (STT) / Text-to-Speech (TTS) pipeline, I enabled the AI to begin streaming audio chunks before the full response was finished. Additionally, I utilized GSAP to animate "active listening" states on the frontend, which effectively masked the remaining processing time and provided a seamless user experience.

---

## 3. Data-Level Enforcement of the No-Reveal Security Gate

### The Challenge
Ensuring the security of intellectual property was paramount. Early testing revealed that simply hiding the project dashboard behind a UI modal was insufficient; savvy users could still access sensitive project data through direct API requests to the /api/project routes before signing the mandatory "No-Reveal" contract.

### The Solution
I implemented a server-side security gate using Next.js Middleware and Mongoose pre-find hooks. Every request targeting project-specific data now undergoes a mandatory permission check against the user's database record. If the nda_signed flag is not set to true, the API rejects the request at the server level with a 403 Forbidden status. This ensures that the idea is protected at the source, regardless of the frontend state.

---

## 4. Solana Transaction Finality and Certificate Issuance

### The Challenge
When minting contribution certificates on the Solana blockchain, the frontend would often report a successful transaction before the data was fully propagated across the network. This caused an error when users attempted to view their certificates on a block explorer immediately after project completion.

### The Solution
I refined the Solana Web3.js integration to use the finalized commitment level for critical transactions. I developed a recursive polling mechanism in the backend that waits for a cluster-wide confirmation signature before updating the certificate status in the user's dashboard. This ensures that whenever a user is notified of a successful contribution record, the link to the blockchain is 100% verified and accessible.

---

## 5. UI Synchronization with Complex State Transitions

### The Challenge
With multiple moving parts—AI interviews, blockchain minting, and real-time task management—keeping the UI in sync without constant page refreshes was difficult. Standard React state management led to "prop drilling" and inconsistent UI updates across the chat and task modules.

### The Solution
I utilized a combination of React 18's concurrent features and custom hooks to manage local state, while Radix UI primitives provided a consistent accessibility layer. Framer Motion was used to handle the transition between the "Recruitment" phase and the "Active Project" phase, ensuring that the heavy lifting of state transitions remained invisible to the end user.

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Firebase Authentication](https://img.shields.io/badge/Firebase%20Authentication-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Human error remains the leading cause of modern cybersecurity breaches.
Despite advanced security systems, users continue to fall victim to phishing attacks, weak passwords, and unsafe digital behavior-

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/d97ac86935124009b573a4aee74d9634/5b3a6da0-81d3-41de-9c36-32140fe599a0.png)primarily due to lack of awareness and practical training.

HEVS (Human Error Vulnerability Scanner) directly addresses this gap by simulating real-world cyber threats and measuring how users respond to them in controlled, safe environments.

The platform analyzes user behavior, quantifies human vulnerability into actionable risk scores, and provides data-driven insights for individuals, HR teams, and security administrators.

By shifting the focus from tools to human behavior, HEVS transforms cybersecurity training into a measurable, practical, and proactive defense mechanism-helping organizations prevent breaches before they happen.

**Challenges we ran into**

One of the major challenges was translating **human behavior into measurable security risk** in a meaningful and ethical way.

Designing phishing simulations that felt realistic while remaining safe for users required careful planning and validation.

Another challenge was implementing **role-based access control** (User, HR, Super Admin) and structuring Firebase data so that analytics could scale across multiple organizations.

We addressed these challenges by modularizing the application, designing structured Firestore collections, and using systematic testing and logging to resolve authentication and data-fetching issues.

![Solidity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Solidity-333333?style=flat-square) ![IPFS](https://img.shields.io/badge/IPFS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![ethers.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/ethers.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Etherscan](https://img.shields.io/badge/Etherscan-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Hardhat](https://img.shields.io/badge/Hardhat-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

**HackFiesta Certificate On‑Chain**

*HackFiesta Certificate On‑Chain transforms hackathon certificates into blockchain‑backed NFTs. Instead of fragile PDFs, every certificate is minted as a verifiable digital asset*

- **On‑Chain Proof**: The smart contract records the certificate’s metadata URI, tying it permanently to the participant’s wallet address. 

- **Immutable Metadata**: Each certificate has a JSON file stored on IPFS, containing the participant’s details, event name, year, and attributes.

- **Permanent Image:** The certificate design (certificate.png) is also stored on IPFS, ensuring it can never be lost or altered.

**How It Helps People**? 

- **Participants**: Own a certificate that can’t be faked or lost. Showcase achievements in portfolios, resumes, or LinkedIn with blockchain‑verified proof.

- **Recruiters & Judges**: Instantly verify participation by checking the certificate metadata and transaction hash on Etherscan.

**Challenges we ran into**

**IPFS CID Confusion**

During testing, the certificate card sometimes failed to show the image. The problem was that we mixed up the CIDs:

- Accidentally used the image CID instead of the JSON CID when minting.

- This led to the frontend fetching metadata that didn’t exist, or metadata pointing to an invalid image.

**The problem it solves**

Dementia or Alzheimer's is a disease which is diagnosed in the later stages when it become chronic and very difficult and expensive to treat. So, we have build a **Dementia Screener** which will help people screen for dementia and if they think their speech and cognitive abilities are declining they can seek medical attention or professional help at right time to avoid further degradation.

Disclaimer: This is a Screener, not a diagnosis, meaning we are focused on helping people analyse if their speech and cognitive abilitites are declining over time.
This can't be used as a medical certificate of the disease.

We have implemented this using some gold standard tests like **Cookie Theft Test** and used Libraries like **Librosa, SpaCy, etc.** and also used APIs like google speech for conversion.

In backend we have used Fast API and SQLite

In frontend we have React + Vite

**Challenges we ran into**

The challenges I faced was working on analysing the audio samples and taking the answers from the cognitive tests to produce a valid score.

As well as, due to shortage of time I had to implement SQLite and storing analysis data in that was very difficult

Apart from that setting up google speech api was a little difficult and to use it for conversion for this project was a little difficult because earlier I had used OpenAI Whisper for conversion of speech to text, but the build image of it was very large for railway.app to handle, so I had to switch to google speech.

**AI TRACK**

We have used Python libraries like 
- librosa
- pydub
- soundfile
- scipy
- numpy
- email-validator
- python-multipart
- uvicorn
to analyse the answers and speech inputs from the user to test them against the datasets.

We have used **Rule Based AI**, as in medical fields that is more **reliable**, meaning it will generate same results for a input using the dataset.

Used NLP for answer quality assessment and in future we are going to implement more ML models for advanced dementia screening.

> ML-Based Forecasting of Crypto Price Trends

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![scikit-learn](https://img.shields.io/badge/scikit--learn-333333?style=flat-square) ![Machine Learning](https://img.shields.io/badge/Machine%20Learning-333333?style=flat-square) ![pandas](https://img.shields.io/badge/pandas-333333?style=flat-square) ![OAuth](https://img.shields.io/badge/OAuth-333333?style=flat-square) ![REST API](https://img.shields.io/badge/REST%20API-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

**OmniCast** 

The ***OmniCast*** platform is a Machine Learning-driven web application designed to bring data science into the volatile world of cryptocurrency trading.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/1aef0b67f13f4af78f41bc83c375e3a4/a82ad1bc-5ac8-4431-93b6-7c9b9104dc93.png)

**1.The Problem It Solves**
The cryptocurrency market is notoriously volatile and driven by emotion, making it difficult for individual investors to make rational, data-backed decisions.

**Problem:** Determining whether to buy, sell, or hold assets like Bitcoin or Ethereum is often based on guesswork, hype, or scattered news sources.

**Solution:** OmniCast aggregates opportunities and risks into a single dashboard. It uses historical data and machine learning to forecast future price trends, aggregates relevant news to gauge market sentiment, and provides tools to calculate potential returns.


**2.What People Can Use It For**

**Price Forecasting:** Users can generate AI-powered price predictions for major cryptocurrencies (BTC, ETH, BNB, DOGE, ADA) for the next 24 hours or longer timeframes.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/1aef0b67f13f4af78f41bc83c375e3a4/90e656ca-a39e-4db4-a385-51d8dcc8991c.png)

**Investment Planning:** Using the Calculator feature, users can simulate investment scenarios (e.g., "If I invest $1000 in ETH today, what might it be worth based on the forecast?").

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/1aef0b67f13f4af78f41bc83c375e3a4/aaed61b7-c973-4bc0-9747-addff08d4b0e.png)

**Asset Comparison:** The Compare feature allows users to evaluate multiple cryptocurrencies side-by-side to identify which asset shows better growth potential or stability.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/1aef0b67f13f4af78f41bc83c375e3a4/306b662c-44d6-46a5-9a31-c38c045e3fe8.png)

**News Aggregation:** Instead of checking multiple news sites, users can get coin-specific news feeds directly within the app to stay updated on regulatory changes or market-moving events.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/1aef0b67f13f4af78f41bc83c375e3a4/0068c849-e16f-418a-81da-7e6994870a8b.png)

**3. How It Makes Tasks Easier & Safer**

**Reduces Analysis Paralysis:** Instead of staring at raw charts for hours, the ML model synthesizes complex patterns into understandable price targets.

**Centralized Intelligence:** It combines quantitative data (price history) with qualitative data (news) in one interface, saving the user time switching between tabs.

**Risk Mitigation:** By providing data-driven "Forecasts" rather than just showing current prices, it helps users avoid buying at local peaks or panic selling during temporary dips.

**Accessibility:** It democratizes access to predictive algorithms that are usually reserved for institutional traders, presenting them in a user-friendly, responsive web interface.

**Challenges we ran into**

**Challenges I ran into**
Building ***OmniCast*** was a rollercoaster of technical hurdles. Here is every major challenge I faced and how I overcame it:

**The "White Screen of Death" (Dependency Hell)**

**The Issue:** Midway through development, the entire application suddenly refused to render, showing only a blank white screen. The console was throwing cryptic errors about "context" and "providers."

**The Fix:** Using a process of elimination, I discovered a severe version conflict between react-router-dom (v6) and framer-motion. They were fighting for control over the component lifecycle. I had to pin specific compatible versions in *package.json* to resolve the crash.

**Performance vs. Aesthetics (The Lag Battle)**

**The Issue:** I wanted a "premium" feel with 3D backgrounds (Vanta.js) and tilt effects. However, this caused significant site lag and jittery scrolling on lower-end devices, making the app feel slow despite the fast backend.

**The Fix:** I initially stripped out all effects to fix the lag, but the app lost its soul. I eventually found a balance by optimizing the rendering cycle ,ensuring the heavy 3D scripts only ran when necessary, restoring the visual "wow" factor without killing the CPU.

**Model Stability (The "Lucky Seed" Problem)**

**The Issue:** My Machine Learning model (XGBoost/Linear Regression) was inconsistent. It would give a great predicted price one run, and a completely different one the next, just by changing the random seed.

**The Fix:** I had to professionalize the workflow by establishing a "Master Build". I experimented with Seed Stability Tests (running the model across multiple seeds) to ensure the variance was low (< 0.005). I stopped relying on luck and started relying on robust statistics.

**The Mobile Responsiveness Trap**

**The Issue:** The dashboard looked amazing on my desktop, but completely broke on mobile. The CSS Grid layouts for the charts would squish together, and the navigation bar became unusable.

**The Fix:** I faced a persistent bug where my media queries weren't applying. I had to debug the CSS specificity and rewrite the layout using Tailwind's flex-col utilities to ensure the complex data tables stacked vertically on phones.

**Authentication Complexity**

**The Issue:** Integrating Google Login was trickier than expected. I struggled with the OAuth flow, specifically managing the Client IDs and ensuring the backend actually verified the token instead of just blindly trusting the frontend.

**The Fix:** I implemented Google OAuth2 with a proper backend verification step using the *google-auth library*, ensuring that only valid users could access the prediction history.

> Transform Your Manufacturing Into Sustainable Prod

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

CirculoMetrix AI is all about sustainable manufacturing analytics — meaning it helps factories and industrial teams actually see what’s going on in their production from both an efficiency and environmental perspective. Think of it as a brain that watches every move on the factory floor, then tells you what’s working, what’s wasteful, and how to fix it smartly. The goal is to turn messy manufacturing data into clear insights so people don’t have to guess what to change. It makes hard decisions easier and sustainability real.
Here’s the breakdown:

 **Problem — Real-World Mess**

        Traditional manufacturing struggles with three big issues:
Waste & inefficiency: Machines and materials get used without a clear picture of how much gets wasted or why production hiccups happen.
Lack of actionable sustainability data: Companies want to reduce their carbon footprint and resource use, but they don’t have real-time, trustworthy analytics to show them how.
Manual, slow reporting: Without automation, environmental and performance reporting becomes a grind — delayed, inaccurate, and expensive.
AI helps loop all that data into one system so people don’t have to play detective anymore. This isn’t just dashboards for executives — it’s real-time analytics that can change decisions mid-shift. 

 **What it enables people to do**

           Here’s how it improves real tasks — more than just buzzwords:
Spot inefficiencies instantly: No more waiting for monthly reports — AI flags anomalies as they happen, so teams can act faster.
Reduce waste of materials and energy: Instead of guessing where scrap is coming from, the system shows patterns so you can fix root causes.
Track sustainability KPIs automatically: CO₂, energy use, water use, supply chain impacts — all of it gets quantified without a spreadsheet meltdown.
Better decision-making: Rather than relying on gut or past habits, teams use data to choose the best tweaks that improve both outputs and environmental performance.
TL;DR — the real-deal description
CirculoMetrix AI is a tool for factories and makers that turns messy production and sustainability data into clear, actionable insights with AI. It helps people cut waste, make better decisions faster, and run greener operations — because optimizing sustainability is no longer a manual slog, it’s smart automation.

**Challenges we ran into**

Challenges we ran into
1. **Messy, inconsistent data**
Manufacturing and sustainability data don’t come in neat little rows wearing name tags.

**The problem:**
Some datasets were incomplete
Some had missing values
Some straight-up contradicted each other
How we got over it:
Built a data preprocessing pipeline to clean, normalize, and validate inputs
Added checks to flag anomalies instead of letting bad data poison the model

2. **Balancing AI accuracy vs real-time performance
The problem:**

- Complex models = better insights
- Better insights = slower responses
- Slow UI = users bounce. Instantly.
How we got over it:
- Optimized inference logic
- Cached frequently used calculations
- Split heavy processing from user-facing interactions

**3. Making insights understandable
The problem:**

Sustainability metrics are abstract
Raw outputs confused users instead of helping them
How we got over it:
Translated outputs into visual dashboards
Focused on actionable insights, not just analytics

4. **Deployment + integration headaches
Local environment?**

Smooth.

**The problem:**

- API mismatches
- Environment variable issues
- Frontend–backend sync problems
How we got over it:
- Tightened API contracts
- Improved error handling and logging

**Final takeaway**

Building CirculoMetrix AI wasn’t about avoiding problems — it was about wrestling them until they behaved. Every bug forced a better design decision. Every hurdle made the system more robust.

> Emergency aid, but on-chain

![Solidity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Solidity-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Blockchain](https://img.shields.io/badge/Blockchain-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

##  The Problem

Disaster response today is slow, opaque, and fragmented.

Critical decisions rely on manual damage reports, relief funds are delayed by bureaucratic approvals, and donors have little visibility into how emergency money is actually used. In high-impact situations, these delays and blind spots lead to wasted resources, mistrust, and avoidable loss of life.

---

##  How AidLedger Solves It

AidLedger is an end-to-end, autonomous disaster relief protocol powered by AI agents and secured by blockchain.

- AI-driven disaster detection analyzes satellite or drone imagery in near real time to identify affected regions  
- Autonomous verification agents cross-check claims, filter misinformation, and validate severity before action  
- On-chain fund disbursement ensures relief funds are released transparently and only after verified triggers  
- Live dashboards convert complex AI and blockchain activity into clear, human-readable insights  

AidLedger replaces fragmented coordination with a single, trusted execution layer for disaster response.

---

##  Why It’s Safer and More Reliable

- Removes slow, manual decision chains during emergencies  
- Prevents fund leakage through verifiable, on-chain transactions  
- Creates an immutable public audit trail for every relief action  
- Balances AI speed with verification for responsible automation  

Every decision is logged. Every transfer is provable. Every action is accountable.

---

##  Who Uses AidLedger

- Governments — faster, auditable emergency response infrastructure  
- NGOs — transparent and efficient aid distribution  
- Donors — cryptographic proof of impact and fund usage  
- Disaster response teams — real-time situational intelligence  

---

##  In One Line

AidLedger transforms disaster relief into a fast, verifiable, and trust-minimized system powered by AI agents and secured by blockchain.

**Challenges we ran into**

##  Challenges I Ran Into

Building AidLedger required tightly integrating AI, multi-agent orchestration, blockchain execution, and real-time visualization—each introducing its own set of challenges. The most critical hurdles and how they were resolved are outlined below.

---

### Blockchain Transaction Failures

**The Issue:**  
Even after successful disaster detection and verification, on-chain transactions occasionally failed due to underpriced replacement errors or silent funding failures.

**Root Cause:**  
Upstream agents did not always populate transaction parameters correctly, leading to invalid or zero-value transfers.

**How I Solved It:**  
I traced the full execution pipeline end-to-end, introduced defensive validation and fallback logic, and resolved Web3 library version mismatches affecting raw transaction handling.

---

### AI Confidence vs Real-World Accuracy

**The Issue:**  
Early computer vision models produced inconsistent confidence scores, making it unclear when an event should trigger fund release.

**Root Cause:**  
Different disaster types require different detection strategies and sensitivity thresholds.

**How I Solved It:**  
I separated detection pipelines by disaster category (fire, flood, structural damage, casualties) and tuned confidence thresholds independently to balance responsiveness with false positives.

---

### Agent Coordination & State Flow

**The Issue:**  
Multiple agents occasionally executed out of order, causing race conditions and premature actions.

**Root Cause:**  
Execution boundaries between detection, verification, and execution stages were not explicitly enforced.

**How I Solved It:**  
I introduced a message-queue-driven workflow with strict state transitions, ensuring each agent acted only after the previous stage completed successfully.

---

### Image Processing Pipeline Errors

**The Issue:**  
Mismatched image formats (raw bytes, PIL images, OpenCV arrays) caused crashes and inconsistent analysis results.

**Root Cause:**  
Different libraries expected different formats, with insufficient validation during conversions.

**How I Solved It:**  
I standardized the image processing pipeline, added validation at each stage, and implemented graceful fallbacks to prevent system-wide failures.

---

### Rapid Frontend Prototyping vs System Complexity

**The Issue:**  
Exposing real-time AI decisions and blockchain activity without overwhelming users.

**Root Cause:**  
Highly complex backend processes needed to be translated into clear, human-understandable signals.

**How I Solved It:**  
I adopted a clarity-first UI approach—surfacing only essential states, using real-time status indicators, and progressively revealing technical details when needed.

**Ethereum Track**

Our project leverages Ethereum as the trust and settlement layer for disaster relief. We use smart contracts on Ethereum to ensure transparent fund allocation, verifiable transactions, and tamper-proof audit trails. By executing relief disbursements on-chain, the system removes intermediaries, reduces fraud, and enables real-time public accountability—demonstrating Ethereum’s strengths in decentralization, security, and programmable finance for real-world impact.

**AI TRACK**

The project is built around a multi-agent AI architecture designed to automate and coordinate disaster-response workflows. Each agent is responsible for a specialized role—such as signal analysis, claim verification, anomaly detection, auditing, and execution readiness.

Incoming data (from reports, feeds, or external inputs) is first processed by detection agents that classify and assess severity. Verification agents then cross-check claims, flag inconsistencies, and assign confidence scores. Auditor agents evaluate the overall integrity of the information flow, while orchestration logic ensures agents collaborate and pass structured outputs between stages.

This agent-driven pipeline enables parallel reasoning, reduces single-point decision bias, and allows the system to scale as new agent roles are added. By combining autonomous AI agents with deterministic on-chain execution, the project demonstrates how agentic systems can operate in high-stakes, real-world environments with transparency, accountability, and human-override capability.

**Open Innovation**

Lovable was used to rapidly generate the boilerplate frontend for the project, allowing us to focus on core logic and integrations. It provided a clean, scalable UI foundation that we customized to connect with our blockchain and AI backends. This significantly reduced setup time and enabled faster iteration during the build phase.

### Truthchain
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/truthchain-22bf) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/Anurag-2007/ApexIv_Truthchain) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://apex-iv-truthchain.vercel.app/) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-HackFiesta-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hackfiesta.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-2-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> The last line of defense against fake news.

![Solidity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Solidity-333333?style=flat-square) ![MetaMask](https://img.shields.io/badge/MetaMask-333333?style=flat-square) ![ethers.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/ethers.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Vercel](https://img.shields.io/badge/Vercel-333333?style=flat-square) ![React.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/React.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![vite.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/vite.js-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

In today’s digital world, misinformation spreads faster than verified facts, influencing public opinion, elections, health decisions, and social harmony. Social media and instant messaging platforms lack reliable mechanisms to verify the authenticity of news before it goes viral, making users vulnerable to fake, manipulated, or misleading content. Even when false information is identified, there is no transparent and tamper-proof system to store verified news for future reference, leading to repeated circulation of the same fake claims. TruthChain addresses this critical problem by combining AI-based fake news detection with blockchain-backed verification, ensuring that once news is verified, it is permanently recorded, traceable, and cannot be altered—restoring trust, accountability, and transparency in digital information ecosystems.

**Challenges we ran into**

As first-year students, implementing blockchain was one of the most challenging aspects of building TruthChain. Understanding core blockchain concepts like smart contracts, immutability, gas costs, required a steep learning curve within a limited time. We initially struggled with integrating the AI pipeline with the blockchain layer and ensuring data was stored securely and efficiently. Debugging smart contracts, handling transaction delays, and dealing with deployment issues were unfamiliar territory for us. However, these challenges pushed us to deeply understand decentralized systems and significantly improved our technical confidence and problem-solving skills.

**Ethereum Track**

TruthChain AI fits the Ethereum track by using Ethereum smart contracts to immutably store AI-verified news, ensuring transparent, tamper-proof, and publicly verifiable records on a decentralized network.

**AI TRACK**

TruthChain fits the AI track by using core NLP and semantic analysis to understand and evaluate news content. It analyzes linguistic patterns, sentiment, credibility cues, and contextual keywords to detect misinformation and classify news as real or fake. This AI-driven language understanding enables automated, explainable verification of unstructured text before storing verified results immutably on the blockchain.

**Open Innovation**

TruthChain fits the Open Innovation track by combining AI-driven fake news detection with blockchain-based verification to solve a real-world problem of digital misinformation. It introduces a novel, interdisciplinary approach by integrating NLP, semantic analysis, and decentralized ledgers to create a transparent, tamper-proof trust system for news verification. The solution is scalable, adaptable across domains like media, governance, and education, and demonstrates innovative use of emerging technologies to restore trust in online information.

**The problem it solves**

The Problem PatientX Solves:
Millions of patients produce valuable medical data through hospitals, wearables, and apps, but:

1.They don’t own or control their data
2.Health records are stored in centralized systems vulnerable to breaches
3.Patients don’t earn any value when companies use their data
4.Researchers struggle to access quality, consent-based medical data due to strict privacy laws
5.Sharing data involves risk, bureaucracy, and no transparency

PatientX solves these problems by creating a system where data ownership becomes patient-centered, secure, and transparent.

What People Can Use PatientX For:

For Patients
1.Store health records securely on a decentralized blockchain
2.Control who accesses their data using smart contracts
3.Share data anonymously through AI-based data anonymization
4.Earn rewards when their anonymized data is used by researchers
5.Verify insights safely using Zero-Knowledge Proofs without exposing identity
6.Prevent misuse by tracking every access in an immutable ledger

For Doctors & Hospitals
1.Access accurate patient data quickly with consent
2.Reduce fraud through transparent, tamper-proof records
3.Enable interoperable health data exchange without paperwork

For Researchers & Healthcare Companies
1.Legally access high-quality, anonymized medical data
2.Speed up medical innovation without violating privacy laws
3.Gain deeper insights validated by AI and ZK-proofs

How It Makes Tasks Easier & Safer

Safer: Decentralization removes single-point data breaches
Faster: Automated smart contract approvals replace manual paperwork
Private: AI-anonymization and zero-knowledge proofs protect identity
Fair: Patients finally earn value from their medical data
Transparent: Every data transaction is traceable and consent-based

**Challenges we ran into**

1.AI-Based Data Anonymization
Problem: Model missed implicit identifiers in reports.
Solution: Added hybrid neural network + rule-based entity removal + multi-layer validation.

2.Smart Contract Development
Problem: Consent contracts reverted due to logic conflicts.
Solution: Introduced HardHat, unit testing, and contract simulation.

3.OCR Inaccuracy
Problem: Pytesseract failed on low-resolution PDFs and images.
Solution: Pre-processing pipeline (denoising, thresholding, sharpening).

4.Decentralized Storage Handling
Problem: Inconsistent IPFS uploads for multiple formats.
Solution: Standardized file metadata + buffer normalization.

5.Zero-Knowledge Proof Integration
Problem: High computational complexity.
Solution: Used lightweight ZKP primitives + optimized proof generation.

**Blockchain**

PatientX aligns strongly with the Blockchain track because it leverages blockchain’s core strengths—data security, transparency, immutability, and decentralized control—to solve critical challenges in healthcare data management.

Secure & Immutable Medical Records
Blockchain ensures that patient health records stored in PatientX cannot be altered or tampered with, increasing trust and data integrity.

Decentralized Data Ownership
Patients have full control over their medical data, deciding who can access it and for how long—removing dependency on centralized authorities.

Transparent Access Control
Every access or update to patient records is recorded on the blockchain, creating a transparent and auditable history.

Enhanced Privacy & Compliance
By using cryptographic techniques and smart contracts, PatientX protects sensitive health data while meeting privacy standards.

Interoperability Across Providers
Blockchain allows secure data sharing between hospitals, labs, and doctors without data duplication or loss.

**Generative AI**

PatientX uses Generative AI to transform complex medical data into meaningful, actionable insights for both patients and healthcare professionals.

AI-Generated Medical Summaries
Generative AI converts raw clinical data, lab reports, and prescriptions into easy-to-understand summaries for patients and doctors.

Personalized Health Insights
By analyzing patient history, Generative AI generates personalized recommendations, alerts, and follow-up suggestions.

Clinical Decision Support
AI assists doctors by generating treatment suggestions, risk assessments, and symptom interpretations based on patient data.

Natural Language Interaction
Patients can interact with PatientX using natural language to ask questions about their health records and receive AI-generated responses.

Time & Cost Efficiency
Automating documentation and analysis reduces administrative workload for healthcare providers.
