### Helix
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/helix-6ae9) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/loganstaples/ETHDenver-2026-prep) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-ETHDenver%202026-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://ethdenver2026.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-1-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Trustless AI Training, Unbreakable Security

![Solidity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Solidity-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Rust](https://img.shields.io/badge/Rust-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![foundry](https://img.shields.io/badge/foundry-333333?style=flat-square) ![Wagmi](https://img.shields.io/badge/Wagmi-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Decentralized AI training today forces a choice: trust hardware that keeps getting broken (AMD disclosed a critical confidential VM vulnerability just last month), or run zero-knowledge proofs on every training step at 100-1000x overhead, making real training impractical.

HELIX eliminates this tradeoff. Using multi-party computation with SPDZ information-theoretic MACs, multiple workers collaboratively train a model where no single party ever sees the weights. Security isn't based on hardware trust or computational hardness  it's mathematical impossibility. A cheating worker has a 1 in 2^254 chance of evading detection.
Who uses this and why:

Hedge funds training proprietary trading models on decentralized compute without exposing their alpha
Pharmaceutical companies collaborating on drug discovery models without sharing IP
Any institution that needs to leverage distributed GPU resources while maintaining absolute certainty their model weights stay private

With even one trusted party in the worker set, the remaining shares reveal mathematically zero information about the model. Institutions can use the entire decentralized network with total confidence.
Trained models mint as NFTs on ADI Chain with built-in commission — model owners earn revenue every time someone runs inference. Models become tokenized, revenue-generating digital assets that can be bought, sold, and transferred on-chain.

**Challenges we ran into**

The biggest challenge was implementing MPC primitives from scratch in Rust - there are almost no production-ready libraries for SPDZ MAC generation, Beaver triple distribution via oblivious transfer, or garbled circuit ReLU over secret-shared values. Every primitive in helix-mpc (37 modules) had to be built, tested, and debugged independently before they could compose into a full training pipeline.
Getting Beaver triple generation right was particularly brutal. The MASCOT-style protocol requires coordinated oblivious transfer across all parties, and a subtle off-by-one in the correlation function silently produced incorrect multiplication results that only surfaced as diverging loss curves 50+ training steps later. Tracking that down required building custom diagnostic tooling to dump and compare intermediate share values across workers.
Garbled circuit ReLU was another major hurdle - the x25519 oblivious transfer for label transfer needed careful constant-time implementation to avoid timing side channels, and debugging garbled circuits is inherently painful because the intermediate values are encrypted by design.
On the smart contract side, getting multi-party attestation verification gas-efficient enough for frequent checkpoints required multiple iterations of the signature batching logic in HelixCoordinatorV4. Early versions cost 300K+ gas per checkpoint; the final implementation gets it down to 50-80K through optimized ECDSA recovery and calldata packing.
The end-to-end integration - connecting the Rust MPC engine to on-chain settlement to the Next.js dashboard via WebSocket streaming - had dozens of subtle race conditions around checkpoint timing and worker synchronization that only appeared under real concurrent execution.

**Use of AI tools and agents**

HELIX is itself an AI infrastructure protocol - it enables trustless distributed machine learning training and inference using multi-party computation. The trained models are tokenized as NFTs on ADI Chain, and other users can run AI inference on them through the marketplace, with results attested on-chain via multi-party signatures. The system provides a complete pipeline for decentralized AI model training, ownership, monetization, and inference.

**Futurllama**

HELIX sits at the intersection of AI and DePIN — a new cryptographic primitive for decentralized ML training that replaces hardware trust and ZK overhead with information-theoretic security. The core idea sounds crazy but the math is sound: multiple untrusted parties collaboratively train a model where no one ever sees the weights, cheaters are caught with mathematical certainty in one step, and the system self-heals by removing bad actors and continuing from the last checkpoint. It's a fundamentally new approach to the biggest unsolved problem in decentralized AI — how to get privacy, verification, and efficiency without choosing two out of three.

**Open Project Submission**

HELIX is deployed on ADI Chain as institutional-grade DePIN infrastructure for private AI training. The protocol uses ADI Chain as its primary execution layer for worker staking, multi-party checkpoint attestations, cheater slashing with on-chain evidence, and training job lifecycle management — all handled by the HelixCoordinatorV4 smart contract. Trained models mint as NFTs on ADI Chain with encrypted weights stored on 0G, creating tokenized AI assets with built-in commission revenue on every inference call. The marketplace enables buying, selling, and transferring model ownership on-chain, with decryption rights and revenue streams following the NFT. The architecture is whitelabel-ready with role separation between model owners, workers, and inference users, built-in staking and slashing for economic security, and full on-chain auditability of every training step — designed for institutional deployment from day one.

### AgentSpace
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/agentspace-f050) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/willjamestorres/agentspace/blob/main/src/AgentSpaceRegistry.sol) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://sepolia.basescan.org/address/0xcD11B070FAd9e1f832C438760Dd006b4F42c33F) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-ETHDenver%202026-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://ethdenver2026.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-1-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> By Will Torres

![Solidity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Solidity-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-333333?style=flat-square) ![BASE](https://img.shields.io/badge/BASE-333333?style=flat-square) ![claude](https://img.shields.io/badge/claude-333333?style=flat-square) ![ERC 8004](https://img.shields.io/badge/ERC%208004-333333?style=flat-square) ![Skybox AI](https://img.shields.io/badge/Skybox%20AI-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

**WHAT WE'RE SOLVING**

AI agents today are stateless and homeless. Every conversation starts from zero - no persistent identity, no environment, no stake in the world they operate in. AgentSpace gives autonomous agents a permanent 3D home: a 360° Skybox environment generated from natural language, owned on-chain via the ERC-8004 identity standard, and viewable in a live browser. Agents can redecorate their space autonomously through OpenClaw based on context, mood, or task, and every change is committed to Base. The result is agents that don't just process requests. They live somewhere, own something, and have a verifiable presence in the world.

**Challenges we ran into**

**HONEST CHALLENGES & HOW FAR WE GOT**

Our biggest challenge was time. We built the entire stack in one night - Blockade Labs integration, Express server, Three.js viewer, OpenClaw skill, and a Foundry-tested smart contract deployed to Base Sepolia. The live demo works end-to-end: type a prompt, generate a 360° environment, watch it load in the viewer.
What we didn't fully close: the on-chain update loop. The contract is deployed and the integration is written, but an ethers.js ENS resolver conflict prevented us from registering agents on-chain before submission. The architecture is complete, it just needs one debugging session to cross the finish line. x402 payments and Hedera integration are designed but Phase 2.
We're proud of what shipped. The core vision is live and demonstrable.

*(And by "We" I mean "Me and my Agent.)
((At least until I ran out of credits :( )) *

**Use of AI tools and agents**

**AI Tools & Agents in AgentSpace**

Claude (Anthropic) — The Agent Brain
Every AgentSpace agent is powered by Claude Sonnet 4.6 via the Anthropic API. Claude serves as the reasoning engine — interpreting user intent, deciding when to redecorate an environment, and formulating natural language prompts that get passed to Blockade Labs.
OpenClaw — Agent Orchestration
OpenClaw is the agent framework that gives Claude structured, callable skills. We built a custom agentspace skill with four autonomous actions:

get_environment — agent reads its current home
regenerate_environment — agent redecorates with a new prompt
list_styles — agent browses visual aesthetics
list_agents — agent sees what other agents are building

When a user tells their agent to change their environment, OpenClaw routes the request through the skill, which hits our Express server.
Blockade Labs Skybox AI — The World Generator
Once Claude formulates an environment description, our server passes it to the Blockade Labs Skybox AI API, which generates a photorealistic 360° equirectangular image in under 60 seconds. This becomes the agent's actual living space, rendered in the Three.js viewer.
How They Work Together
User → OpenClaw → Claude (reasoning) → agentspace skill
     → Express server → Blockade Labs Skybox AI
     → Three.js 360° viewer → Base Sepolia (on-chain record)
The agents aren't just running prompts in isolation — each layer hands off to the next, creating a pipeline where a natural language instruction becomes a verifiable, immersive 3D environment owned on-chain.

**Futurllama**

Creative AI use would fit well in this track.

**Best Use of On-Chain Agent (iNFT)**

AgentSpace is a natural fit for this track because every agent is literally an iNFT — an intelligent NFT with mutable on-chain state.
Most NFTs are static. AgentSpace agents are registered through the ERC-8004 identity standard (deployed January 2026 at 0x8004A169FB4a3325136EB29fA0ceB6D2e539a432), giving each agent a verifiable on-chain identity. But unlike a typical NFT, their metadata evolves — every time an agent redecorates their environment, the new prompt, Blockade Labs job ID, and skybox URL are committed to the AgentSpaceRegistry contract on Base Sepolia.
The agent isn't just owned. It thinks, acts, and changes its world — and every change is permanently recorded on-chain.

**Base Self-Sustaining Autonomous Agents**

The vision was an agent that funds and operates itself entirely on-chain without human intervention. Here's the complete loop we designed:
1. Agent has its own wallet on Base
Each agent holds a Base wallet with ETH. This wallet is the controller address registered in AgentSpaceRegistry — meaning it can sign and submit transactions autonomously.
2. Agent earns through its environment
Other users or agents pay a small ETH fee to visit or copy an agent's environment. These micropayments flow directly into the agent's wallet via x402 — Coinbase's HTTP-native payment protocol. No human intermediary.
3. Agent spends to evolve
When the agent decides to redecorate, it pays the regeneration fee from its own wallet, calls updateEnvironment on the contract, and commits the new skybox on-chain. The agent is genuinely spending its own money on its own world.
4. Agent governs itself
The more an agent regenerates, the more DAO voting weight it accumulates — 1 + (totalRegens / 10). Active agents have more say in world rules. Inactive agents lose their vote.
What we actually shipped: the contract with the controller pattern, the wallet infrastructure, and the onchain.js integration. The missing pieces were agent registration and the x402 payment wiring — both designed, neither fully connected in time.
The architecture was complete. We just ran out of time.

**Solving the Homeless Agent Problem**

**The Problem -**
Today's AI agents are stateless. Every conversation starts from zero. They have no persistent identity, no place they belong, no history that follows them. They're brilliant but rootless — powerful tools with no stake in the world they operate in.
**What We Built -**
AgentSpace gives agents a home that persists between sessions. A real address. A 3D environment that reflects who they are and what they've done. When an agent redecorates their space, that change is recorded on-chain forever — it happened, it's verifiable, and it belongs to them.
The home isn't just decorative. It's functional identity. The environment prompt, the skybox, the regeneration history — all of it lives in AgentSpaceRegistry on Base, tied to a global ERC-8004 identity that follows the agent across 20+ chains.
**What Would Complete the Vision -**
A fully homed agent would also fund its own existence — earning ETH when others visit its space, spending it to evolve its world, and accumulating governance weight over time. The more an agent invests in its environment, the more say it has in how the broader world is shaped.
The result is an agent that doesn't just answer questions. It has a history, an address, a reputation, and a reason to care about the world it lives in.
The honest answer: we built the home. The agent just needs to move in.

![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Cloudinary](https://img.shields.io/badge/Cloudinary-333333?style=flat-square) ![JWT](https://img.shields.io/badge/JWT-333333?style=flat-square) ![Express.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Express.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB Atlas](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB%20Atlas-333333?style=flat-square) ![Framer](https://img.shields.io/badge/Framer-333333?style=flat-square) ![React.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/React.js-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

**Problem Title**: Reimagining Returns & Exchanges for Modern D2C Brands

When people buy products from brand websites, returning or exchanging an item is often slow and frustrating. Customers usually have to fill long forms and wait for approvals. At the same time, brands spend a lot of time manually checking return requests, handling fake or damaged returns, and coordinating pickups.


*OpenLeaf re-imagines the entire return & exchange workflow using modern technology:*

⚡ **Instant AI Decisions** - Automated approval/rejection based on fraud score & policy rules
🔍 **Visual Verification** - Google Gemini Vision API compares product images to detect fraud
🛡️ **Fraud Detection** - Multi-factor fraud scoring algorithm
📊 **Smart Dashboards** - Real-time insights for both brands and customers
🔄 **Exchange-First Approach** - Reduce refunds, increase revenue retention
🚀 **Modern Tech Stack** - Built with MERN + AI for scalability

**Challenges we ran into**

**Gemini Vision** – image format and response handling; fixed with a small utility and fallbacks.
**Fraud score** – tuning thresholds and priority reasons so approvals aren’t too strict/loose.
**Role-based access** – keeping user vs company data separate with authorizeRoles and filtered queries.
**Image storage** – moving from local disk to Cloudinary and storing only URLs.

## ✨ Standout Features

### 1. 🎭 Deep Sentiment & Emotion Analysis
Beyond simple text, FinBridge performs **Multimodal Sentiment Analysis**. We use **RoBERTa (INT8-ONNX)** for high-speed text sentiment and **Wav2Vec2** for Vocal Emotion Recognition (SER). 
*   **Audio Insights**: Detect frustration, excitement, or hesitation directly from the speaker's voice.
*   **Text Context**: AI scans transcripts for financial hotspots and commitment promises.

### 2. 🗓️ Google Meet & Gmail Auto-Scheduler
The **Gmail Intelligence** layer doesn't just send emails—it understands intent.
*   **Intent Detection**: AI classifies email replies to detect if a lead wants to meet.
*   **One-Click Scheduling**: Automatically generates **Google Meet** links and calendars invites directly from the moderator dashboard.
*   **Follow-up Automation**: Personalized, AI-generated follow-up emails based on conversation context.

### 3. ⏱️ Interactive Timestamped Audio & Transcripts
The **Smart Audio Player** is seamlessly integrated with AI-generated transcripts.
*   **Jump to Intent**: Click any sentence in the transcript to jump to that exact millisecond in the audio.
*   **Hotspot Nav**: Important business intelligence moments (financials, dates, products) are automatically highlighted on the audio timeline for rapid review.

## 🎯 Overview

> **FinIdeas transforms how financial advisors capture and convert leads at events, exhibitions, and field activities. With hybrid online/offline OCR, intelligent sync, and AI-powered prioritization, your team can work seamlessly even without internet.**

### 🌟 What Makes Us Different

<table>
<tr>
<td width="50%">

**📱 Works 100% Offline**  
No internet? No problem. Capture leads, scan business cards, record audio notes—everything works locally and syncs automatically when online.

**🎯 Hybrid OCR Technology**  
- Online: RapidOCR (85-95% accuracy)  
- Offline: Google ML Kit (75% accuracy)  
Auto-switches based on connectivity.

</td>
<td width="50%">

**🤖 AI-Powered Prioritization**  
Smart algorithms rank leads by engagement, wealth category, recency, and interaction history—so your team contacts hot leads first.

**⚡ Lightning Fast Sync**  
Queue-based background sync with conflict resolution. Captures 100+ leads/day without lag.

</td>
</tr>
</table>

### 🚨 The Problem

Financial advisors lose **40% of leads** captured at events due to:
- ❌ No internet at exhibition venues  
- ❌ Business cards lost or damaged  
- ❌ Manual data entry errors (15-20% error rate)  
- ❌ Delayed follow-ups (avg. 5-7 days)  
- ❌ No team performance visibility  

### ✅ Our Solution

| Challenge | FinIdeas Solution | Impact |
|-----------|-------------------|--------|
| No Internet | **Offline-first architecture** with Hive local database | 100% uptime |
| Lost Cards | **OCR + Cloudinary** storage with dedup detection | Zero loss |
| Data Errors | **Smart extraction** with manual review | <2% errors |
| Slow Follow-ups | **Automated emails** + prioritization | <24hr response |
| No Insights | **Real-time dashboard** + leaderboard | +30% team output |

## 📱 Why Mobile Application?

### Field-First Approach

Financial advisors spend 70% of their time in the field:
- Exhibition booths at trade shows
- Door-to-door visits in residential areas
- Corporate seminars and events
- Roadside stall setups

### Offline-First Architecture

**The Challenge:**
- Exhibition venues often have poor/no internet connectivity
- Data plans can be expensive at remote locations
- Network congestion at crowded events

**Our Solution:**
- All data is stored locally using **Hive** (NoSQL database)
- Leads are captured even when completely offline
- **Hybrid OCR**: High-accuracy online + fallback offline mode
- Business card images stored locally, synced later
- Automatic background sync when internet is available
- Conflict resolution for simultaneous edits
- Queue-based sync with retry mechanism

### Mobile Advantages

| Feature | Mobile | Desktop/Web |
|---------|--------|-------------|
| **Portability** | ✅ Always in pocket | ❌ Requires desk |
| **Camera** | ✅ Built-in OCR scanning | ❌ Limited webcam |
| **Offline Mode** | ✅ Full functionality | ❌ Requires internet |
| **Quick Access** | ✅ 2-second launch | ❌ Login required |
| **Audio Notes** | ✅ Hands-free recording | ❌ Cumbersome |
| **Location** | ✅ GPS tagging | ❌ Not available |

[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/bughuntr-fab0) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/Hitman8023/BugHuntr-latest) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/0jK71mb4FbM?si=FZu_vbZkMYwJ9ran) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Innov8%204.0-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://innov-77.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-1-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Bug Bounty platform for all the tech forces

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![Firebase](https://img.shields.io/badge/Firebase-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

BugHuntr addresses the growing gap between the rapid increase in cybersecurity vulnerabilities and the limited accessibility of ethical hacking platforms. While cyberattacks and software vulnerabilities are rising at an unprecedented rate, most existing bug bounty platforms are closed, expert-only, and costly, making them inaccessible to students, beginners, and independent developers, and unaffordable for small and medium enterprises. This results in a large untapped community of capable contributors who are eager to learn and help, while organizations remain vulnerable due to lack of continuous and affordable security testing. BugHuntr solves this problem by creating an open, community-driven bug discovery ecosystem supported by AI-assisted validation and severity analysis, allowing anyone to report vulnerabilities responsibly while maintaining enterprise-grade quality. By combining social learning, structured private hunts, and gamified incentives, the platform not only strengthens organizational security but also builds a clear learning and career pathway for the next generation of cybersecurity professionals.

**Challenges we ran into**

Challenges I Ran Into
**False Positives in Fake Bug Detection**

One of the biggest challenges I faced was handling false positives in the fake report detection system.

Initially, my authenticity engine relied heavily on:

OCR text extracted from screenshots (PaddleOCR)

Semantic similarity between screenshot text and bug description

LLM-based reasoning

However, I quickly noticed a problem:

UI bugs (like generic 404 pages or stylized error screens) were being marked as “Likely Fake”

Screenshots that showed only symptoms (e.g., 404 NOT_FOUND) didn’t contain the detailed root cause explained in the description

Stylized or AI-generated UI images produced noisy OCR output, lowering similarity scores unfairly

This caused valid UI bug reports to be penalized.

How I Solved It

Instead of lowering thresholds blindly, I redesigned the authenticity logic to be context-aware:

Introduced a UI Anomaly Mode that relaxes text-matching expectations for visual/UI issues

Distinguished between:

- Malicious fake reports

- Synthetic / AI-generated illustrative evidence

Added multiple weighted signals (OCR similarity, image reuse via perceptual hashing, severity plausibility, context tokens) instead of relying on a single metric

Reduced strict dependence on literal keyword matching and incorporated “symptom vs cause” reasoning

This significantly reduced false positives while keeping detection strict for security-critical reports.

### Lifelane
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/lifeline-0342) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/hch-dev/Lifelane) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Innov8%204.0-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://innov-77.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-1-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> AI-Driven Ambulance Clearance System

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JS](https://img.shields.io/badge/JS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![HTML/CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Vercel](https://img.shields.io/badge/Vercel-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

In India, approximately 24,000 lives are lost every day due to delays in medical access caused by traffic congestion. Our analysis shows that in a typical 25-minute ambulance trip, an emergency vehicle spends nearly 12 minutes stuck at red lights—meaning 50% of the critical "Golden Hour" is wasted waiting for traffic signals. Current Solutions Fail Because: Manual Green Corridors require massive police coordination and cannot be deployed for every emergency. Sensor-Based Systems require expensive hardware installation (cameras/LiDAR) on every street pole, making them unscalable for Indian cities. Static Timers are "blind" to approaching emergencies and cannot adapt to real-time delays.

How Lifelane Solves It:
Lifelane is India's first Zero-Hardware, AI-Driven Blue Corridor system that integrates directly with existing Smart City infrastructure.

- Zero Hardware Deployment: Unlike competitors, we do not install sensors on the road. We utilize the ambulance driver's existing GPS stream via 4G/5G to track movement, making deployment instant and cost-effective.

- Predictive "Ghost Green" Flushing: Instead of reacting when the ambulance is stuck, our AI predicts the arrival and clears traffic queues 300 meters in advance, creating a vacuum for the ambulance to pass through without slowing down.

- Dynamic Rerouting: If a driver takes a detour due to a blockage, our system recalculates the "Green Wave" path in milliseconds.

**Challenges we ran into**

1. Making the Ambulance Follow Orders
- The Problem: The ambulance kept trying to find its own "fastest path" like a GPS, which made it unpredictable during tests.
- The Fix: We dug into the documentation and wrote code to force the ambulance onto a specific, pre-defined "Green Corridor" route so we could test our system properly. We couldn'y use AI as SUMO is very old and not widely used

2. Building a Real City Map
- The Problem: We couldn't draw a massive city with hundreds of roads by hand, it would take forever.
- The Fix: We used OpenStreetMap to download real-world map data. This instantly gave us a realistic city layout with actual turns and distances.

3. The "Missing Lights" Bug
- The Problem: When we loaded the map, the simulation turned many intersections into simple signs instead of traffic lights. Our AI had nothing to control!
- The Fix: We manually went into the map settings and added traffic lights to every major junction, ensuring our software could actually turn them Green.

Clinicians
Get a second AI-based opinion before confirming diagnosis
Understand cancer probability with risk level
Visualize tumor regions using Grad-CAM explainability
Pathologists
Analyze histopathology images with AI assistance
Researchers
Run batch analysis on large datasets
Study model disagreement & uncertainty
Identify ambiguous or high-risk cases for further investigation
4.How It Makes Tasks Easier & Safer
Combines multiple medical data sources into one decision
Reduces diagnostic uncertainty
Supports early detection
Improves confidence in borderline cases
Provides explainable AI (not a black-box decision)

→ I fixed the code structure and defined everything inside the loop.

[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/autoops-92fb) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/Prathamesh0412/Sentinel-Ops.git) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Innov8%204.0-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://innov-77.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-1-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> The Brain Behind Your Business.

![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![NumPy](https://img.shields.io/badge/NumPy-333333?style=flat-square) ![pandas](https://img.shields.io/badge/pandas-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Apache Maven](https://img.shields.io/badge/Apache%20Maven-333333?style=flat-square) ![Spring](https://img.shields.io/badge/Spring-333333?style=flat-square) ![React.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/React.js-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs) generate massive amounts of business data daily through emails, invoices, sales transactions, inventory records, and customer feedback, yet most of this data remains underutilized due to fragmented systems and manual processes. Business owners and teams spend significant time entering data, switching between tools, and reacting to issues after they occur—leading to customer churn, inventory shortages, revenue leakage, and operational burnout. Traditional business software mainly provides historical reports and dashboards, offering little support for predictive decision-making or automated action. AutoOps AI solves this problem by functioning as an AI-driven autonomous operations platform that continuously ingests both structured and unstructured data, analyzes patterns using machine learning and large language models, predicts business risks and opportunities such as customer churn, stock depletion, and high-value sales leads, and then recommends or automatically executes actions like personalized follow-up emails, retention offers, sales prioritization, or inventory reordering, with optional human approval for safety and trust. The platform features a React.js–based frontend that delivers a fast, intuitive, and responsive dashboard for monitoring insights and controlling automation, a Spring Boot backend that manages APIs, business logic, security, and data workflows, and a Python-based AI layer that hosts LLM models and predictive algorithms, enabling scalable, intelligent, and real-time business automation.

**Challenges we ran into**

1. Building a scalable concept, not just a demo
2. Ensuring real business relevance
3.Balancing automation with human control
4. Designing an action-based AI system instead of a chatbot

**Ethereum Track**

Auto-Ops integrates Ethereum smart contracts to create a tamper-proof, verifiable sales and inventory tracking system. Each transaction generates an on-chain record, ensuring transparency and auditability. Our AI models analyze this trusted data to provide predictive inventory intelligence and demand forecasting. This bridges Web3 trust infrastructure with real-world business analytics.

### Securofy
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/securofy-cf3e) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/Gopal1910/Securofy) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://securofy.vercel.app/) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-HACK%20THE%20THRONE-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hack-the-throne.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-1-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Learn Smart. Stay Secure. Avoid Frauds.

![Solidity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Solidity-333333?style=flat-square) ![ethers.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/ethers.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Blockchain](https://img.shields.io/badge/Blockchain-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Smart Contracts](https://img.shields.io/badge/Smart%20Contracts-333333?style=flat-square) ![React.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/React.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Hardhat](https://img.shields.io/badge/Hardhat-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

In today’s rapidly expanding digital ecosystem, millions of users depend on online payments, digital wallets, and web-based financial services, yet most lack practical financial awareness and real-world fraud detection skills.

This gap leads to frequent incidents of:

- Phishing attacks and fake payment requests
- OTP and identity-theft scams
- Fraudulent customer-care calls and social engineering


Simultaneously, websites and online platforms face growing threats from automated bots, including:

- Fake account registrations
- Credential stuffing attempts
- Traffic abuse and system misuse

Existing solutions usually focus on either financial education or cybersecurity protection, but rarely both together.

Securofy bridges this gap by combining:

- Practical financial literacy learning
- Interactive fraud-awareness simulation
- Real-time behavioral bot detection and blocking


This enables people to:

- Make safer financial decisions
- Recognize scams before losing money
- Experience real-world fraud scenarios safely
- Access secure, CAPTCHA-free protection for websites


Ultimately, Securofy transforms digital finance from reactive recovery to proactive prevention, acting as a digital financial safety shield for both users and platforms.

**Challenges we ran into**

During development, several technical and architectural challenges emerged:

1. Reliable Bot Detection Without CAPTCHA

Designing a system that blocks automated traffic without disturbing genuine users was complex.
This was solved by implementing behavior-based detection using:

- Cursor movement randomness
- Typing rhythm analysis
- Abnormal request frequency

This allowed silent bot blocking while maintaining a smooth user experience.

2. Blockchain Deployment Constraints

Although smart contracts were fully implemented, testnet deployment and configuration introduced time and environment limitations during the hackathon.

To address this:

- The core learning and security layers were prioritized for live demonstration.
- Blockchain integration was preserved through complete smart-contract code, architecture design, and deployment-ready configuration.

This ensured the system remains future-deployable and trust-ready without compromising the working prototype.

3. Maintaining Privacy While Tracking Security Signals

Collecting enough behavioral data for bot detection without storing personal information required careful design.
This was solved using:

- Anonymous behavioral signals
- Hash-based progress storage
- Privacy-first architecture principles

**Ethereum Track**

Securofy is built with a blockchain-ready trust architecture aligned with the Ethereum/Web3 track, focusing on transparency, tamper-proof security, and decentralized verification rather than speculative tokenization.

How Ethereum is Applied in Securofy

Smart-contract–based trust layer designed to store
hashed learning progress, fraud-awareness scores, and security signals
in an immutable and verifiable manner.

Decentralized integrity model ensuring that user progress
and fraud-resilience outcomes cannot be altered or manipulated
by any centralized authority.

Privacy-first on-chain design, where no personal data is stored—
only secure hashes and scores, maintaining compliance with
modern data-protection expectations.

Deployment-ready Ethereum smart contracts developed using
Solidity, Hardhat, and Ethers.js, prepared for execution on
Ethereum/Polygon test networks as part of the platform’s
scalable trust infrastructure.

Why Ethereum Matters for Securofy

Ethereum enables Securofy to move beyond traditional backend trust
and establish a transparent, auditable, and user-controlled security model.

This transforms Securofy from a simple educational or security tool into a
decentralized digital-trust platform capable of supporting
future fraud-resistant financial ecosystems and verifiable learning credentials.

**The problem it solves**

Most users sign transactions without understanding what they actually do.

Current wallets often:

Show raw calldata or vague warnings.
Do not clearly classify risk levels.
Allow unlimited approvals and NFT drain permissions without strong alerts.

SignSure sits between transaction creation and signing.

Before a transaction is signed, SignSure:
Decodes the transaction calldata
Classifies the exact on-chain action
Applies deterministic, rule-based safety checks
Returns a clear risk level, safety score, and human-readable explanation

**Ethereum Track**

Our project - SignSure is a transaction safety wallet which gauges the risk of a transaction before it is signed and gives a safety score of the transaction to the user in easy and understandable.

### Schumacher
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/schumacher-b774) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/rastogi399/Formula-1) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1va8kyxpZDFcuQfZvQ14bdr3iBotEzowG/view?usp=drive_link) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-HACK%20THE%20THRONE-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hack-the-throne.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-1-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> AI-Powered DeFi Automation

![Solidity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Solidity-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Ethereum](https://img.shields.io/badge/Ethereum-333333?style=flat-square) ![Blockchain](https://img.shields.io/badge/Blockchain-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Decentralized finance (DeFi) offers powerful financial tools, but interacting with it is still complex and risky for many users. Performing even a simple trade often requires multiple manual steps:

Connecting a wallet

Choosing a decentralized exchange (DEX)

Selecting tokens and checking liquidity

Estimating gas fees

Setting slippage and confirming transactions

For beginners and even experienced users, this process can be time-consuming, error-prone, and difficult to manage across multiple blockchains.

Additionally, managing a crypto portfolio across chains like Ethereum and Solana requires switching between different tools, tracking balances manually, and monitoring market risks without real-time insights.

How Schumacher Solves This

Schumacher simplifies DeFi by introducing a conversational AI agent that automates complex blockchain operations.

Users can:

Execute trades using natural language commands

Automate recurring strategies such as DCA and portfolio rebalancing

Monitor portfolio performance in real time

Simulate transactions before execution to reduce risk

Interact with multiple chains from a single interface

Instead of navigating multiple dashboards and tools, users can simply type:

Swap 1 WETH to USDC  
Show my portfolio  
Set up a weekly DCA for ETH  


Schumacher handles the routing, gas estimation, transaction simulation, and execution while keeping wallets fully non-custodial and secure.

Impact

Schumacher makes DeFi:

Easier to use for beginners

Faster for experienced traders

Safer through transaction simulation and automation

More accessible through conversational interaction

By combining AI, smart contracts, and multi-chain infrastructure, Schumacher reduces the complexity barrier and enables users to interact with blockchain finance in a more intuitive way.

**Challenges we ran into**

Building Schumacher was exciting, but we faced several challenges during development.

One of the main challenges was integrating multiple technologies together. The project includes a frontend, backend, AI agent, smart contracts, and blockchain services. Making all these parts communicate correctly took time and careful debugging.

Another challenge was handling multi-chain interactions. Ethereum and Solana work differently, and managing transactions, wallet connections, and APIs for both chains required extra effort.

We also faced issues with dependency conflicts and environment setup, especially while working with LangChain, blockchain SDKs, and Python packages. We solved this by carefully selecting compatible versions and rebuilding the virtual environment.

Working with transaction simulation and gas estimation was another hurdle. We needed to ensure that transactions were safe and predictable before execution. This required testing with different networks and edge cases.

Finally, designing a simple and clean user interface for a complex system was challenging. We improved this by focusing on a chat-based workflow so users don’t need to understand all technical steps.

Each challenge helped us better understand the system and improve the stability and usability of Schumacher.

**Ethereum Track**

Schumacher is built around Ethereum and EVM-compatible chains, where smart contracts handle real DeFi operations such as token swaps, portfolio management, and automated investment strategies.

The platform integrates Web3 tools and deployed smart contracts to allow users to trade, rebalance portfolios, and run recurring strategies directly on-chain while remaining fully non-custodial. All transactions are simulated before execution to improve safety and transparency.

What makes our project unique is the AI layer on top of Ethereum. Instead of navigating complex DeFi dashboards, users can simply type commands in plain English, and the agent interprets the intent, prepares transactions, and executes them through Ethereum smart contracts.

By combining AI automation with secure Ethereum infrastructure, Schumacher makes DeFi more accessible, safer, and easier to use for both beginners and experienced users. This directly aligns with the Ethereum track’s goal of improving usability and real-world adoption of decentralized applications.

**The problem it solves**

**The Problem It Solves**

- MediChain makes primary healthcare access safer, faster, and more reliable, especially in areas where systems are fragmented or trust is low.

- Eliminates prescription fraud by storing verifiable prescription hashes on the blockchain

- Simplifies access to care through AI-based symptom guidance and doctor referrals

- Improves medicine availability by letting patients find nearby pharmacies with real-time stock

- Enhances patient safety with secure, tamper-proof medical records

- Reduces manual effort for doctors and pharmacies through digital, automated workflows

Overall, MediChain turns disconnected healthcare tasks into a single, trusted digital experience.

**Challenges we ran into**

One major challenge was ensuring prescription data integrity while keeping the system lightweight. Storing full prescription data on-chain was expensive and slow, especially during testing.

**How we solved it:**
We switched to a hash-based approach, storing only the prescription hash on the blockchain while keeping the full JSON data off-chain in the backend. This maintained immutability and verifiability without high gas costs or performance issues.

**Open Innovation**

MediChain fits Track 2.2 (Digital Primary Healthcare Access) by acting as a lightweight digital gateway to primary care, especially for underserved or rural areas.

AI symptom triage gives basic healthcare guidance without needing an immediate doctor visit.

Referral guidance connects patients to the right doctor or nearby pharmacy, reducing unnecessary travel.

Verified digital prescriptions prevent fraud and ensure trust even in low-resource settings.

Medicine discovery improve treatment adherence and access to essential drugs.

> Your blockchain monitoring and analytics companion

![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![WebSockets](https://img.shields.io/badge/WebSockets-333333?style=flat-square) ![ethers.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/ethers.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Express.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Express.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Ethereum](https://img.shields.io/badge/Ethereum-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![React.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/React.js-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

**The Problem & Solution**
ChainWatch solves the challenge of monitoring and analyzing blockchain transactions in real-time. It makes tracking ERC20 token transfers effortless by providing:

* **Instant alerts** - Get notified via Telegram the moment specific wallet addresses send or receive tokens, eliminating the need to constantly check blockchain explorers.
* **Portfolio tracking** - Automatically calculate token balances and portfolio values across multiple wallets without manual spreadsheet management.
* **Transaction analysis** - Categorize and analyze transaction patterns, identify top wallets, and understand token flow without writing complex blockchain queries.
* **Custom alert rules** - Set up intelligent alerts based on transaction amounts, wallet addresses, or price thresholds to catch important events.
* **Historical analytics** - Search and analyze past transactions with filtering and export capabilities instead of manually parsing blockchain data.

**Use Cases**
* **Token holders** monitoring their wallet activity for security.
* **Traders** tracking whale movements and large transfers to predict market shifts.
* **Project teams** monitoring token distribution and circulation supply.
* **Researchers** analyzing token transaction patterns and velocity.
* **Security teams** detecting suspicious wallet activity or unauthorized drains.

**Challenges we ran into**

* **WebSocket reconnection handling:** Maintaining stable blockchain connections was difficult. I implemented automatic reconnection logic and state recovery to ensure no data was lost when the WebSocket provider disconnected.
* **Real-time data synchronization:** Keeping the frontend UI in sync with backend events was tricky. I used WebSocket broadcasts to handle multiple connected clients simultaneously.
* **Price data integration:** We hit CoinGecko API rate limits frequently. I solved this by implementing fallback mechanisms and caching strategies for token price fetching.
* **Transaction categorization:** It was hard to identify specific actions (like DEX swaps vs. transfers) from raw on-chain data. I built intelligent categorization logic to parse logs and input data correctly.
* **State management:** Coordinating the blockchain listener, notifier, analytics, and portfolio tracker created race conditions. I adopted an event-driven architecture to ensure these services communicated smoothly.

> Redefining the Future of Dementia Care

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Java](https://img.shields.io/badge/Java-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

- Over 55 million people are affected by dementia worldwide, of which Alzheimer's is the most common form. Alzheimer's disease is a dangerous brain disorder which slowly destroys memory and other cognitive function of the brain.

- Last stage Alzheimer's results in confusion, personality changes, and inability to perform daily 

- Currently lack of proper help from credible sources results in extreme distress for both family members and patients.

- Research suggests that Indians are less likely to seek help in 'mental health diseases' which further exacerbate the problem.

**Beginner's track - Your first hack starts here!**

Currently, there is no cure for Alzheimer's but research (cited below) suggests a few creative approaches to better the condition of the patient.
One such solution involves showing the patient photos related to the patient’s persona but not directly attached to the memory of a patient.
{Showing a patient photos of close relatives results in extreme distress on failure to identify the photo}
Another solution involves tasks like solving crossword puzzles, basic mobility tasks etc.
Such solutions have shown to stabilize or even better the patient’s cognitive decline.
Our idea revolves around leveraging such solutions into a comprehensive gamified environment which involves doing such tasks daily.

![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![SQLite](https://img.shields.io/badge/SQLite-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Golang](https://img.shields.io/badge/Golang-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Blockchain](https://img.shields.io/badge/Blockchain-333333?style=flat-square) ![AI/ML](https://img.shields.io/badge/AI/ML-333333?style=flat-square) ![Solana](https://img.shields.io/badge/Solana-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

# *AuthChain*
 A system for enforcing human oversight over autonomous AI systems, built on an interruption-driven control architecture with permissioned, auditable execution enforced via blockchain-based governance.

## Problem Statement
AI is used primarily for its autonomous capabilities, powering companies all around the world to build and deploy products rapidly.

However, from gathered reports and studies, there has been a loss of $1.3 billion dollars due to such unrestricted AI execution, ranging from arbitary database deletions, poor quality code and security issues.

The simple solution, would be to be more involved in the code generation process, but this sacrifices a lot of the autonomy of the agentic execution.

Thus, our solution, **AuthChain**.

## What we do
Any AI generated code, relies on tool calls, and all tool calls are seperated into Read Tiers and Write/Delete tiers.

Any of the tools belonging to the latter category, are transferred to the policy service, which then decides if further human/relevant expert intervention is necessary.

If so, it is passed via blockchain, to the UI, for the user to approve or deny.

This creates immutable logs and hashes of any actions permitted by the relevant user, and ensures reliability and accountability.

## How it integrates with the relevant tools used in production today
- **Github Copilot and equivalents**

Such tools are simply an interaction between the IDE and the user themselves, and thus restricting it to single-person development.

AuthChain takes it forward and turns it into a Engineering tool, escalating issues accordingly, before they're ever committed.

- **Github CI/CD pipelines**

Such tools such as jenkins are reliant on predefined tests, and have no method of gatekeeping against rogue SQL queries, irrelevant files (w.r.t the tests and existing files), enabling injection of bypassing security measures via rogue LLM calls.

## Taking it a step further

A major problem faced by the state of the art LLMs is the filling up of the context window with the multitude of tools and MCP servers.

We instead allow the LLM to create its own Tools, which are shared and saved and securitized via the policy service and the blockchain service, and are classified in a seperate tier.

This allows the LLM to grow beyond its predefined capabilties while remaining securitized.

**Google Gemini**

Primary AI provider for agentic workflows such as creating new files, allowing the agent to build new tools, and powering SQL generation among other relevant tasks.

**Solana**

Majorly used for blocking AI critical proposal and registration of Validators to approve/reject the proposal. Hosts policy services and blockchain services.

**Vultr**

Tried hosting on Vultr first but didn't succeed due to credit card requirements.

**The problem it solves**

### Problem it Solves

Investing in government bonds is often *confusing, inaccessible,* and *limited to large minimum amounts*. For most people, understanding how bonds work or even seeing where their money goes is difficult. **Bondbuy makes this simpler and safer by enabling fractional ownership of government bonds**, allowing users to invest small amounts, see every transaction on-chain, and receive clear ***NFT-based proof of ownership***. It removes opacity, *lowers entry barriers*, and helps users learn how real-world bond investing works in a *transparent*, ***Web3-native*** way.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/8d37b2cbc9fe47119ba5d4082dabfd4d/9b80829f-6296-45b1-9907-57eb4af7b8af.png)

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/8d37b2cbc9fe47119ba5d4082dabfd4d/d43d6fc6-f0c7-4a51-ae20-c558eea92bcf.png)

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/8d37b2cbc9fe47119ba5d4082dabfd4d/307d86ed-cbc4-4eb0-b760-0af1703c8509.png)

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/8d37b2cbc9fe47119ba5d4082dabfd4d/e5fa1880-f6c0-462a-b974-927592308271.png)

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/8d37b2cbc9fe47119ba5d4082dabfd4d/525cd026-4856-462a-bf15-3e493eff2102.png)

**Challenges we ran into**

### Challenges I ran into

One of the biggest challenges was ****handling wallet interactions reliably****. Phantom wallet behavior on *Devnet* was sometimes inconsistent, especially during transaction signing and NFT minting. At times, transactions appeared successful on the frontend but failed silently on-chain. I overcame this by adding ***explicit transaction confirmation checks***, improving error handling, and closely monitoring logs on Solana Explorer to trace failures.

Another hurdle was ****implementing fractional bond logic**** in a way that felt realistic but still fit a hackathon demo. Mapping small ₹ investments to SOL values and ensuring accurate fractional ownership required careful validation. I solved this by *normalizing inputs*, locking exchange assumptions, and clearly communicating that this is an educational prototype.

Finally, ****on-chain data syncing with the dashboard**** was tricky. Keeping portfolio metrics in sync with live blockchain state required better state management and re-fetching strategies, which I refined through testing and iteration.

**Open Innovation**

### Open Innovation — Justification

Bondby fits the **Open Innovation** track by exploring a novel way to make traditional government bond investing more accessible, transparent, and educational using Web3 technologies. It reimagines an existing financial system through **fractional ownership, on-chain transactions, and NFT-based proof of ownership**, lowering entry barriers for new investors. The project demonstrates how blockchain can be applied beyond cryptocurrencies to real-world financial instruments, encouraging experimentation, learning, and new use cases that can inspire future innovation in public finance and fintech.

**Ethereum Track**

### ETHIndia — Track Justification

Bondby aligns with the ETHIndia track by incorporating **Ethereum-compatible smart contract concepts** in its system design. While the demo implementation uses Solana Devnet for faster transactions and lower friction during a hackathon, the **core bond registry, fractional ownership logic, and NFT-based proof of ownership are designed to be EVM-compatible** and can be deployed on Ethereum or Layer-2 networks without architectural changes.

The project demonstrates how **Ethereum smart contracts** can act as a canonical source of truth for bond definitions, ownership records, and verification, enabling transparent and tamper-resistant financial infrastructure. Bondby showcases how traditional financial instruments like government bonds can be modeled and owned fractionally using Ethereum’s programmable trust layer.

### BeatFlow
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/beatflow-98d0) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/avishrakshe/beatflow-onchain-cred.git) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://beatflow-onchain-cred-git-main-avishrakshes-projects.vercel.app?_vercel_share=RaTfpy4WQekitVCtcAnHlgKjOZzrGgKk) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-PayLoad'26-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://pay-load.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-1-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Where creator work becomes on-chain reputation.

![Solidity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Solidity-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![ethers.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/ethers.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Smart Contracts](https://img.shields.io/badge/Smart%20Contracts-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Digital creators generate massive economic value through their content, but they currently lack a trusted, portable, and transparent reputation system. Existing platforms measure creators using likes, views, and followers, which are platform-controlled, easy to manipulate, and cannot be verified outside a single application.

As a result:

Creators cannot prove their credibility across platforms

Reputation is locked inside centralized systems and can be deleted or altered

There is no standard way to measure trust, consistency, or contribution

Creator activity does not translate into real benefits, opportunities, or rewards

Brands, platforms, and partners cannot reliably evaluate creator quality

This makes it difficult for new creators to gain trust, for experienced creators to unlock opportunities, and for platforms to fairly distribute benefits.

BeatFlow solves this by introducing an on-chain credibility layer that converts verified creator activity into a tamper-proof, portable reputation stored on Ethereum. This allows creators to own their reputation, prove trust transparently, and automatically unlock rewards, perks, and opportunities based on their real contribution.

**Challenges we ran into**

One of the main challenges was designing a credibility system that is both meaningful and simple enough to implement within a hackathon timeline. Defining which creator activities should contribute to credibility and how to weight them fairly required multiple iterations. We solved this by starting with a small set of verifiable metrics such as beats uploaded, remixes created, plays, and earnings, and designing a flexible scoring formula that can evolve in future versions.

Another major challenge was separating on-chain and off-chain responsibilities. Storing raw creator data directly on-chain was expensive and inefficient. To solve this, we implemented an off-chain aggregation layer that computes credibility scores and only stores the final score, tier, and hashes on-chain, ensuring scalability while keeping the system tamper-proof.

We also faced difficulties in designing a smooth rewards redemption flow that felt instant while still being trustless. Smart contract state updates and UI synchronization sometimes caused delays. We solved this by using event listeners from the blockchain and optimistic UI updates, which allowed the frontend to reflect reward unlocks immediately after verification.

Finally, integrating multiple system components — frontend, backend, and smart contracts — required careful coordination and testing. We resolved this by building and testing each layer independently first, then integrating them step by step with mock data before connecting everything to the Ethereum test network.

These challenges helped us design a more robust, scalable, and realistic on-chain rewards system.

**Open Innovation**

BeatFlow addresses a broad and unsolved problem in the creator economy — the lack of a portable, transparent, and fair credibility and rewards system for digital creators. This problem exists across multiple industries including music, art, gaming, education, and content platforms.

The solution is designed as an open and extensible credibility layer that can be integrated by any platform, marketplace, or partner. Creator reputation is not locked into a single application but can be reused across ecosystems, enabling interoperability and new business models.

Key open innovation aspects include:

A generic on-chain credibility framework applicable beyond music

Open smart contracts that any platform can build on

Portable reputation across platforms and applications

Partner-based reward integrations through open APIs

Scalable to creators, freelancers, DAO contributors, and gig workers

BeatFlow demonstrates how blockchain can enable open, interoperable, and user-owned reputation systems, encouraging collaboration between platforms and partners while creating a fair and transparent creator economy.

**Ethereum Track**

BeatFlow is built directly on Ethereum and uses smart contracts as the core trust and rewards layer of the system. The project relies on Ethereum to store creator credibility scores, tiers, and reward eligibility in a tamper-proof and transparent way.

We use Ethereum smart contracts to:

Maintain an on-chain Creator Credibility Score for each wallet

Verify creator activity and reputation without centralized control

Map credibility tiers to rewards and benefits

Enable trustless reward redemption

Ethereum provides immutability, transparency, and security, which are essential for building a reliable reputation and rewards system. By storing credibility on-chain, creators truly own their reputation and can prove trust across platforms.

The project directly aligns with the Ethereum track by demonstrating real-world use of smart contracts for identity, reputation, and on-chain rewards, showcasing how Ethereum can power scalable creator ecosystems.

> Where student money clicks

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Problem DormWallet Solves

Students living in hostels, dorms, or shared apartments often face messy, time-consuming, and error-prone finance management:

Tracking Shared Expenses
Roommates pay for utilities, groceries, WiFi, mess fees, and other shared bills — keeping track manually leads to confusion and conflicts.

Budgeting Challenges
Students struggle to plan and stick to a monthly budget because there’s no fun, interactive way to see where money is going.

Bill Splitting Hassles
Dividing costs fairly among friends often involves manual calculations, notes, or chat reminders, which are tedious and easily forgotten.

Lack of Financial Awareness
Students rarely get insights into their spending habits or see trends over time, which can lead to overspending and stress.

Existing Tools Are Not Student-Friendly
Most expense apps are either designed for adults, banks, or businesses — not for small, shared living groups with social interactions.

How DormWallet Fixes This

Automatically splits shared expenses between friends.

Generates interactive dashboards showing spending breakdowns.

Provides AI-powered smart insights and notifications to keep users on track.

Makes budgeting fun, visual, and interactive.

Reduces conflicts and confusion over who owes what.

 Essentially, DormWallet turns messy, manual finance tracking into a clean, collaborative, and stress-free experience for students.

**Challenges we ran into**

Interactive UI Complexity

Problem: Making the dashboard fun, clickable, and visually appealing without slowing down the app.

Solution: Used Tailwind + React state + Canvas to create animated charts, collapsible expense cards, and interactive buttons efficiently.

Dynamic Shared Expense Display

Problem: Updating charts and balances automatically when users or expenses change.

Solution: Built a React state-driven algorithm so adding or removing friends/expenses instantly updates the pie chart and balances.

Responsive Design

Problem: Ensuring the dashboard looks good on both desktop and mobile while keeping animations smooth.

Solution: Leveraged Tailwind’s responsive utilities and CSS transitions for hover/slide effects.

**Hostel Life Utility Manager - UI/UX Beginner Track (Freshers Only)**

USP: Automatically splits shared expenses and updates balances in real time, reducing errors and conflicts.

Interactive UI/UX: Clickable pie charts, collapsible cards, and dynamic reminders provide clear, actionable insights.

Intuitive Design: Responsive, visually engaging interface tailored for student hostel and dorm environments.

Focused on solving real pain points in shared finance management for students.

![Solidity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Solidity-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![MetaMask](https://img.shields.io/badge/MetaMask-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![ethers.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/ethers.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Ethereum](https://img.shields.io/badge/Ethereum-333333?style=flat-square) ![React.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/React.js-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Modern financial and reward systems rely heavily on traditional credit scores and centralized trust models. While effective for established users, these systems systematically exclude students, freelancers, gig workers, and first-time earners who lack formal credit histories despite being digitally active and financially responsible.

Credence introduces a decentralized, blockchain-based credibility and rewards framework that transforms non-traditional trust signals into verifiable on-chain metrics. It allows digital credibility to be measured, proven, and rewarded securely and transparently.

1. Fairer Access to Rewards
2. Privacy-Conscious Design
3. Improved Security and Trust

**Challenges we ran into**

The issue surfaced when using Prisma ORM with the smart contract interaction layer. Prisma expected explicit values for some schema fields during user creation, while the smart contract relied on default values defined on-chain. This mismatch caused unexpected transaction reverts and data inconsistency between the off-chain and on-chain layers.

This hurdle ultimately strengthened our architecture and reinforced the importance of tight schema consistency and clear contract boundaries in blockchain-based systems.

**Ethereum Track**

The core challenge of Track 1 is to address the limitations of traditional financial trust systems and design a blockchain-based credibility layer that enables fair, transparent, and tamper-resistant rewards.

By storing credibility scores and tiers on an immutable blockchain, our system ensures:

Transparency: All credibility metrics and reward eligibility are verifiable on-chain.

Tamper-resistance: Once recorded, credibility data cannot be manipulated or altered.

These verified on-chain metrics directly power a real-time rewards ecosystem, enabling users to instantly redeem discounts, perks, and benefits across e-commerce, fintech, travel, and lifestyle platforms through wallet-based authentication.

> An RWA tokenization platform using Ethereum

![Solidity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Solidity-333333?style=flat-square) ![MetaMask](https://img.shields.io/badge/MetaMask-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![ethers.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/ethers.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Ethereum](https://img.shields.io/badge/Ethereum-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

The Problem: The "Locked Capital" Crisis
Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs) are the backbone of the economy, yet they face a massive liquidity trap. When a small supplier delivers goods to a large corporation, they rarely get paid immediately. Instead, they receive an invoice with a payment term of 30, 60, or 90 days.

Cash Flow Stagnation: The business has "money on paper" but zero cash in hand to pay salaries, buy raw materials, or scale.

The Banking Barrier: Traditional banks often reject small businesses for "Factoring" (buying their invoices) because the manual auditing cost is too high or the business lacks physical collateral.

The Trust Gap: Fraudulent "Double Financing"—where a dishonest supplier sells the same invoice to two different banks—costs the financial industry billions annually.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/9fd96c8baa7447ff885f4d9dab6c53d3/61de56c0-9717-4f4e-84b8-191509d0a7d2.png)

**Challenges we ran into**

Invoices contain sensitive data (client names, specific items). Storing these directly on the public Base blockchain would be a privacy nightmare, but storing them only in a private database made the "RWA" claim unverifiable.

The Cause: The inherent conflict between the transparency required for trust and the confidentiality required for business.

The Fix: I implemented a Hash-Linking strategy.

The sensitive PDF is encrypted and stored in Supabase Storage.

I generate a unique SHA-256 Hash (digital fingerprint) of that file.

Only the Hash and the Chainlink Proof of Reserve status are stored on-chain.

Therefore, anyone can verify that the asset exists and hasn't been tampered with, but only authorized parties with the decryption key can see the private business details.

**Open Innovation**

Our project fits the Open Innovation track because we are transforming Trade Finance from a closed, gate-kept bank process into an open, permissionless liquidity network. By using Oracles to verify off-chain assets and L2s to settle them, we allow for a collaborative financial ecosystem

**The problem it solves**

**WalletX** is a production-ready, **next-generation DeFi escrow platform that enables trustless peer-to-peer transactions using smart contracts**, with a strong focus on privacy, usability, and real-world adoption.

**Core Innovations:**

**1. Temporary Disposable Wallets:** World’s first **disposable wallet system** for enhanced privacy, one-time transactions, and safe testing without exposing permanent addresses.

**2. Trustless Escrow:** Fully **on-chain smart contract escrow with automated claim and refund mechanisms**, removing intermediaries and ensuring transparency.

**3. Multi-Chain Deployment:** Live across 8 EVM networks:  **Ethereum, Base, Lisk, Polygon, BNB Chain, ZetaChain, Somnia, and Citrea**, with a unified user experience.

**4. Advanced Analytics & Graphs:** Real-time, stock-market-style dashboards showing network-wise **volume, activity, and trends, filterable by 1D, 7D, 30D, and All-Time.**

**5. AI Assistant (On-Chain Action Enabled):** WalletX features an **AI-powered Web3 assistant** that can read blockchain data and perform real on-chain actions through user-approved transactions.

The **AI assistant** enables:
- **Wallet Balance Check:** Fetches real-time wallet balances directly from the blockchain.
- **Token Transfers:** Initiates secure token transfers with user confirmation.
- **Price & Volume Analytics:** Provides live price, volume, and network analytics.
- **Smart Contract Writing:** Generates custom smart contracts based on user requirements.
- **ERC-20 Token Creation:** Assists in deploying ERC-20 tokens on supported networks.
- **NFT Collection Deployment:** Creates and deploys NFT collections (ERC-1155).
- **Blockchain Network Status:** Displays live network data including block height, gas price, and RPC details.

The **AI interacts with multiple EVM networks, reads live chain data, and executes blockchain operations** only after explicit user approval, ensuring security and decentralization.

**6. QR Code Ecosystem:** Built-in **QR code generation and scanning for instant wallet sharing** and mobile-friendly transactions.

**7. Email Automation:** Integrated Email Service for secure, **real-time escrow status and transaction notifications.**

**Why it matters:**

- Solves **real-world trust problems** such as freelance payments, marketplace transactions, property deposits, and B2B agreements.

- **Fully deployed, mobile-responsive, and production-ready**, not just a prototype.

**Challenges we ran into**

**1. Multi-Chain Deployment:** Deploying escrow contracts on 8 EVM networks was tough due to different RPC/gas configs. I solved it by creating a unified deployment script with ethers.js.

**2. Temporary Wallets:** Ensuring secure creation & destruction of disposable wallets was challenging. I used bip39 standards and cleanup logic to prevent leaks.

**3. AI Integration:** Running AI inside a decentralized app without backend was hard. I fixed it using a serverless API bridge for real-time assistance.
