**The problem it solves**

## The Problem Voxrt Solves

Today’s digital creators face ***three major problems***: **lack of trust**, **platform dependency**, and **unfair monetization**. Traditional NFT marketplaces are either too complex for beginners or too centralized, where creators lose control, transparency, and earnings.

## How Voxrt Helps

**Voxrt** solves this by providing a ***trustless, transparent, and creator-first*** NFT marketplace on Ethereum.

- *Creators* can mint NFTs without worrying about manipulation, hidden fees, or asset loss  
- *Collectors* get **on-chain verified ownership**, making purchases safer and scam-resistant  
- *Beginners* use Web3 features without understanding blockchain complexity  
- *Artists* store assets on ***IPFS***, ensuring permanence and censorship resistance  
- *Sellers* earn more due to **low platform fees (2.5%)**

With **AI-powered pricing suggestions**, Voxrt also removes guesswork in NFT valuation, making minting smarter and faster.

***In short: Voxrt makes NFT creation, trading, and ownership simpler, safer, and more transparent for everyone.***

**Challenges we ran into**

## Challenges I Ran Into

One of the biggest challenges I faced was ***handling real-time blockchain state with a smooth user experience***. Blockchain transactions are slow and unpredictable, but users expect instant feedback.

Initially, actions like **minting, listing, or buying NFTs** felt broken because the UI stayed idle while the transaction was still pending on-chain. This created confusion and poor UX.

### How I Solved It

I implemented an ***optimistic UI approach***:
- UI state updates immediately after wallet confirmation  
- Clear step-based status like *“Approving…”*, *“Processing…”*, and **“Success”**  
- Rollback handling in case a transaction fails  

Another major hurdle was ***IPFS gateway failures and CORS issues***. Some images randomly failed to load.

To fix this, I added **multiple IPFS gateway fallbacks** and caching, ensuring assets always load reliably.

***These challenges taught me how to balance decentralized systems with real-world user expectations.***

**Open Track**

## Open Track — Why Voxrt Fits

Voxrt is a ***full-stack Web3 application*** that combines **blockchain, AI, and modern frontend engineering** to solve real problems in digital asset ownership and trading.

On the blockchain side, Voxrt uses **Ethereum smart contracts** for trustless NFT minting, secure marketplace transactions, transparent fee handling, and on-chain ownership verification. All assets and transactions are fully verifiable and decentralized.

On the AI side, Voxrt integrates **AI-powered pricing intelligence** that analyzes NFT metadata to suggest fair market prices with confidence scores, helping creators make informed listing decisions.

### Why Open Track Is Ideal

- Combines **AI + Blockchain + IPFS** in a production-ready system  
- Solves a real creator–collector marketplace problem  
- Demonstrates strong engineering across frontend, backend, and smart contracts  
- Focuses on usability, transparency, and scalability  

***Voxrt represents an end-to-end, real-world application—making Open Track the perfect fit.***

**Web3/Defi Track**

## Partner Track — DeFi / Web3 (Lucidly Finance)

Voxrt aligns with the **DeFi Web3 track** by building a fully decentralized digital asset marketplace powered by **Ethereum smart contracts**, transparent on-chain transactions, and trustless ownership transfer.

The platform enables **peer-to-peer value exchange** using Ethereum, where NFTs act as on-chain financial assets that can be minted, listed, priced, and traded without intermediaries. All marketplace logic—escrow handling, fee distribution, and asset transfer—is executed directly on-chain, ensuring transparency and security.

Voxrt also introduces **AI-assisted price intelligence**, helping creators make more financially informed decisions while listing assets. This reduces market inefficiencies such as overpricing or undervaluation and improves overall liquidity behavior within the NFT economy.

### Why It Fits DeFi / Web3

- Fully decentralized marketplace on Ethereum  
- Smart contract–based asset custody and settlement  
- Transparent, on-chain financial transactions  
- NFTs treated as programmable digital assets  
- AI-driven insights improving market efficiency  

***Voxrt demonstrates how DeFi principles can be applied beyond tokens—into real, creator-driven digital economies.***

**Track Opinion**

## Track Opinion — Why Voxrt Fits

Voxrt strongly aligns with the **Track Opinion** category by using AI as a ***decision-support system*** rather than a rule-based or automated tool.

The platform provides **AI-driven pricing suggestions with confidence scores**, forming an *informed opinion* on fair NFT valuation based on content context, rarity indicators, and market signals. This opinion actively guides creators during minting and listing decisions.

### Judge-Safe Justification

- AI delivers ***market-aware opinions***, not enforced outcomes  
- Helps creators avoid **overpricing and underpricing**  
- Reduces guesswork in NFT valuation  
- Builds **trust and efficiency** within the marketplace  

Instead of automating decisions, Voxrt empowers users with intelligent insights.

***This makes Track Opinion a natural and strong fit for Voxrt in its current form.***

> Military-Grade DeFi Intelligence

![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Google Gemini, Wagmi, Viem, RainbowKit, Aave, Framer Motion, Web3, DeFi, Blockchain](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js,%20TypeScript,%20Tailwind%20CSS,%20Google%20Gemini,%20Wagmi,%20Viem,%20RainbowKit,%20Aave,%20Framer%20Motion,%20Web3,%20DeFi,%20Blockchain-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Aegis Command is a risk management dashboard for the Aave Protocol (Sepolia Testnet). It features:

The Neural Link: A Gemini-powered AI that continuously monitors yield (APY) and Health Factor data to generate real-time tactical advice.

Risk Heatmap: A visual, color-coded gauge that translates raw health data into instant situational awareness.

Direct Execution: Users can Supply and Borrow assets directly on-chain without leaving the terminal interface.

Voice Command (Beta): A natural language interface to query risk scenarios hands-free.

**Challenges we ran into**

1. The "Infinite Feedback" Loop (AI Rate Limiting)

The biggest technical hurdle was integrating the live yield listener with the AI backend. Initially, our useEffect hook tracked the apy state too aggressively. Because DeFi yields fluctuate constantly, this triggered an infinite loop of API calls to Google Gemini, causing us to hit the "429 Too Many Requests" rate limit almost immediately.

The Fix: We implemented a "Debounce" mechanism and a strict 60-second cooldown timer in the frontend. This ensures the AI only re-calibrates when there is a significant state change, preventing API bans while keeping the data fresh.

2. Taming the Web Speech API

Building a reliable Voice Command interface in the browser was surprisingly difficult. The native Web Speech API is inconsistent across different browsers and would often disconnect silently in the middle of a sentence.

The Fix: We added visual feedback states (a pulsing red mic icon) and error handling that logs "Neural Link Sync Failed" to the terminal if the browser drops the connection. We also marked this feature as "Beta" to set realistic user expectations.

3. Real-Time Blockchain State Management

synchronizing the local React state with the Aave V3 smart contract on Sepolia was complex. We faced issues where the UI would show "Success" before the blockchain actually updated the user's balance.

The Fix: We utilized useWaitForTransactionReceipt from Wagmi to create a "Optimistic UI" update flow. The terminal only logs "Ledger Updated" once the transaction is actually confirmed on-chain, ensuring truth in data.

**Fresher's Track**

I am a first-year undergraduate (Batch 2029) at IIT Roorkee. This project represents a massive "Zero to One" technical leap for me. In under 24 hours, I learned and integrated three complex domains:

Web3: Interacting with EVM smart contracts via Wagmi/Viem.

AI Engineering: Securing Google Gemini API keys server-side to prevent exposure.

Production UI: Building a responsive, animated terminal interface with Next.js 15. Aegis Command is my entry into serious full-stack development.

**Web3/Defi Track**

Deep Protocol Integration (Aave V3): Unlike read-only dashboards, Aegis Command is a fully functional DeFi terminal. We integrated directly with the Aave V3 Lending Pool on the Sepolia Testnet. The application handles complex state management for depositETH, borrow, repay, and withdraw functions, proving full read/write capabilities on the EVM.

2. Solving the "Web3 UX" Crisis: The biggest barrier to Web3 adoption is complexity. By abstracting raw on-chain data (Health Factors, Liquidation Thresholds) into a Neural Link interface, we solve a critical Web3 design problem: making decentralized finance accessible without dumbing down the protocol's power.

3. Modern Web3 Stack Mastery: The project demonstrates proficiency with the cutting-edge Ethereum stack:

Wagmi & Viem: For type-safe, low-level hook interactions.

RainbowKit: For seamless wallet connection and network management.

Smart Contract ABIs: We manually integrated the Aave Pool ABI to execute collateral management strategies directly from the frontend.

Team **Git Ignore Us** -- Ashutosh singh, [Aditya Raj Gupta](https://github.com/aditya-raj-gupta-prog)

[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/yieldx-76e5) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/vyqno/yieldX) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://yield-x-cylq.vercel.app/) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-MERGE--CONFLICT-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://mergeconflict.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-1-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> The Intelligent Interface for DeFi Yields on Aave

![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![AAVE](https://img.shields.io/badge/AAVE-333333?style=flat-square) ![Redis](https://img.shields.io/badge/Redis-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Supabase](https://img.shields.io/badge/Supabase-333333?style=flat-square) ![ThirdWeb](https://img.shields.io/badge/ThirdWeb-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

### The problem it solves
DeFi yields on Aave are constantly changing, making it difficult for users to manually track the best opportunities. Existing dashboards are often slow, cluttered, or lack real-time updates.

**YieldX solves this by providing:**
*   **Instancy**: leveraging a Redis-backed caching layer to serve yield data in <10ms.
*   **Clarity**: A glassmorphism-based UI that simplifies complex protocol data into clear health factors and APY metrics.
*   **Intelligence**: An embedded AI agent that contextually analyzes your wallet risk and recommends safer pools based on real-time on-chain data.
*   **Accessibility**: A public, rate-limited API that allows other developers to build on top of our aggregated data.

**Challenges we ran into**

### Challenges I ran into

**1. Vercel Hobby Limits**
We initially hit execution time limits with our cron jobs. We solved this by optimizing our daily-snapshot logic and moving heavy data ingestion to a background worker pattern that processes tasks asynchronously.

**2. AI Hallucinations**
The AI initially recommended non-existent pools. We fixed this by implementing a **"Tool Call"** architecture where the AI is forced to query our real-time API tools (/api/yields) before giving any financial advice, ensuring 100% factual accuracy.

**3. API Rate Limiting**
To safely open our API to the public, we had to implement a robust rate-limiting strategy using **Upstash Redis**. This prevents abuse while ensuring high availability for all developers building on our platform.

**Open Track**

### Open Innovation Track

YieldX pushes the boundaries of open financial data by creating a **public, permissionless infrastructure** for DeFi intelligence.

**1. Democratizing Data Access:**
We built a custom, high-performance indexing layer that transforms complex, raw blockchain data from Aave into a standardized, easy-to-consume API (/api/yields). By making this API public and documented, we are not just building a product but an open utility that allows *any* developer to build yield-aware applications without needing to run their own indexers.

**2. Novel UX Patterns:**
We are innovating on the "DeFi Dashboard" experience by:
*   **Removing Friction**: Implementing "Lazy Caching" to deliver sub-10ms response times, challenging the norm of slow Web3 dApps.
*   **Human-Centric Design**: Replacing complex tabular data with a conversational AI interface that understands natural language queries about risk and returns.

**3. Open Source Contribution:**
The entire codebase is open-source, providing a reference implementation for:
*   Next.js 16 + WebSockets pattern for real-time crypto data.
*   Integrating Vercel AI SDK with on-chain EVM tools.
*   A scalable background worker architecture for serverless environments.

**Web3/Defi Track**

YieldX is a direct solution to the complex problem of tracking real-time DeFi yields. It fits the Web3/DeFi track by building a production-ready indexing layer on top of the Aave protocol.

**How we addressed the Problem Statement:**

1.  **Protocol Integration**: We integrated directly with Aave V3 on Ethereum Mainnet, tracking the specific required assets: **USDC, USDT, USDe, and crvUSD**, along with 50+ others.
2.  **Low Latency Indexing**: We solved the challenge of "continuous ingestion" by building a background worker that fetches on-chain data and caches it in **Upstash Redis**, reducing read latency to <10ms.
3.  **Real-Time Data**: As requested in the problem statement, we implemented **WebSockets** to push live APY updates to the dashboard without page reloads.
4.  **Public Infrastructure**: We went beyond just a dashboard by exposing a **clean, documented Public API** (/api/yields), fulfilling the requirement to provide accessible data for other developers.
5.  **DeFi USP**: Our "Brownie Point" feature is the **AI Risk Agent**, which adds a layer of intelligence over raw DeFi data, helping users manage LTV ratios and avoid liquidation.

> A decentralized, privacy-first grievance system.

![IPFS](https://img.shields.io/badge/IPFS-333333?style=flat-square) ![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Rust](https://img.shields.io/badge/Rust-333333?style=flat-square) ![Solana](https://img.shields.io/badge/Solana-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

**For the first 24 hours: Simple changes your dns entry of your system to 1.1.1.1. or 8.8.8.8 (if using JIO network, for some reason jio is blocking dns request) or simply access the project link via VPN like Proton or else, as DNS entries may take time to be written or use brave browser ( it works for me without vpn )**

A Privacy-Preserving & Transparent Grievance Reporting Platform

Overview:

GrievanceChain is a blockchain-based grievance reporting system that enables citizens to submit grievances securely, privately, and immutably, while ensuring full transparency and auditability of grievance status updates.

Traditional grievance portals are centralized, opaque, and editable by administrators, which often results in loss of trust, silent modification, or unresolved complaints.

GrievanceChain addresses this by combining:

-Client-side encryption
-Decentralized storage (IPFS)
-Immutable audit trails (Solana blockchain)

The platform ensures that grievance content remains confidential, while its lifecycle and resolution status remain publicly verifiable.


Problem Statement-

-Existing grievance systems suffer from:
-Centralized control and lack of transparency
-No verifiable proof of submission or progress
-Potential manipulation or deletion of records
-Privacy risks due to plaintext storage

Citizens have no cryptographic guarantee that:
-Their grievance exists
-It hasn’t been altered
-Its status updates are genuine

Solution
GrievanceChain introduces a trust-minimized architecture:

-Grievance content is encrypted client-side
-Encrypted data is stored on IPFS
-Only the CID (content hash) is stored on-chain
-Status updates are appended as immutable blockchain events
-The backend remains stateless and untrusted
This ensures:
🔒 Privacy
🧾 Integrity
🔍 Transparency
🧱 Tamper resistance



Flow
   │
   ├─ Encrypt grievance (AES – MVP)
   │
   ├─ Upload encrypted JSON → IPFS
   │        └─ CID
   │
   ├─ Store CID + metadata → Solana
   │
   └─ Status updates recorded on-chain

This project is a proof-of-work MVP demonstrating:
- Secure grievance submission
- On-chain anchoring
- Verifiable integrity
- Privacy-preserving storage

It is intentionally minimal to validate feasibility within a hackathon timeframe.


Future Work:

- Replace symmetric encryption with asymmetric encryption
- Role-based admin dashboard for departments
- Automated email notifications on submission & status updates
- DAO or multi-sig based grievance resolution authority
- Escrow-based incentive model for guaranteed responses
- Production-grade key management
- Better UX for non-technical users

**Challenges we ran into**

-Implementing everything within a short hackathon timeframe

-Steep learning curve for IPFS content addressing

-Designing and deploying a robust Solana smart contract

-Handling PDAs, account sizing, and status chaining

-Integrating blockchain logic with a clean UI

-Balancing security correctness with MVP scope

**Open Track**

This project fits the open track because it addresses a real-world governance and transparency problem that does not currently have a production-grade, decentralized solution. It is not limited to a single domain track (like DeFi, NFTs, or tooling) but instead explores a new application of Blockchain Technology for civic infrastructure: secure, immutable, and verifiable grievance reporting.
The idea is exploratory and impact-driven: combining client-side encryption, IPFS, and blockchain immutability to build trust in systems where trust is currently weak. Since this problem space is not explicitly covered by existing tracks and the solution itself is novel, experimental, and cross-domain, open track is the most appropriate category

Sandeep Singh

### Vultara
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/vultara-e808) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/vultara-labs) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://www.vultara.xyz/) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/f7Qk6HbKSIw) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Base%20Indonesia%20Hackathon%202025-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://base-indonesia-hackathon-2025.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-1-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Sustainable ETH Yields, Zero Complexity.

![Solidity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Solidity-333333?style=flat-square) ![OpenZeppelin](https://img.shields.io/badge/OpenZeppelin-333333?style=flat-square) ![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Vultara solves the complexity barrier of institutional-grade yield strategies for everyday ETH holders. While DeFi options protocols like Thetanuts V4 offer powerful yield generation capabilities, they remain inaccessible to the 99% of retail users due to intimidating interfaces, complex terminology, and high execution risks.

**Core Problems Addressed:**

**1. Complexity Paralysis**
Options trading is notoriously difficult. Users must understand "Delta," "Theta," and "Strike Selection" before placing a trade. A single mistake could lead to total loss. Vultara abstracts this entire complexity into a simple "Deposit & Earn" interface. Our protocol handles the strategy execution and compounding behind the scenes, making complex derivatives as simple as a savings account.

**2. Inaccessible Institutional Yield**
Strategies like "Covered Calls" are standard tools for institutions to generate consistent cash flow on idle assets. Retail users typically just hold tokens and miss out on this yield. Vultara democratizes access to these institutional strategies by leveraging Thetanuts V4's OptionBook, allowing anyone with as little as 0.001 ETH to participate in sophisticated real-yield generation.

**3. Safety & Execution Risk**
Manually managing options positions requires 24/7 monitoring. Missing an expiry or failing to exercise can result in lost profits. Vultara's smart contracts streamline the entire lifecycle—from order filling to settlement—eliminating human error and ensuring that strategies are executed with precision on-chain.

**4. Lack of Guidance**
Most DeFi protocols are "self-service" with zero support. Users are left guessing which strategy fits their risk profile. Vultara integrates Nova AI, a context-aware intelligent advisor that analyzes live user positions and explains risks in plain language (supporting multiple languages), guiding users to make informed decisions without needing a finance degree.

**What People Can Use It For:**

**- Sustainable ETH Accumulation:** Long-term ETH holders can deposit their idle assets to earn "Real Yield" (premiums paid by market makers) rather than inflationary token emissions, effectively growing their ETH stack over time.

**- Automated Portfolio Hedging:** Users can use Vultara's vaults to generate cash flow that buffers against market volatility, smoothing out the ups and downs of the crypto market.

**- Education-First DeFi:** Newcomers can use Vultara as a safe sandbox to learn about options concepts through our "Gamified User Journey" and AI assistant before diving into more complex trading.

**How It Makes Tasks Easier and Safer:**

**- Easier:** We replaced the traditional 10-step options trading workflow (Analyze → Select Strike → Select Expiry → Approve → Mint → Sell) with a 1-click experience. Users simply deposit ETH, and the protocol handles the rest.

**- Safer:** Built on Base Mainnet with non-custodial infrastructure. Users retain ownership of their vault shares (vETH). Our strategies are transparent on-chain, and the smart contracts handle ETH/WETH conversion internally, eliminating the counterparty risks associated with centralized yield platforms.

**Challenges we ran into**

**Challenge 1: Bridging Complex Options Logic with Simple UX**

**Problem:** Thetanuts V4 uses a powerful "Option Book" architecture where users must "fill orders" with signatures. This concept (RFQ, Limit Orders) is alien to retail users who just want to "Deposit and Earn." Exposing this complexity would kill adoption.

**Solution:** I abstracted the entire Option Book interaction layer. Instead of asking users to sign individual orders, I built a Vault interface acting as an asset manager. The user deposits ETH, and the smart contract pools liquidity to execute strategies against the Option Book automatically.

**Learning:** The best DeFi products are "mullets" — Simple in the front (UX), sophisticated in the back (Protocol).

---

**Challenge 2: Handling Native ETH vs. WETH**

**Problem:** Thetanuts V4 requires wrapped tokens (WETH) for collateral, but for the best UX, I wanted Vultara to accept native ETH directly — saving users from extra "Wrap/Unwrap" transactions.

**Solution:** I engineered the vault smart contract to handle wrapping internally. Users deposit raw ETH, receive vault shares, and the contract manages WETH conversion only when executing strategies. Users never need to touch WETH manually.

**Learning:** Every click matters. Optimizing gas and steps for users is worth the extra engineering effort.

---

**Challenge 3: Fair Share Pricing Across Epochs**

**Problem:** Options strategies run in weekly "epochs." Users deposit at different times, and vault value fluctuates based on performance. Calculating fair share prices that reward early depositors without punishing late ones was tricky.

**Solution:** I implemented dynamic share pricing based on total vault assets (ETH + WETH + locked positions). The formula ensures late depositors don't dilute early depositors' earnings. I also built an epoch-aware withdrawal system to prevent flash-loan exploits during active strategies.

**Learning:** DeFi accounting is harder than it looks. Every edge case needs explicit handling.

---

**Challenge 4: AI Hallucinations in Financial Advice**

**Problem:** Integrating an LLM as a financial advisor ("Nova") carried the risk of providing inaccurate or dangerous advice, or inventing non-existent features.

**Solution:** I implemented strict system prompting with real-time context injection. Nova receives live user data (balance, vault state) and is constrained to only discuss Vultara's specific strategies. I added explicit risk disclaimers to ensure it educates users on downside scenarios rather than just hyping returns.

**Learning:** AI in DeFi needs guardrails. Context-aware prompting transforms a chatbot into a valuable, safe protocol interface.

**Thetanuts Finance Track**

Vultara was built precisely to answer Thetanuts V4's call for simplifying options complexity. We fit directly into the "Gamified Frontends" and "AI Agents" categories by repackaging V4's sophisticated infrastructure into a retail-friendly experience on Base.

**1. Simplifying the "Intimidating Interface":**

The brief identifies "complex terminology" as a major barrier. Vultara abstracts Thetanuts' OptionBook mechanics (RFQ & Signatures) entirely behind a "1-Click Deposit" interface. We replaced finance jargon with a mobile-first, premium dark UI that focuses on "Yield Generation" rather than "Option Selling," onboarding users who would otherwise drop off instantly.

**2. Integrating an "AI Agent" for Guidance:**

Directly addressing the request for "AI agents that guide users," we built Nova AI. Nova is a context-aware on-chain interpreter that reads a user's active vault position and live market data to explain risks and strategies in plain language. This transforms the "Lack of Guidance" problem into an interactive learning experience with real-time, personalized advice.

**3. Building "Gamified Engagement Loops":**

We introduced a Tier System (Initiate → Associate → Partner → Sovereign) that rewards users for healthy financial behaviors. By tracking progress, unlocking tier benefits based on TVL, and visualizing achievements, we create the "engagement loops" and "progression" systems explicitly requested in the brief. DeFi feels less like a spreadsheet and more like leveling up.

**4. Technical Integration with V4 Infrastructure:**

Under the hood, Vultara's smart contracts directly interact with the Thetanuts V4 OptionBook via the 'fillOrder' API. We built a vault abstraction layer that pools user deposits and executes covered call strategies, demonstrating real, functional usage of V4's RFQ engine—not just a frontend mockup.

### Voclin
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/voclin-d2cf) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://trodi.vercel.app/) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Base%20Indonesia%20Hackathon%202025-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://base-indonesia-hackathon-2025.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-1-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Borrow cheaper by selling volatility

![Solidity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Solidity-333333?style=flat-square) ![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

In today's DeFi lending landscape (as of January 2026), borrowers face persistently high borrowing costs even when markets are volatilebecause standard protocols (Aave, Morpho, Compound forks) only charge utilization-based interest without any mechanism to offset that cost using the very volatility that's driving up rates. At the same time, advanced DeFi users who understand options vaults (like those from Thetanuts Finance) are manually farming premiums in separate positions, but they can't easily combine that yield with leverage or borrowing needs. This creates friction, opportunity cost, and risk:

Borrowers pay full interest rates (often 8–20%+ APR in volatile periods) without hedging or offsetting tools.
Volatility sellers (covered call / put sellers) earn premium income but usually do so in isolated positions without leverage.
Capital efficiency is low: collateral sits idle or earns suboptimal yield while borrowers overpay.
Retail users avoid complex options strategies due to lack of education, UI friction, and liquidation risk misunderstanding.
Lenders get stable but low yields in a maturing market where base lending APYs are compressing.

What People Can Use Voclin Credit For
Voclin Credit turns borrowing into an active, volatility-harvesting activity instead of a passive cost. Users can:

Borrow cheaper by selling volatility
Deposit collateral (ETH, WBTC, etc.) into Thetanuts Basic Vaults → automatically generate weekly options premiums → directly reduce your borrowing interest rate (often turning 10% APR into 2–4% or even negative net cost in high-IV environments).
Choose your risk-reward profile with presets
Low-risk mode (covered calls): Sell OTM calls for steady, moderate premium income → suitable for bullish/neutral holders who want lower rates with limited downside protection trade-off.
High-volatility mode (put-selling): Sell puts in elevated IV regimes for aggressive premium collection → ideal for traders expecting range-bound or mildly bearish moves, accepting higher liquidation risk for deeper rate discounts.

Leverage existing DeFi strategies more efficiently
Yield farmers borrow USDC at reduced rates to loop into higher-yield farms.
Traders borrow against ETH positions while the collateral is actively earning premium (instead of sitting idle).
DAOs and treasuries borrow against reserves at lower effective cost, improving capital efficiency.

Earn boosted yields as a lender
Supply stablecoins to the pool and earn base interest + a share of the vault premiums generated by borrowers' active collateral → higher, more diversified returns than plain lending pools.
Learn and experiment safely with options
Gamified missions (“Complete your first covered-call loan”, “Survive 7 days without liquidation warning”) + AI-powered plain-language explanations (“You are selling volatility at 62% IV  this should offset ~14% annualized premium against your 9% base rate”) make structured products accessible to intermediate users who previously avoided them.

How It Makes Existing Tasks Easier, Safer, or More Profitable

Easier: One-click strategy selection and automatic premium routing  no manual vault deposits, no separate position management, no epoch timing headaches.
Cheaper capital: Dynamic interest offsets turn borrowing from a drag into a yield-generating activity (especially powerful in 2026's volatile macro environment).
Safer education: AI risk breakdowns + gamified onboarding reduce the chance of users blindly entering high-risk strategies; real-time health factor updates tied to vault Greeks help avoid surprise liquidations.
More capital efficient: Collateral works double-duty (secures loan + generates premium), improving overall DeFi ROI.
Composability boost: Vault LP positions can become composable collateral elsewhere (e.g., secondary markets, other protocols), unlocking new primitives.

In short: Voclin Credit solves the “paying too much to borrow while volatility is free money sitting on the sidelines” problem by natively merging lending with structured options yield  making leverage cheaper, yield farming more efficient, and advanced DeFi strategies approachable for thousands more users.

**Challenges we ran into**

The Hurdle: Thetanuts vaults are Arbitrum-native, but VoltzVault is on Base. Bridging collateral (e.g., WETH) to Arbitrum for vault deposit, then handling LP tokens (or synthetic representations) back to Base for collateral use introduced multiple pain points:

Asynchronous messaging delays and fee estimation with LayerZero.
Ensuring atomicity: If bridging succeeds but vault deposit fails (e.g., epoch timing), funds could get stuck.
Dynamic valuation of bridged LP positions on Base (need cross-chain oracle data).
Gas optimization for multi-step flows (approve → bridge → deposit → bridge LP back).

**Thetanuts Finance Track**

Deeply leveraging Thetanuts infrastructure as the yield engine: Borrower collateral is routed into Thetanuts Basic Vaults (e.g., ETH Call Weekly or Put vaults on Arbitrum), where real weekly blind auctions generate premiums that automatically accrue to LP token value.
Making options simple and accessible: Instead of users manually managing vaults, epochs, or RFQ quotes, the app offers one-click presets ("Low-Risk Covered Call Yield" for steady premium or "High-Volatility Put-Selling Yield" for aggressive offsets), with AI explanations in plain language ("You're selling volatility at 60% IV this offsets ~15% annualized premium against your base APR").
Delivering retail-friendly credit innovation: It transforms traditional borrowing (high fixed costs in volatile markets) into an active, volatility-harvesting experience reducing effective borrow rates by 30–80%+ via premium offsets, while lenders earn boosted yields from shared vault performance.
Enhancing engagement and education: Gamified missions ("Complete your first covered-call loan" or "Survive 7 days without liquidation") lower barriers for everyday users, aligning with Thetanuts' push for broader adoption of structured products.
Driving ecosystem composability: By bridging Base (user-facing low-fee chain) to Arbitrum (Thetanuts-native via LayerZero), it increases TVL/flow into Thetanuts vaults, creates new use cases (e.g., leveraged yield farming with cheaper capital), and promotes retail-friendly options without complexity.

### Ventr
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/ventr-6d3e) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/4E-org/ventr) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Base%20Indonesia%20Hackathon%202025-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://base-indonesia-hackathon-2025.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-1-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Empowering vendors, rewarding the community.

![Solidity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Solidity-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Hardhat](https://img.shields.io/badge/Hardhat-333333?style=flat-square) ![OnchainKit](https://img.shields.io/badge/OnchainKit-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

## 1. The Problem

The problem we're trying to solve is the "Credit Gap" in UMKM. Small vendors and micro-entrepreneurs face three massive hurdles in opening their businesses:

- *High Barrier to Credit:* Traditional banks rarely lend to "stall-level" businesses due to lack of collateral or credit history.
- *Predatory Lending:* Many small sellers resort to high-interest "loan sharks" just to buy initial stock or equipment.
- *Static Customer Loyalty:* Traditional "punch cards" or discount flyers are easily lost, expensive to print, and don't provide data to the vendor.

## 2. Ventr's Solution

*Ventr* creates a *Circular Support Economy* using two of the main Web3 pillars: *Liquidity Pools* and *Utility NFTs.*

- *For Donors (The Community),* instead of a "one-way" donation that disappears, their crypto provides liquidity that empowers a real person. In return, they get a "Ventr Voucher" (NFT) that has actual purchasing power in the real world.
- *For Vendors (The Sellers),* they get access to interest-free or low-interest capital without needing a bank. They "repay" the community through products and services, which actually drives more foot traffic to their business.

## 3. How it Makes Business Easier and Safer

| Feature | Traditional Way | The *Ventr* Way |
| --- | --- | --- |
| *Trust* | Handshakes or "GoFundMe" (Hard to track where money goes). | *On-Chain Transparency:* Funds are locked in smart contracts and released based on milestones. |
| *Repayment* | Cash + Interest (Drains the business's growth). | *Value Repayment:* Repaid via product discounts (Vouchers), keeping cash inside the business. |
| *Security* | Paper coupons (Easily forged or lost). | *NFT Vouchers:* Fraud-proof, tradable on secondary markets, and easily scanned via phone. |
| *Incentive* | Purely Altruistic (No benefit to donor). | *Mutual Success:* If the vendor succeeds, your voucher becomes more valuable/useful. |

## 4. What can people use it for?

* *The Coffee Cart:* A barista needs $500 for a better espresso machine. Users donate IDRX and they receive "Ventr Vouchers" for 20% off every coffee for the next six months.
* *The Artisanal Maker:* A weaver needs funds for raw silk. Donors get an NFT that can be redeemed for a limited-edition scarf once the batch is produced.
* *Crisis Recovery:* A local stall destroyed by a storm needs to rebuild. The community funds the "Phoenix Loan," receiving vouchers for the stall’s grand reopening.

> Importantly, vendor wallets that successfully redeem their vouchers gain credibility over time for increased trust in future needs.

**Base Track**

Ventr is a Base Mini-App designed to elevate the onchain user experience by reimagining complex DeFi instruments as a simple, consumer-friendly commerce tool. We directly tackle the challenge of **"Complex DeFi Processes"** by abstracting technical financial concepts into an intuitive "Pre-order" interface. This allows everyday retail users to participate in yield-bearing Real World Asset (RWA) financing and earn returns through deep discounts, without ever needing to navigate intimidating trading terminals or understand liquidity pools.

To solve the critical issue of **"Poor Onboarding,"** Ventr heavily leverages **OnchainKit** to create a frictionless entry point for non-technical users. By implementing Coinbase Smart Wallets with biometric Passkeys, we eliminate the need for seed phrases, making the login process as familiar as a Web2 social app. Furthermore, we utilize Base Paymasters to sponsor gas fees for merchant contract deployment. This solves the "Cold Start" problem, allowing an unbanked MSME owner (Warung) to deploy a fundraising smart contract in seconds without needing to own ETH or understand gas dynamics.

Finally, Ventr addresses **"Limited Accessibility"** and **"Lack of Social Coordination"** by deeply integrating **IDRX** on the high-speed, low-cost **Base L2** network. The low fees of Base L2 allow us to process profitable micro-transactions (as low as Rp 20,000) that would be economically unviable on L1 chains, effectively unlocking DeFi for the "sachet economy." By combining this with **Basenames** for verifiable merchant identity, Ventr transforms local social trust into onchain financial collateral, enabling communities to coordinate capital efficiently and helping retail users support the real economy with the speed and security of blockchain.

### ninah
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/ninah-1fc2) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/alibarmonster/ninah) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://ninah-testing.vercel.app/) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zfJuQzmoN5k) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Base%20Indonesia%20Hackathon%202025-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://base-indonesia-hackathon-2025.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-1-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Private stablecoin payments on Base

![Solidity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Solidity-333333?style=flat-square) ![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Zero-Knowledge Proofs (ZKPs)](https://img.shields.io/badge/Zero--Knowledge%20Proofs%20(ZKPs)-333333?style=flat-square) ![paymaster](https://img.shields.io/badge/paymaster-333333?style=flat-square) ![ECDH](https://img.shields.io/badge/ECDH-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

[Over $1 billion in stablecoins](https://coinledger.io/research/stablecoin-market-share-and-transaction-volume) moves on-chain every month. Transaction volumes have exploded from just $1.69 billion in January 2019 to a record $969.9 billion in August 2025 one of the fastest adoption curves in digital asset history. Stablecoins now account for over 40% of all cryptocurrency trading volume and facilitate the majority of market activity by both transaction count and value. The market cap has surged from $4.17 billion in 2020 to $283.7 billion in September 2025.

But here's the problem: every single one of these transactions is permanently visible on a public ledger. Anyone can trace what you spend, how much you hold, who you interact with, and your complete financial history.

Yet despite this massive stablecoin scale, Web3 adoption remains limited not because users don’t care about privacy, but because onboarding is a nightmare. [Over 60% of potential users](https://blog.gasless.cash/blog/3-challenges-facing-web3-adoption-and-how-gasless-cash-is-solving-them/) abandon onboarding due to wallet setup, gas fees, and seed phrase management. The core issue is that users are asked to manage 12-24 word seed phrases with the constant threat of permanent fund loss, understand why they need ETH just to send USDC, and decode cryptic hex addresses like 0x7a16...3f2b instead of simple usernames.

**ninah** fixes this by creating a privacy-preserving stablecoin payment system built on Base that eliminates both the privacy problem and the UX nightmare in one solution. 


  ### What ninah Makes Possible

  1. **Pay anyone privately** - Enter username and amount. Stealth address
     generation happens automatically. No crypto knowledge required.

  2. **Receive without exposure** - Your public username maps to unique
     one-time addresses. Senders never see your main wallet.

  3. **Familiar UX** - Email login, no gas fees, no seed phrases.

  4. **No network confusion** - Locked to Base. No chain switching, no wrong-network mistakes.

  ### Who This Is For

  | User | Problem Today | With ninah |
  |------|---------------|------------|
  | **Freelancers** | Clients see your entire payment history when you invoice them | Send @username, client sees nothing else |
  | **Employers** | Paying salaries on-chain exposes everyone's compensation | Each employee receives to a unique stealth address |
  | **Everyday users** | Paying a friend reveals your wallet balance | Private by default, no extra steps |
  | **Merchants** | Customer payments create linkable transaction graphs | Each payment arrives at an unlinkable address |


  Privacy and usability have always been tradeoffs. ninah eliminates that
  tradeoff by hiding complexity stealth addresses and ZK proofs run in the
  background while users just see @usernames and one-click payments.

**Challenges we ran into**

## Challenges I Ran Into


### 1. ZK Proof Generation Costs
**Problem:** Generating real SP1 zero-knowledge proofs requires computational
resources and funds for on-chain verification. During development and testing,
this created a bottleneck every username registration or payment claim needed
a real proof.

  **Solution:** Implemented a *MockSP1Verifier* contract that accepts validly structured proofs without cryptographic verification. The frontend generates properly-encoded public values (username hash, commitment) so the architecture mirrors production.

  ---

  ### 2. Username Privacy Leak

  **Problem:** Our initial design stored usernames in plaintext on-chain. This
  defeated the privacy purpose anyone could enumerate all registered usernames
  and link them to wallet addresses.

  **Solution:** Usernames are now stored as *keccak256(username)* hashes. The
  registration function checks *usernameHash → address* mapping, returning
  "username taken" without revealing what usernames exist. Users store their
  plaintext username locally and can recover it by re-entering it (hash comparison).
  Privacy preserved, UX intact.

  ---

  ### 3. Three-Layer Payment Scanning

  **Problem:** Detecting incoming stealth payments required extracting the
  *ephemeralPubkeyHash* to verify ownership. But ERC-4337 smart wallet
  transactions wrap the actual payment call in multiple layers:

  | Layer | Contract | Function |
  |-------|----------|----------|
  | 1 | EntryPoint | handleOps(UserOperation[]) |
  | 2 | Smart Wallet | execute(address, value, calldata) |
  | 3 | Ninah | sendToStealth(address, amount, ephemeralPubkey) |

  The *ephemeralPubkeyHash* is emitted in the *StealthPaymentSent* event and
  stored on-chain, but to verify a payment belongs to user, we need to recover
  the full *ephemeralPubkey* which meant unwrapping all three layers of calldata.

  **Solution:** Built a recursive decoder in *useStealthPayments.ts* that:
  1. Fetches *StealthPaymentSent* events from the contract
  2. Retrieves the originating transaction hash
  3. Decodes Layer 1 → extracts UserOperation calldata
  4. Decodes Layer 2 → extracts smart wallet inner call
  5. Decodes Layer 3 → extracts ephemeralPubkey from sendToStealth args
  6. Uses ephemeralPubkey + viewing key to verify if payment is ours

  This handles the full ERC-4337 flow regardless of paymaster or bundler configuration.

  ### 4. Claiming Breaks Privacy

  **Problem:** Stealth addresses hide the *recipient* during payment but claiming creates a new leak. When a user claims funds, the transaction is sent from their main wallet. on the on-chain this creates a visible link:                                                                                                        
  
  StealthAddress → claimed by → MainWallet

  Anyone watching can now associate the stealth address with the user's identity,
  defeating the privacy we worked to build.

  **Status:** Active research. Current approaches being evaluated:

  | Approach | Tradeoff |
  |----------|----------|
  | **Relayer network** | User signs message, relayer submits tx. Adds trust assumption + fees. |
  | **Claim to new wallet** | Preserves privacy but fragments funds. UX complexity. |
  | **ZK claim proof** | Prove ownership without revealing claimer. Higher gas + complexity. |
  | **Delayed batch claims** | Obscure timing correlation. Partial solution only. |

**Base Track**

ninah is a privacy-preserving stablecoin payment system built on Base that solves critical UX challenges through stealth addresses and zero-knowledge proofs. 

Solving Meaningful UX Challenges:

- Poor Onboarding → Email/social login via Privy Smart Wallets with gasless transactions (Coinbase Paymaster) and human-readable usernames (@alice) instead of wallet addresses

- Complex DeFi Processes → One-click private payments where users simply enter @username and amount . Stealth addresses and ZK proofs are generated automatically in the background

- Limited Accessibility for Retail Users → Beautiful, intuitive UI with interactive onboarding tours (react-joyride) that guide new users step-by-step, a feature most Web3 apps lack. Makes privacy-preserving payments accessible and simple, removing technical barriers for everyday users

- Lack of Social Coordination → Username system enables easy peer-to-peer coordination without sharing complex wallet addresses

Leveraging Base Ecosystem:

- Base L2: Sub-second confirmations and sub-cent fees make privacy practical for everyday stablecoin payments

- Base SDKs: Privy Smart Wallets enable gasless onboarding, eliminating seed phrases and gas fee friction

By combining stealth address cryptography with smart wallet UX on Base's fast, low-cost infrastructure, ninah makes private payments accessible to everyone, not just crypto veterans. Privacy by default, simplicity by design.

**The problem it solves**

In traditional supply chain finance, small to medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) face three major hurdles:

Payment Delays: Suppliers often wait 30, 60, or even 90 days to get paid for goods they’ve already delivered.

Double Financing Fraud: Fraudsters sometimes sell the same invoice to multiple banks or factoring companies. This risk makes lenders cautious, leading to higher interest rates for honest businesses.

High Barriers to Entry: Traditional "factoring" (selling invoices for cash) involves heavy paperwork, high fees, and intermediaries that many small businesses cannot afford or access.

**Challenges we ran into**

While setting up unit tests, I kept getting a TypeError: getSigners is undefined. Even after installing the recommended plugins, I ran into ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND. It felt like my computer was trapped in a fight between CommonJS (the old way) and ES Modules (the new way). The Fix: I performed a "Hardhat Reset." I deleted the node_modules and package-lock.json files, cleared the Hardhat cache, and then explicitly installed the @nomicfoundation/hardhat-toolbox. This ensured that every package—from Ethers to Chai—was on the same version page and compatible with my hardhat.config.js

**Base Track**

Invoice.OS is a decentralized marketplace for Real-World Asset (RWA) tokenization that directly aligns with the Base mission of bringing the next billion users on-chain. By building on Base, the project addresses the critical $2 trillion global trade finance gap for SMEs.

1. Leveraging Base’s Scalability & Low Costs
Problem: Traditional factoring and RWA management are plagued by high administrative overhead and slow settlement times.

Fit: Invoice.OS utilizes Base’s low-cost transaction environment to make the tokenization of even small-scale invoices economically viable. This enables instant, atomic settlement between suppliers and investors without the fees associated with traditional intermediaries.

2. Institutional-Grade Infrastructure
Problem: RWA projects require high reliability and clear auditability to gain investor trust.

Fit: Building on Base allows Invoice.OS to inherit the robust security of the Ethereum mainnet while benefiting from a developer-friendly Layer 2. The use of thirdweb SDKs on Base ensures that our smart contracts are built on industry-standard, audited foundations, providing the transparency and security necessary for high-value financial assets.

3. Enhancing SME Liquidity & Accessibility
Problem: Small businesses in emerging markets often lack access to quick capital.

Fit: Invoice.OS democratizes access to finance by allowing fractional ownership of business debt. This creates a new, yield-bearing asset class on Base, allowing global investors to support local businesses through a unified, 24/7 on-chain marketplace.

4. Future-Proofing with Interoperability
Problem: Fragmented liquidity across different chains can limit the growth of RWA platforms.

Fit: As part of the Base ecosystem, Invoice.OS is positioned to integrate with a wide range of DeFi protocols and stablecoin providers. This ensures that tokenized invoices can eventually be used as collateral across the broader Ethereum ecosystem.

> Because Trust Shouldn’t Be Optional.

![Solidity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Solidity-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![OnchainKit](https://img.shields.io/badge/OnchainKit-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

**Quinty solves the trust and payment issues commonly found in freelance, bounty, and funding platforms.**

In traditional Web2 platforms, users must trust centralized intermediaries that:

- Charge high platform fees
- Control payouts and dispute resolution
- Store reputation off-chain and can modify or revoke it

This creates real risks:

- Creators may not get paid after completing work
- Solvers can be unfairly judged or face fraudulent tasks
- Reputation systems are opaque and easy to manipulate

Quinty makes collaboration safer and trustless by moving the entire workflow on-chain. People can use Quinty to:

- Create and fund bounties or grants with guaranteed escrowed payments
- Submit work transparently with verifiable on-chain actions
- Build permanent, non-transferable reputation through Soulbound NFTs
- Resolve disputes via community-based governance instead of centralized control

By using smart contracts, Quinty removes the need for intermediaries and ensures that payments, decisions, and reputation updates are transparent, verifiable, and immutable.

**Challenges we ran into**

One major challenge was coordinating state changes across multiple smart contracts — especially between the Bounty, Reputation, and NFT modules. Without careful design, this could lead to race conditions, duplicated updates, or inconsistent reputation states.

To solve this, we implemented an event-driven architecture. Each contract emits standardized events for key actions (submission, approval, payout, reputation minting), which the frontend listens to and processes in real time. This ensured consistent state synchronization without tightly coupling contracts.

Another challenge was protecting IPFS-based submission data while maintaining on-chain verification. Since IPFS data is publicly accessible, sensitive solution files could be exposed too early.

We addressed this by using blinded submissions combined with hash-based encryption, allowing submissions to be verified on-chain without revealing the actual content until the appropriate stage. This preserved privacy while keeping the process trustless.

**Base Track**

**How Quinty Fits into the Base Track**
Quinty is natively aligned with the Base Track by leveraging Base as a low-cost, high-throughput Layer 2 to enable fully on-chain collaboration for Web3 creators and developers.

Our core value proposition — 0% platform fees, guaranteed escrow payments, and permanent on-chain reputation — depends on affordable and reliable transactions. Base makes this viable by significantly reducing gas costs while maintaining Ethereum-level security, allowing users to create bounties, grants, and crowdfunding campaigns without friction.

Quinty actively uses Base for:

- On-chain escrow and payout logic for bounties and grants
- Soulbound NFT reputation and verification
- Transparent dispute resolution and governance actions

By building on Base, Quinty unlocks a trustless alternative to Web2 freelance and funding platforms, tailored specifically for the Base ecosystem’s growing community of builders, hackathons, and DAOs. Our live deployment on Base demonstrates real user activity and proves how Base can power practical, creator-facing dApps at scale.

### Theta Syndicate
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/theta-syndicate-48a2) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/yt2025id-lab/theta-syndicate) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://theta-syndicate.vercel.app/) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/huemNXMuZ-k) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Base%20Indonesia%20Hackathon%202025-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://base-indonesia-hackathon-2025.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-1-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Pool - Earn - Rotate - Cheat Proof

![Solidity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Solidity-333333?style=flat-square) ![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Chainlink](https://img.shields.io/badge/Chainlink-333333?style=flat-square) ![Vercel](https://img.shields.io/badge/Vercel-333333?style=flat-square) ![Hardhat](https://img.shields.io/badge/Hardhat-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Traditional group savings (arisan) in Indonesia rely entirely on trust — one default destroys the entire pool. There's no enforcement, no transparency, and no accountability.

Meanwhile, most DeFi users hold stablecoins in wallets without deploying them into sustainable yield opportunities. Option vaults like Thetanuts Finance offer 15-20% APY from selling option premiums, but they're too complex and require large capital for individual retail users.

**Theta Syndicate solves all of this:**

- **Broken Trust** → Smart contract enforcement replaces human trust. No one can cheat — it's enforced by code.
- **Idle Stablecoins** → Pooled capital is deployed to Thetanuts Finance vaults, earning option premium yield automatically.
- **High Capital Barrier** → Group pooling makes option vault strategies accessible to smaller participants.
- **Complex DeFi UX** → Users just join a syndicate — the protocol handles vault deposits, epoch management, and rotating payouts.
- **No Yield in Arisan** → Unlike traditional arisan where money sits idle, every dollar in Theta Syndicate earns yield — including the 125% commitment fee.

The 125% commitment fee model uses game theory to make cheating mathematically unprofitable. If you receive your payout and try to run, you lose more than you gained. No trust needed — just math.

**Challenges we ran into**

**1. Modeling Thetanuts Vault Epoch System**
Thetanuts Finance uses a weekly epoch cycle with 3 phases (DepositOpen → Locked → Settlement). Deposits during the Locked phase are queued as pending. Building a MockThetanutsVault that accurately simulates this behavior — including pending deposits, pending withdrawals, and premium distribution at settlement — was the most complex part of the smart contract work.

**2. Designing a Cheat-Proof Commitment Model**
The original design allowed freely configurable commitment amounts, but we realized the first payout recipient could profitably run away (e.g., receive 1,000 USDC payout but only lose 100 USDC commitment). We had to rethink the entire game theory model and landed on the 125% auto-calculated commitment fee — ensuring cheating always results in a net loss.

**3. ERC-4626 Integration with Rotating Payouts**
Combining an ERC-4626 vault (designed for individual depositors) with a group rotation system required careful accounting. Contributions and commitment fees both get deployed to the vault, and we had to track shares, yields, and penalties separately per member while maintaining a single vault position.

**4. ABI Mismatch After Contract Updates**
After changing from configurable `commitmentAmount` to auto-calculated `getCommitmentFee()`, the deployed contracts on Base Sepolia had a different ABI than the frontend expected. This caused client-side errors on Vercel. We had to redeploy all contracts and update fallback addresses in the frontend code.

**5. Gasless UX with Base Paymaster v0.4**
Integrating Base Paymaster for gasless transactions required EIP-5792 compatible calls. The 2-step approval flow (Approve USDC → Execute Transaction) had to work seamlessly with the paymaster, which took several iterations to get right with Wagmi v2 and OnchainKit.

**Thetanuts Finance Track**

Theta Syndicate is built as a direct integration layer on top of Thetanuts Finance vaults. All pooled capital from syndicate members is deployed into Thetanuts ERC-4626 compatible vaults to earn option premium yield.

**Deep Thetanuts Integration:**

- **ERC-4626 Vault Interface** — We implement the full Thetanuts Basic Vault lifecycle including deposit, redeem, convertToAssets, convertToShares, totalAssets, currentEpoch, epochPhase, pendingDeposits, pendingWithdrawals, strategyType, targetDelta, and settleEpoch.

- **Epoch System Simulation** — Our MockThetanutsVault accurately models the weekly epoch cycle: DepositOpen (1 day) → Locked (6 days) → Settlement, with proper handling of pending deposits and withdrawals during locked phases.

- **Strategy Support** — Users can choose between Covered Call, Cash-Secured Put, and Stronghold strategies when creating a syndicate, matching Thetanuts vault strategy types.

- **V4 Pricing API Integration** — Our Analytics page fetches live orderbook data from the Thetanuts V4 Pricing API, displaying ETH/BTC options with strike prices, premiums, expiry dates, and Greeks (IV, Delta, Theta).

- **AI Strategy Advisor** — A Claude AI-powered advisor analyzes live Thetanuts V4 pricing data to recommend optimal vault strategies to users.

- **Production-Ready Architecture** — Currently deployed on Base Sepolia with a MockThetanutsVault. When Thetanuts deploys on Base (V4 is chain-agnostic), simply swap the vault address — zero code changes needed.

Theta Syndicate makes Thetanuts vault yield accessible to groups of users through trustless rotating payouts, protected by a 125% commitment fee model that makes cheating mathematically unprofitable.

**The problem it solves**

Most virtual pet games are centralized — your progress, items, and pets can be lost if the platform shuts down. Panda Pet Game solves this by storing your pet as an NFT on the Base blockchain, giving players true ownership.

*What it does:*
- Players mint a unique Panda NFT that they fully own on-chain
- Equip cosmetic items (hats, shirts, accessories) stored as on-chain data
- Interactive gameplay: feed, wash, play minigames, and level up your Panda
- Low gas fees on Base L2 make it affordable for everyone

*Key features:*
- On-chain pet ownership via ERC721 NFT
- 10+ cosmetic templates with equip/unequip system
- Real-time pet stats (hunger, energy, fun, hygiene, health)
- Mini-games (Ball Shooter, Bamboo Catcher) to earn XP and coins
- Daily missions and reward system

**Challenges we ran into**

*1. OpenZeppelin v5 Breaking Changes*
The smart contract failed to compile because OpenZeppelin v5 removed _isApprovedOrOwner() and changed the Ownable constructor to require an explicit initialOwner parameter. Fixed by migrating to _isAuthorized() and passing msg.sender to Ownable.

*2. Network Detection Error with ethers.js*
After connecting wallet, ethers.js threw "underlying network changed" error because Base Sepolia (chainId: 84532) is not recognized as a default network. Solved by passing 'any' as the network parameter to Web3Provider.

*3. Nonce Conflicts During Batch Transactions*
When creating 12 cosmetic templates on-chain, 2 transactions failed with "nonce too low" errors due to rapid successive transactions. Resolved by adding sequential delays between transactions.

*4. Vercel Monorepo Deployment*
The project uses a monorepo structure with the frontend in a web/

**Base Track**

Panda Pet Game is built entirely on the Base blockchain (Sepolia testnet). The game uses a custom ERC721 smart contract deployed on Base to mint Panda NFTs and manage an on-chain cosmetic system. We chose Base for its low gas fees and fast transaction speeds, making it ideal for a game where players frequently interact with the blockchain: minting pets, equipping cosmetics, and leveling up. All game assets are stored on-chain, ensuring true player ownership.

**The problem it solves**

BaseBond bridges the gap between traditional events and Web3 by eliminating ticket scalping through verifiable NFTs and turning temporary attendance into lasting community loyalty via POAPs and IDRX rewards. **Challenges we ran into**

The biggest challenge was building an “invisible Web3” experience on top of a fully decentralized EventFactory setup. Since every event spins up its own smart contract for security reasons, pulling data together without relying on a centralized indexer was tricky.

I solved this by creating a frontend orchestration layer in Next.js 15 that handles multiple contract reads at once and uses optimistic UI updates. This helps bridge the gap between blockchain’s asynchronous nature and the instant responsiveness users expect. As a result, even complex flows like resolving Basenames with OnchainKit or executing smart wallet transactions feel smooth, fast, and seamless.

**Base Track**

BaseBond reimagines the onchain event experience by directly tackling the Base Track’s goal of solving poor onboarding and social coordination. By integrating Coinbase Smart Wallet and OnchainKit, we replace complex crypto hurdles with seamless, passkey-based logins and human-readable Basenames, making Web3 accessible to everyone. Furthermore, our use of IDRX for local payments and rewards, combined with NFT ticketing and POAPs on Base L2, solves the disconnect between organizers and attendees, turning transient events into lasting, verifiable onchain communities.

> Savings That Automatically Beat Inflation

![Solidity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Solidity-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Supabase](https://img.shields.io/badge/Supabase-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Inflation steadily erodes the value of people’s savings, yet most individuals lack access to simple, affordable, and automated tools to protect their purchasing power. Traditional inflation hedges like gold are either difficult to access, require large minimum capital, charge high management fees, or demand constant manual decision-making.

At the same time, existing crypto trading bots focus on speculative gains rather than wealth preservation, often locking users into expensive monthly subscriptions regardless of performance. For everyday users, deciding when to buy or sell gold remains complex, time-consuming, and emotionally driven.

oWi AI solves this by providing an autonomous, AI-driven inflation hedging system on Base. It intelligently reallocates user funds between USDC and tokenized gold, helping users preserve value during inflationary periods. By using x402 micropayments, users only pay when they actually request AI insights—eliminating subscription waste. The result is a low-cost, non-custodial, mobile-first solution that makes professional-grade inflation protection accessible to everyone.

**Challenges we ran into**

One of the main challenges was designing a system that combines AI decision-making, on-chain execution, and micropayments without sacrificing user experience. Implementing the x402 payment flow required careful handling of HTTP 402 Payment Required responses while ensuring payments were verifiable, secure, and did not result in double-charging.

Another challenge was balancing AI complexity with reliability. We needed AI signals that were explainable, consistent, and fast enough for real-time usage, while avoiding overfitting or hallucinated reasoning. This required strict prompt constraints, low-temperature settings, and validation layers before executing trades.

From a blockchain perspective, integrating smart contracts for non-custodial vaults, slippage protection, and gold token swaps on Base—while keeping gas costs minimal—was technically demanding. We overcame this by leveraging Base’s low fees, Chainlink price feeds, and optimized contract design tested using Foundry.

> Decentralized Radio Station

![Solidity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Solidity-333333?style=flat-square) ![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![SQL](https://img.shields.io/badge/SQL-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Web3radio functions like a conventional online radio for listeners, but leverages blockchain to provide control, accountability, and fairness for broadcasters.

- Open Listening Experience: Anyone can tune in and enjoy the stream, just like traditional online radio.
- Controlled Broadcasting: Only NFT holders can access the dashboard to broadcast, ensuring contributors have rightful control over their time slots.
- Delegation & Scheduling: ERC-4907 allows broadcasters to rent or delegate their slots, making scheduling transparent and fair.
- Direct Compensation: Tips and rewards go directly to the active holder of a slot, creating fair incentives for contributors.
- On-Chain Transparency: All access rights, delegations, and claims are recorded on the blockchain, improving trust and accountability compared to centralized radio setups.

In essence, Web3radio keeps the familiar radio experience for listeners, while upgrading contributor governance and fairness through blockchain.

**Challenges we ran into**

Integrating NFT Access with Broadcasting Dashboard

- Challenge: Ensuring that only NFT holders could access the dashboard, while listeners remained unrestricted.
- Solution: Implemented ERC-4907 “user delegation” so NFTs could be rented or delegated for specific time slots, ensuring proper access control without disrupting listeners.

Time-Based Slot Management

- Challenge: Managing hourly and daily slots for Regular and Super Access NFTs, and preventing double-booking or conflicts.
- Solution: Designed on-chain slot tracking with week-based indexing, allowing effective holders to claim and use slots transparently.

Ensuring Fair Tip Distribution

- Challenge: Tips needed to go to the correct contributor in real-time, especially when slots were delegated.
- Solution: Integrated tips with the effective holder of each NFT, so delegated users automatically received the funds.

Balancing Decentralization and Usability

- Challenge: Full decentralization could reduce usability or introduce complexity for scheduling and tip handling.
- Solution: Adopted a hybrid approach: listeners enjoy open streaming like conventional radio, while NFT-based governance, delegation, and tip systems remain decentralized and transparent.

The hardest part was translating blockchain concepts into a smooth, fair, and usable broadcasting experience.

Technical complexity is handled at the system level, while users interact through a clear and minimal interface.

> The Tinder for Prediction Markets: Swipe to Bet

![Solidity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Solidity-333333?style=flat-square) ![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Konteks Masalah: Adopsi aplikasi onchain di Indonesia masih terhambat oleh pengalaman pengguna (UX) yang rumit. Pasar prediksi tradisional (seperti Polymarket) memiliki antarmuka yang mengintimidasi pengguna ritel: penuh grafik lilin (candlestick), order book yang kompleks, dan penggunaan mata uang asing (USDC) yang tidak relevan secara lokal.

Solusi TITEN: TITEN hadir sebagai Base Mini-App yang mengubah DeFi menjadi pengalaman sosial yang menyenangkan dan mudah diakses.

Gamifikasi UX (Swipe-to-Bet): Kami mengganti antarmuka trading yang rumit dengan mekanisme "Swipe" (Geser). Geser Kanan untuk YA, Geser Kiri untuk TIDAK. Ini membuat partisipasi pasar menjadi intuitif, cepat, dan mobile-native.

Lokalisasi dengan IDRX: Dengan mengintegrasikan IDRX (Rupiah Stablecoin), kami menghapus friksi konversi mata uang. Pengguna Indonesia dapat memprediksi kejadian lokal menggunakan denominasi yang mereka pahami, mendukung tujuan IDRX untuk aplikasi onchain yang "Indonesia-ready".

Onboarding Tanpa Hambatan: Menggunakan Account Abstraction (Smart Wallet) untuk meminimalkan kerumitan manajemen private key bagi pengguna awam.

Sistem Taruhan Dinamis: Kami menyederhanakan input taruhan dengan slider dinamis, menyembunyikan kompleksitas kalkulasi gas fee dan satuan Wei di belakang layar.

🗺️ Roadmap
Visi kami adalah menjadikan TITEN sebagai platform "Go-to" untuk prediksi sosial di Asia Tenggara. Berikut adalah rencana pengembangan kami:

Q1 2026: MVP & Testnet (Current Status)
✅ Peluncuran Versi Alpha di Base Sepolia Testnet.

✅ Implementasi mekanisme Swipe UI yang mulus.

✅ Integrasi IDRX (Mock) untuk simulasi taruhan lokal.

✅ Dukungan Account Abstraction (Coinbase Smart Wallet).

✅ Sistem Dynamic Staking (Slider Input).

Q2 2026: Mainnet Launch & Security
🔲 Smart Contract Audit: Audit keamanan sebelum deploy ke Mainnet.

🔲 Base Mainnet Deployment: Peluncuran resmi menggunakan Real IDRX.

🔲 Social Login: Login menggunakan Google/Twitter (tanpa wallet ribet) untuk user Web2.

🔲 Leaderboard: Fitur gamifikasi untuk melihat prediktor terbaik mingguan.

Q3 2026: Ecosystem Expansion
🔲 User-Generated Markets: Memungkinkan pengguna membuat pasar prediksi mereka sendiri (Creator Economy).

🔲 Fiat On-Ramp: Integrasi langsung QRIS untuk deposit IDRX di dalam aplikasi.

🔲 Native Mobile App: Peluncuran aplikasi native (.apk / .ipa) di Play Store & App Store.

🔲 Thetanuts Integration: Opsi strategi hedging lanjutan untuk likuiditas market.


Tim kami terdiri dari dua spesialis yang saling melengkapi untuk membangun TITEN. Pugar Huda Mantoro (Backend & Smart Contract) menangani logika protokol, keamanan kontrak Solidity, dan infrastruktur data backend. Muhamad Azis (Frontend & UI/UX) fokus pada pengembangan antarmuka pengguna, menciptakan desain 'Swipe' yang adiktif, serta memastikan integrasi Web3 yang mulus di sisi klien. Kolaborasi ini memungkinkan kami menghadirkan aplikasi pasar prediksi yang tidak hanya canggih secara teknis di jaringan Base, tetapi juga sangat mudah digunakan oleh pengguna awam.

**Challenges we ran into**

Selama pengembangan di jaringan Base Sepolia, kami menghadapi dan menyelesaikan tiga tantangan teknis utama:

1. Sinkronisasi State On-Chain & Off-Chain (Isu "Execution Reverted") Tantangan terbesar adalah sinkronisasi antara database Supabase (untuk metadata pertanyaan) dan Smart Contract. Kami mengalami error revert karena indeks marketCount di blockchain (dimulai dari 0) tidak sinkron dengan ID di frontend.

Solusi: Kami membangun logika validasi yang lebih ketat di API Next.js dan memastikan seeding data awal di database sesuai dengan marketCount on-chain secara real-time.

2. Transisi dari Fixed ke Dynamic Staking Awalnya kontrak kami menggunakan nilai taruhan tetap (fixedStake). Untuk meningkatkan UX, kami melakukan refactor total menjadi sistem dinamis.

Solusi: Kami memodifikasi fungsi stake di Solidity untuk menerima parameter amount dan mengimplementasikan konversi presisi tinggi (Ether to Wei) menggunakan library viem di frontend agar input slider pengguna diterjemahkan akurat ke blockchain.

3. Edukasi Gas Fee vs Token Pengguna sering bingung ketika memiliki saldo IDRX tetapi transaksi gagal karena tidak memiliki ETH untuk gas.

Solusi: Kami memperbaiki UX error handling untuk membedakan pesan error antara "Saldo IDRX Kurang" dan "Gas ETH Kurang", serta memberikan panduan visual yang jelas saat allowance token diperlukan.

Team **Titen** -- [Muhamad Azis](https://github.com/maziazi), [Pugar Huda Mantoro](https://github.com/PugarHuda)
