[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/codeyogi-46f1) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/dip04-eng/Hack_Technique.git) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Hack%20Technique%202026-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hack-technique2026.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-1-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> One-click intelligence for modern DevOps

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Modern software teams rely heavily on CI/CD pipelines to ship features quickly. However, as projects grow, these pipelines become complex, rigid, and difficult to manage. Developers often face challenges such as bloated workflows, inefficient build steps, fragile deployments, poor rollback mechanisms, and a lack of intelligent guidance when failures occur.

Most existing DevOps tools are static and rule-based. When a pipeline or deployment fails, teams are left to manually inspect logs, compare commits, and guess the root cause. Rollbacks—although supported by platforms like GitHub—are often operationally painful, requiring developers to identify the correct commit, manage tokens, and trigger rollback procedures manually. This increases recovery time, deployment risk, and developer stress.

Code_Yogi bridges this gap by introducing an agentic AI-driven DevOps assistant that continuously analyzes repositories, CI/CD workflows, logs, and deployment patterns. It performs intelligent failure analysis by correlating code changes, pipeline steps, and historical execution data to explain why a failure happened in plain language. Instead of digging through logs, developers get actionable insights and recommended fixes.

In addition, Code_Yogi introduces rollback intelligence. Rather than manual rollback workflows, developers are presented with a list of AI-evaluated stable commits. With a single click, they can safely roll back to the most reliable version, minimizing downtime and human error. Code_Yogi also automates optimized YAML generation, deployment strategy selection, and workflow improvements.

By reducing DevOps complexity, enabling faster failure recovery, and eliminating rollback friction, Code_Yogi empowers teams to build faster, deploy safer, and recover instantly, even without deep DevOps expertise.

**Challenges we ran into**

One of the biggest challenges was designing intelligent failure analysis for CI/CD pipelines. Pipeline logs are often noisy, unstructured, and spread across multiple stages. Mapping a failure back to the exact code change or configuration that caused it was non-trivial. I addressed this by correlating commit history, workflow steps, and execution metadata, allowing the AI agents to narrow down likely root causes and present them in a human-readable format instead of raw logs.

Another major challenge was implementing a practical rollback mechanism. While platforms like GitHub support rollbacks, identifying the correct stable commit and triggering a rollback usually requires manual effort, access tokens, and deep Git knowledge. To overcome this, I designed a rollback intelligence layer that evaluates past successful commits, ranks them based on stability signals, and enables a one-click rollback experience without forcing developers to manually search through commit histories.

Building an agentic AI system itself was also challenging. Coordinating multiple AI agents (for analysis, optimization, workflow generation, and rollback decisions) without creating conflicts or redundant actions required careful orchestration and state management. This was solved by defining clear responsibilities for each agent and introducing a decision pipeline that ensures actions are explainable and deterministic.

Finally, balancing automation with safety was a key concern. Fully automated changes in CI/CD systems can be risky. To mitigate this, Code_Yogi follows a “recommend first, execute on approval” approach, ensuring transparency and developer control while still significantly reducing manual effort.

**The problem it solves**

🟨 The Problem NexVyapaar Solves

Local businesses like kirana stores and pharmacy shops still depend heavily on manual record-keeping. Owners spend hours after closing time calculating sales, checking stock registers, and guessing customer trends.

This leads to everyday issues such as:

lost sales due to stock-outs

excess purchase of low-demand items

expiry losses in medicines and FMCG goods

difficulty understanding profit and cashflow

inability to reach customers digitally

NexVyapaar replaces this uncertainty with a single intelligent system that works in local languages and even without internet.

🟩 What People Can Use It For

NexVyapaar acts as an affordable digital assistant for day-to-day shop operations.

Shopkeepers can use it for:

Faster Billing in Rush Hours

Create customer bills using barcode scanning or simple POS interface

No need to write amounts in registers

Bills are stored instantly and inventory reduces automatically

Smart Inventory Management

Add new stock in seconds

Get alerts about overstocked or soon-to-expire products

Know exactly which items need to be reordered

Clear Profit Visibility

View daily, weekly, and monthly sales reports

Understand which products are most profitable

Track UPI and cash transactions from one dashboard

Hybrid Input Modes

Use voice assistant onboarding when convenient

Switch to fast manual or barcode modes when the shop is crowded

AI runs quietly in the background without slowing work

🟦 How It Makes Existing Tasks Easier and Safer
✔ Saves Time

Tasks that earlier took hours now take minutes. Owners no longer need to calculate totals or flip through notebooks.

✔ Reduces Losses

Demand forecasting suggestions help avoid unnecessary purchases and prevent expiry wastage.

✔ Improves Compliance (for Medicine Shops)

A dedicated compliance center blocks sale of banned medicines

Government ban lists can be uploaded via CSV/API

The AI automatically excludes illegal items from billing

✔ Works Offline

Even in Tier-3 areas with poor connectivity:

billing

inventory entry

alerts

AI suggestions

continue using the local-first database. When internet returns, all data syncs automatically.

🟪 Real-World Impact

For a non-tech shop owner, NexVyapaar means:

“Close the shop and go home peacefully – the system has already done the thinking.”

It transforms traditional small shops into data-driven businesses without requiring technical knowledge, making digital tools truly inclusive.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/50bd40e2c65749cb816cdbb39b4fef5d/78e6a767-c7f6-46d8-a9bc-bf476955f14f.png)

**Challenges we ran into**

🚧 Challenges I Ran Into

Building NexVyapaar as a platform aimed at local Indian shopkeepers came with several practical and technical hurdles.

1. Designing True Offline Functionality

One major challenge was proving that the application could work without internet connectivity. Initially, most features depended on live cloud APIs and online databases.
I had to rethink the architecture and implement a local-first storage layer so that billing, inventory entry, and alerts continue even in Tier-3 areas with unstable networks.

How I overcame it:

Integrated IndexedDB/local database inside the device

Built an action queue to store operations locally

Added automatic background syncing when the network is restored

This resulted in what I named the “Resilient Store-and-Sync Engine.”

2. Pharmacy Compliance Logic

While adding AI suggestions, I realized a serious real-world risk: pharmacy shops must not sell medicines that get banned by the government from time to time.

The hurdle was ensuring that:

banned items are detected

blocked from appearing in bills

owners remain updated without manual checking

Solution approach:

Built a dedicated Compliance Dashboard

Allowed upload of CSV ban lists

Added hybrid logic so AI excludes illegal medicines automatically from POS operations

This required debugging TypeScript type errors and creating strict validation flows.

3. Image Upload Failures

Since AI inventory onboarding relied on product images, unreliable uploads could break the experience. Large image sizes and poor connectivity caused repeated failures during testing.

Fix implemented:

Client-side compression before upload

Retry mechanism

fallback to manual/barcode modes

This ensured the system remains usable even if pictures cannot be uploaded.

4. Handling Peak-Hour Usability

Judges questioned whether voice input would slow down a crowded shop. Balancing AI interaction with fast real POS workflows was difficult.

How I handled it:

Introduced barcode scanning and quick POS entry

AI runs silently in background

Voice kept only as an optional channel

🧩 What This Taught Me

The biggest lesson was that building for real local businesses is not only about code, but about understanding practical constraints like language, education level, and network reliability.

Each challenge pushed me to make NexVyapaar more inclusive, safer, and closer to how an actual shop operates.

### CollabFlow
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/collabflow-3a8e) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/Md-Arif-hasnat99/Collab-Flow) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://collab-flow-self.vercel.app) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Hack%20Technique%202026-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hack-technique2026.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-1-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> A remote project management board for teams.

![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Firebase](https://img.shields.io/badge/Firebase-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![WebSockets](https://img.shields.io/badge/WebSockets-333333?style=flat-square) ![Firestore](https://img.shields.io/badge/Firestore-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Firebase Authentication](https://img.shields.io/badge/Firebase%20Authentication-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

## The Problem
Remote teams often face **fragmented workflows**, where project details are scattered across emails, Slack messages, and spreadsheets. This leads to the constant question:

> *"Who is working on what?"*

This results in unnecessary status meetings and misaligned priorities.

## How CollabFlow Solves It
CollabFlow bridges this gap by strictly solving three core issues:

* **🚫 Eliminates Status Meetings:** By providing a real-time Kanban board, the state of the project is always visible to everyone. You don't need a meeting to know a task is "In Progress" or "Done."
* **🧠 Reduces Context Switching:** Instead of jumping between a chat app and a to-do list, discussions and task management happen in one centralized workspace.
* **🌍 Synchronizes Distributed Teams:** Time zones don't matter when the "source of truth" is always live. A team member in London sees the exact same board state as a team member in San Francisco, instantly.

**Challenges we ran into**

## Challenges I ran into
Here are the key technical hurdles faced during the development of CollabFlow and how they were overcome:

### 1. Synchronizing Drag-and-Drop with Firestore
* **The Challenge:** Implementing `@dnd-kit` for smooth local interactions while simultaneously ensuring those changes synced accurately to the Firestore backend. We often faced "jitter" where the card would snap back to its original position before the database write confirmed the new location.
* **The Solution:** We implemented **Optimistic UI updates**. We update the local state immediately to give the user instant feedback, then perform the database write in the background. If the write fails (rare), we revert the state, but for 99% of interactions, it feels instant.

### 2. Managing Complex Order States
* **The Challenge:** Keeping track of the exact order of tasks within a column and across different columns. When a user drags a task from index 1 to index 5, calculating the new order indices for all affected items in a NoSQL database like Firestore is non-trivial compared to a relational DB.
* **The Solution:** We used a **"lexical rank"** (or floating point) strategy in some areas and strict array reordering in others. This ensured efficient updates where we only modify the document that changed, rather than re-writing the entire collection every time a user moves a card.

### 3. Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
* **The Challenge:** Ensuring that "Employees" could view boards and move tasks but **not** delete columns or board settings, while "Admins" had full control.
* **The Solution:** We implemented dual-layer protection.
    * **Frontend:** We created a custom hook `useBoard()` that checks the user's role and conditionally hides delete buttons and configuration settings.
    * **Backend:** We wrote **Firestore Security Rules** to reject write operations to specific paths if the `request.auth.token` did not match the required admin privileges, ensuring the app is secure even if someone bypasses the UI.

![JS](https://img.shields.io/badge/JS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Java](https://img.shields.io/badge/Java-333333?style=flat-square) ![XML](https://img.shields.io/badge/XML-333333?style=flat-square) ![HTML5](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML5-333333?style=flat-square) ![AWS Lambda](https://img.shields.io/badge/AWS%20Lambda-333333?style=flat-square) ![Cloudinary](https://img.shields.io/badge/Cloudinary-333333?style=flat-square) ![AWS](https://img.shields.io/badge/AWS-333333?style=flat-square) ![ESP32](https://img.shields.io/badge/ESP32-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

The women safety system addresses the critical problem of delayed response and lack of real-time location visibility during emergencies. In threatening situations, victims often cannot make calls or explain their location clearly, leading to lost time and ineffective help. This system provides a quick, discreet, and automated emergency trigger that instantly shares the user’s live location with trusted contacts and a cloud server. Continuous location tracking ensures up-to-date information even if the user is moving. By combining hardware portability, automated alerts, and cloud-based tracking, the system significantly improves the chances of timely assistance, accountability, and personal safety during distress situations.

**Challenges we ran into**

While developing this project, we faced several challenges at different stages. One major challenge was ensuring reliable real-time location tracking while keeping data usage and battery consumption low. Integrating cloud services with secure APIs and handling errors like authentication and deployment issues also required careful debugging. Another difficulty was maintaining privacy and security while sharing live location data only during emergencies. Limited time and coordinating tasks among team members added to the pressure. Despite these challenges, continuous testing, teamwork, and step-by-step problem solving helped us successfully build a working and practical safety system.

### Takumi AI Wallet
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/takumi-wallet-1dde) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://takumiaiwallet.xyz/) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/AcV87_kR0xA) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Lisk%20Builders%20Challenge:%20Round%20Three-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://lisk-builders-challenge-3.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-1-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Your Crypto, Your Digital Goods

![Solidity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Solidity-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

### problem statement
Web3 today is still too difficult for the average user. Even as crypto tools mature, the user experience has barely evolved — wallets remain technical, fragmented, and unintuitive. Users must navigate gas settings, networks, seed phrases, dApps, bridges, and endless confirmation screens. This complexity creates anxiety and blocks millions from using blockchain confidently.

On mobile — where most global users live — the problem is even worse. Wallet apps are slow, cluttered, and require constant switching between apps, browsers, and dApps. And most wallets only offer basic functions like sending tokens or swapping — everything else requires leaving the wallet entirely. This fragmentation produces friction, confusion, and drop-off.

What Web3 lacks is a human interface.

Today’s wallets expect users to think like developers. They require technical understanding, not natural intent. As a result, everyday users — especially in emerging markets — struggle to adopt crypto because wallets feel complex, unsafe, and disconnected from real-life needs.

### The core problem:
Web3 has powerful infrastructure, but users have no simple way to interact with it.

---

### Solution

**Takumi Wallet** is the **AI-powered wallet agent** that fixes blockchain’s broken UX.

Instead of navigating confusing menus or switching between apps, users can simply chat or speak naturally:

> “Send 75K IDRX to Pedro.”
> “Top up my phone with 50k pulsa.”
> “What can I buy using my crypto today?”
> “How much did I spend this month?”
> “Swap my USDT to ETH and stake it.”

Takumi’s AI agent understands intent, executes transactions safely, and guides users seamlessly - turning blockchain from **confusing to conversational.**

---

### Impact

* **Fixing the UX gap** that blocks mass adoption.
* **Bringing crypto into daily life** - payments, utilities, entertainment.
* **Transforming wallets** into **AI-driven companions** that manage, analyze, and assist.
* Making Web3 **as natural as talking to a friend.**
* **Keeping users inside one ecosystem** - pay, invest, spend, top up, withdraw, and manage crypto assets seamlessly.

With Takumi Wallet, blockchain becomes **usable, human, and ready for the next billion users.**

### what's next for Takumi AI wallet?

1. QRIS Open API Integration — Real-World Payments at Massive Scale Our next milestone is integrating the QRIS Open API, enabling Takumi Wallet to operate inside Indonesia’s rapidly growing digital payments ecosystem. The Indonesian mobile-payments market is already valued at USD 40.97B (2025) and projected to reach USD 98.57B by 2030, with QRIS powering over 50M users, 30M+ merchants, and 2.6B transactions in Q1 2025 alone.

We are integrating QRIS Open API to access this emerging market at scale — unlocking seamless crypto-to-real-world payments across Indonesia and expanding into QRIS’ cross-border network with Malaysia, Thailand, Singapore, and future interoperability with Japan and China.

This will allow Takumi Wallet users to:

    Pay merchants directly with stablecoins or local currency
    Top-up utilities, buy goods, or pay in-store via QR
    Spend crypto in real life without complexity or bridges
    Become a frictionless point where Web3 meets everyday commerce

This step transforms Takumi from a crypto wallet into a daily-life payment companion for millions.

2. AI Agent Long-Term Memory (GraphRAG Integration)

To evolve Takumi into a truly intelligent financial companion, we will integrate GraphRAG and other long-term memory systems. This allows the Takumi Agent to store, retrieve, and reason over a user’s financial behavior — such as spending patterns, recurring payments, portfolio history, and past conversations. With persistent structured memory, the agent can deliver smarter financial insights, personalized budgeting recommendations, anomaly detection, context-aware advice, and proactive financial automation. This transforms the Takumi Agent from a transactional interface into a continuously learning financial brain that gets smarter over time.

### LiskSplitter
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/gasbuddy-6705) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/pratama404/lisksplitter) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://lisksplitter-split-once--etgy561.gamma.site/) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Lisk%20Builders%20Challenge:%20Round%20Three-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://lisk-builders-challenge-3.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-1-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Split Once. Pay Everyone.

![Solidity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Solidity-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![ethers.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/ethers.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Hardhat](https://img.shields.io/badge/Hardhat-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Splitting bills or distributing payments to multiple people using cryptocurrency is often inefficient and error-prone. Users typically have to send funds one by one, manually copy wallet addresses, and pay transaction (gas) fees for each transfer. This process not only takes time but also increases costs and the risk of sending funds to the wrong address.

LiskSplitter solves this problem by enabling users to send funds to multiple recipients in a single blockchain transaction. It significantly simplifies group payments, reduces transaction fees, and ensures transparency through smart contracts on the Lisk network.

This makes LiskSplitter ideal for:
Splitting bills among friends
Distributing payments to team members
Sending rewards, allowances, or shared expenses in crypto
Any scenario requiring fast, secure, and efficient multi-recipient transfers

**Challenges we ran into**

One of the main challenges was handling multiple recipient addresses and ensuring accurate fund distribution within a single smart contract execution. Managing edge cases such as mismatched amounts, invalid addresses, and ensuring the total distributed value matched the sent amount required careful validation logic in Solidity.

Another challenge was integrating the smart contract smoothly with the frontend. Synchronizing wallet interactions, handling transaction states (pending, success, failure), and providing clear user feedback took multiple iterations to refine.

These challenges were overcome by:
Implementing strict input validation and require checks in the smart contract
Testing extensively using Hardhat on the Lisk Sepolia testnet
Improving frontend UX to clearly display transaction status and errors
Using Ethers.js for reliable wallet and contract interaction

**Winner Classification**

finance

> On-chain daily commitment saving

![Solidity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Solidity-333333?style=flat-square) ![OpenZeppelin](https://img.shields.io/badge/OpenZeppelin-333333?style=flat-square) ![Visual Studio Code](https://img.shields.io/badge/Visual%20Studio%20Code-333333?style=flat-square) ![ethers.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/ethers.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Hardhat](https://img.shields.io/badge/Hardhat-333333?style=flat-square) ![sourcify](https://img.shields.io/badge/sourcify-333333?style=flat-square) ![SafeERC20](https://img.shields.io/badge/SafeERC20-333333?style=flat-square) ![Lisk Sepolia](https://img.shields.io/badge/Lisk%20Sepolia-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

**The Financial Discipline Gap in Web3 & Emerging Markets**

Most financial products assume humans are rational.

In reality, humans are inconsistent.

People don’t fail to save because they lack income or access — they fail because **there is no system that enforces discipline**.

Traditional finance relies on motivation, reminders, and self-control.
Web3 relies on trustless execution — but still assumes disciplined users.

**This gap between human behavior and financial systems is the real problem.**



**COSAV is not a savings app.**

**COSAV is a behavioral finance protocol** that turns financial discipline into enforceable on-chain infrastructure.

Instead of relying on motivation, COSAV enforces commitment using smart contracts:

● Users lock funds upfront, creating immediate commitment pressure

● Daily on-chain check-ins transform saving into a habit, not a decision

● Transparent penalties leverage loss aversion when commitments are broken

● All rules are enforced entirely by smart contracts

● No intermediaries, no banks, no KYC, no human discretion

● Funds and logic are immutable and globally permissionless

**COSAV shifts saving from motivation-based behavior to enforceable commitment.**


**Why Lisk**

Daily commitment systems are impossible on high-fee blockchains.

COSAV is built on Lisk because low fees make **daily financial behavior economically viable**.

COSAV positions Lisk not just as a scalable blockchain — but as a **daily financial habit chain**.


**From Individuals to Infrastructure**

COSAV is designed for:

✔ Individuals building long-term financial discipline

✔ Communities running commitment challenges

✔ DAOs enforcing contribution or saving behavior

✔ Organizations creating behavioral finance programs

**COSAV turns discipline into infrastructure.**

**Revenue Model**

COSAV is designed as a sustainable Web3 venture, not an experiment.

The protocol generates revenue through:

➤ **Penalty-based protocol fees** from failed commitments

➤ **Yield strategies** applied to locked capital during commitment periods

➤ **B2B and community programs** for DAOs, organizations, and institutions

➤ **White-labeled commitment systems** for behavioral finance initiatives

**Every broken commitment generates protocol value.**

This model aligns incentives:
users gain discipline, and the protocol grows sustainably.

**Challenges we ran into**

**Challenges I Ran Into**

Building COSAV exposed both technical and infrastructure challenges:

**1. Lisk Sepolia RPC instability**
Explorer and RPC endpoints occasionally returned 500 or DNS errors.
This was mitigated by enabling Sourcify verification, storing full artifacts, and tuning gas configurations.

**2. Hardhat deployment issues**
Unsupported Node versions, gas misconfigurations, and nonce conflicts required custom Hardhat optimization and explicit gas control.

**3. Smart contract verification reliability**
Explorer verification was inconsistent, so full constructor parameters and build metadata were provided for manual verification.

**4. Commitment logic & penalty safety**
Designing a fair check-in window (12h minimum, 48h maximum), handling penalties, and preventing reentrancy required careful contract architecture.

Despite these challenges, COSAV is **fully deployed, verified, documented, and production-ready.**

**Winner Classification**

COSAV fits the Lisk Builders track because it showcases a real, usable financial primitive built entirely on Lisk Sepolia.
It demonstrates on-chain habit enforcement, daily check-in mechanics, SafeERC20-based penalty transfers, and behavioral-finance-driven incentives.
This is a unique use case on Lisk that proves how smart contracts can enable discipline-based savings, transparent commitment devices, and trustless financial automation.

**The problem it solves**

# 📌 SIGNET — Blockchain-Based Content Authenticity Verification

**Trust as a Service for a World Flooded With Deepfakes**

## 🌍 The Problem

The rise of AI-generated media has made it increasingly difficult to distinguish real content from fabricated misinformation. Deepfake videos, synthetic images, and manipulated documents have already caused global confusion and economic impact — from the deepfake of President Zelensky urging Ukrainian troops to stand down, to the fake Pentagon explosion image that temporarily caused the stock market to dip.

**Misinformation isn't just noise anymore. It's a global threat with real-world consequences.**

---

## 🚀 SIGNET: The Cryptographic Proof of Content Authenticity

SIGNET provides an immutable and trustless method for verifying the authenticity of digital content. Using **Perceptual Hashing (pHash)** and blockchain-backed storage with **gasless meta-transactions**, SIGNET ensures that any image or video can be cryptographically verified even if it has been slightly modified (compression, cropping, format conversion).

### ✔ How SIGNET Works

1. **Content Registration** (Two Modes):
   - **Gasless Mode**: User signs an EIP-712 typed message with their wallet, backend relayer submits the transaction via MinimalForwarder (EIP-2771) - user pays no gas
   
2. **Perceptual Hashing**:
   - Images: 16x16 pHash (256-bit) after resizing to 128x128 using LANCZOS
   - Videos: pHash of middle frame to resist padding/trimming attacks
   
3. **Blockchain Storage**: Hash stored in SignetRegistry smart contract on LISK Sepolia testnet

4. **Verification**: Upload content → Generate pHash → Compare with blockchain-indexed hashes using Hamming Distance

If an organization faces a hoax, they can respond instantly with:
> "This content is fake — here is the original on-chain hash proving it."

**SIGNET provides mathematical, perceptual-based truth, not pixel-perfect matching.**

---

## 🔒 Why Perceptual Hashing + Blockchain?

- **Tamper-resistant**: Detects modified content even after compression/cropping (unlike SHA-256)
- **Immutable**: Stored hashes cannot be modified once recorded on blockchain
- **Decentralized**: No single entity can modify or delete authenticity records
- **Trustless**: Anyone can verify authenticity by comparing perceptual hashes
- **Gasless**: Publishers don't pay gas fees thanks to EIP-2771 meta-transactions
- **Privacy**: Only the perceptual hash is stored — original files never leave the user's environment

---

## 🧩 System Architecture

```
Content File → Perceptual Hash (pHash) → Gasless Meta-Transaction → SignetRegistry Contract → Event Indexer → PostgreSQL Database → Verification API
```

### Core Components

**Backend**: FastAPI with perceptual hashing (pHash 16x16), dual-mode registration (gasless EIP-712/EIP-2771), blockchain event indexer, PostgreSQL database

**Frontend**: React + Vite with Wagmi Web3 integration, protected publisher routes, public verification page, admin panel

**Smart Contracts**: SignetRegistry (content storage, publisher management) + MinimalForwarder (meta-transaction relayer)

---

## 💼 Business Model — "Trust as a Service" (TaaS)

### Enterprise API
Target: Governments, media, social platforms, fact-checkers  
Features: High-throughput registration, gasless transactions, private API keys, SLA

### Professional Dashboard
Target: Journalists, photographers, legal teams, investigators  
Features: Wallet auth, gasless registration, verification, tiered usage limits

---

## 🏗️ Tech Stack

**Backend**: Python + FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Web3.py, imagehash/Pillow/OpenCV  
**Frontend**: React 19 + TypeScript, Vite, Wagmi, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion  
**Blockchain**: Solidity on LISK Sepolia, EIP-712/EIP-2771 standards

---

## 📊 Key Technical Innovations

**pHash vs SHA-256**: Perceptual similarity matching survives compression, cropping, format changes  
**Gasless Transactions**: Users sign EIP-712 messages, backend relayer pays gas  
**Publisher Authorization**: Contract owner controls who can register content

---

## 🌐 Vision

In an era where AI can generate convincing fake content at scale, verifying authenticity becomes essential. SIGNET aims to become the global trust infrastructure for digital content — offering a future where truth is verifiable, immediate, and decentralized, even when content undergoes normal transformations.

**We're building the perceptual trust layer of the internet.**

> Bridging the Archipelago to the Superchain

![Solidity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Solidity-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![OpenZeppelin](https://img.shields.io/badge/OpenZeppelin-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Docker](https://img.shields.io/badge/Docker-333333?style=flat-square) ![SQLite](https://img.shields.io/badge/SQLite-333333?style=flat-square) ![Hardhat](https://img.shields.io/badge/Hardhat-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

**Santara Terminal** acts as a unified liquidity gateway designed to solve the fragmentation of assets between the emerging **Lisk (Layer 2)** ecosystem, other L2s like **Base**, and the foundational **Ethereum (Layer 1)**.

As the L2 landscape expands, moving assets often becomes a friction point. Users face fragmented liquidity and complex bridging processes when trying to move between Optimism-based chains (Lisk, Base) and the main settlement layer (Ethereum).

**Santara Terminal** unifies these layers into a single **"Multi-Layer Terminal"**, positioning **Lisk Sepolia** as the liquidity hub.

**Key Solutions:**

1. **Multi-Layer Interoperability (L2 <->  L2 <->  L1):**
We implement a secure "Lock-and-Mint" and "Burn-and-Release" mechanism connecting three distinct layers:
* **Lisk Sepolia (L2):** Acts as the **Home Chain (Origin)** for native assets.
* **Base Sepolia (L2):** Demonstrates seamless L2-to-L2 bridging.
* **Ethereum Sepolia (L1):** Demonstrates L2-to-L1 settlement and liquidity flow.
This ensures verifiable 1:1 asset pegging across the entire stack.


2. **Hybrid Smart Contract Architecture:**
We solve the dilemma of flexibility vs stability by employing a hybrid model:
* **SAN Ecosystem:** Utilizes **OpenZeppelin Transparent Proxies** (Upgradeable). This allows us to upgrade bridge logic on Lisk without migrating liquidity.
* **SIDR (Stablecoin) Ecosystem:** Utilizes **Immutable Standard Contracts**. This guarantees trust and stability for fiat-pegged assets.


3. **Integrated Liquidity (DEX):**
Users don't just bridge; they can trade immediately. We deployed **Santara DEX** (AMM) on all connected chains, facilitating instant arbitrage and liquidity provision between Lisk L2 and the broader Ethereum ecosystem.

4. **Relayer Security:**
We address the "hot wallet" vulnerability common in bridges. Our custom Relayer uses **Web3 Secret Storage Definition V3** (Encrypted Keystore) running inside a hardened **Docker** container with **PM2**, ensuring keys are never exposed in plain text.

**Challenges we ran into**

Building a bridge that connects L1 and L2 infrastructure came with specific technical hurdles:

**1. The "Fresh Deploy" vs. "Upgrade" Dilemma**

* **Challenge:** We wanted to use an Upgradeable Proxy pattern for the SAN Vault to allow future fee adjustments. However, initializing a proxy usually sets values to zero. We needed a V2 contract (with Fee logic) to be the "Genesis" deployment.
* **Solution:** We customized the *initialize* function in our V2 implementation to accept specific arguments (Fee & Token Address) during the proxy creation. This allowed us to perform a "Direct V2 Deployment" using Hardhat Upgrades, ensuring the system was production-ready from block 0.

**2. Docker Permission & Keystore Management**

* **Challenge:** Our Relayer runs on Docker for stability. Initially, mounting the keystore volume (-v) caused *EACCES* (Permission Denied) errors because the container user lacked read access to host files.
* **Solution:** We shifted to a "Secure Build" strategy. We created a *setup-keys.js* script that generates encrypted JSON keystores and places them in a dedicated directory. The Dockerfile then **COPIES** these keys into the image during the build process, and we use **PM2** for robust process management inside the container.

**3. Hybrid Contract Standards**

* **Challenge:** Managing two different standards (Upgradeable for SAN, Immutable for SIDR) in a single frontend codebase was complex.
* **Solution:** We standardized the ABI interaction in the frontend while keeping deployment scripts separate. This creates a uniform UI experience for users, even though the underlying asset logic differs (Mutable vs Immutable).

**Winner Classification**

We primarily target the **Infrastructure & Interoperability** classification.
Our project is fundamentally a **Multi-Layer Bridge Engine** connecting Lisk (L2), Base (L2), and Ethereum (L1). It solves the liquidity fragmentation problem by providing a secure "Lock-and-Mint" and "Burn-and-Release" mechanism.
Uniquely, this infrastructure supports two distinct asset classes:
1. **Utility Tokens (SAN):** Supported by an integrated AMM DEX for immediate liquidity on all chains.
2. **Real World Assets (SIDR):** A Rupiah-pegged stablecoin designed for secure cross-chain value transfer and payments without slippage.

[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/real-time-iv-fluid-monitoring-with-alert-system-9dfe) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://divine-design-do.lovable.app/) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Lisk%20Builders%20Challenge:%20Round%20Three-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://lisk-builders-challenge-3.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-1-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> A Real-Time Healthcare Solution for Patient Safety

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![API](https://img.shields.io/badge/API-333333?style=flat-square) ![Supabase](https://img.shields.io/badge/Supabase-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Intravenous (IV) fluid administration in hospitals is largely monitored manually by nursing staff, requiring frequent physical checks of IV fluid levels. In busy clinical environments, this manual process is time-consuming and prone to human error. When IV bags are not replaced on time, it can lead to air embolism, blood backflow, infusion interruptions, patient discomfort, and increased infection risk. Additionally, over-infusion or under-infusion due to improper monitoring can negatively affect patient treatment outcomes. Continuous manual monitoring also increases staff workload and stress, especially in high-patient-volume settings. Existing automated IV monitoring systems are often expensive, complex, and inaccessible to small clinics and rural healthcare facilities. This project addresses these issues by providing an affordable, automated, real-time IV fluid monitoring and alert system that ensures timely intervention, improves patient safety, and reduces the burden on healthcare staff.

**Challenges we ran into**

Challenges Faced During the Project

Accurate Weight Measurement
Calibrating the load cell to detect small and continuous changes in IV fluid weight was challenging. Minor vibrations, bag movement, and environmental disturbances affected accuracy.

Sensor Drift and Noise
Load cells are sensitive to temperature changes and electrical noise, which caused fluctuating readings and required repeated filtering and calibration.

Converting Weight to Fluid Volume
Translating weight data into an accurate remaining fluid percentage was complex due to variations in IV bag size, fluid density, and tubing weight.

Threshold Optimization
Setting the correct alert threshold (e.g., 10%) was critical. Too early caused unnecessary alerts, while too late increased patient risk.

Power Stability Issues
Ensuring uninterrupted operation during power fluctuations or outages was a concern, especially for continuous real-time monitoring.

Wireless Connectivity Reliability
Maintaining stable Wi-Fi/Bluetooth communication for real-time alerts was difficult in environments with weak or inconsistent network coverage.

False Alerts Reduction
Sudden bag movement or nurse handling sometimes triggered false alerts, requiring logic refinement and delay mechanisms.

Hardware Mounting Constraints
Designing a secure and universal mounting system for different IV stands and bag sizes without disturbing normal clinical workflow was challenging.

Cost vs Performance Trade-off
Balancing affordability with reliable components was difficult, as high-precision sensors increase cost while low-cost alternatives reduce accuracy.

Limited Clinical Testing
Testing the system in real hospital environments was restricted, so most validations were done through simulations and controlled setups.

**The problem it solves**

**FraudScan AI - Automated Blockchain Invoice Verification**

FraudScan AI saves auditors from **3 days down to 30 seconds** to verify hundreds of blockchain invoices. Normally, they manually check Etherscan one by one—copying invoice numbers, amounts, wallet addresses (0xA→0xB format), and transaction hashes. It's exhausting and error-prone, especially since **85% of fake invoices** use fabricated TX hashes that are hard to spot.

**How it works simply:**
1. Upload PDF/text invoice files
2. AI automatically extracts key data (invoice number, Rp amount, wallet addresses, TX hash) 
4. Delivers **instant risk scores**:
   **FULL_MATCH** = 0-12% risk (Rp500M+ flagged for audit attention)
   **NO_TX_FOUND** = 85%+ (confirmed fraud)
   **AMOUNT_MISMATCH** = 60%+ 
   **DUPLICATES** = +25% risk penalty

**Who uses it:**

- **Corporates** catching vendor payment fraud via duplicate detection

**FraudScan transforms blockchain invoice verification from tedious manual work into instant AI-powered audit intelligence, ready for enterprise scale on Lisk Sepolia Testnet.**

**Challenges we ran into**

The biggest challenge was fixing the Analytics dashboard that completely broke because st.session_state.last_results was never set during analysis, causing the page to crash with KeyError when users switched from Audit to Analytics tab. The main analysis correctly stored st.session_state.results and st.session_state.last_results, but the Analytics page tried reading a non-existent key, so no charts or data appeared despite successful audits. I solved this by changing one line from results = st.session_state.last_results to results = st.session_state.results, making all three charts (Risk Distribution pie, Amount vs Risk scatter, Risk Score histogram) instantly functional.

The toughest technical challenge came when integrating the mandatory Lisk Sepolia smart contract requirement for the competition, discovered just hours before submission deadline. With zero Solidity experience and no testnet ETH, I had to learn MetaMask Lisk network setup (Chain ID 4202, RPC endpoint), hunt down working faucets.

> Because Claims Aren’t Credentials.

![Solidity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Solidity-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

**Medix**  is a decentralized protocol for tracking, verifying, and certifying media consumption using non-transferable (soulbound) NFTs. It enables users to generate cryptographically verifiable proof that they have genuinely completed digital content such as books, movies, anime, manga, TV shows, online courses, and other consumable media. By transforming everyday consumption into immutable on-chain records, Medix eliminates trust issues associated with unverifiable claims and enables new primitives for reputation, community formation, and credentialing in Web3.

 Medix combines automatic client-side tracking, backend verification, and gasless NFT minting to create a scalable Proof of Work (PoW) model rooted in authentic human activity rather than computational expenditure.

**Problem Statement**

Digital media consumption is a core component of modern identity, education, and culture. However, claims such as “I read this book,” “I completed this course,” or “I watched this series” are inherently unverifiable. Existing platforms rely on centralized records, screenshots, or self-reported data, all of which are prone to fraud, exaggeration, or loss.

This lack of verifiable proof creates friction across multiple domains:

Communities suffer from shallow or inauthentic participation

Creators and brands lack reliable engagement metrics

Educators and employers cannot trust completion claims

Users cannot port their achievements across platforms

Medix addresses this gap by introducing an on-chain verification layer for media consumption.

**Medix Overview**

Medix is a decentralized achievement verification system that issues soulbound NFTs as proof of completed media consumption. These NFTs are:

Non-transferable, ensuring authenticity

Immutable, guaranteeing long-term verifiability

Wallet-bound, forming part of a user’s on-chain identity

By anchoring consumption data on-chain, Medix converts subjective claims into objective credentials.

**System Architecture**
3.1 Client-Side Tracking

A Medix Chrome extension monitors user engagement on supported platforms (e.g., streaming services, reading platforms, educational sites). The extension tracks progression signals such as:

Watch duration and completion thresholds

Page progression and reading milestones

Session continuity and interaction patterns

This ensures that achievements reflect genuine engagement rather than superficial interaction.

**Verification Layer**

Tracked data is submitted to Medix backend services, where it undergoes verification checks to confirm:

Completion validity

Anti-cheat heuristics

Platform-specific thresholds

Only verified completions are eligible for minting.

**Minting and Blockchain Layer**

Once verified, a soulbound NFT is minted on the Lisk testnet and permanently linked to the user’s wallet. Key properties include:

Gasless minting via transaction sponsorship

Metadata encoding content type, completion proof, and rarity

Non-transferability enforced at the smart contract level


**Proof of Work Model**

Medix introduces a novel Human-Centric Proof of Work, where time, attention, and completion replace computational hashing as the scarce resource.

Unlike traditional PoW:

No energy-intensive computation is required

Work is tied to real-world intellectual or cultural activity

Value is derived from verified human effort

This model redefines “work” as meaningful engagement rather than raw compute.

**Rarity and Gamification**

Each NFT is assigned a rarity tier (Common → Legendary) based on criteria such as:

Media type and length

Completion difficulty

Category scarcity

Rarity introduces gamification while preserving the integrity of achievements, encouraging long-term participation without compromising trust.

**Core Use Cases**
6.1 On-Chain Media Resume

Users build a verifiable portfolio of consumed content, forming a decentralized “media resume” that can be shared across platforms. This is applicable to:

Personal branding

Job applications

Knowledge and interest signaling

**Gated Communities**

NFT ownership enables access-controlled communities where participation is limited to verified completers of specific content. This ensures high-signal interactions and authentic group formation.

6.3 Creator and Brand Analytics

Creators and platforms gain access to verifiable engagement metrics, enabling:

Authentic fan identification

Token-gated rewards and perks

Trustworthy testimonials

6.4 Education and Professional Credentialing

Medix NFTs function as decentralized credentials for:

Online courses

Training programs

Certification materials

These credentials are portable, tamper-proof, and interoperable with broader Web3 identity systems.

6.5 Review and Reputation Systems

**Challenges we ran into**

- **Lisk Faucet Limitations:** Medix required more testnet funds than the Lisk faucet allowed due to frequent deployments and NFT minting. This was solved by sourcing ETH on Sepolia and bridging it to Lisk using the Lisk testnet bridge.

- **Soulbound NFT Enforcement:** Preventing NFT transfers required custom contract logic beyond standard ERC-721 behavior. We solved this by overriding transfer and approval functions at the smart contract level and adding additional tests for edge cases.

- **Gasless Minting Reliability:** Transaction sponsorship occasionally failed due to relayer issues or invalid payloads. This was resolved by adding retry logic and stricter backend verification before submitting sponsored transactions.

- **Client-Side Tracking Accuracy:** Early tracking logic produced false positives for media completion. We refined engagement thresholds and added interaction and session-continuity checks to ensure only genuine consumption was verified.

**Winner Classification**

Medix is positioned as a winner-class project because it goes beyond a hackathon demo and functions as a real, scalable venture that solves a clear, global problem using blockchain in a way that is both practical and novel.

At its core, Medix introduces a new on-chain primitive: verifiable proof of media consumption. Today, claims like “I completed this course,” “I read this book,” or “I watched this series” are unverifiable, fragmented across centralized platforms, and impossible to port across ecosystems. Medix transforms these subjective claims into objective, wallet-bound credentials using soulbound NFTs on Lisk.

This directly aligns with the hackathon’s emphasis on:

Real-world problem solving

Founder mindset

Building ventures, not just prototypes

Medix is not just a feature or tool — it is an infrastructure layer for reputation, education, creator analytics, and community formation, with clear long-term product-market fit.

**The problem it solves**

Problems Solved
Individuals and MSMEs often need proof that a document:

✅ Existed at a certain time (timestamp)
✅ Has never been modified (integrity)
✅ Can be verified independently (without intermediaries)
Traditional solutions such as conventional notaries:

❌ Expensive
❌ Centralized (dependent on one party)
❌ Administratively complex
❌ Unaffordable for small businesses, freelancers, or students

Solution:

ProofStamp
ProofStamp offers a simple way to stamp your documents on the blockchain:

Upload your document (PDF, image, or other file)
The cryptographic hash is calculated automatically (Keccak-256)
Stamp the hash onto the blockchain with one click
Verify anytime by re-uploading the same document
🔑 Key Principle: Blockchain is only used as a trust layer (permanent neutral clock), not as a database. All logic and UX remain off-chain.

### ClearFund
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/clearfund-cb27) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/BeingAnurag/ClearFund) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://clear-fund-website.vercel.app/) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Lisk%20Builders%20Challenge:%20Round%20Three-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://lisk-builders-challenge-3.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-1-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Transparent crowdfunding built on Ethereum

![Solidity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Solidity-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Ethereum](https://img.shields.io/badge/Ethereum-333333?style=flat-square) ![React.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/React.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Supabase](https://img.shields.io/badge/Supabase-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

****The Problem****

Most crowdfunding platforms rely on centralized trust and provide little control once funds are transferred. After donating, contributors have no reliable way to verify how or when their money is used. This results in three core problems:

**Uncontrolled Fund Usage**

- Creators can access the full amount immediately, regardless of project progress, exposing donors to risks such as fund misuse, abandoned projects, or rug pulls.

**No Enforced Accountability**

- Funding is typically released as a single lump sum instead of being tied to measurable progress. There is no technical enforcement linking capital release to actual delivery.

**Poor Web3 Usability**

- Existing decentralized solutions often suffer from slow data access, frequent wallet prompts, and high latency caused by direct blockchain reads, making them difficult for non-technical users to adopt.

****The Solution: ClearFund****

*ClearFund* is a hybrid Web3 crowdfunding platform that enforces *transparency* and *accountability* using **smart contracts**, while maintaining the speed and usability of modern web applications.
Blockchain is required to enable trustless fund custody and milestone-based capital release without relying on a centralized intermediary.

**1. On-Chain Escrow with Milestone Enforcement**

- Funds are locked inside a smart contract escrow.
- Creators can withdraw funds only after predefined milestones are approved.
- If a campaign fails to reach its funding goal by the deadline, donors can automatically claim refunds on-chain.

**2. Hybrid Architecture for High Performance**

- All financial logic (donations, escrow, withdrawals, refunds) is executed on-chain.
- Campaign metadata and discovery data are indexed in real time using a SQL database, enabling fast load times and efficient filtering without relying on slow blockchain queries.

**3. Immutable Asset Storage**

- Campaign images and verification documents are stored on IPFS via Pinata.
- This ensures permanent, tamper-resistant storage of campaign commitments and supporting data.

**Revenue Model**

*ClearFund* operates on a protocol fee charged on successfully released funds.
Additional revenue streams include creator verification services and premium analytics for campaign performance.

**Challenges we ran into**

Challenges I Ran Into

- **Hybrid State Synchronization (Web2 + Web3)**
Keeping Supabase (SQL) data synchronized with on-chain state introduced race conditions, where off-chain data updated faster than blockchain confirmations.
I resolved this by implementing a hybrid fetching strategy: static metadata (titles, images, categories) is fetched from Supabase for instant load times, while dynamic financial data (total raised, donor count) is read directly from the smart contract using Wagmi hooks, ensuring on-chain accuracy.

- **Breaking Changes in Wagmi v2**
A mid-development upgrade removed the watch: true property, breaking real-time updates and blocking deployment due to TypeScript errors.
I refactored all contract reads to use Wagmi’s polling-based architecture with query: { refetchInterval }, restoring live updates while maintaining compatibility and type safety with the latest version.

- **Type Safety vs Real-World Data Flow**
Strict TypeScript schemas conflicted with partially available blockchain data during the donation flow, causing compilation failures.
I redesigned the donation modal to accept a minimal, flexible interface and added just-in-time Supabase lookups before persisting transactions, bridging rigid database types with dynamic on-chain data.

**The problem it solves**

# ENTRUST - The All-in-One Operating System for On-Chain Companies
Entrust is a comprehensive treasury management and automation platform for on-chain companies (remote dev agencies, DAOs, startups). It combines Safe Smart Accounts with AI-powered agents to automate repetitive financial tasks like payroll, recurring payments, and expense reimbursements.

Contract Address: 0xaf23bf3798D70959ac2B68a6108A0Dcf7CAb5Aee
**((The contract can't be verified in lisk sepolia, but in eth sepolia it can, maybe due to factory characteristics, already try both via foundry cli and manual file upload in blockscout))**
Lisk Sepolia Blockscout: https://sepolia-blockscout.lisk.com/address/0xaf23bf3798D70959ac2B68a6108A0Dcf7CAb5Aee?tab=index
Pitch Deck Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1pvlpjytDXb0HPG7Ljkg3yx8bK6YR1_HJ?usp=sharing
Demo Video: https://youtu.be/AMuNsQwfCI8
Pitch Video: https://youtu.be/sx5AXfLMotk

### 🎯 The Problem We're Solving
Managing a crypto company's treasury today is a nightmare:

**For Remote Teams:**
- ❌ Using personal wallets for business expenses = accounting hell
- ❌ Reimbursements require 3+ manager signatures for every $50 expense
- ❌ Tracking subscriptions across 10 different SaaS tools is impossible
- ❌ No budget visibility until the month ends

**For DAOs & Agencies:**
- ❌ Manual multisig approvals block operations (3-24 hour delays)
- ❌ Payroll takes hours of manual work each month
- ❌ No way to automate recurring vendor payments safely
- ❌ Fragmented tools: Safe for treasury, spreadsheets for accounting, Discord for approvals

**The Core Issue:** A "Human Bottleneck" where every transaction requires manual approval, killing operational efficiency.

### 💡 Our Solution

**Entrust** is a treasury automation platform that combines Safe Smart Accounts with AI-powered agents to eliminate the human bottleneck while maintaining full security and control.

**What Makes Us Different:**

| Traditional Safe | Entrust |
|-----------------|---------|
| Every $50 expense needs 3 human signatures | AI agents auto-approve within limits |
| Manual tracking of expenses/reimbursements | Automated budget tracking per category |
| No visibility into spending until month-end | Real-time Envio-indexed cashflow insights |
| Risky full-privilege delegates | "Rich Treasury, Poor Agent" security model |
| Fragmented tooling | All-in-one OS: Budgets, Payroll, Subscriptions |

**Our "Why":**
We built Entrust because we've lived this pain. Running a remote dev agency means juggling dozens of subscriptions across AWS, Notion, Figma, Linear—each requiring manual payments. We're passionate about freeing teams from manual finance ops so they can focus on building products.

## 📈 Future Roadmap

### Post-Hackathon (Q1 2025)
- [ ] Smart contract security audit
- [ ] Deploy on Lisk Mainnet
- [ ] Launch subscription tier for early adopters
- [ ] Add USDC bridge integration

### Q2 2025
- [ ] Advanced policy engine (department-specific limits)
- [ ] Tax export generation (CSV/PDF for accountants)
- [ ] Paymaster integration (gasless transactions)
- [ ] Mobile app (iOS/Android)

### Q3 2025
- [ ] Multi-org support (enterprise)
- [ ] Advanced analytics (predictive spending)
- [ ] Plugin system (custom agent actions)
- [ ] API for third-party integrations

**Challenges we ran into**

While building entrust, I encountered problems with the smart account/delegation setup. I even spend weeks to find the best smart account/delegation implementation, and eventually I found Safe {Core}. Also lisk has limitations with popular defi such as Aave/Compound Finance for my yield optimization and CoW Swap for swapping volatile tokens to stablecoins, because lisk hasn't been supported yet. and also the contract can't be verified, already tried both ways (via foundry cli and manual file upload), but in eth sepolia, it can be verified.

**Winner Classification**

**1. "Rich Treasury, Poor Agent" Security Model**
- Unlike delegating full wallet control, our agents have strictly limited permissions
- Smart contract enforces spending caps regardless of what AI "thinks"
- Even if session key is compromised, max loss = agent's spending limit

**2. Multi-Agent Architecture**
- Different agents for different purposes (Invoice, Subscription, Payroll)
- Each with own session key, spending limits, and permissions
- Prevents "single point of failure"

**3. Envio-Powered Accounting**
- Blockchain is source of truth (not database)
- Real-time cashflow without manual reconciliation
- Immutable audit trail for tax/compliance

**4. Role-Based Access Built-In**
- Not an afterthought—designed from ground up for teams
- Employees can submit/view, managers control
- Mirrors real company structures

### TrustPay SEA
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/trustpay-sea-5c58) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/nayrbryanGaming/trustpay-sea) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Lisk%20Builders%20Challenge:%20Round%20Three-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://lisk-builders-challenge-3.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-1-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Secure milestone payments for freelancers in SEA

![Solidity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Solidity-333333?style=flat-square) ![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Freelancers and small businesses in Southeast Asia often face serious payment risks when working on milestone-based projects.

Freelancers frequently experience delayed payments or clients disappearing after work has been delivered, while clients hesitate to pay upfront due to uncertainty about whether milestones will be completed as agreed. These trust issues are even more challenging in cross-city or cross-border collaborations, where legal enforcement is slow, expensive, and impractical.

TrustPay SEA addresses this problem by providing a blockchain-based milestone escrow system. Funds are securely locked in a smart contract at the start of a project and are released only when each milestone is approved by the client. All transactions and milestone states are transparent, tamper-resistant, and verifiable on-chain.

By using blockchain as a neutral and trustless execution layer, TrustPay SEA ensures fair payments, reduces disputes, and creates a safer collaboration environment for freelancers, clients, and SMEs across Southeast Asia.

**Challenges we ran into**

One of the main challenges was designing a milestone escrow system that is secure while remaining simple enough for non-technical users.

Smart contracts require strict logic and clear state transitions, especially when handling multiple milestones, approvals, and payment releases. We had to carefully design the contract structure to prevent edge cases such as double payments, premature releases, or locked funds. This was addressed by defining explicit milestone states and enforcing strict access control for each action.

Another challenge was creating a user experience that does not feel complex or intimidating like many existing Web3 applications. Most blockchain products expose technical details that are confusing for everyday users. To overcome this, we intentionally designed the interface to resemble familiar invoice and project management workflows, hiding blockchain complexity behind clear actions such as “Fund Project”, “Submit Milestone”, and “Release Payment”.

Finally, ensuring the frontend always reflects the correct on-chain state required careful handling of smart contract events. This was solved by mapping contract events directly to UI status updates, ensuring users always see accurate and trustworthy information.

**Winner Classification**

TrustPay SEA is designed as a practical, real-world blockchain application that directly addresses a common and unresolved problem in Southeast Asia: payment trust in milestone-based freelance and SME collaborations.

The project goes beyond a conceptual demo by implementing a fully functional smart contract escrow system, where funds are securely locked, milestone approvals are enforced on-chain, and payment releases are executed transparently without relying on centralized intermediaries.

TrustPay SEA fits the Winner Classification track because it demonstrates:
- A clear and validated real-world use case with strong relevance to freelancers and SMEs
- A complete end-to-end implementation, from smart contracts to a usable frontend
- Responsible and minimal use of blockchain technology strictly where it adds real value
- A strong foundation for real deployment and future adoption, not just hackathon experimentation

By focusing on usability, security, and practical impact, TrustPay SEA represents the type of production-ready project that this track aims to recognize.

**The problem it solves**

Many schools and educational institutions still rely on cash or fragmented payment systems for daily transactions such as canteen purchases, stationery, and event payments. This creates several challenges:

Lack of transparency: Parents cannot track how or where money is spent.

Security risks: Cash handling increases the risk of loss, theft, and misuse.

Poor spending control: Students can overspend without limits or accountability.

Event payment issues: School events and fests face coupon fraud, manual reconciliation, and operational inefficiency.

No intelligent insights: Existing systems provide no data-driven understanding of spending behavior.

SamayPay solves these problems by offering a secure, cashless, and transparent payment system built on blockchain (Solana) and powered by Google Cloud and Gemini AI. It enables controlled spending, real-time visibility, tamper-proof transaction records, and intelligent insights—making everyday payments and events safer, simpler, and smarter.

**Challenges we ran into**

One of the main challenges was integrating blockchain transactions with a smooth, real-time user experience. Blockchain operations are asynchronous, which initially caused delays in UI updates. We addressed this by separating UI confirmation from on-chain settlement and using backend validation with real-time updates.

Another challenge was coordinating multiple technologies—RFID hardware, cloud backend, blockchain (Solana), and AI (Gemini). Ensuring reliable communication between these layers required careful architecture design, logging, and fallback handling.

We also faced difficulty in converting raw transaction data into meaningful insights. Designing effective prompts and outputs for Gemini took multiple iterations to ensure the insights were simple, accurate, and useful for non-technical users.

Overall, these challenges helped us improve our system design, debugging skills, and ability to build reliable full-stack solutions under time constraints.

**Winner Classification**

SamayPay fits the Winner Classification track by demonstrating strong innovation, real-world applicability, and technical execution. The project solves a clear problem around cash dependency and lack of transparency in payments by combining blockchain (Solana), cloud infrastructure, and AI (Gemini). It goes beyond a concept by presenting a scalable architecture, clear use cases, and practical deployment potential for schools and events, making it competitive for top recognition.

### auditFlow
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/auditflow-e4ee) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/kimtony123/auditFlow) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://audit-flow-three.vercel.app/#/) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Lisk%20Builders%20Challenge:%20Round%20Three-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://lisk-builders-challenge-3.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-1-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Stake LSK tokens , Get Audit-Ready in minutes

![Solidity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Solidity-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Express.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Express.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![OpenAi](https://img.shields.io/badge/OpenAi-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

My friend, a brilliant developer from a developing country, won a hackathon with a yield-optimizing agent. To launch it safely, he needed an audit. He was quoted $15,000 just for preparation and the first review. Bootstrapped and with only his prize money, he faced an impossible choice: risk users' funds or abandon his dream. He shut down the project.

His story isn't unique. In Web3, where every project handles value, trust is built on security audits. While founders in developed regions can raise $50k+ for this, builders in emerging markets often rely on bootstrapping and hackathon prizes. The colossal cost of audits isn't just a business expense; it's a barrier to innovation that silently kills promising projects and limits global participation in the ecosystem.

AuditFlow exists to shatter this barrier. We automate the costly, manual pre-audit preparation and provide AI-powered preliminary analysis. We turn a process that costs $15,000 and weeks of work into one that takes hours.

Our model is designed for bootstrapped founders. Instead of a large upfront fee, users stake LSK tokens to access the platform. Their principal stake remains theirs, but the staking yield generated powers the service. This means founders don't burn precious capital on security prep; they can redeploy their stake after the audit. Our mission is to level the playing field, enabling founders everywhere to build trustworthy applications and bring their ideas to market.

**Challenges we ran into**

The core challenge was creating an AI analysis that was consistently useful and structured, not just clever commentary. Early versions would hallucinate or provide vague feedback, which is unacceptable for a security tool.

To overcome this, I engineered a deterministic framework:

**Structured Parsing First:** The system first extracts concrete, verifiable data: function lists, state variables, and permission models.

**Targeted AI Queries**: This structured data is then sent to OpenAI with very specific, scoped prompts (e.g., "Here are the contract's ownership functions. Identify centralization risks and list the exact function names.").

**Standardized Outputs**: The AI's insights are forced into a consistent finding format (Risk, Location, Description), which is then populated into a professional report template.

This hybrid approach ,combining deterministic code analysis with targeted AI , ensured reliable, auditor-ready output and was our key technical breakthrough.

**The problem it solves**

Travel bookings are locked and worthless if plans change. You book a $500 flight three months ahead. Life happens meeting gets canceled, family emergency, or you just can't go. Your options? Lose the money, pay $200+ change fees, or let it expire. The ticket has real value, but you can't sell it to someone who actually needs it.

As travelers, we're also stuck with loyalty points trapped in one platform. Airline miles expire. Hotel rewards are useless if you don't travel in that platform again while there many interesting offers.

We help travel agencies tokenize their inventory so customers can trade it or enter raffles. This enables customers to store, transfer, or trade their flight credits and booking slots. Our platform allows businesses to maximize occupancy through safe overselling while providing upfront capital. The tickets leverage Reflect.money protocol to generate yield while being held.

Key insight: Travel has high urgency value—flights are always needed. By enabling credits to be stored and kept as tradeable assets, we transform urgent needs into investment opportunities.

This helps MSMEs (Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises) join blockchain in our RWA marketplace as a secondary goal because our current focus is within Flight and Travel booking inventory. We have direct API access through business partnerships with Tixia, Emiless, and other OTAs, allowing you to:

Buy flight tickets, hotel bookings, and vacation packages as NFTs
Trade them on our marketplace if your plans change
Creates a liquid secondary market for real-world travel assets.
Whether you're a traveler who needs flexibility, or a seller with unsold inventory.

**Challenges we ran into**

e implemented cross-chain authentication and raffles by integrating Solana with EVM-based networks like Lisk and Polygon. While I am familiar with using EIP-712 and SIWE on EVM, other networks use Rust-based Ed25519 signatures. This created some authentication hurdles, though we eventually resolved them. Time constraints remain our biggest challenge.

Additionally, since we don’t have a designer, I built a placeholder UI for now. While I’m open to more inspiring designs, switching directions now would delay the final code

> Tamper-proof academic certificates on blockchain

![Solidity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Solidity-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![ethers.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/ethers.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS3](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS3-333333?style=flat-square) ![Express.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Express.js-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Academic certificate fraud is a widespread issue, where fake or tampered certificates are used during job applications and higher education admissions. Traditional certificate verification processes are manual, time-consuming, and require dependency on issuing institutions, making them inefficient and unreliable.

CertiChain solves this problem by providing a tamper-proof, blockchain-based certificate issuance and verification system. Educational institutions can issue certificates that are securely stored on the blockchain, ensuring immutability and long-term trust.

With CertiChain, certificates can be verified in multiple secure ways:

- By entering the Certificate ID

- By entering the Certificate Hash

- By scanning a QR code embedded in the certificate

The QR code verification enables instant validation using any device, making the process fast, user-friendly, and accessible even for non-technical users. Once verified, the system securely retrieves and displays the student’s authentic details directly from the blockchain.

This approach completely eliminates certificate forgery, reduces verification time from days to seconds, and removes the need for manual confirmation from institutions. CertiChain ensures transparency, trust, and scalability for students, educational institutions, employers, and recruiters.

**Challenges we ran into**

One of the major challenges was understanding how to securely store certificate data on the blockchain while avoiding storage of large or sensitive information. Since storing complete certificate details on-chain is costly and inefficient, we had to carefully design a structure using a Certificate Hash and Certificate ID instead of raw data.

Another challenge was integrating blockchain data with the web application. Fetching certificate details in real time using the Certificate ID and hash, and ensuring the frontend correctly reflected the blockchain response, required multiple iterations and debugging.

Generating and managing QR code–based verification links was also challenging. We had to ensure that scanning the QR code consistently redirected to the correct verification page and reliably fetched the corresponding student details without errors.

Handling blockchain transaction delays and ensuring a smooth user experience during certificate issuance was another hurdle. We addressed this by providing clear status feedback to the user while the transaction was being confirmed.

Finally, coordinating development within a limited hackathon timeframe required careful task division and rapid testing to ensure all components—smart contracts, backend logic, and frontend UI—worked seamlessly together.

**Winner Classification**

CertiChain fits strongly into the Winner Classification track as it addresses a real-world and widely faced problem—academic certificate forgery—using a practical and scalable blockchain-based solution.

Educational institutions currently rely on paper-based or editable digital certificates, which are easy to forge or manipulate. Verification by employers or organizations is time-consuming and often unreliable. CertiChain eliminates this issue by issuing tamper-proof academic certificates secured on the blockchain.

Each certificate is minted with a unique certificate ID and cryptographic hash, ensuring authenticity and immutability. A QR code embedded in the certificate links directly to a verification page, where employers or institutions can instantly verify student details without intermediaries.

The project demonstrates strong technical implementation, real-world applicability, and clear user impact. It simplifies certificate issuance, prevents fraud, and enables instant trust-based verification, making CertiChain a strong contender for recognition under the Winner Classification track.
