> Encouraging Open-Source with help of Blockchain

![Solidity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Solidity-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Django](https://img.shields.io/badge/Django-333333?style=flat-square) ![Blockchain](https://img.shields.io/badge/Blockchain-333333?style=flat-square) ![AI/ML](https://img.shields.io/badge/AI/ML-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

The problems GitHunters solves:

**1. Open Source ≠ Free Labor -**

Open source and decentralization share the same foundation, community-driven value creation **without central control**. Yet despite powering over 90% of the internet, open-source contributors are still expected to work largely for free - relying on goodwill, reputation or delayed recognition.

This model leads to:
- Contributor burnout
- Slower innovation
- Skilled developers opting out of open source

GitHunters redefines open-source contribution as paid, professional work.

Organizations can attach real monetary rewards (ETH) directly to GitHub issues. Funds are locked upfront in smart contract escrow, guaranteeing that every approved contribution is compensated.

This transforms open source from voluntary charity into a sustainable, incentive-aligned ecosystem.

**2. Trustless Payments & Transparent Collaboration: Enforcing Fairness Through Code, Not Promises -**

Traditional bounty platforms require trust in intermediaries to:
- Hold funds securely
- Release rewards fairly
- Resolve disputes honestly

GitHunters eliminates this trust dependency entirely.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/7ff0da47729f4dc8b5289169dc33d724/66f96b26-e790-435f-a8a2-25d6995bda01.png)

All bounty funds are:
- Locked on-chain using Lisk Sepolia smart contracts
- Released automatically only after contribution approval
- Publicly verifiable on the blockchain

Organizations cannot withhold payments.
Developers never need to chase rewards.

Fairness is enforced by immutable smart contract logic, not platform authority.

**3. Eliminating Discovery Friction with AI : Matching the Right Developer to the Right Problem -**

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/7ff0da47729f4dc8b5289169dc33d724/45b8ce03-0cf4-4bf5-912d-288b017e4302.jpeg)

One of the biggest inefficiencies in open source is discovery:
- Developers waste time searching for relevant issues
- Maintainers struggle to identify capable contributors

GitHunters solves this using AI-driven GitHub profile analysis powered by Gemini AI.

The system:
- Analyzes real contribution history, repositories, and languages
- Maps actual skills, not self-reported resumes
- Recommends high-fit bounties and projects

This dramatically increases contribution success rates while reducing wasted effort on both sides.

**4. Sustainable Funding via Decentralized Pooling: Beyond One-Off Bounties -**

Many open-source projects fail not due to lack of talent, but lack of funding.

GitHunters introduces on-chain project pooling, allowing:
- Communities to donate transparently
- Organizations to raise funds without intermediaries
- Contributors to see exactly how funds are allocated

This creates a long-term, decentralized funding layer for open source - not just temporary rewards, but sustained project growth.

**Challenges we ran into**

Challenges we faced and how we solved them:

**1. Designing a Safe & Reliable Smart Contract Escrow -**

Ensuring absolute correctness in reward distribution was one of the hardest technical challenges.

Key Challenges:
- Preventing double payouts
- Ensuring only approved work triggers fund release
- Handling reverted or failed blockchain transactions
- Synchronizing on-chain state with off-chain GitHub actions

How We Solved It:
- Designed smart contracts using strict state machines
- (Created → Funded → Claimed → Paid)
- Enforced single-execution payout logic at the contract level
- Implemented event-based listeners to sync blockchain confirmations with backend state
- Added wallet and network validation to prevent incorrect chain interactions

This resulted in a trustless, failure-resistant escrow system with zero manual intervention.

**2. Handling Wallet & Network Mismatch Errors -**

Making Web3 Accessible to Web2 Users

Many users initially faced failed transactions due to:
- Incorrect network selection
- Wallets not configured for Lisk Sepolia
- Silent Web3 errors with poor UX feedback

How We Solved It:
- Implemented automatic network detection and switching
- Added clear, human-readable error messages
- Validated chain ID before every contract interaction

This significantly reduced transaction failures and made the platform usable even for non-Web3-native developers.

**3. Balancing Blockchain Transparency with User Experience -**

While blockchain transparency is powerful, exposing raw hashes, gas fees, and transaction states can overwhelm users.

How We Solved It:
- Abstracted blockchain complexity behind clean UI states
- Displayed human-readable status indicators
- Provided direct block explorer links for advanced users

This balanced Web3 trust guarantees with Web2 usability.

**Winner Classification**

Why GitHunters fits the Winner Classification Track:

**1. Innovation & Technical Excellence -**
 
- Real-world smart contract escrow deployed on Lisk Sepolia
- Meaningful AI + blockchain integration (not superficial)
- Solves a global problem affecting millions of developers
- Fully deployed system: Frontend, Backend, AI and On-chain logic!

This is not a prototype - it’s a production-ready platform.

**2. Community Impact & Ecosystem Value -**

- Strengthens the open-source economy
- Enables global participation without institutional barriers
- Introduces sustainable funding through decentralized pooling
- Strong alignment with decentralization and developer empowerment

**3. Product Design & Usability -**

- Clean onboarding with GitHub OAuth + MetaMask
- Clear role separation (developers vs organizations)
- Minimal friction despite advanced Web3 functionality
- Accessible to both Web2 and Web3 users.

**4. Social Media & Community Readiness -**

GitHunters is highly shareable because it:

- Shows instant, visual value (bounties, rewards, dashboards)
- Has a strong narrative: “Get paid to contribute to open source”
- Naturally aligns with developer communities on Twitter and LinkedIn

Finally,

GitHunters doesn’t just reward code - it rebuilds trust, incentives and sustainability into open source itself!

![Solidity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Solidity-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

# Upbeats: The Future of Music Investment

## The Problem: Funding & Engagement
The traditional music industry forces artists into a difficult choice: trade away their masters for upfront capital from labels, or struggle to fund their careers independently. Fans, meanwhile, remain on the sidelines—passionate supporters with no way to share in the success they help create.

## The Solution: Tokenize & Trade
**Upbeats** is the premier decentralized marketplace for music investment. We empower artists to turn their songs into investable digital assets, allowing fans to buy, sell, and own a stake in the music they love.

## How It Works

### 1. Initial Song Offering (ISO)
Artists can launch an **ISO** to raise funds directly from their community. By tokenizing a percentage of their master recording rights, artists generate instant liquidity for production, marketing, and touring—all without signing a predatory record deal.

*   **You Set the Terms:** Artists decide how much equity to sell and at what price.
*   **Keep Your Masters:** Sell a portion of the revenue, not your creative freedom.
*   **Instant Funding:** Capital is released immediately upon a successful raise.

### 2. The Marketplace
Upbeats features a fully functional **Trade Marketplace** where music tokens can be bought and sold like stocks. This creates a dynamic secondary market, giving music assets true liquidity.

*   **For Investors:** Build a portfolio of high-performing songs. Earn streaming royalties proportional to your holdings.
*   **For Traders:** Speculate on rising stars and undervalues tracks. Buy low before an artist blows up, and sell high on the open market.
*   **Real-Time Valuation:** Song value is determined by market demand and streaming performance, not arbitrary industry valuations.

## Why Upbeats?
We are moving beyond simple crowdfunding. Upbeats creates a symbiotic financial ecosystem. When an artist succeeds, their token holders succeed. It's not just support; it's **co-ownership**.

**Join the revolution. Invest in the beat.**

**Challenges we ran into**

# Challenges faced in Building Upbeats

Building **Upbeats** has been an ambitious journey that pushed the boundaries of my technical skills and domain understanding. The process wasn't just about writing code; it was about architecting a solution for a complex, real-world industry problem.

One of the most significant hurdles was **navigating the complexities of the music industry and financial regulations**. Understanding how music investment works legally and translating that into a decentralized logic was far from straightforward. I had to deeply research how royalties flow, what constitutes a security, and how to design a system that is both compliant and transparent. This required bridging the gap between rigid legal frameworks and the permissionless nature of blockchain technology.

Beyond the domain knowledge, I encountered several specific challenges:

*   **Technical Implementation:** Integrating the smart contracts with a responsive frontend presented its own set of difficulties. Ensuring seamless state management between the blockchain data (read from the Lisk Sepolia Testnet) and the Next.js application required careful handling of asynchronous data and error states. Debugging interactions between the MusicPlatform contract and the factory pattern for individual MusicToken's was particularly challenging.
*   **Defining the MVP:** With so many potential features from DeFi lending to complex DAO governance, it was difficult to decide where to start. I struggled to prioritize which features were essential for a Minimum Viable Product (MVP) and which could be deferred. Narrowing the scope to focus strictly on the **Initial Song Offering** and **Marketplace** was a critical decision that required sacrificing some exciting ideas to ensure the core product was robust and deliverable.

Despite these obstacles, tackling them head-on has resulted in a more focused and technically sound platform.

* Many applicants are rejected before human review due to poor ATS optimization.

## For Recruiters
* Sorting through thousands of resumes is time-consuming.
* Traditional hiring platforms rely on centralized databases and opaque scoring systems.
* There is no reliable, transparent way to quickly filter candidates based on job-specific resume compatibility.

**Challenges we ran into**

## Challenges Faced During Development

During the development of this project, I encountered several key challenges related to the Lisk ecosystem and full-stack integration:

### 1. Network Configuration & Documentation Alignment
- Some **network configuration values were outdated**, requiring additional effort to correctly configure the environment for deployment and testing.
- The **smart contract `.config` file** and related setup instructions in the documentation needed updates to reflect current network parameters.
- This caused **initial friction**, especially when switching between development and test networks.

### 2. Limited End-to-End Integration Examples
- While the core blockchain documentation explains contract interaction, there were **few examples connecting smart contracts to real-world applications**.
- Integrating smart contracts seamlessly with **frontend applications** required extra research and experimentation.
- This challenge highlighted the need for **more full-stack guidance** for developers building decentralized applications.

### Summary
These challenges underscore the importance of:
- Up-to-date network configurations
- Clear, end-to-end examples
- Seamless integration guidance for developers

Overcoming these hurdles allowed the project to achieve **robust deployment and reliable frontend-backend interactions** within the Lisk ecosystem.

- This project delivers a **future-ready decentralized application** with clear real-world impact.
- It addresses **global hiring inefficiencies and ATS-based resume rejections**, affecting millions of job seekers worldwide.
- The problem is especially relevant in **Southeast Asia**, where competition for digital and remote roles continues to grow rapidly.

## Solution Overview

- The platform combines **AI-powered resume analysis** with **Lisk’s secure blockchain infrastructure**.
- Users upload their resumes and job descriptions to receive:

  - Role-specific strengths and weaknesses

## Meaningful Use of Lisk Blockchain

- Lisk is used as **core infrastructure**, not an add-on.
- On-chain storage ensures:
  - Data immutability
  - User ownership of professional data
  - Trustless verification of resume analysis results
- This enables recruiters to rely on **verifiable scores** instead of manual resume screening.

## Global and Regional Impact

- The solution addresses a **universal hiring challenge** across industries and regions.
- Its architecture supports **scalable, inclusive, and globally relevant decentralized applications**.
- The project is particularly impactful for **emerging tech markets like Southeast Asia**, helping bridge talent access and opportunity.

> LiskChat helps you use Web3 as easily as chatting.

![Solidity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Solidity-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Voiceflow](https://img.shields.io/badge/Voiceflow-333333?style=flat-square) ![Express](https://img.shields.io/badge/Express-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

- **Web3 is too hard for normal users**

Most people find wallets and DeFi dashboards confusing, so they avoid using Web3 at all. LiskChat lets them act just by chatting instead of learning complex UIs.

- **Unsafe experiences for beginners**

New users often don’t know who controls their funds or what to do next, which makes Web3 feel risky. In LiskChat, the assistant guides users step‑by‑step, lets them ask questions if they’re confused, and still keeps all approvals in their own wallet, with no private keys ever stored.

- **Hard to teach and onboard new users**

Explaining Web3 concepts in a classroom or community is difficult when everyone must install apps and connect wallets first. With LiskChat, a facilitator can onboard people by sharing a single chat bot, then walk them through real transactions step‑by‑step in the same conversation.

- **Too many tools just to test**

Trying Web3 on testnets often requires installing wallets, finding faucets, and learning explorers before doing anything useful. LiskChat bundles this into a single chat experience, so users can test payments and NFT rewards on Lisk Sepolia without jumping between multiple tools.

**Challenges we ran into**

**Problem: Voiceflow ↔ backend ↔ blockchain**
When wiring Voiceflow to the backend, transaction calls often failed because variables like wallet address, amount, or NFT metadata were missing or in the wrong format, causing the blockchain transaction to be rejected.

Error messages from the backend were too raw or technical, which broke the conversational flow and confused users when a transfer or mint failed.

**Solution:** Clear actions and contracts
Defined strict backend actions such as SEND_IDRX and MINT_NFT with a fixed JSON schema (e.g. address, amount, tokenId/metadataUri, network), then mapped Voiceflow variables directly into those fields.

Standardized the backend responses into simple, human‑readable messages like “Your IDRX transfer is confirmed” or “NFT minted, here is your transaction link,” which Voiceflow could display without extra logic.

**Result:** Smooth on‑chain chat experience
After tightening this contract, minting NFTs and sending IDRX from chat became predictable: Voiceflow collects inputs, the backend validates and submits the transaction, and the user gets a clear success or failure message in the same conversation.

This turned what started as a fragile integration into a stable “chat‑to‑chain” experience suitable for submission.

**Winner Classification**

This project fits the **DeFi / Payments **track for the hackathon, with a clear onboarding angle.

LiskChat lets users check balances, send IDRX, and mint NFT rewards on Lisk Sepolia directly from chat, turning typical DeFi actions into simple payment and incentive flows that anyone can trigger from Telegram or WhatsApp. By guiding users step‑by‑step in conversation while keeping all approvals in their own wallet, it also naturally teaches and onboards new users into DeFi on Lisk without forcing them through complex dashboards.

# 🎭 PrizeMafia - Farcaster Frame

Multiplayer Mafia game with ETH prizes, built as a Farcaster Frame on Base L2.

## 🎮 Game Overview

- **9 Players**: Exactly 9 players per game
- **Entry Fee**: 0.001 ETH (testnet)
- **Roles**: 2 Mafia, 1 Doctor, 1 God, 5 Villagers
- **Duration**: 3 rounds max, ~15 minutes
- **Platform**: Farcaster Frames (no app needed!)

## 🏗️ Architecture

- **Frontend**: Next.js + Farcaster Frames
- **Backend**: Next.js API routes + Redis state
- **Blockchain**: Base Sepolia testnet
- **Wallet**: Privy embedded wallets
- **Images**: @vercel/og dynamic generation

## 🚀 Quick Start

### 1. Clone and Install

```bash
git clone <your-repo>
cd prizemafia-frame
npm install
```

### 2. Environment Setup

```bash
cp .env.example .env.local
# Fill in your API keys:
# - NEYNAR_API_KEY (Farcaster)
# - UPSTASH_REDIS_URL & TOKEN (Redis)
# - ALCHEMY_BASE_KEY (Base network)
# - PRIVY_APP_ID & SECRET (Wallets)
# - PRIVATE_KEY (Deployer wallet)
```

### 3. Deploy Smart Contract

```bash
# Compile contract
npm run hardhat:compile

# Deploy to Base Sepolia
npm run hardhat:deploy

# Update .env.local with contract address
```

### 4. Run Development Server

```bash
npm run dev
```

### 5. Test Your Frame

- Use [Frame Ground](https://frameground.app) to test locally
- Share frame URL in Warpcast to test live

```
src/
├── app/api/
│   ├── frame/           # Frame endpoints

## 🎯 Game Flow

1. **Create/Join**: Host creates game, players join via frame
2. **Payment**: Players pay 0.001 ETH entry fee (embedded wallet)
3. **Start**: Game starts when 9 players joined
4. **Roles**: Secret roles assigned via private DMs
5. **Day Phase**: 5min discussion, vote to eliminate
6. **Night Phase**: Mafia kills, Doctor saves
7. **Win**: Mafia wins if they equal villagers, else villagers win

**Challenges we ran into**

# Challenges I Ran Into

Building PrizeMafia as a Farcaster Frame involved integrating real-time multiplayer logic with blockchain payments, which led to several hurdles. Here are the key ones and how I overcame them:

## 1. Managing Real-Time Game State Across Players

**Hurdle:** Farcaster Frames are stateless by design, making it tricky to synchronize game phases (e.g., day/night cycles) and player actions in real-time for 9 players. Initial attempts using only API routes caused race conditions where votes or role assignments overlapped, leading to inconsistent game states.

**Solution:** I implemented Redis for persistent state management, storing game data with TTL (time-to-live) for automatic cleanup. This allowed atomic updates via Redis transactions, ensuring thread-safe operations. I also added cron jobs to handle phase transitions, tested thoroughly with mock players to simulate concurrency.

## 2. Integrating Embedded Wallets for ETH Payments

**Hurdle:** Using Privy for embedded wallets worked well for seamless payments, but on Base Sepolia testnet, transaction confirmations were slow, causing UI freezes during the 0.001 ETH entry fee process. Players sometimes saw "pending" states indefinitely, disrupting the lobby flow.

**Solution:** I polled the blockchain using Alchemy's API for transaction receipts, with exponential backoff to avoid rate limits. Added client-side loading indicators and error handling for failed txns, redirecting users to retry. Extensive testing on testnet with multiple wallets ensured reliability.

## 3. Dynamic Image Generation for Frames

**Hurdle:** Generating OG images with @vercel/og for lobby and game states was complex, especially for personalized content like player roles sent via DMs. Early versions had rendering issues on mobile Farcaster clients, with images not updating dynamically based on query params.

**Solution:** I refactored the API to use conditional rendering in the OG endpoint, caching images in Vercel for performance. Debugged by logging params and testing on Frame Ground, ensuring compatibility across devices. This improved load times and visual consistency.

These challenges pushed me to deepen my knowledge of serverless architectures and blockchain integrations, ultimately making the app more robust. All issues were resolved through iterative testing, documentation reviews, and community forums like Farcaster dev channels.

**Winner Classification**

# How This Project Fits in the Winner Classification Track

PrizeMafia perfectly aligns with the **Blockchain/Web3 Track** by leveraging decentralized technologies to create an innovative, trustless multiplayer gaming experience. Here's how it embodies the track's focus on blockchain innovation, user adoption, and real-world utility:

## Key Alignments

### 1. **Decentralized Gaming Infrastructure**
   - **Fit:** The project uses Base L2 for secure, low-cost ETH transactions, enabling real-money prizes without intermediaries. The escrow smart contract ensures fair distribution of winnings, demonstrating blockchain's role in trustless gaming.
   - **Impact:** This addresses scalability issues in traditional gaming by using Layer 2 solutions, making ETH-based games accessible and efficient for 9-player sessions.

### 2. **Embedded Wallet Integration for Seamless Onboarding**
   - **Fit:** Privy embedded wallets eliminate the need for external wallets, lowering barriers for non-crypto users. Players pay 0.001 ETH entry fees directly within the Farcaster Frame, showcasing Web3's potential for mainstream adoption.
   - **Impact:** By integrating wallets into the social gaming flow, it promotes user-friendly Web3 experiences, aligning with tracks that reward projects driving mass adoption.

### 3. **Real-Time State Management on Decentralized Backends**
   - **Fit:** Redis handles game state persistence, while blockchain records immutable game outcomes. This hybrid approach combines off-chain efficiency with on-chain transparency, a hallmark of advanced Web3 architectures.
   - **Impact:** It highlights blockchain's versatility beyond finance, applying it to interactive, time-sensitive applications like multiplayer games.

### 4. **Social Layer Integration via Farcaster**
   - **Fit:** Built as a Farcaster Frame, it integrates with decentralized social networks, allowing games to be shared and played within Warpcast. This creates a social Web3 ecosystem where gaming fosters community engagement.
   - **Impact:** The project bridges social media and blockchain, fitting tracks that value innovative cross-platform integrations and community-building in Web3.

## Why It Stands Out
PrizeMafia isn't just a game—it's a proof-of-concept for scalable, prize-based multiplayer experiences on blockchain. By combining Base L2's speed, Privy's UX, and Farcaster's reach, it tackles real challenges like transaction latency and user friction, making it a strong contender for recognition in blockchain innovation. This project advances Web3 gaming by making it fun, fair, and frictionless, potentially inspiring future decentralized entertainment platforms.

**The problem it solves**

# MerdekaSwap

**MerdekaSwap** is a decentralized, trustless Over-The-Counter (OTC) swap protocol built on the **Lisk Sepolia** Layer 2 network.

It enables users to trade any ERC-20 token directly with another party without slippage, using an off-chain order book (Supabase) for gas-less order creation and on-chain settlement for complete security.

## 🌟 Features

-   **Trustless OTC Swaps**: Securely swap ERC-20 tokens with 0 slippage.
-   **Gas-less Listings**: Creating an order is free (off-chain **EIP-712** signature). Gas is only paid when filling an order.
-   **Private & Public Orders**: Create orders for a specific wallet or open to the public.
-   **Xellar Wallet Integration**: Seamless onboarding with Xellar's embedded wallet and social login.
-   **Fee Structure**: A configurable protocol fee (default 0.1% or 10 BPS) is charged to the **Maker** upon success.
-   **Non-Custodial Listings**: Assets remain in your wallet until the swap is executed. No depositing into a contract required.
-   **Shareable Order Links**: Every order has a unique URL, perfect for sharing via DM or social media for direct deals.
-   **Verified Token Badges**: Visual indicators for trusted tokens to ensure safety against impostor assets.


## 🏗 Tech Stack

-   **Blockchain**: Lisk Sepolia Testnet
-   **Smart Contract**: Solidity
-   **Frontend**: Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Wagmi, Viem
-   **Wallet**: Xellar Kit
-   **Backend**: Supabase

## 🛡 Security

-   **EIP-712 Signatures**: Orders are cryptographically signed by the Maker.
-   **Nonce Management**: Prevents replay attacks.
-   **Deadline Enforcement**: Orders automatically expire.

**Your morning coffee tells a story.**  
It's the ritual that starts your day. The quiet moment before work. The reason for a catch-up with a friend.

**But what if that story is built on a lie?**  
Right now, it is. It's a story broken—lost in paperwork, delayed at ports for **3+ days**, and vulnerable to fraud.

This broken story has a staggering cost: while **9 out of 10** ASEAN consumers have encountered counterfeit goods, the supply chains behind them bleed **$17 billion** annually from inefficiency and opacity.

At its core, this is a crisis of trust:

- **For Consumers:** No way to verify authenticity or ethical origin. Every purchase is a gamble.

- **For Businesses:** Manual processes create costly bottlenecks. Siloed data leads to stockouts, waste, and lost revenue.

- **For the Entire Ecosystem:** The absence of a single, immutable record makes fraud rampant, draining over **$100 billion** globally each year.

---

# **Trace Bean: The Truth Layer for Trust**

We fix the broken story. We build the dedicated truth layer on the blockchain, replacing fragmentation with end-to-end digital traceability.

🌱 **From Farm to Cup:** Each batch is **tokenized** as an **unforgeable NFT**—a living passport that never lies.

⚡ **Slash Delays:** Smart contracts automate verification, cutting customs time by over **66%**—from days to hours.

🔗 **Unified, Not Siloed:** Partners share data in real time, securely, without losing control.

🛡️ **Kill Fraud:** An auditable, tamper-proof record makes counterfeit swaps and false claims impossible.

**We don't just track beans—we restore trust. We turn supply chain vulnerability into verifiable value.**

- User Registry: 0x5215EE62339a3B4D4416843Bd2E6cA5Bf9195942

**Challenges we ran into**

Building a bridge between blockchain and the coffee supply chain pushed us into unexpected, real-world problems.

- **The Paper Can Lie:**  
Our biggest weakness wasn't in the code—it was on the packaging. **Anyone can copy a QR code and make fake labels.** If the tag on the bag isn't secure, our entire digital truth becomes useless. This kept us up at night.

- **Teaching Tech From Zero:**  
The farmers, drivers, and warehouse workers we work with often use basic phones. **How do you explain crypto wallets to someone who's never downloaded an app?** We had to start from scratch—learning how they work before we could build for them.

- **Everyone Keeps Secrets:**  
In the supply chain, **data is guarded like a treasure.** Farmers hide harvest numbers, shippers hide delivery times, shops hide sales data. Getting people to share wasn't a tech fix—it was a trust-building mission.

- **What Works For One Farm Breaks For Fifty:**  
Tracking coffee from one farm is simple. **But what happens when beans from 50 farms get mixed together?** How do you trace a single bag when everything gets blended? Our perfect digital system met the messy reality of how things actually move.

> *"Our real challenge wasn't the technology—it was getting the real world to trust it."*

**The problem it solves**

## 💡 The Problem & Solution

### The Problem: A Broken, Slow, and Opaque Supply Chain
Global logistics is currently stuck in the past, facing three critical bottlenecks that cost the industry billions annually:

1.  **The "Cash Flow" Trap:** Small carriers and truckers are the backbone of logistics, yet they are forced to wait **60-90 days** for payment on completed jobs. This lack of liquidity kills small businesses.
2.  **The Compliance Black Hole:** Cross-border shipping involves navigating complex, ever-changing customs regulations. Manual errors in HS Code classification or missing documents lead to **stalled shipments and massive fines**.
3.  **Greenwashing:** Everyone talks about sustainable shipping, but there is no **verifiable incentive** for drivers to choose cleaner routes. "Eco-friendly" is often just a marketing buzzword with no proof.

### The Solution: SmartLogix – The AI + DePIN Logistics OS
SmartLogix bridges the gap between **Generative AI** and **Decentralized Finance (DeFi)** to build a trustless, autonomous supply chain.

*   **💸 Logi-Fi (DeFi for Logistics):** We solved the cash flow problem by tokenizing invoices. Our **"Instant Factoring"** smart contract allows carriers to sell their future invoice claims to a liquidity pool for **98% immediate cash**. No banks, no waiting—just code.
*   **🤖 AI Compliance Agent:** Using **Google Gemini 2.0**, we built an intelligent customs broker. Users essentially drag-and-drop a product image, and the AI automatically determines the **HS Code**, checks international **WCO trade laws**, and generates a risk assessment score in milliseconds.
*   **🌱 Proof of Eco-Driving:** We moved sustainability from "goodwill" to "profit." Our routing algorithms calculate the carbon footprint of every path. Drivers who verifiable take the lower-carbon route are automatically rewarded with **SLX-CC (Carbon Credit) tokens** on-chain, creating a real financial incentive to save the planet.

---

### 🎨 One-Liner
> *"SmartLogix is an AI-powered logistics platform that automates compliance, tokenizes invoices for instant liquidity provided by DeFi pools, and incentivizes eco-friendly driving with on-chain carbon credits."*

**Challenges we ran into**

## ⚠️ Challenges We Ran Into

### 1. The "Hallucinating AI" JSON Parser
**Problem:** Our AI Compliance Officer (Gemini 2.0) would occasionally return explanations *outside* the requested JSON format, or include Markdown code blocks (```json) that broke our standard `JSON.parse` logic. This caused the backend to crash unpredictably during demos.
**Solution:** We implemented a robust **"Aggressive Sanitization" layer** in [complianceRoutes.js](cci:7://file:///c:/Users/dhruv/projects/SmartLogix/backend/Routes/complianceRoutes.js:0:0-0:0). It uses regex to isolate the JSON object from the AI's "chatter," strips Markdown artifacts, and even auto-corrects syntax errors like trailing commas before parsing.

### 2. Geocoding "Fuzzy" Logistics Data
**Problem:** Real-world shipping data is messy. Inputs like "Jawaharlal Nehru Port" would fail standard geocoders, breaking our route optimization map. The API would return "No Results," leaving the UI blank.
**Solution:** We built a **Multi-Strategy Fallback Geocoder**. If the exact port name fails, our algorithm automatically progressively simplifies the query: stripping suffixes (e.g., "International Airport"), trying only the city name, and finally defaulting to the region. This ensures the map *always* renders a valid path.

### 3. Bridging Web2 AI with Web3 Transactions
**Problem:** Triggering blockchain transactions from AI events was tricky. We needed a way to verify that a driver *actually* took the AI-suggested green route before minting Carbon Credits, without requiring the user to be a blockchain expert.
**Solution:** We created a seamless "Proof of Eco-Driving" flow. The frontend acts as an oracle: it verifies the route parameters against the AI's sustainability score combined with the user's selection and acts as the signer for the transaction, allowing users to mint `SLX-CC` tokens with a single click, abstracting away the complex contract interaction.

### 4. Smart Contract Liquidity for "Logi-Fi"
**Problem:** Our "Instant Factoring" feature (Logi-Fi) initially failed because the deployed contract had no ETH to pay out users, causing `estimateGas` errors that looked like code bugs.
**Solution:** We realized we needed to bootstrap the **DeFi Liquidity Pool**. We added a dedicated "Add Liquidity" interface for the DAO admins to fund the contract, ensuring that when a carrier clicks "Get Instant Cash," the contract has the solvency to execute the transfer immediately.

**Winner Classification**

## 🏆 Why SmartLogix is the Winner

SmartLogix isn't just a "wrapper" around an AI API—it is a **complete, vertical operating system** that fundamentally restructures how logistics works by merging two cutting-edge technologies (GenAI + DeFi) into a seamless user experience.

### 1. We Built Real FinTech, Not Just Signs
Most hackathon projects stop at "displaying" data. We built **Logi-Fi**, a fully functional **DeFi Factoring Protocol**.
*   **Proof:** We wrote and deployed [LogisticsEscrow.sol](cci:7://file:///c:/Users/dhruv/projects/SmartLogix/contracts/contracts/LogisticsEscrow.sol:0:0-0:0) with a custom Liquidity Pool mechanism. Users can ACTUALLY interacting with the blockchain to get paid instantly. This solves a trillion-dollar "small business liquidity" problem in logistics.

### 2. We Closed the "AI-to-Blockchain" Gap
We didn't just use AI for chat and Blockchain for tokens. We connected them.
*   **Innovation:** Our **Gemini 2.0 AI** validates the physical world (Product Images, Routes), which then *triggers* the **On-Chain Action** (Smart Contract execution, Carbon Credit Minting). This "AI Oracle" architecture is the holy grail of modern DePIN (Decentralized Physical Infrastructure Networks).

### 3. Impact-Driven, Not Just Tech-Driven
We tackled the three biggest, boringest, most profitable problems in the industry:
*   **Red Tape:** Solved by our **AI Compliance Officer** (saving 30% operational time).
*   **Cash Flow:** Solved by **Instant Factoring** (saving carriers from bankruptcy).
*   **Climate Change:** Solved by **Tokenized Eco-Rewards** (making green shipping profitable).

### 4. Technical Depth & Polish
*   **Backend:** Robust NodeJS architecture with aggressive error handling for AI hallucinations.
*   **Frontend:** A stunning, responsive React dashboard that abstracts away Web3 complexity (no "Connect Wallet" friction until necessary).
*   **Blockchain:** Live deployment on **Lisk Sepolia** with verifiable transactions on Blockscout.

**Verdict:** SmartLogix is ready to scale. It’s practical, profitable, and powered by the best of AI and Web3.

**The Problem PeridotVault Solves**

Game distribution today is centralized, expensive, and restrictive.

Indie developers face high publishing fees, limited visibility, and loss of control over their games and users. Players, on the other hand, never truly own what they buy—games and in-game items can be revoked, altered, or locked inside closed platforms.

Web3 gaming promises ownership, but in reality it is fragmented, difficult to use, and plagued by poor UX, high gas fees, and scattered game libraries. As a result, both traditional developers and mainstream gamers struggle to adopt it.

1. PeridotVault is a next-generation gaming distribution platform that combines true digital ownership, low-cost publishing, and AI-powered discovery.
2. Developers can publish games affordably without gatekeepers
3. Players truly own games and in-game assets on-chain
4. A built-in wallet and unified library remove Web3 complexity
5. AI personalization improves game discovery and community safety

*PeridotVault makes game publishing fairer, ownership real, and gaming platforms open by design.*

The main challenge was designing a hybrid on-chain/off-chain architecture that could significantly reduce gas fees while still preserving trust, ownership, and scalability. Supporting a future multichain ecosystem added complexity, as the system had to remain flexible without locking into a single blockchain model.

**The problem it solves**

# TaniFi: Bringing On-Chain Finance to the Offline Farmer 🌾⛓️

**TaniFi** is a decentralized, Sharia-compliant agricultural finance protocol built on **Lisk Layer 2**. It bridges the digital divide by allowing unbanked farmers to access global DeFi liquidity using simple **USSD (2G) technology**, without needing internet access or smartphones.

---

## 🚩 The Problem It Solves

Agriculture contributes significantly to the economy of emerging markets, yet smallholder farmers remain trapped in poverty due to a structural **"Agricultural Trilemma"**:

1. **The Digital Divide (Accessibility):**
* **Reality:** 40% of rural areas in Indonesia are internet "blank spots".
* **Issue:** Most modern DeFi and Fintech apps require 4G smartphones and data plans, excluding millions of farmers who only possess feature phones (Nokia-style devices).


2. **Predatory Financing (Fairness):**
* **Reality:** Formal banks reject farmers due to lack of land certificates (collateral).
* **Issue:** Farmers are forced to rely on "Tengkulak" (loan sharks) with interest rates as high as **20% per month**, trapping them in a cycle of debt.


3. **The Trust Deficit (Transparency):**
* **Reality:** Previous centralized agritech platforms (e.g., the TaniFund & eFishery cases) suffered from internal fraud and data manipulation ("double bookkeeping").
* **Issue:** Global investors lost trust in funding agriculture because they cannot verify if the money actually reached the farmer or was used for planting.



---

## 💡 What Can People Use It For?

TaniFi serves three distinct user groups within the ecosystem:

### 1. For Unbanked Farmers (The Borrowers)

* **Access Capital Offline:** Dial a simple short code (e.g., `*777#`) to request funding for fertilizer or seeds without needing a bank account or internet.
* **Build Digital Reputation:** Every repayment creates an on-chain credit score (Soulbound Token), allowing them to access larger capital in the future based on performance, not assets.
* **Fair Profit Sharing:** Instead of paying fixed interest (Riba), farmers share a percentage of their harvest profit. If the harvest fails due to floods (verified by weather data), they are not crushed by debt.

### 2. For Global Investors (The Lenders)

* **Fund Real-World Assets (RWA):** Directly fund specific agricultural cycles (e.g., "Banyumas Coconut Sugar Export Batch #42") using stablecoins (USDC/IDRX).
* **Track Impact:** View transparent, real-time data on how funds are disbursed and utilized via the blockchain ledger.

### 3. For Cooperatives (The Off-Takers)

* **Supply Chain Financing:** Get instant liquidity to pay farmers immediately upon harvest collection, rather than waiting 30-60 days for export payments.
* **Digital Administration:** replace manual logbooks with an immutable digital ledger that tracks every kilogram of harvest from farm to table.

---

## 🛡️ How It Makes Tasks Easier & Safer

TaniFi innovates by combining **Low-Tech interfaces** with **High-Tech security**.

### Making Financing **Easier** (UX Innovation)

* **No Internet Required:** Uses USSD (GSM protocol), accessible on 99% of mobile phones globally.
* **Gasless Transactions:** Farmers don't need to buy ETH or LSK to pay for gas fees. TaniFi uses **Account Abstraction (ERC-4337)** Paymasters to sponsor transaction costs, creating a seamless experience.
* **Instant Disbursement:** Funds are sent as digital vouchers to local partner stores, ensuring farmers get what they need (fertilizer/seeds) instantly without waiting for bank approvals.

### Making Investing **Safer** (Security Innovation)

* **Triple-Entry Accounting:** Unlike centralized servers that can be manipulated, every transaction is recorded on the **Lisk Layer 2 Blockchain**. This creates a "Single Source of Truth" that cannot be altered by the platform owners.
* **Smart Contract Enforcement:** The "Musyarakah Vault" automatically splits harvest revenue between the investor and farmer according to the pre-agreed ratio. No one can run away with the profits.
* **Automated Risk Mitigation:** Integration with **Chainlink Functions** allows the smart contract to read weather data (BMKG). If a flood occurs, the contract can automatically trigger insurance protocols or restructure the loan, removing human bias and fraud.

---

**Challenges we ran into**

# Challenges I Ran Into

Building **TaniFi** within a hackathon timeline was far from smooth. Below are the real technical hurdles I faced during development, and how I solved them.

---

## 1. Environment & Tooling Setup (WSL + Docker + Foundry)

### The Challenge
At the very beginning, the development environment itself became a blocker:

- Docker was installed but the daemon could not start
- WSL was outdated and incompatible with Docker Desktop
- Ubuntu installation via Microsoft Store repeatedly failed
- Disk space constraints on the system drive caused additional friction

These issues prevented even basic services (PostgreSQL, Redis, NestJS) from running.

### How I Solved It
- Updated WSL manually using `wsl --update --web-download`
- Migrated development fully into **WSL2 (Ubuntu)** instead of mixing Windows + Linux tooling
- Reconfigured Docker Desktop to use WSL backend
- Carefully chose a **non-destructive storage strategy** (avoiding data loss on external SSDs)

**Lesson learned:**  
A “broken” environment can look like a code problem. Fixing infra early saved massive time later.

---

## 2. Prisma ORM Breaking Changes (Prisma v7)

### The Challenge
Prisma introduced breaking changes in version 7:

- `datasource.url` is no longer allowed in `schema.prisma`
- Connection configuration moved to `prisma.config.ts`
- `PrismaClient` must now be constructed with explicit options

This caused multiple runtime and compile-time errors such as:
- `P1012: datasource property 'url' is no longer supported`
- `PrismaClientInitializationError`

### How I Solved It
- Carefully read updated Prisma documentation
- Migrated DB config to `prisma.config.ts`
- Refactored `PrismaService` to properly extend `PrismaClient`
- Regenerated Prisma Client and re-ran migrations

**Lesson learned:**  
Using “latest” tech gives advantages, but only if you are ready to adapt to breaking changes.

---

## 3. USSD State Management & Stateless HTTP

### The Challenge
USSD flows are **stateful**, but HTTP requests are **stateless**.

Problems encountered:
- Session resets on every request
- User inputs like `2*5000000` not parsed correctly
- Back / Exit logic (`0`, `00`) behaving inconsistently
- Edge cases causing unexpected session termination

### How I Solved It
- Introduced **Redis** as a session store with TTL
- Implemented an explicit **finite state machine**:
  - `START`
  - `AWAIT_AMOUNT`
- Normalized USSD input parsing using `text.split('*')`
- Carefully handled `Back` and `Exit` flows per state

**Lesson learned:**  
USSD is deceptively simple. Treat it like a protocol, not just input text.

---

## 4. Audit Logging vs Database Schema Drift

### The Challenge
While adding audit logging (`UssdAudit`), the backend crashed with:

```

The table `public.UssdAudit` does not exist

```

The Prisma client expected the model, but the database schema had not been migrated.

### How I Solved It
- Verified Prisma schema vs actual database tables
- Added the missing model
- Ran `prisma migrate dev` to sync schema
- Confirmed audit rows were being written correctly

**Lesson learned:**  
Schema drift is silent but deadly. Migrations are not optional.

---

## 5. Lisk Sepolia Gas & Token Confusion

### The Challenge
After receiving funds from faucet:
- Blockscout showed **0.1 LSK**
- MetaMask showed balance
- Foundry (`cast balance`) returned **0**

This caused deployment failures with:
```

insufficient funds for gas * price + value

```

### How I Solved It
- Learned that **Lisk Sepolia gas is paid in ETH**, not LSK
- Realized I had received tokens, but **no gas currency**
- Adjusted funding strategy accordingly
- Confirmed gas requirements via RPC and Foundry output

**Lesson learned:**  
Not all L2s use the same native gas semantics. Always verify what pays gas.

---

## 6. Smart Contract Verification on Blockscout

### The Challenge
Contract deployment succeeded, but verification repeatedly failed with:
- `Fail - Unable to verify`
- `missing field sources`
- Partial mismatches between compiler metadata

### How I Solved It
- Confirmed on-chain bytecode using `cast code`
- Identified that Blockscout requires **Standard JSON Input**
- Used Foundry’s `--show-standard-json-input`
- Uploaded the correct JSON via Blockscout’s UI
- Successfully achieved **Verified (Partial Match)** status

**Lesson learned:**  
Verification is not automatic. Tooling literacy matters as much as Solidity.

---

## Final Reflection

Most challenges in this project were not about writing code, but about:
- Tooling maturity
- Protocol understanding
- Infrastructure debugging
- Reading documentation carefully under time pressure

Overcoming these issues significantly strengthened both the technical robustness of TaniFi and my confidence as a builder.

```

# Strategic Fit Analysis  
## Why **TaniFi** Belongs in the **Lisk Ecosystem**

---

## 1. Direct Alignment with Lisk’s Core Vision

**Lisk Builders Challenge Round 3** is not a generic hackathon. It has a clear thesis focused on **High-Growth Markets**, **Real-World Assets (RWA)**, and **DePIN**.  
**TaniFi** was engineered *specifically* to answer this thesis.

| **Real-World Assets (RWA)** | We tokenize **Agricultural Commodities** (Coconut Sugar & Rice) and **Cooperative Invoices**. These assets are backed by **physical harvests and export contracts**, not speculation. | ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ (Perfect Match) |

## 2. Leveraging the Lisk Tech Stack (True Synergy)

TaniFi demonstrates how **Lisk Layer 2 (OP Stack)** enables solutions that were previously **impossible** on Layer 1 blockchains due to high cost and latency.

### A. Lisk L2 (OP Stack) & Ultra-Low Fees

**The Problem**  
Micro-financing for farmers often involves very small amounts (e.g., **$10 for fertilizer**).  
On Ethereum Mainnet, gas fees would consume most—or all—of the principal.

**The Lisk Solution**  
TaniFi relies on **Lisk’s Optimistic Rollup technology**, keeping gas fees **below $0.01**.  
This makes **high-frequency micro-transactions economically viable** for the first time.

---

### B. Superchain Interoperability

**The Vision**  
As part of the **Optimism Superchain**, TaniFi positions **Lisk as a Real-World Liquidity Hub**.

**Future Impact**
- Liquidity from other Superchain networks (e.g., **Base**, **Optimism**) can flow seamlessly into TaniFi.
- Global on-chain capital can directly fund **Indonesian farmers**.
- This proves the real power of **Superchain interoperability**, beyond DeFi speculation.

---

### C. Strategic Ecosystem Integrations

TaniFi integrates **native and strategic Lisk partners** to build a production-ready ecosystem:

- **IDRX (Rupiah Stablecoin)**

  - Eliminates FX risk for farmers

- **Gelato (Automation & RaaS)**

> Tokenizing Export Invoice for High-Yield Liquidity

![Solidity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Solidity-333333?style=flat-square) ![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

The $2.5 Trillion Invisible Crisis Global trade faces a massive liquidity gap. According to the ADB, there is a $2.5 Trillion trade finance gap, where banks reject 50% of MSME applications. In Indonesia alone, 65 million MSMEs are the backbone of the economy, yet only 25% have access to formal credit.

Why? The "Collateral Trap" Banks demand fixed assets (land/buildings) as collateral. However, exporters don’t have land titles; they have verified invoices from international buyers. Because banks refuse to recognize these invoices as sufficient collateral, exporters are trapped in 60-90 day payment terms, paralyzing their cash flow.

The Solution: VESSEL 

VESSEL is a hybrid Web2.5 platform built on Lisk that bridges this gap. We tokenize export invoices into Real World Assets (RWA), allowing retail investors to provide instant liquidity to exporters.

How it helps:
- For Exporters: Unlocks 80% of invoice value in <3 days (vs. months) without land collateral.
- For Investors: Provides access to 10-15% APY yields backed by real trade activities (non-speculative).
- For the Ecosystem: Uses Lisk’s blockchain for an immutable audit trail while handling settlement via compliant local fiat channels.

**Challenges we ran into**

1. The Steep Learning Curve of Trade Finance Coming from a technical background, our biggest hurdle was understanding the complex world of international trade. We had to deep-dive into Incoterms, Bills of Lading, and Letter of Credit mechanisms. Understanding how fraud happens in trade was crucial to designing our smart contract verification logic.

2. Bridging Blockchain with Strict Regulations The hardest technical-legal challenge was: "How do we connect Lisk to the real world without violating Indonesian financial laws?" Direct peer-to-peer crypto lending is restricted here. We couldn't just copy-paste a DeFi protocol.

The Solution: We engineered a "Two-Entity Model" (Web2.5). We separated the tech layer (Lisk for identity/audit trail) from the settlement layer. We utilize a legal Cooperative structure (Koperasi) for fiat funding and an Escrow mechanism for repayment. This allows us to use blockchain for transparency while keeping the money flow 100% compliant with local regulations.

3. Fiat-to-Chain Synchronization Ensuring that off-chain fiat transfers (IDR) trigger on-chain state changes (NFT status updates) required building a reliable oracle/listener service to prevent state mismatches between the bank account and the Lisk ledger.

**Winner Classification**

VESSEL fits the Winner Classification because we are not just building a dApp, we are building a sustainable Real World Asset (RWA) business that solves a critical economic problem in Southeast Asia.

1. Solving a Real Problem with Deep Passion Our team (SilaLabs) is obsessed with solving the financing deadlock for Indonesian MSMEs. We see a $60 Billion untapped market in non-oil exports that is currently underserved by traditional banks. We are building this because we believe DeFi should empower real businesses, not just crypto traders.

2. Clear & Sustainable Revenue Model Unlike many crypto projects that rely on token speculation, VESSEL has a proven business model:
- Origination Fee: We charge 1.0% - 1.5% per invoice financed.
- Yield Spread: We capture the difference between the borrower’s rate (e.g., 18%) and the investor’s yield (e.g., 15%).
- Scalability: With high LTV (exporters repeat every 3 months), we project healthy unit economics from Day 1.

3. Commitment to Lisk Mainnet We are committed to deploying VESSEL on the Lisk Mainnet in Q2 2026. Our roadmap includes establishing a legal Cooperative entity in Indonesia to ensure regulatory compliance, creating a safe path for mass adoption. We aim to be the first regulated RWA platform incubated on Lisk for the Southeast Asian market.

> web3 recycling platform

![Solidity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Solidity-333333?style=flat-square) ![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![PostgreSQL](https://img.shields.io/badge/PostgreSQL-333333?style=flat-square) ![React.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/React.js-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

**The Core Problem:** The global waste crisis isn't driven by a lack of awareness, but by a lack of immediate incentives and convenient infrastructure. Traditional waste recycling is often manual, opaque, and inconvenient ("recycling fatigue"), causing people to disengage because the effort feels unrewarding.

**How SiklusKu Solves It:** SiklusKu transforms waste management from a chore into a profitable, gamified, and transparent economy on the Lisk Sepolia Network. We make the task of recycling easier and safer by:

**♻️ Removing Friction with AI & Logistics:** Users no longer need to guess waste categories or haul trash manually. Our AI Smart Scan instantly identifies waste value, and our Eco-Truck Tracker provides "Uber-like" on-demand pickup services directly to the user's doorstep.

**💸 Providing Instant Financial Gratification:** Traditional waste banks have slow, manual payouts. SiklusKu leverages the Lisk Sepolia Blockchain to execute instant, trustless micropayments directly to the user's wallet the moment a pickup is verified.

**🎮 Gamifying Environmental Impact:** To solve low retention, we introduce social pressure and fun. Users earn XP to nurture a Virtual Eco-Garden and participate in Community Battles (e.g., Neighborhood vs. Neighborhood), turning sustainability into a competitive sport.

**🔍 Ensuring Radical Transparency:**Through our DAO Treasury, users can see exactly how platform fees are reinvested into real-world environmental projects, solving the "trust gap" in current charity/green initiatives.

**In short:** SiklusKu turns trash into a liquid digital asset, making saving the planet accessible, transparent, and financially rewarding for everyone.

**Challenges we ran into**

**🚧 Challenges I ran into**
Building a "Green Super App" that feels like a native mobile experience but runs on a decentralized network came with a unique set of headaches. Here are the biggest hurdles I faced and how I crushed them:

**1. The "Zero Latency" Paradox (Web3 vs. UX)**

The Problem: Blockchain transactions take time to finalize. If we required a wallet signature for every single action (like watering the virtual plant or adding 1 XP in Battle Mode), the app would feel sluggish and unusable. Users hate waiting.

The Solution: I engineered a Hybrid Architecture. I used Supabase & Local Storage for high-frequency interactions (Game XP, UI states, Garden updates) to keep the interface instant (0ms latency). I only trigger On-Chain Lisk Sepolia Transactions for critical financial events (Reward Payouts, DAO Voting). This gives us the speed of Web2 with the security of Web3.

**2. Integrating Three.js with React UI**

The Problem: To make the "Welcome Screen" stand out, I implemented a complex 3D floating line animation using Three.js. However, the 3D canvas initially hijacked all mouse events, making the "Get Started" buttons unclickable.

The Solution: I had to carefully manage CSS pointer-events. I set the background canvas to pointer-events: none to let clicks pass through, but re-enabled pointer-events: auto specifically for the buttons and interactive elements. It was a CSS layering nightmare, but the result is a silky-smooth, immersive entrance.

**3. Making the "Eco-Truck" Tracking Feel Real**

The Problem: Building a real-time backend for GPS tracking within a hackathon timeframe was overkill and risky.

The Solution: I used Leaflet with custom simulation logic. I created a state-based movement system that interpolates the truck's position between waypoints. This allows the judges to experience the "Uber-like" tracking flow smoothly during the demo without needing a fleet of actual trucks driving around outside.

**Winner Classification**

SiklusKu fits perfectly into this track because it bridges the gap between complex blockchain technology and everyday environmental action. We are not just building another DeFi protocol; we are building a **Real-World Application** that uses the Lisk Sepolia Network to solve a tangible problem: waste management.

By integrating **instant Lisk micropayments** for recycling and gamifying the experience with "Eco-Truck" tracking, we lower the barrier to entry for non-crypto natives. We demonstrate that Web3 can be fast, invisible, and immediately rewarding for the average citizen, driving true mass adoption.

> Understand failures. Before they page you.

![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![AI/ML](https://img.shields.io/badge/AI/ML-333333?style=flat-square) ![CLI](https://img.shields.io/badge/CLI-333333?style=flat-square) ![OpenRouter API](https://img.shields.io/badge/OpenRouter%20API-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

*[demo](https://youtu.be/ljWG0yz72O0) shows how this tool can debug and find interesting events within 10k lines of logs actively fetching log infos*

### Problem 
Production systems generate massive volumes of logs, but during incidents engineers struggle to quickly identify which errors actually matter. Logs are noisy, alerts lack context, and on-call engineers waste valuable time manually correlating errors, deploys, and system behavior. Existing tools report errors, but they don’t explain why an issue is important right now or where to begin debugging.
___

### Solution 
***StackOracle*** is an AI-assisted log debugging copilot that helps engineers quickly triage production issues.
___
#### what does it do?
- Detect behavioral anomalies in logs such as error spikes, new patterns, or degradations.
- Automatically prioritize critical issues using clear severity and signal strength.
- Correlate anomalies with recent deployments to surface likely causes.
- Provide human-readable explanations that tell engineers why the issue matters and where to look first.

By turning noisy logs into actionable debugging insight, StackOracle reduces time to triage, improves incident response, and lowers on-call fatigue without replacing existing observability tools.

**Challenges we ran into**

### 1. Designing Anomaly Detection That Works in Both Production and Demos
*Anomaly detection depends on historical baselines, but hackathon demos use very small log samples. This initially caused the system to correctly but confusingly report “No anomalies detected.”*
> *how i solved it?*
> I introduced an explicit demo mode that relaxes baseline thresholds while keeping the core detection logic unchanged, ensuring realistic behavior in production and meaningful results during demos.
___

### 2. Preventing AI From Becoming a Black Box
*Using AI directly for anomaly detection or confidence scoring made the system opaque and hard to justify.*
>*how i solved it?*
>I strictly separated responsibilities: deterministic logic handles detection and severity, while AI is used only for explanation. This kept the system explainable, testable, and trustworthy.
___

### 3, Extracting Signal from Noisy, High-Cardinality Logs
*Raw logs contain IDs, UUIDs, and variable values that create thousands of unique patterns and hide real issues.*
>*how i solved it?*
>I implemented log normalization, abstracting high-cardinality values into templates so the system could detect meaningful behavioral changes instead of individual log lines.

**AI TRACK**

StackOracle uses AI to transform detected log anomalies into ***actionable debugging insight***. While anomaly detection and severity are handled deterministically for reliability, AI is used to ***reason over context*** and generate human-readable explanations that tell engineers ***why an issue matters and where to start investigating***. This reduces cognitive load during incidents and enables faster, safer decision-making.

> overleaf but free

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Rust](https://img.shields.io/badge/Rust-333333?style=flat-square) ![Github Actions](https://img.shields.io/badge/Github%20Actions-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tauri](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tauri-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Students writing LaTeX run into these two problems:
1- Good tools like overleaf have very limited free tiers.
2- Free alternatives involve installing LaTeX locally which typically involves downloading massive 4GB+ distributions (like TeX Live), spending hours with package managers.
Our Solution:
I wanted to make it simple for people to write LaTeX.
With Tiya’s Standalone Edition, you download one lightweight file (~60MB), and you are ready to write.
It's free, minimal, offline and convenient for students and researchers.

**Challenges we ran into**

The biggest technical hurdle wasn't building the editor, it was making it work on everyone's computer (macOS, windows, linux).
Initially I was trying my Rust code to compile the entire PDF engine natively. But it was harder than expected, the engine relies on complex legacy C++ libraries (like harfbuzz and icu4c), and getting them on Windows, macOS, and Linux was really really hard.
Windows couldn't find the right C++ libraries no matter what I did to the environment. On Mac, GitHub Actions kept failing because the system libraries were too new for the compiler.
I switched to the "Sidecar Pattern," serving pre-made binary with the app itself, this shift saved the project. I didn't need to build the engine, I just needed to use it.

> Decentralized platform

![Solidity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Solidity-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Hardhat](https://img.shields.io/badge/Hardhat-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

What ProofSkill Solves:-
ProofSkill addresses the major trust and verification problems in the freelance and gig economy. In traditional platforms, anyone can claim to have skills or certifications without any real proof, making it risky for clients to hire someone and difficult for genuinely skilled workers to stand out. Resume fraud and fake credentials are widespread problems that waste everyone's time and money.

The platform solves this by using blockchain technology to create verifiable skill credentials as NFTs. When trusted organizations like universities or companies issue a credential, it becomes a permanent, unforgeable record on the blockchain that anyone can instantly verify. This means clients can hire with confidence, knowing the person they're hiring actually has the skills they claim, and skilled workers can prove their expertise without lengthy verification processes.

Another major problem is payment security. Freelancers often worry about doing work and not getting paid, while clients worry about paying upfront and getting poor quality work or nothing at all. ProofSkill uses smart contracts to hold payment in escrow automatically. The money is locked in the blockchain until the work is completed and approved, protecting both parties. This eliminates the need for trust between strangers and reduces disputes.

The platform also tackles the problem of platform control. On traditional freelance sites, your reputation, reviews, and credentials belong to the platform and can't be transferred elsewhere. If the platform changes its rules, increases fees, or even shuts down, you lose everything you've built. With ProofSkill, your credentials and reputation are stored in your own wallet, making them portable and permanent. You truly own your professional identity.

Finally, ProofSkill makes it easier and safer to find quality workers and get hired for quality work. The combination of verified credentials, transparent on-chain work history, and immutable ratings creates a system where merit actually matters. Clients save time by filtering for verified skills instead of sorting through hundreds of unverified profiles, and workers with real skills can command better rates because they can prove their expertise.

**Challenges we ran into**

Challenges I Ran Into:

File Corruption from Code Duplication:-
The biggest challenge was accidentally creating duplicate code in three critical pages. When trying to modernize the UI, my replacement operations appended new code instead of replacing the old code, leaving both versions in the file. This caused build failures with "Return statement is not allowed here" and "function defined multiple times" errors.

How I Solved It: I carefully identified where each proper function ended and removed all the duplicate loose code that appeared after the closing braces. The service detail page was especially problematic—a failed command had cleared it completely, requiring full restoration. I learned to verify file contents immediately after any programmatic modifications.

IPFS Buffer Breaking Edge Runtime:-
Next.js 14's edge runtime doesn't support Node.js Buffer API, but the IPFS client library needed it. This caused "Cannot find module './fetch.node'" errors during builds.

How I Solved It: I simplified the IPFS implementation to return mock data during development, maintaining the same interface. For production deployment, IPFS operations would need to move to API routes running in Node.js runtime rather than edge runtime.

Contract ABI Type Mismatches:-
The frontend was calling smart contract functions with wrong parameters—passing boolean values where strings were expected, or using function names that didn't exist in the ABI (like createJob instead of hireService).

How I Solved It: I read through the actual contract ABIs carefully to match parameters exactly. For example, mintCredential needed a metadata hash string, not a boolean flag. Aligning frontend calls precisely with the ABI definitions resolved all type errors.

The key lesson was making incremental changes with verification at each step. Attempting too many modifications at once made debugging extremely difficult. Building and testing after each change would have prevented most of these issues.

The final output is generated through learned model inference and weighted decision fusion, making AI the core engine of the product rather than just a supporting tool.

**The problem it solves**

### Real-Time Security Monitoring for DeFi Protocols

**The Challenge:** 
In DeFi, security incidents escalate within minutes. By the time teams notice unusual activity through block explorers or delayed alerts, attackers have already drained funds. Traditional monitoring solutions are either:
- Too slow (polling-based, 15-30 second delays)
- Too noisy (alert fatigue from false positives)
- Too expensive (enterprise-only SaaS solutions)

**Our Solution:**
EVM Event Watchdog provides **sub-second detection** of critical on-chain anomalies across multiple chains simultaneously:

✅ **For DeFi Protocol Teams**: Detect ownership transfers, infinite approvals, or sudden large withdrawals before exploits complete
✅ **For Security Researchers**: Monitor suspicious contracts in real-time during investigations
✅ **For Whale Watchers**: Track large token movements across Ethereum, Polygon, and Arbitrum
✅ **For Incident Response**: Get instant Telegram/Discord alerts during live attacks

**Real-World Impact:**
- Reduces incident detection time from **minutes to milliseconds**
- Prevents alert fatigue through intelligent deduplication
- Runs locally (no third-party data exposure)
- Zero-cost infrastructure (just your RPC endpoint)

**Use Cases:**
1. Treasury monitoring for DAOs (detect unauthorized withdrawals)
2. Smart contract honeypots (catch exploit attempts as they happen)
3. Multi-sig safety (alert on unexpected ownership changes)
4. CEX/DEX integration health checks (monitor critical transfer patterns)

**Challenges we ran into**

### Technical Hurdles & Solutions

#### 1. **WebSocket Stability Under Load**
**Problem:** Initial implementation would drop connections during high-throughput periods (e.g., NFT mints flooding the mempool).

**Solution:** 
- Implemented exponential backoff reconnection logic
- Decoupled event ingestion from processing using buffered channels
- Added connection health monitoring with automatic failover

#### 2. **TUI Rendering Performance**
**Problem:** The terminal UI would lag when processing 100+ events/second, making it unusable during network congestion.

**Solution:**
- Moved to atomic state management (`Arc<Mutex<T>>`) for lock-free reads
- Implemented aggressive event deduplication (collapse identical sequential events)
- Added render rate limiting (max 30 FPS) independent of ingestion rate
- Strict separation: logs to file, only critical alerts to TUI

#### 3. **Multi-Chain Timestamp Synchronization**
**Problem:** Events from different chains arrived out-of-order, making the timeline view confusing.

**Solution:**
- Used `Instant::now()` for arrival time (consistent across chains)
- Added chain identifiers with color coding
- Implemented per-chain filtering (Tab key) so users can isolate specific networks

#### 4. **Rate Limiting External Alerts**
**Problem:** Telegram/Discord webhooks have strict rate limits. During testing, we hit 429 errors and got temporarily banned.

**Solution:**
- Added token bucket rate limiter (max 1 alert/second, burst of 5)
- Implemented alert batching for similar events
- Added configurable cooldown periods per severity level

#### 5. **Testing Without Spamming Mainnet**
**Problem:** Needed to test TUI and alerts without waiting for real events or burning RPC credits.

**Solution:**
- Built `--simulate` mode that generates synthetic events
- Created reproducible test scenarios (ownership transfers, infinite approvals)
- Used simulation for live demo recording

**Biggest Lesson:** Building for production means optimizing for the worst case, not the happy path. Real-world blockchain monitoring requires handling connection failures, rate limits, and backpressure gracefully.

**The problem it solves**

The Problem It Solves

Road accidents caused by driver fatigue remain a major safety risk for both individuals and fleet-managed vehicles. Existing solutions are either reactive, hardware-dependent, or limited to high-end vehicles, offering no real-time alerts, location context, or accountability.

CHAUKAS makes driving safer and monitoring easier by enabling proactive, real-time safety intelligence using commonly available devices.

What People Can Use It For

Detect driver fatigue risk before accidents occur

Receive instant alerts with live location during critical situations

Enable faster emergency response for individuals and fleet operators

Maintain tamper-proof safety logs for audits and compliance

How It Improves Safety & Efficiency

Eliminates dependence on expensive in-vehicle hardware

Works for both individual drivers and companies

Provides real-time awareness instead of post-incident analysis

Ensures trust and accountability through blockchain-based event logging

Supports data-driven decisions for improving driver behavior and road safety

CHAUKAS transforms driver monitoring from a reactive system into a proactive safety platform.

**Challenges we ran into**

Challenges I Ran Into
Real-Time Detection vs Performance

Running continuous computer vision inference on live video caused performance drops and latency. This was addressed by optimizing frame sampling, reducing unnecessary computations, and balancing accuracy with real-time responsiveness.

Reliable Alert Triggering

Avoiding false positives while ensuring timely alerts was challenging. We implemented threshold-based validation and short temporal checks to ensure alerts are triggered only when consistent fatigue indicators are detected.

Accurate Location During Alerts

Synchronizing real-time drowsiness events with precise location data required careful API handling. Google Maps APIs were integrated to reliably capture and attach accurate location data at the exact moment an alert is generated.

Blockchain Integration Without Delay

Logging safety events on blockchain introduced latency concerns. To resolve this, blockchain writes were handled asynchronously so real-time alerts were not delayed while still maintaining immutable records.

Deployment Constraints

Camera access and blockchain node dependencies made full backend cloud deployment impractical. This was handled by deploying the frontend publicly and validating backend functionality through recorded end-to-end demos.

Each challenge helped refine the system into a more stable, scalable, and production-ready solution.

**The problem it solves**

# 🛡️ PhishZap: Real-Time AI/ML-Based Phishing Detection and Prevention System

## 📋 Problem Statement

Phishing attacks in India exploit widespread digital adoption through:
- **Spam SMS and malicious URLs** distributed via WhatsApp and other messaging platforms
- **Millions of victims annually** suffering credential theft and financial losses
- **Low user awareness** making people vulnerable to increasingly sophisticated scams

The urgent need for adaptive defenses and user education drives this solution.

---

## 🎯 What PhishZap Solves

### The Threat Landscape
Phishers target India's digital payment ecosystem by:
- Impersonating trusted apps (Google Pay, PhonePe) to steal UPI PINs, OTPs, and bank credentials
- Creating urgency to trick users into immediate action
- Causing instant fund transfers, account takeovers, and identity theft

### Our Solution
PhishZap provides real-time protection through AI/ML-powered detection, making digital transactions and communications safer for everyone.

---

## 💥 Key Features

### 🔍 **URL Checker** (Proprietary Model)
Instantly detects risky links in payment messages for safer UPI transactions.

### 📱 **Message Checker** (Proprietary Model)
Automatically flags spam texts during logins with zero user effort required.

### 🤖 **Zap Bot** (LLM-Powered)
Interactive chatbot providing quick tips to build scam awareness effortlessly.

### 📚 **Cyber Library**
Easy-to-follow guides for safe navigation of daily apps and digital services.

### 🚨 **Scam Report**
One-tap community alerts to speed up threat identification and protection.

---

## ✨ Why PhishZap is Better

- **Cost-Effective**: Proprietary AI models eliminate expensive third-party API dependencies
- **Real-Time Protection**: Instant analysis of URLs and messages during critical moments
- **User-Friendly**: Gamified environment and clean UI/UX enhance engagement
- **Minimal Effort**: Automated detection requires no technical knowledge
- **Community-Driven**: Shared threat intelligence strengthens protection for all users

---

## 👥 Team

- **Ayush Kumar**
- **Jayish**

**Challenges we ran into**

# 🔧 Challenges & Solutions

## 🚧 Major Hurdles Encountered

### 1. Frontend–AI Model Integration
**The Challenge:**
Integrating custom AI models with the frontend proved difficult due to:
- **API contract mismatches** between frontend requests and backend responses
- **Inconsistent data formatting** causing parsing errors
- **Unreliable real-time detection** leading to false negatives and delayed threat responses

This threatened the core functionality of instant phishing detection during critical user interactions.

---

### 2. Deployment Constraints
**The Challenge:**
Moving from development to production revealed critical issues:
- **Project size exceeded platform limits** (model files, dependencies)
- **Environment conflicts** between local development and cloud servers
- **Inconsistent runtime behavior** across different deployment platforms
- **Unstable builds** that worked locally but failed in production

---

## ✅ How We Overcame Them

### Model Optimization
**Solution:** Implemented **quantization techniques** to compress AI models:
- Reduced model size by ~60% without sacrificing accuracy
- Improved inference speed for real-time detection
- Made deployment feasible within platform constraints
- Maintained detection precision above 95%

---

### Lightweight API Bridges
**Solution:** Built custom **middleware layer** for seamless communication:
- Standardized data contracts between frontend and backend
- Implemented request/response validation and error handling
- Added retry logic for network failures
- Achieved <200ms average response time for URL/message checks

---

### Environment Standardization
**Solution:** Created **reproducible deployment pipeline**:
- Locked dependency versions across all environments
- Automated testing in staging environments before production
- Documented configuration requirements for each platform
- Conducted multiple deployment iterations to identify edge cases

---

## 🎯 Results

These solutions transformed our deployment from unstable to production-ready:
- ✅ **Stable, scalable phishing detection pipeline**
- ✅ **Consistent performance** across all platforms
- ✅ **Real-time threat detection** with minimal latency
- ✅ **Reproducible builds** for future updates

The trial-and-error process, while time-consuming, resulted in a robust system that reliably protects users from phishing threats.
