**The problem it solves**

Smart Kisan Mitra tackles the real challenges that keep Indian farmers struggling—bringing practical solutions that directly impact their income and quality of life.
Stop Crop Losses Before They Happen: When a farmer notices yellow spots on their wheat or strange marks on their tomatoes, waiting days for an expert's visit can mean losing an entire crop. Our Disease Diagnosis tool lets farmers snap a photo and get instant answers about what's wrong and how to treat it. It's like having an agricultural expert in their pocket, available 24/7.
Know Your Crop's True Worth: Too many farmers sell their produce without knowing they could have gotten ₹500 more per quintal at the next mandi. Our Crop Rates feature shows live prices from nearby markets, so farmers can choose where to sell and negotiate confidently. Knowledge is power, and in this case, it's also money in the bank.
Claim What's Rightfully Yours: The government launches schemes worth thousands of crores for farmers, but most never reach the people who need them. Our Schemes section brings all these opportunities—subsidies, insurance, loans—into one simple place. No more missing out on financial support that could transform a farming season.
Sell Direct, Earn More: Why give 20-30% to middlemen when you can connect directly with buyers? Our Marketplace lets farmers negotiate deals from their homes, get better prices, and receive payments faster. It's fair trade made simple.
Farm Smarter, Not Harder: Every piece of land is different, and what works in Punjab might not work in Maharashtra. Our AI Farming Assistant creates personalized farming plans based on local conditions, suggesting the best crops, optimal planting times, and strategies to maximize profit. It's like having a seasoned farming consultant design a success roadmap specifically for you.
Help When You Need It Most: During emergencies—whether it's a sudden pest attack, natural disaster, or urgent need for government assistance—our Emergency Helpline section puts critical phone numbers right at farmers' fingertips. Because sometimes, immediate human support makes all the difference.
The Bottom Line: Smart Kisan Mitra isn't just another app—it's a complete farming partner that helps increase income, reduce losses, and make better decisions. We're bridging the gap between technology and agriculture, ensuring that Indian farmers have the same advantages as any modern business owner. Because farming isn't just a livelihood; it's the backbone of our nation, and farmers deserve tools that respect their expertise while amplifying their success.

**Challenges we ran into**

Building Smart Kisan Mitra was an incredible learning journey filled with technical hurdles and real-world challenges that tested my problem-solving abilities.
AI Image Recognition for Crop Diseases: Getting the disease diagnosis feature to work accurately was incredibly challenging. Training the model to differentiate between similar-looking diseases, handling poor lighting conditions in field photos, and ensuring it worked across different crop varieties required extensive dataset preparation and model fine-tuning. I also had to figure out how to compress images for faster processing without losing diagnostic accuracy.
Real-Time Mandi Price Integration: Aggregating live crop rates from multiple mandis was tougher than expected. Different mandis report prices in different formats, update at different times, and some don't have digital APIs. I had to implement web scraping, handle inconsistent data formats, and create fallback mechanisms when certain sources went offline. Keeping the data fresh while managing API rate limits required smart caching strategies.
Building a Secure Marketplace: Creating a platform where farmers and buyers could transact safely involved implementing authentication, preventing fraud, and building trust features. I had to think about payment verification, user ratings, and dispute resolution—challenges I hadn't anticipated when I started.
AI Recommendation System Complexity: Making the farming roadmap truly useful meant the AI needed to consider soil type, local climate, water availability, market demand, and seasonal patterns simultaneously. Crafting prompts that could generate practical, location-specific advice rather than generic suggestions took numerous iterations and testing with real farming scenarios.
Performance on Free Hosting: Deploying on Render's free tier meant dealing with cold starts that could take 30-50 seconds. For farmers in rural areas with limited patience for tech, this was a major UX concern. I implemented loading messages and optimized the backend, but it taught me hard lessons about balancing cost and performance.
Making It Actually Usable for Farmers: The biggest challenge wasn't technical—it was designing for users with varying digital literacy. What seemed intuitive to me wasn't always clear to end users. I learned to simplify navigation, use more visual elements, and reduce the number of steps needed to accomplish tasks. Testing with real farmers would have been invaluable.
Data Accuracy and Reliability: Ensuring that the disease recommendations, government schemes information, and helpline numbers were current and accurate carried real responsibility. Wrong medical advice could harm crops; outdated scheme information could waste farmers' time. This pushed me to implement regular data validation and update mechanisms.
These challenges taught me that building for real users with real problems requires more than just coding skills—it demands empathy, persistence, and a willingness to iterate based on actual needs rather than assumptions.

![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![SQLite](https://img.shields.io/badge/SQLite-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![AI/ML](https://img.shields.io/badge/AI/ML-333333?style=flat-square) ![FastAPI](https://img.shields.io/badge/FastAPI-333333?style=flat-square) ![gemini](https://img.shields.io/badge/gemini-333333?style=flat-square) ![AIAGent](https://img.shields.io/badge/AIAGent-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

# The problem it solves
As student developers, we face a constant struggle: context switching kills productivity. We're learning React, then we need to Google an error. We're debugging FastAPI backend, then we jump to Stack Overflow. We're building a project, then we switch to ChatGPT to ask a question. By the time we're back in our code editor, we've lost our flow state.
Bob is the bridge that eliminates this friction.
# What all Bob can do
For Developers;
- Insighful debugging: Based on the error, the agent will switch from stackoverflow, open github discussions or search web to find the best solution ( with context )
- README generation: Bob scans your repository structure, detects your tech stack, and writes a professional README with proper badges, installation steps, and documentation.
- Code snippet management: Save and search code patterns with clean descriptions, kinda your personal Stack Overflow.
- GitHub workflow: Bob can create issues, list repos, validate projects,all without leaving a conversation.
- Project validation: "Is my project good enough for this hackathon?" Bob analyzes your GitHub repo, compares it to similar projects, and gives you a scored report with specific improvements

For students personal use:
- Voice-first learning: Ask questions while your hands stay on the keyboard. No more breaking focus to type into a search bar
- YouTube note-taking: Watching a tutorial? Bob extracts transcripts and creates structured notes automatically. Never pause to take notes again.
- Email automation: Send email to anyone without remembering their address. Bob has alias where you can set nick names.
- Discord integration: Bob can share whatever you say to your discord channel.
- Task management: Ask bob to add a tasks, and he will remember it forever so that you don't have to.
- Conversation history: Nothing is lost , you can see all your previous interaction in the history.

# The Bigger Picture: Education Meets Development
Bob isn't just a tool, it's a learning accelerator for the current student developers.
We're not replacing Stack Overflow, GitHub, or YouTube. We're making them accessible without breaking your flow.
That's the problem Bob solves. And that's why student developers will choose Bob over generic AI assistants.

**Challenges we ran into**

Most of the challenges was from the agentic part. mainly on the emails sending part where we have to send email without actually asking the user for the address, this feature had to deal with multiple other elements eventually taking time. Also the backend+frontend integration took time.

**AI TRACK**

Bob is implemented as an agent-based AI system that performs intent detection, contextual reasoning, and tool selection as part of its core execution flow.

**Open Innovation**

Bob addresses a real and widely faced problem among student developers, loss of productivity due to fragmented tools and constant context switching. Rather than replacing existing platforms, Bob innovates by connecting them into a single, seamless experience. This open and integrative approach allows Bob to evolve with new tools, workflows, and user needs, making it adaptable across different domains, institutions, and communities. The solution encourages accessibility, extensibility, and collaboration, aligning strongly with the principles of open innovation.

### EduSafe
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/edusafe-ebb2) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/angelabera/EduSafe-Dropout-Identification) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://edu-safe-gamma.vercel.app/) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-HackFiesta-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hackfiesta.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-1-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Detect dropout risk before it’s too late.

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS Animation](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS%20Animation-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Educational institutions often identify struggling students too late—usually after term-end results expose failures. By this stage, many students have already disengaged academically or emotionally, making recovery difficult.

Although early warning signs such as falling attendance, declining assessment scores, and repeated attempts in subjects exist weeks in advance, this data is typically scattered across multiple spreadsheets and systems. As a result, mentors and counsellors lack a single, timely view to recognize when a student is slipping across multiple dimensions at once.

Commercial analytics platforms promise predictive insights but are often costly, complex, and opaque, making them impractical for public institutions and smaller colleges.

**Challenges we ran into**

**1. Merging Data from Multiple CSV Sources**

One of the first challenges was combining attendance, assessment, and academic attempt data that existed in separate CSV files with different structures. Inconsistent column names and missing entries made direct merging unreliable.

How I solved it:
I standardized all datasets using a common *StudentID*, validated records during upload, and handled missing values gracefully by applying safe defaults. This ensured that incomplete data did not break the system while still contributing meaningfully to risk analysis.

**2. Designing a Risk Model **

Another challenge was balancing the requirement for an “AI-based” system while avoiding complex machine learning models that would be hard to explain or trust in an educational setting.

How I solved it:
I implemented a transparent, rule-based risk scoring system that assigns weights to observable indicators such as attendance drops and declining scores. This approach maintained explainability, allowed mentors to understand why a student was flagged, and aligned with ethical AI principles.


**3. Maintaining Performance with Animated UI Elements
**
Integrating an animated SVG background into the hero section introduced performance concerns, especially for lower-end devices.

How I solved it:
I chose lightweight SVG-based animations instead of JavaScript-heavy effects and layered them carefully behind content using CSS positioning. This kept the interface visually engaging without impacting responsiveness or load times.

[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/kisanmitra-dfa1) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/rohandey2004/Kisan-Mitra) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-HackFiesta-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hackfiesta.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-1-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Guiding Farmers, Growing Futures

![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Firebase](https://img.shields.io/badge/Firebase-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flutter](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flutter-333333?style=flat-square) ![Natural language processing (NLP)](https://img.shields.io/badge/Natural%20language%20processing%20(NLP)-333333?style=flat-square) ![Computer Vision](https://img.shields.io/badge/Computer%20Vision-333333?style=flat-square) ![Azure Speech-to-text](https://img.shields.io/badge/Azure%20Speech--to--text-333333?style=flat-square) ![Google Cloud Platform (GCP)](https://img.shields.io/badge/Google%20Cloud%20Platform%20(GCP)-333333?style=flat-square) ![AI/ML](https://img.shields.io/badge/AI/ML-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Kisan-Mitra solves the problem of farmers having limited access to timely, reliable, and localized agricultural guidance, which often leads to poor crop decisions, lower yields, and financial losses. Farmers can use Kisan-Mitra as a digital farming companion to receive personalized advice on crop selection, sowing, irrigation, fertilizer use, and pest or disease management based on their location, soil conditions, crop stage, and real-time weather data. The app makes farming tasks easier and safer by replacing guesswork and informal advice with AI-driven, scientific recommendations, providing early weather alerts and pest detection to reduce crop damage, and offering market price insights to help farmers sell their produce at the right time. With multilingual and voice-based interaction, simple dashboards, reminders, and offline support, Kisan-Mitra ensures that even farmers with low digital literacy or limited internet access can make better decisions, reduce input costs, increase productivity, and improve overall farm income in a practical and user-friendly way.

**Challenges we ran into**

While making Kisan-Mitra, one of the key challenges we are facing is working with inconsistent and incomplete data coming from multiple sources such as weather APIs, market price feeds, and varied user inputs, which can affect the accuracy of recommendations. We are also dealing with the challenge of designing the app for farmers with low digital literacy, especially while implementing multilingual and voice-based interactions that work reliably across different accents, languages, and background noise. To overcome these hurdles, we are implementing strong data validation, fallback mechanisms, and offline caching to ensure the app remains functional even with poor connectivity. We are continuously simplifying the user interface based on testing, adding confirmation steps for voice inputs, and refining logic through iterative development and team collaboration. These ongoing improvements are helping us make the system more reliable, accessible, and practical for real-world farming conditions.

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![SQL](https://img.shields.io/badge/SQL-333333?style=flat-square) ![PostgreSQL](https://img.shields.io/badge/PostgreSQL-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![AI/ML](https://img.shields.io/badge/AI/ML-333333?style=flat-square) ![Supabase](https://img.shields.io/badge/Supabase-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

**The Silent Loss of Family Wisdom**

Every generation carries invaluable knowledge life lessons, mistakes, values, stories, traditions, and emotional experiences.
Yet most of this wisdom is never preserved.

It fades due to:

Busy lives and growing generational gaps

Conversations that are “meant for later”

Memories scattered across phones, chats, and notebooks

The absence of a structured, private place to store personal history

When a person is gone, their experiences go with them — leaving future generations without guidance rooted in real family context.

**What LegacyAI Does**

LegacyAI is a private digital time capsule for families.

It allows parents and grandparents to:

Record life experiences, lessons, and stories in their own words

Securely store them in a personal family vault

Preserve wisdom not just as text, but as contextual knowledge

For children and future generations, LegacyAI becomes:

A trusted source of family wisdom

A way to ask life questions and receive answers grounded in real experiences

A bridge between generations that time alone cannot break

How It Makes Life Easier & Safer
1️⃣ Centralized & Secure Knowledge Storage

Instead of scattered notes, messages, or lost recordings, LegacyAI provides:

A single, structured vault

Secure authentication and private access

Data ownership that stays with the family

This eliminates the chaos of fragmented memory storage.

2️⃣ Wisdom That Can Be Interacted With

LegacyAI doesn’t just store memories — it understands them.

Using AI:

Family members can ask natural questions like
“What advice did my parents give about career decisions?”

The AI responds only using stored family memories, not generic internet advice

This transforms passive records into living guidance.

3️⃣ Time-Aware Access

Some lessons are meaningful only at the right stage of life.

LegacyAI enables:

Controlled access to memories

Unlocking wisdom based on age or life milestones

Preventing sensitive knowledge from being accessed too early

This makes legacy sharing intentional and responsible.

4️⃣ Reduces Emotional & Cognitive Burden

Instead of:

Remembering everything

Repeating the same advice

Worrying that wisdom will be forgotten

Families can:

Record once

Trust that their voice will reach future generations

Focus on living, not preserving manually

**Why It’s Safer Than Existing Alternatives**

Unlike social media, note apps, or cloud drives:

❌ No public feeds

❌ No ads

❌ No data used for training or monetization

LegacyAI is:

Private by design

Family-owned

Context-aware, not attention-driven

**The Bigger Impact**

LegacyAI doesn’t just solve a technical problem it solves a human one.

It ensures that:

Wisdom doesn’t die with time

Families stay connected beyond generations

Advice comes from lived experience, not algorithms alone

It preserves what truly matters  not for today, but forever.

**AI TRACK**

LegacyAI fits naturally into the AI track because Artificial Intelligence is the core engine that gives the product its value. Instead of acting as a simple storage or note-taking system, LegacyAI uses AI to understand, reason over, and respond to human life experiences stored inside a private family vault. Users can ask questions in natural language, and the AI retrieves the most relevant family memories and lessons, then generates responses grounded strictly in that personal data rather than generic internet knowledge. This Retrieval-Augmented Generation approach makes the system accurate, contextual, and deeply personalized while minimizing hallucinations. The AI is designed with a human-centered and ethical focus, operating within clear boundaries, respecting privacy, and never training on or sharing user data. By transforming unstructured human memories into an intelligent, interactive source of guidance, LegacyAI demonstrates how AI can preserve human wisdom, provide meaningful long-term impact, and extend knowledge across generations making it a strong and purposeful entry in the AI track.

**Open Innovation**

LegacyAI fits into the Open Innovation task by reimagining how technology can solve a deeply human and universally relevant problem the loss of generational knowledge and wisdom in a way that cuts across domains, cultures, and use cases. Rather than targeting a narrow industry or predefined problem statement, the project introduces a new paradigm for preserving and interacting with human experiences using modern AI. It combines ideas from digital archiving, privacy-first data ownership, conversational AI, and long-term knowledge preservation to create a solution that does not exist in traditional systems today. LegacyAI is flexible and extensible by design, meaning it can evolve beyond families into areas like mentorship, education, cultural preservation, or community knowledge sharing. This openness to adaptation, along with its novel application of AI for long-term societal impact, aligns strongly with the spirit of Open Innovation where creativity, cross-domain thinking, and original problem-solving are valued over conventional or single-track solutions.

[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/explainmyrepo-9cb2) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/Alpha-778/explain_my_repo) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://explain-my-repo.vercel.app/) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-HackFiesta-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hackfiesta.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-1-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Understand any GitHub repo in under a minute.

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![Request Network](https://img.shields.io/badge/Request%20Network-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Gunicorn](https://img.shields.io/badge/Gunicorn-333333?style=flat-square) ![Vercel](https://img.shields.io/badge/Vercel-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Recruiters and non-technical reviewers often struggle to understand GitHub repositories quickly. Opening a repo usually means scanning unfamiliar folder structures, configuration files, and long READMEs, which is time-consuming and error-prone. As a result, good projects can be misunderstood or overlooked simply because their intent and tech stack are not immediately clear.

Explain My Code for Recruiters solves this by turning a GitHub repository into a clear, recruiter-friendly explanation. By pasting a public GitHub link, users instantly get a structured summary of what the project does, what technologies it uses, and how it is architected — all in simple, non-technical language.

This makes it easier to:

- Review candidate projects faster

- Understand unfamiliar tech stacks

- Prepare interview discussions

- Add clear project descriptions to CVs or portfolios

**Challenges we ran into**

One major challenge was working with rapidly changing Gemini APIs and model availability. Some models were deprecated, others had region-based restrictions, and certain models hit quota limits unexpectedly. This caused multiple errors like invalid model names and exhausted token limits during development.

I solved this by:
- Switching to the latest supported google-genai SDK
- Dynamically listing available models instead of hardcoding assumptions
- Choosing stable, quota-friendly models (gemini-pro-latest) for reliability
- Adding fallbacks and clear error handling when API limits are hit

Another challenge was extracting meaningful information from diverse repositories without deep static code analysis. I addressed this by focusing on high-signal files like READMEs, dependency files, and folder structure, and by carefully constraining the LLM prompt to avoid hallucinations.

**AI TRACK**

Explain My Code for Recruiters fits the CodeCrafters track because it is fundamentally about building a well-crafted developer tool that turns complex technical artifacts into clear, usable insights. The project combines backend engineering, API integration, and careful prompt design to reliably analyze real-world GitHub repositories and extract meaningful structure from them.

Rather than relying on superficial summaries, the system thoughtfully selects high-signal files such as dependency manifests, READMEs, and folder hierarchies, and processes them through a constrained LLM workflow to produce accurate, consistent explanations. Emphasis was placed on clean architecture, minimal dependencies, robust error handling, and predictable outputs, making the tool stable and easy to extend.

The project showcases craftsmanship through deliberate scope control, clean code organization, and an engineering-first approach to solving a real developer pain point, which aligns strongly with the goals of the CodeCrafters track.

**Open Innovation**

Explain My Code for Recruiters fits the Lovable track because it focuses on reducing frustration and cognitive load for both recruiters and developers during the hiring and review process. Reviewing GitHub repositories can often feel overwhelming, especially for non-technical or semi-technical reviewers who are not familiar with complex folder structures or modern tech stacks. This project transforms that confusing experience into a clear, approachable, and even reassuring one.

By converting raw code and repository metadata into simple, structured explanations, the platform makes technical work feel more accessible and less intimidating. It helps recruiters feel confident in understanding projects, and it helps developers feel seen and fairly evaluated for the work they’ve built. The result is a more human, empathetic interaction between people and code, which aligns strongly with the spirit of the Lovable track.

[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/findit-f67e) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://lostlink-1.web.app) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-HackFiesta-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hackfiesta.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-1-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Helping students find lost items on campus

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

In shared environments such as colleges, hostels, hotels, residential societies, or city-level public spaces, people frequently lose personal belongings. Currently, the recovery process often depends on informal methods such as WhatsApp groups, word of mouth, or physical notice boards. These approaches are scattered across multiple platforms and lack structure, making the recovery process time-consuming and unreliable.

This project provides a centralized, web-based lost and found system where users can post lost or found items based on a selected location or community. By filtering items according to specific areas—such as a campus, building, or locality—users can quickly access relevant information without unnecessary clutter.

The system reduces manual effort, improves organization, and increases the chances of safe item recovery by directly connecting the owner with the finder. While initially developed for a college environment, the same approach can be extended to hotels, residential complexes, corporate offices, or city-level implementations.

This project was built for a college use case as a starting point, but the system is designed to scale and adapt to any closed community or location-based environment.

**Challenges we ran into**

One of the main challenges was displaying complete item details after a user clicked on a post. Since item data was stored in the database, passing the correct post information between pages and fetching the relevant data dynamically required careful handling. This was resolved by passing the post identifier through the URL and using it to retrieve and display the correct item details from the database.

Another major challenge was sending the correct information to the notifications section. When someone submitted a “found item” report, the system needed to notify only the original owner and display the associated item and finder details accurately. This required structuring the database so that each found report was linked to the corresponding post and owner. By filtering notifications based on the logged-in user’s ID, relevant notifications were shown correctly.

These challenges helped improve the overall data structure and logic of the application, making the system more reliable and scalable.

**Open Innovation**

This project addresses a real-world problem using a simple yet effective web-based approach. It focuses on improving the lost-and-found process in shared communities by introducing a centralized, location-based system that is easy to use and accessible to everyone.

The solution does not rely on complex or specialized technologies; instead, it demonstrates how core web technologies can be innovatively applied to solve everyday coordination problems. Its design allows the system to start within a small environment, such as a college, and scale to other communities like hostels, hotels, or residential societies.

By emphasizing practical impact, usability, and scalability, the project aligns well with the Open Innovation track, which encourages creative and flexible solutions to real-world challenges.

**The problem it solves**

**The problem it solves**

- Most people fail at goals due to **lack of consistency and discipline**, not motivation.
- Traditional productivity apps only **list tasks**; they don’t enforce follow-through.
- Progress is often **invisible**, making users feel stuck and unrewarded.
- There is no structured way to **track effort, growth, and accountability over time**.
- Skipping tasks usually has **no real consequence**, leading to habit drop-off.

**How it helps / What people use it for**

- Converts goals and tasks into a **system-driven progression model**, not just reminders.
- Organizes tasks as **quests** with clear structure and outcomes.
- Uses **XP, levels, and ranks** to make progress visible and measurable.
- Applies **penalty rules** (XP locks, streak resets, reductions) to enforce discipline.
- Encourages long-term consistency through **rules and structure**, not motivation.
- Designed for future upgrades:
  - **AI-assisted task evaluation and XP assignment**
  - **Advanced analytics and smart insights**
  - **FORGE physical training subsystem** (planned, locked for now)
- Makes self-improvement feel **serious, accountable, and rewarding**, like a progression system applied to real life.

**In short:**  
This app turns self-improvement into a **controlled, rule-based system** where progress is **earned**, discipline is **enforced**, and growth is **clearly visible**—with strong foundations for powerful future upgrades.

**Challenges we ran into**

**Challenges I ran into**

- **Balancing gamification with productivity**
  - Early versions felt too much like a game.
  - Risk: users focusing on XP instead of real work.
  - Fixed by making **AI control XP**, not the user.
  - Progress is earned only through meaningful tasks.

- **Designing a fair XP deduction system**
  - Penalizing users too hard caused frustration.
  - Penalizing too little reduced accountability.
  - Solved by introducing **priority-based XP (50/30/10)**.
  - This kept the system strict but fair.

- **Avoiding fake or demo data**
  - Many UI builders auto-fill demo content.
  - This reduced realism and hackathon credibility.
  - Solved by explicitly enforcing **no demo data anywhere**.
  - UI now depends fully on real user input.

- **Calendar + recurring task complexity**
  - Daily tasks across multiple dates were hard to visualize.
  - Risk of duplicate or lost records.
  - Solved by a **date-based quest calendar system**.
  - Each day stores its own task history cleanly.

- **Maintaining a consistent dark theme**
  - Adding new sections broke visual consistency.
  - Especially for Auth and Profile pages.
  - Fixed by defining a **single global design system**.
  - Same typography, colors, and UI behavior everywhere.

- **Preventing feature overload**
  - Too many ideas reduced clarity.
  - Hackathon apps must stay focused.
  - Solved by prioritizing **core discipline mechanics** only.

**Outcome**

- Each challenge improved the system’s **fairness, realism, and usability**.
- The final product feels **intentional, controlled, and scalable**.
- Problems directly shaped the app into a stronger solution.

**The problem it solves**

Many undergraduate students and first time researchers struggle with writing research papers, not because they lack ideas, but because they don’t yet know how to find relevant literature, evaluate originality, or structure strong academic arguments. We built an AI research assistant specifically to support students at this early stage of research writing. It helps them discover semantically relevant papers, evaluates their drafts across key research dimensions such as novelty, coherence, alignment, and relevance, and provides specific, learning-focused feedback like identifying unsupported claims or weak connections to the research problem. Rather than generating content to copy, the system acts as a guided mentor, helping students understand existing literature, improve their writing skills with each iteration, and build confidence in producing, original and high quality research work.

**Challenges we ran into**

We tackled CORS issues for backend-frontend connection, managed information overload with smart UI design, and transformed complex AI metrics into simple feedback (all within a 24-hour deadline.) Our breakthrough was realizing papers are tools, not goals, so we built a writing mentor that improves research quality, not just finds references.

> Mapping what cities never stop saying.

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

**WHAT WE SOLVE**

Pollution is invisible — yet it causes heart disease, sleep disorders, stress, and permanent hearing loss.

1.No real-time noise maps exist the way air or traffic maps

2.Cities lack regional-scale (100–200 km) acoustic data to plan healthy urban spaces.

3.Home buyers and renters have no way to judge long-term noise exposure before choosing a location.

4.Hospitals, schools, and parks are often built in high-noise zones unknowingly.

5.Doctors treat hearing issues but lack environmental data to identify noise as the root cause.

6.Governments rely on manual complaints, not data-driven sound analytics.

7.Citizens have no simple tool to report or visualize neighborhood noise levels.

**Challenges we ran into**

1.**Lack of existing open noise datasets**: Unlike air pollution, real-time regional noise data is not publicly available, so we had to simulate large-scale acoustic patterns.

2.**Browser limitations on microphone accuracy**: Web-based audio capture varies by device and environment, requiring careful normalization of FFT-based sound analysis.

3.**Real-time heatmap rendering at regional scale**: Visualizing dense acoustic data over a 200 km radius without performance drops was technically challenging.

4.**Precise location handling**: GPS accuracy differs across devices, especially indoors, affecting exact noise positioning.

5.**No public-access medical & housing databases:
**
i) Verified ENT doctor listings

ii) Authentic housing and real-estate noise data
require platform-level access, permissions, and partnerships.

**Compliance & privacy constraints**: Handling health-related and location-based data demands strict legal and ethical compliance.

**Ethereum Track**

1.**Tamper-proof data**: Noise data hashes can be stored on Ethereum to ensure authenticity and prevent manipulation.

2.**Transparent citizen reporting**: Public noise complaints recorded via smart contracts for accountability.

3.**Incentive mechanism**: Smart contracts reward users for contributing valid noise data.

4.**Verified quiet-zone certification**: Low-noise areas and housing complexes can receive on-chain, non-forgeable certifications.

5.**Ethical monetization**: Advertisements and partnerships handled transparently through smart contracts.

6.**Public infrastructure support** Governments and NGOs can rely on verifiable data for urban planning

**AI TRACK**

1.**Intelligent Sound Analysis**
AI processes environmental audio data to understand sound behavior, not just raw loudness.

2.**FFT-Based Feature Extraction**
Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) converts raw microphone input into frequency-domain features that AI can analyze effectively.

3.**Predictive Heatmap Generation**
AI estimates sound intensity across surrounding regions (up to 200 km), even where no sensors exist.

4.**Pattern Recognition & Noise Classification**
AI identifies dominant noise patterns and differentiates between quiet, moderate, and high-risk acoustic zones.

5.**Anomaly Detection**
AI detects unusual sound spikes that may indicate hazards, infrastructure issues, or public disturbances.

6.**Health Risk Assessment Logic**
AI evaluates prolonged exposure levels to flag potential hearing risk areas.

7.**Scalable Learning Architecture**
The system is designed to improve accuracy as more real-world data is collected post-launch.

8.**Decision-Support Intelligence**
AI-powered insights help citizens, doctors, and governments make informed decisions.

### Liquefaction Alert System
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/liquefaction-alert-system-8a4a) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/igun997/soil-liquefaction-alerts) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://soil-liquefaction-alerts.onrender.com) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-HackFiesta-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hackfiesta.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-1-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> I think we need this to check disaster

![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

### Why This Matters

Soil liquefaction is a devastating phenomenon where saturated soil loses its strength during earthquake shaking, causing the ground to behave like a liquid. This can lead to:

- **Building collapse and foundation failures** - structures sink or tilt as the ground loses bearing capacity
- **Infrastructure damage** - roads crack, pipelines rupture, bridges fail
- **Loss of life** - particularly in densely populated areas with poor soil conditions
- **Massive economic losses** - billions of dollars in damage from a single event

Historical disasters like the 1964 Niigata earthquake (Japan), 1999 Chi-Chi earthquake (Taiwan), and 2011 Christchurch earthquake (New Zealand) caused catastrophic liquefaction damage that could have been mitigated with proper risk assessment.

### How This System Helps

1. **Democratizes Access to Geotechnical Analysis**
   - Professional liquefaction assessments typically cost $10,000-$50,000+ and require specialized consultants
   - This tool provides instant preliminary risk screening for any location worldwide at no cost
   - Empowers engineers, urban planners, and property developers to make informed decisions

2. **Real-Time Risk Awareness**
   - Fetches live earthquake data from USGS to show recent seismic activity
   - Integrates current weather and groundwater conditions that affect liquefaction susceptibility
   - Provides actionable alerts when conditions indicate elevated risk

3. **Scientific Rigor with Accessibility**
   - Implements the industry-standard **Boulanger & Idriss (2014)** methodology used by professional geotechnical engineers
   - Supports both SPT (Standard Penetration Test) and CPT (Cone Penetration Test) based analysis
   - Calculates Liquefaction Potential Index (LPI) for comprehensive site assessment

4. **Multi-Source Data Integration**
   - **USGS Earthquake API** - Real-time seismic event monitoring
   - **OpenTopography** - High-resolution terrain and elevation data
   - **OpenWeatherMap** - Current weather conditions affecting soil saturation
   - **Google Earth Engine** - Land cover classification for soil type estimation

### Use Cases

- **Construction Planning**: Assess liquefaction risk before purchasing land or designing foundations
- **Urban Development**: Identify high-risk zones for zoning regulations and building codes
- **Emergency Preparedness**: Understand which areas are most vulnerable during earthquakes
- **Insurance Assessment**: Evaluate seismic risk for property underwriting
- **Educational Tool**: Learn about liquefaction mechanics and geotechnical engineering principles

---

**Challenges we ran into**

### 1. Complex Geotechnical Calculations

**The Problem:**
Implementing the Boulanger & Idriss (2014) simplified procedure required understanding deeply nested geotechnical formulas with multiple correction factors (CN, CE, CB, CR, CS for SPT; stress-dependent normalization for CPT).

**How I Solved It:**
- Studied the original research papers and EERI monographs thoroughly
- Broke down the calculation into discrete, testable functions (`calculate_rd`, `calculate_csr`, `calculate_msf`, `calculate_k_sigma`)
- Created dataclasses (`StressState`, `LayerResult`) to track intermediate values through the calculation chain
- Implemented comprehensive docstrings referencing specific equations from the literature

```python
# Example: The CRR calculation follows Equation 4 from Boulanger & Idriss (2014)
crr = math.exp(
    n / 14.1
    + (n / 126) ** 2
    - (n / 23.6) ** 3
    + (n / 25.4) ** 4
    - 2.8
)
```

### 2. Integrating Multiple External APIs

**The Problem:**
The system needs to fetch data from 4+ external services (USGS, OpenTopography, OpenWeatherMap, Earth Engine), each with different authentication methods, rate limits, and response formats.

**How I Solved It:**
- Created dedicated service classes for each API with consistent interfaces
- Implemented async HTTP clients using `httpx` and `aiohttp` for non-blocking requests
- Added robust error handling with graceful fallbacks when services are unavailable
- Used Pydantic models to validate and normalize responses from different APIs

### 3. Handling Missing or Incomplete Data

**The Problem:**
Real-world analysis often lacks complete soil profile data. Users may only have partial SPT/CPT data, unknown groundwater depth, or estimated soil properties.

**How I Solved It:**
- Implemented sensible defaults based on typical soil conditions
- Created "quick analysis" mode that estimates soil parameters from terrain and land cover data
- Used the Soil Behavior Type Index (Ic) from CPT to estimate fines content when lab data is unavailable
- Added clear documentation about assumptions and limitations in the response

### 4. Stress Integration Through Depth

**The Problem:**
Calculating effective stress requires integrating unit weight through varying soil layers, accounting for the groundwater table position.

**How I Solved It:**
- Implemented numerical integration using small depth steps (0.1m)
- Created a flexible `SoilProfile` class that can interpolate properties between defined layers
- Properly handled the transition at the groundwater table where buoyant unit weight applies

```python
while z < depth:
    step = min(dz, depth - z)
    unit_weight = profile.get_unit_weight_at_depth(z)
    sigma_v += unit_weight * step

    if z >= gwt:
        sigma_v_eff += (unit_weight - self.WATER_UNIT_WEIGHT) * step
    else:
        sigma_v_eff += unit_weight * step
    z += step
```

### 5. Earth Engine Authentication in Serverless Environment

**The Problem:**
Google Earth Engine requires OAuth authentication, which is challenging in a serverless/containerized deployment where you can't run interactive browser authentication.

**How I Solved It:**
- Made Earth Engine integration optional - the system works without it
- Supported service account authentication via `EE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY` environment variable
- Provided fallback to simpler elevation/terrain APIs when Earth Engine is unavailable
- Documented the setup process for users who need full functionality

**The problem it solves**

The Problem PatientX Solves:
Millions of patients produce valuable medical data through hospitals, wearables, and apps, but:

1.They don’t own or control their data
2.Health records are stored in centralized systems vulnerable to breaches
3.Patients don’t earn any value when companies use their data
4.Researchers struggle to access quality, consent-based medical data due to strict privacy laws
5.Sharing data involves risk, bureaucracy, and no transparency

PatientX solves these problems by creating a system where data ownership becomes patient-centered, secure, and transparent.

What People Can Use PatientX For:

For Patients
1.Store health records securely on a decentralized blockchain
2.Control who accesses their data using smart contracts
3.Share data anonymously through AI-based data anonymization
4.Earn rewards when their anonymized data is used by researchers
5.Verify insights safely using Zero-Knowledge Proofs without exposing identity
6.Prevent misuse by tracking every access in an immutable ledger

For Doctors & Hospitals
1.Access accurate patient data quickly with consent
2.Reduce fraud through transparent, tamper-proof records
3.Enable interoperable health data exchange without paperwork

For Researchers & Healthcare Companies
1.Legally access high-quality, anonymized medical data
2.Speed up medical innovation without violating privacy laws
3.Gain deeper insights validated by AI and ZK-proofs

How It Makes Tasks Easier & Safer

Safer: Decentralization removes single-point data breaches
Faster: Automated smart contract approvals replace manual paperwork
Private: AI-anonymization and zero-knowledge proofs protect identity
Fair: Patients finally earn value from their medical data
Transparent: Every data transaction is traceable and consent-based

**Challenges we ran into**

AI-Based Data Anonymization
Problem: Model missed implicit identifiers in reports.
Solution: Added hybrid neural network + rule-based entity removal + multi-layer validation.

Smart Contract Development
Problem: Consent contracts reverted due to logic conflicts.
Solution: Introduced HardHat, unit testing, and contract simulation.

OCR Inaccuracy
Problem: Pytesseract failed on low-resolution PDFs and images.
Solution: Pre-processing pipeline (denoising, thresholding, sharpening).

Decentralized Storage Handling
Problem: Inconsistent IPFS uploads for multiple formats.
Solution: Standardized file metadata + buffer normalization.

Zero-Knowledge Proof Integration
Problem: High computational complexity.
Solution: Used lightweight ZKP primitives + optimized proof generation.

**Ethereum Track**

Our project “Patient X” is an AI + Blockchain–powered healthcare data platform designed to ensure secure, tamper-proof, and privacy-centric patient record management. We chose ETH India as our primary track because Blockchain forms the core of our architecture, enabling decentralized verification, immutable medical records, and transparent access control.

**AI TRACK**

PatientX comes under the AI track because artificial intelligence is the core intelligence layer that drives decision-making and value creation in the platform. AI is used to analyze large volumes of medical data, extract meaningful patterns, and generate actionable insights that would be impossible or inefficient through manual methods. It enables automated data classification, anonymization, quality assessment, and dynamic pricing of medical records based on factors such as relevance, rarity, and research demand. AI also supports recommendation systems that match researchers with the most suitable patient datasets while preserving privacy. Since the platform’s functionality, scalability, and impact are fundamentally dependent on AI-driven reasoning and automation, PatientX strongly aligns with the objectives of the AI track.

**Open Innovation**

PatientX comes under the Open Innovation track because it introduces a cross-domain solution that goes beyond traditional healthcare applications. It integrates AI for intelligent analysis and value estimation of medical data with Blockchain to ensure secure, transparent, and consent-based data sharing. Instead of keeping patient records confined to hospitals, PatientX enables a collaborative ecosystem where patients, researchers, and institutions can interact on a unified platform. This combination of emerging technologies and a new collaboration model does not fit into a single predefined category, making it a strong example of Open Innovation. The solution is also highly scalable and adaptable across use cases such as medical research, clinical trials, insurance analytics, and public health initiatives, which aligns perfectly with the objectives of the Open Innovation track.

> Context-aware document generation made simple

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![RestAPIs](https://img.shields.io/badge/RestAPIs-333333?style=flat-square) ![langchain](https://img.shields.io/badge/langchain-333333?style=flat-square) ![LangGraph](https://img.shields.io/badge/LangGraph-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

## Problem & Solution

Writing documents like **SRS, SOW, and proposals** takes a lot of time and effort. Most teams end up rewriting similar content, referring to old files manually, and still risk missing important points.

This project makes the process simpler. You upload past documents, give basic requirements, and the system helps generate a clean, well-structured document using relevant context from earlier work. It also helps improve clarity and consistency.

**Outcome:** less manual work, quicker document creation, and more reliable, professional results.

**Challenges we ran into**

A major challenge was getting **RAG-based document generation** to work accurately. In the early stages, the system either retrieved too much irrelevant context or failed to fetch the most useful sections from past documents. This caused generated content to be inconsistent or slightly off-topic.

To fix this, I improved the **retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipeline** by using semantic embeddings and adding a retrieval agent that filters, ranks, and chunks documents more carefully before passing them to the generation agent. This ensured the model only used relevant, high-quality context.

Another challenge was **coordinating multiple agents** in the workflow. Since ingestion, retrieval, generation, and review were handled separately, small errors could break the flow. I solved this by clearly defining agent responsibilities and validating outputs at each stage.

I also faced performance issues while rendering large documents in the editor. Optimizing state management and debouncing real-time previews helped keep the UI smooth.

These challenges helped make the system more reliable and improved the overall quality of RAG-based document generation.

**AI TRACK**

This project directly fits into the **AI track** as it is built around **retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)** and a **multi-agent AI architecture** to solve a real-world problem.

It uses AI models to understand user requirements, retrieve relevant information from previously uploaded documents using semantic search, and generate structured, high-quality documents such as SRS, SOW, and proposals. Instead of relying on static templates, the system dynamically reasons over context and adapts outputs based on historical data.

The use of specialized AI agents for ingestion, retrieval, generation, and review demonstrates applied AI beyond simple text generation. The project focuses on improving accuracy, consistency, and reliability through intelligent orchestration, making AI the core driver of functionality rather than a supporting feature.

Overall, the project showcases practical, end-to-end use of AI to automate and enhance professional documentation workflows, which aligns strongly with the goals of the AI track.

> Decentralized Governance Powered by CELO & AI

![Solidity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Solidity-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![OpenZeppelin](https://img.shields.io/badge/OpenZeppelin-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Framer](https://img.shields.io/badge/Framer-333333?style=flat-square) ![FastAPI](https://img.shields.io/badge/FastAPI-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

The Problem: Traditional governance systems are often opaque, slow, and prone to centralization. Even in many DAOs, voter apathy is high because proposals are complex, technical, and hard to verify. Communities lack the tools to validate information quickly, leading to uninformed voting or centralized control.

The Solution: EchoDAO is a next-generation decentralized governance platform built on the Celo blockchain. It bridges the gap between transparent on-chain decision-making and AI-powered intelligence. We empower communities to propose, vote, and manage funds with complete autonomy, while our integrated AI agents verify content and summarize complex proposals to ensure every voter is an informed voter.

Key Features:

🗳️ On-Chain Governance: A fully decentralized system where every proposal, vote, and execution is recorded immutably on the Celo blockchain.

🤖 AI-Powered Verification: We utilize a BART-CNN model to verify the authenticity of proposal content and generate concise summaries, cutting through the noise and reducing voter fatigue.

💰 Automated Treasury: A secure, smart-contract-controlled treasury that automatically executes transfers once a proposal passes, removing human error or bias.

🆓 Gasless Onboarding: To lower the barrier to entry, new users get their first proposal creation for free (0 CELO fee), encouraging wider participation.

🎨 Cosmic UI: A modern, responsive interface designed with space-themed aesthetics and "Space Grotesk" typography for a seamless user experience.

**Challenges we ran into**

One of the biggest challenges was bridging the gap between the deterministic world of Blockchain and the probabilistic nature of AI.

1. AI-Blockchain Integration: getting our Python-based FastAPI backend (running the BART-CNN models) to communicate seamlessly with the Celo smart contracts was tricky. We had to ensure that the AI's verification data was pinned to IPFS and referenced on-chain without incurring high gas costs or latency.

2. Gas Optimization: We wanted to make the platform accessible to everyone, which meant implementing the "First Proposal Free" feature. Logicizing this in Solidity while preventing abuse required careful contract design to track user states securely.

3. Cross-Origin Issues: coordinating the React frontend with the Python backend and the Celo blockchain nodes simultaneously led to several CORS and state management synchronization issues that we had to debug extensively.

### WhistleChain
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/whistlechain-a7a8) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/Adityamtl/WhistleChain) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/SdIWXswGY98) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/SdIWXswGY98) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-HackFiesta-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hackfiesta.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-1-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Expose the crime. Not your name.

![Solidity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Solidity-333333?style=flat-square) ![IPFS](https://img.shields.io/badge/IPFS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![ethers.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/ethers.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Ethereum](https://img.shields.io/badge/Ethereum-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

## The problem it solves

Imagine you are an employee and you discover fraud inside your company.  
You want to report it, but if your identity is exposed, you could lose your job or face retaliation.

Most existing whistleblowing systems are centralized. This means:
- Evidence can be deleted or altered later
- Submission times can be disputed
- Users must trust the platform owner to protect them

Because of this, many people choose to stay silent, even when they have important information.

---

## The solution

WhistleChain allows people to submit evidence anonymously and make sure it **cannot be erased or changed**.

When a user submits evidence:
- A cryptographic proof is recorded on the blockchain
- The document is stored in decentralized storage
- Anyone can later verify when it was submitted

The platform does not collect names, emails, or accounts.  
It only preserves proof that the evidence existed at a specific time.

---

## How it helps in real situations

- An employee can submit internal documents without revealing their identity  
- A journalist can receive tips with verifiable timestamps  
- An activist can preserve sensitive evidence even if it is later censored  

WhistleChain also includes an optional **Dead Man’s Switch**.  
If the submitter stops checking in, the evidence is automatically released, ensuring it is not silenced.

---

## What WhistleChain focuses on

WhistleChain does not judge whether a claim is true or false.  
It only guarantees that evidence **exists, is timestamped, and has not been modified**.

This makes whistleblowing safer by removing the need to trust a single authority.

**Challenges we ran into**

## Challenges I ran into

### 1. Balancing anonymity with blockchain transparency
A major challenge was that blockchains are transparent by default.  
If users submit transactions directly, their wallet address becomes permanently visible, which defeats the purpose of anonymous whistleblowing.

This was especially risky because even a single on-chain link could expose a whistleblower later through transaction history analysis.

**How I solved it:**  
I implemented a **gasless relayer system**. Instead of users sending transactions themselves, the platform submits transactions on their behalf. This removes the need for wallets and prevents any direct on-chain link between the whistleblower and the submission.

This approach preserves blockchain guarantees (immutability and timestamps) while protecting user anonymity.

---

### 2. Preventing spam without collecting identity
Another challenge was stopping spam and abuse without asking users to create accounts, emails, or logins.  
Traditional authentication methods would compromise anonymity.

**How I solved it:**  
I integrated **World ID** to verify that each submission comes from a real human, without revealing who that person is. World ID provides a cryptographic proof of personhood, not identity.

This allowed me to limit spam and automated submissions while keeping the system completely account-less and privacy-preserving.

---

### 3. Avoiding overuse of blockchain and AI
Another challenge was deciding *where not to use* blockchain or AI. Overusing them would add complexity without real benefit.

**How I solved it:**  
Blockchain is used only for immutability and timestamping.  
AI is used only for redaction and summaries, not to judge truth.  

---
These challenges forced careful design decisions to ensure WhistleChain remained both secure and respectful of user privacy.

**Ethereum Track**

## How WhistleChain Fits the Ethereum Track

WhistleChain is built on the **Ethereum ecosystem** using smart contracts to create a trustless and censorship-resistant whistleblowing platform.

The core logic of the system runs on **Solidity smart contracts deployed on Polygon Amoy**, an Ethereum Layer-2 network. Polygon allows WhistleChain to remain fully **EVM-compatible** while keeping transactions fast and gas-efficient. The same contracts can be deployed to Ethereum mainnet without modification.

Ethereum smart contracts are used to:
- Permanently record evidence hashes and submission timestamps
- Enforce immutability and public verifiability
- Power the **Dead Man’s Switch**, which autonomously releases evidence if the user fails to check in

All blockchain interactions are handled using standard **Ethereum tooling** such as Hardhat and ethers.js, following established Ethereum development practices.

WhistleChain reflects core Ethereum values:
- **Decentralization** - no central authority controls evidence
- **Censorship resistance** - submissions cannot be altered or removed
- **Trustlessness** - verification does not rely on a trusted intermediary
- **Permissionless access** - anyone can submit or verify evidence

This makes WhistleChain a practical, real-world Ethereum application focused on transparency, safety, and accountability.

**AI TRACK**

## How WhistleChain Fits the AI Track

WhistleChain uses AI to **make whistleblowing safer and easier** for real users.

### Practical Use of AI
- AI automatically **detects and redacts sensitive information** (names, emails, phone numbers, IDs) from uploaded evidence before it is stored permanently.
- AI generates **short, readable summaries** of complex documents so the public can understand the issue without exposing private details.

### Why AI Matters Here
Whistleblowers often don’t know what information might put them at risk.  
AI acts as a **safety layer**, reducing human error and protecting both the submitter and innocent third parties.

### Responsible AI Usage
- AI is used only for **assistance**, not decision-making
- No claims of truth verification or judgment
- Users always review AI output before submission

This project shows how AI can be applied responsibly to solve real-world safety and privacy problems, not just automate tasks.

**Open Innovation**

WhistleChain explores a new, privacy-first approach to whistleblowing by combining open technologies with real-world problem solving.

The project uses **blockchain, decentralized storage, AI-assisted processing, and open development tools** to build a system where sensitive evidence can be submitted and verified without exposing the person behind it.

### Use of Open & Modern Tools
- Built using **Lovable** to rapidly design and iterate on the user experience
- Open-source technologies like **Next.js, Solidity, IPFS, and Polygon**
- Designed to be transparent, inspectable, and verifiable by anyone

### Why This Is Open Innovation
- Reimagines whistleblowing without centralized trust or accounts
- Applies blockchain beyond finance to a real social problem
- Uses automation (AI + smart contracts) to reduce human control and bias

WhistleChain demonstrates how open tools and decentralized systems can be combined to create safer, more transparent solutions for high-risk real-world use cases.

![IPFS](https://img.shields.io/badge/IPFS-333333?style=flat-square) ![OpenZeppelin](https://img.shields.io/badge/OpenZeppelin-333333?style=flat-square) ![Docker](https://img.shields.io/badge/Docker-333333?style=flat-square) ![ethers.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/ethers.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Hardhat](https://img.shields.io/badge/Hardhat-333333?style=flat-square) ![slither](https://img.shields.io/badge/slither-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python (FastAPI, pydantic, pytest)](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python%20(FastAPI,%20pydantic,%20pytest)-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Creators and collectors lack a simple, end-to-end way to generate, mint, and verify digital art provenance. CanvasChain combines generative AI, decentralized storage (IPFS), and on‑chain provenance so creators can mint authentic work with immutably verifiable history, and collectors can confidently verify authenticity and royalties.

**Challenges we ran into**

IPFS reliability & metadata permanence — implemented a dedicated upload/pinning flow (/api/upload) and gateway URLs; added pinning support to ensure long-term availability.
Gas costs & contract design constraints — optimized contracts (batch ops where appropriate) and used Foundry/Hardhat gas-reporting to iterate on cheaper patterns.
Provenance immutability vs. metadata updates — added cryptographic provenance hashes and a ProvenanceRegistry contract so provenance history is immutable while metadata can be referenced off-chain.
Wallet UX and mint flow — integrated ethers.js (v6) in the frontend, added clear wallet prompts and friendly error handling to reduce user friction.
Cross-stack testing — added unit + integration tests (Foundry/Hardhat for contracts, pytest for backend, vitest for frontend) and CI-friendly scripts.

**Blockchain**

CanvasChain anchors artwork provenance on‑chain via a ProvenanceRegistry and ERC‑721 tokens, ensuring immutable ownership and transparent royalty rules. Contracts were optimized and audited with Foundry/Hardhat and tools like slither to reduce gas costs while preserving security.

**Generative AI**

Our backend exposes /api/generate to orchestrate multiple models, support seeded reproducibility, and emit cryptographic content hashes that become part of an NFT’s provenance. We also integrate emotion‑aware and DNA engines for evolving, creative outputs while keeping full metadata traceability.

**Ethereum Track**

CanvasChain is designed for Ethereum ecosystems—smart contracts follow OpenZeppelin patterns, we use ethers.js in the frontend for secure wallet interactions, and CI scripts support Hardhat/Foundry deployments and gas reporting. This makes integration with Ethereum events, tooling, and partner programs straightforward.

**Challenges we ran into**

## 🎥 **WebRTC Video Calling Crisis**

The biggest hurdle was implementing real-time video consultations. Users could connect and see their own feeds, but **remote video streams weren't displaying** between participants despite successful peer connections.

**Root Issues:**
- Signaling race conditions in offer/answer exchange
- ICE candidates sent before remote descriptions were set
- Browser auto-play policies blocking video streams

**Kiro's Solution:**
```typescript
// Kiro helped debug and fix the stream handling
pc.ontrack = (event) => {
    const [remoteStream] = event.streams;
    if (remoteStream && remoteStream.getTracks().length > 0) {
        setRemoteStream(remoteStream);
        if (remoteVideo.current) {
            remoteVideo.current.srcObject = remoteStream;
            remoteVideo.current.play().catch(e => 
                console.log('Auto-play prevented, user interaction required')
            );
        }
    }
};
```

Kiro identified the timing issues and suggested proper state management, turning days of debugging into hours.

## **Next-intl Configuration Nightmare**

Setting up internationalization for 7 languages caused **build failures** and routing conflicts:

```bash
Error: Cannot resolve module 'next-intl/middleware'
TypeError: createMiddleware is not a function
```

**The Problem:** Wrong package name, middleware conflicts with NextAuth.js, missing translation files.

**Kiro's Fix:** Corrected the import path, suggested proper middleware ordering (auth check → locale detection), and helped generate comprehensive translation files for all languages.

## **Production Authentication Failures**

Authentication worked in development but **completely failed on Vercel production** - users couldn't sign in, sessions weren't persisting.

**Issues:** Missing environment variables, incorrect cookie settings, hardcoded localhost URLs.

**Kiro's Resolution:** Identified production-specific configurations needed, suggested secure cookie settings, and fixed redirect URL handling for serverless deployment.

## **Ethereum Integration Complexity**

Integrating Web3 wallet connections with traditional authentication created conflicts and MetaMask dependency issues.

**Kiro's Approach:** Implemented progressive enhancement - Web2 auth as base with Web3 as optional enhancement, including graceful fallbacks when wallets aren't available.

**Key Learning:** Kiro's real-time debugging and solution suggestions transformed potential weeks of troubleshooting into rapid iteration, allowing focus on healthcare innovation rather than technical hurdles.

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Express.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Express.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Blockchain](https://img.shields.io/badge/Blockchain-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

MedChain helps people verify whether a medicine is genuine, safe, and not expired using a simple QR code scan. Today, consumers have no easy way to confirm if a medicine they purchase is authentic or has been tampered with. Fake and expired medicines often enter the supply chain due to poor transparency and paper-based record systems.

MedChain solves this by enabling:

Instant medicine verification for consumers and pharmacists

Supply chain traceability from manufacturer to pharmacy

Detection of counterfeit, expired, or reused QR codes

Faster recalls by identifying affected batches quickly

Safer access for elderly and visually impaired users through voice assistance and multi-language support

**Challenges we ran into**

Blockchain Simulation: Deploying a real blockchain wasn’t feasible due to time and infrastructure limits. We solved this by creating a lightweight ledger simulation with hash-linked transactions to demonstrate immutability.

QR Reuse Detection: Static QR codes are easy to copy. We addressed this by assigning unique UUIDs, tracking scan counts, and validating each scan against the ledger to detect reuse or counterfeits.

QR Scanning Issues: Inconsistent lighting affected scan accuracy. We improved reliability using jsQR optimizations and added a manual input fallback.

Voice & Language Support: Managing dynamic text-to-speech across multiple languages was complex. We solved this by modularizing the voice system with language-specific templates.

Supply Chain Mapping: Without real GPS data, tracking movement was challenging. We simulated checkpoint locations and visualized them using Leaflet.js.

**The problem it solves**

# 🚀 The Problem RudraPay Solves

**RudraPay** fundamentally addresses the critical vulnerability of modern digital finance:  
the absolute dependency on **stable internet connectivity** to complete transactions.

By leveraging **Classic Bluetooth for peer-to-peer data transmission**, it empowers users to **send and receive payments seamlessly** in environments where traditional banking apps and UPI gateways fail.

---

## 🌍 Works Anywhere
It enables financial exchanges in **remote rural areas**, **underground transit systems**, **flights**, or **crowded events (like concerts)** where network congestion renders mobile data useless.

---

## ⚡ Reliable Experience
It eliminates the frustration of **“server unreachable” errors** and **infinite loading screens** by processing transfers **locally**.

---

## 🛡️ Enhanced Safety
It reduces the necessity of carrying **physical cash** in off-grid locations, minimizing **theft risk**.

---

## 🔐 Technical Trust
Through **cryptographic token locking** and **atomic transaction protocols**, it ensures that users can trust the integrity of every offline transfer, effectively **bridging the gap between the convenience of a digital wallet and the reliability of physical currency**.

**Challenges we ran into**

# 🚧 Challenges I Ran Into

Building RudraPay in 48 hours presented critical technical challenges that nearly derailed our project. 

The most significant hurdle was **Bluetooth message fragmentation** - when transferring large amounts of tokens (300+), JSON payloads exceeded packet size limits, causing messages to split across fragments and leading to decode failures. We overcame this by implementing a message reassembly buffer that accumulates incoming fragments and uses intelligent brace counting to detect when a complete JSON message has been received, allowing us to successfully handle transfers of 500+ tokens. 

Another major challenge was **preventing double-spending attacks** where users could send the same tokens multiple times. We overcame this by implementing a token locking mechanism that exclusively locks tokens during transfers with transaction-specific IDs - when a transfer starts, tokens are immediately locked and unavailable for other transactions until the transfer completes or fails, ensuring atomic operations and preventing race conditions that could compromise transaction integrity.

**Best Innovation**

RudraPay represents a groundbreaking innovation in digital payments by solving the fundamental problem of offline transactions. Our solution introduces the world's first **offline-first digital wallet** that enables peer-to-peer token transfers using Bluetooth technology without requiring any internet connection.

**Key Innovations:**

🔄 **Offline-First Architecture**: Unlike traditional payment systems that fail without internet, RudraPay works completely offline and syncs when connectivity returns, making it ideal for remote areas, emergencies, or network outages.

📡 **Bluetooth P2P Protocol**: We developed a custom message protocol that handles large token transfers through intelligent message fragmentation and reassembly, enabling secure transfers of hundreds of tokens via Bluetooth.

🔐 **Atomic Transaction System**: Our innovative token locking mechanism prevents double-spending attacks while ensuring all-or-nothing transfers, maintaining transaction integrity even when connections drop mid-transfer.

🌐 **Cross-Platform Compatibility**: Built with Flutter, RudraPay runs natively on Android, iOS, Web, and Desktop platforms, making it accessible to users regardless of their device.

⚡ **Real-Time State Management**: Advanced state synchronization ensures balance updates propagate instantly across all screens, providing users with accurate information during complex multi-step transactions.

This innovation addresses real-world problems in financial inclusion, disaster relief scenarios, and areas with poor connectivity, while maintaining the security and reliability expected from modern payment systems. RudraPay doesn't just digitize payments - it reimagines how digital transactions can work in a disconnected world.
