### Surplus-connect
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/surplusconnect-8865) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/dangbros/surplus-connect.git) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Hack%20Technique%202026-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hack-technique2026.devfolio.co)

> Don't waste but save food

![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Data Mining](https://img.shields.io/badge/Data%20Mining-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![React.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/React.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Supabase](https://img.shields.io/badge/Supabase-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Every day, huge amounts of edible food are wasted, while at the same time millions of people struggle with food insecurity.
This gap does not exist because food is unavailable —
it exists because there is no efficient way to connect surplus food with people who need it, at the right time and place.

**Challenges we ran into**

1. Designing a Trustworthy System Without Overpromising Safety
Challenge:
Food safety is a sensitive topic. We initially struggled with how to address concerns like food poisoning without making unrealistic claims such as “we can guarantee food safety,” which would reduce credibility.
How We Overcame It:
We reframed the problem from guaranteeing safety to reducing risk through accountability.
We introduced:
Verified donor tiers (institutional vs individual)
Mandatory food metadata (type, time, expiry)
Traceability and community reporting
This made the solution realistic, honest, and defensible.
2. Balancing Logistics Without Building a Costly Delivery System
Challenge:
Building a full delivery or logistics system was not feasible due to cost, scalability, and time constraints.
How We Overcame It:
We redesigned the platform as a coordination-first solution, not a logistics provider.
Delivery is handled through:
Self pick-up
NGO and volunteer networks
Institutional donor delivery
This minimized operational cost while keeping the system practical and scalable.

Team **ITRONIX** -- Sounak Adhikari, [Jenisha Bhattacharya](https://github.com/jenishabhattacharya-oss), [Titli Purkait](https://github.com/Titli-Purkait)

### Cyber Bandhu
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/cyber-bandhu-75b8) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/XfTIhkWNkNo) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Hack%20Technique%202026-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hack-technique2026.devfolio.co)

> doorstep digital assistance

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Cyber Bandhu bridges the digital divide by offering *doorstep digital assistance* to students in underserved areas. Whether it's filling out online college forms, applying for scholarships, government schemes, or job applications - many students in rural or semi-urban regions lack access to reliable digital support. Cyber Bandhu lets them *raise help requests online, and trained **local student volunteers* (called digital mitras) are assigned to help in person.

This ensures:
- Safe, affordable, and guided access to digital services  
- Empowerment of local youth through volunteering  
- Digital inclusion for marginalized communities

**Challenges we ran into**

- *Designing a simple UI for rural students*: We conducted peer feedback loops to simplify form flows and iconography.  
- *Matching users with volunteers in real-time*: Initially, the matching logic was inefficient. We restructured our database schema and used MongoDB geolocation queries to make it dynamic.  
- *Multi-role authentication*: Implementing secure JWT-based role-specific dashboards took time to structure properly.  
- *Payment gateway integration*: Razorpay's documentation was good, but debugging UPI callbacks required detailed logging.  
- *Time constraints during the hackathon*: We prioritized MVP features and built mobile support using React Native post-hackathon.

### ShramikMitra
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/shramikmitra-6bb9) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/saheli56/Hack_Technique) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Hack%20Technique%202026-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hack-technique2026.devfolio.co)

> Empowering Migrant Workers: Jobs & IVR support

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

The Challenge:
Migrant workers in India—often in construction, delivery, cleaning, and driving—face critical barriers to stability and rights:

Limited Job Access: No centralized platform for verified local opportunities; reliance on informal networks leads to exploitation.
Language & Tech Barriers: Many speak Hindi or regional languages, with low digital literacy; smartphones are common but apps are English-heavy.
Legal & Financial Exclusion: Unaware of labor rights, minimum wages, or micro-loans; no easy way to seek help during crises.
Isolation: Lack of community support, leading to unsafe working conditions and unpaid wages.
These issues affect millions, exacerbating poverty and vulnerability in urban migration.

Our Solution: ShramikMitra
A bilingual (Hindi/English) web platform designed for accessibility:

Voice-First IVR Helpline: Toll-free phone support for job search, legal queries, and loan applications—works on basic phones.
Job Marketplace: Verified listings with employer ratings; apply via web, SMS, or IVR.
Community & Legal Support: Forums for peer help, free legal resources, and dispute resolution guidance.
Micro-Loans & Financial Tools: Eligibility checks, EMI calculators, and emergency funding access.
AI Chatbot & Offline Mode: Instant help with job matching; PWA for low-connectivity areas.

**Challenges we ran into**

Challenges Faced
Building ShramikMitra as a hackathon project pushed us to solve real-world accessibility and integration issues for India's migrant workforce. Here's what we tackled:

Technical Integration Hurdles
IVR & Twilio Setup: Integrating voice-based interactions with Twilio was complex—handling TwiML responses, multi-language prompts, and webhook security. Testing locally without real calls required creative workarounds like curl commands and a custom IVR simulator.
Bilingual Support: Ensuring seamless Hindi/English switching across UI, chatbot, and IVR. Font rendering for Devanagari (Hindi) needed custom CSS fallbacks to avoid broken text display.
Backend API Complexity: Managing MongoDB schemas for jobs, users, applications, and IVR call logs while ensuring real-time data sync between web and voice channels.

Team **PIKACHU** -- [Saheli Das](https://github.com/saheli56), [Sk Masum Ali](https://github.com/insaneodyssey26)

### Academia Authenticity Validator
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/academia-authenticity-validator-91fa) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/Baby3042007/Code-Mafia) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://codemafiaproto.netlify.app/) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/UZ_lP3HQgnE) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Lisk%20Builders%20Challenge:%20Round%20Three-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://lisk-builders-challenge-3.devfolio.co)

> Blockchain-backed trust for education.

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Django](https://img.shields.io/badge/Django-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![OCR](https://img.shields.io/badge/OCR-333333?style=flat-square) ![Hyperledger](https://img.shields.io/badge/Hyperledger-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

1. Background & Problem Statement
Fake and forged academic certificates are an increasing global concern.

Manual verification of certificates is slow, error-prone, and expensive.

Institutions and employers experience delays, causing lost opportunities.

Fraudulent certificates reduce trust in education and professional systems.

Existing solutions often fail to detect advanced forgeries and lack tamper-proof verification.

There is a need for a scalable, automated, reliable digital solution for real-time certificate authentication.

2. Solution Overview
Academia Authenticity Validator (AAV) is a secure digital platform for instant certificate verification.

Supports bulk certificate uploads for institutions and real-time verification for employers and regulators.

Combines OCR, AI-based forgery detection, and blockchain technology to ensure tamper-proof validation.

Designed to be adaptive, scalable, and interoperable across institutions and platforms.
3. Key Components
Certificate Upload Module

Institutions can upload certificates in bulk.

Supported formats: PDF, JPEG, PNG, scanned documents.

Each certificate receives a unique QR code or digital watermark.

Blockchain Integration

Certificate details are hashed and stored on blockchain.

Provides tamper-proof digital identity for each certificate.

Ensures authenticity and prevents duplication or alteration.

OCR & Data Extraction

OCR engine scans or uploads certificates for verification.

Extracts key fields: Name, Roll Number, Marks, Certificate ID, Issue Date.

Supports multi-language recognition for global compatibility.

AI-Based Forgery Detection

AI engine analyzes fonts, formatting, signatures, seals, and document structure.

Detects subtle inconsistencies indicative of forgery.

Machine learning model improves continuously with new forgery patterns.

Cross-Verification

Extracted certificate details are cross-checked against official databases.

Blockchain hash ensures no tampering occurred.

Any mismatch triggers flagging for admin review.

Real-Time Alerts & Notifications

Instant notifications for fake or suspicious certificates.

Repeat offenders or blacklisted IDs are automatically flagged.

Admins can track verification status on dashboards.

Classification System

Genuine (✔): Verified via QR/Blockchain

Fake (❌): Flagged, alerted, and blacklisted

Suspicious (⚠): Sent for further review

4. Uniqueness & Key Selling Points
Tamper-Proof Digital Identity: Certificates carry unique QR codes or watermarks; blockchain prevents alteration.

AI-Powered Forgery Detection: Detects advanced fraud invisible to human eyes using pattern recognition.

Dual-Layer Verification: OCR + AI + blockchain hash matching reduces human error.

Real-Time Fraud Alerts: Immediate notifications help prevent fraud early.

Adaptive & Scalable: Supports bulk uploads, ERP integration, and multi-language formats.

Audit Trail & Analytics: Logs verification attempts and provides insights into fraud trends.

5.Features Summary
Instant Verification: Scan or upload for immediate results.

Bulk Uploads: Saves time for institutions.

AI Forgery Detection: Detects advanced fraudulent certificates automatically.

Blockchain Security: Ensures tamper-proof certificate storage.

Dual-Layer Verification: OCR + AI + Blockchain.

Real-Time Alerts: Early fraud detection.

Dashboard & Analytics: Track certificate status and fraud trends.

Blacklist Management: Maintain repeat offender database.

Multi-Language Support: Recognizes certificates in multiple languages.

ERP Integration: Seamless integration with institutional systems.
6.Security & Privacy
Certificate data encrypted at rest and in transit.

Blockchain ensures immutable and tamper-proof records.

Role-based access control restricts verification to authorized users.

Compliance with GDPR and local privacy regulations.

**Challenges we ran into**

Challenges / Potential Hurdles
Data Privacy & Compliance

Handling sensitive academic data requires strict privacy policies.

GDPR and local regulations may limit data sharing between institutions.

Integration with Legacy Systems

Many institutions still use manual or outdated databases.

Connecting AAV seamlessly with existing ERP or certificate management systems can be complex.

AI Model Accuracy

Forgery detection relies on AI; some advanced forgeries may still bypass initial checks.

Continuous training and updating of the AI model is essential.

Blockchain Costs & Scalability

Storing large certificate datasets on blockchain can be resource-intensive.

Transaction costs on public blockchain networks may increase with scale.

User Adoption

Universities, employers, and agencies may be hesitant to adopt new technology.

Requires education and awareness campaigns for smooth adoption.

Multi-Language & Format Challenges

Certificates come in varied languages and formats globally.

OCR accuracy may vary, and additional fine-tuning may be needed.

Real-Time Verification Load

High volume of simultaneous certificate verification requests may strain servers.

Needs robust backend infrastructure to maintain speed and reliability.

False Positives / Negatives

AI or OCR may occasionally flag genuine certificates as suspicious.

Requires a manual review process to avoid misclassification.

Security Threats

Although blockchain is tamper-proof, endpoints like upload portals may be targeted by attackers.

Requires secure authentication, encryption, and monitoring.

Interoperability with International Bodies

Integrating with foreign universities or certification authorities may require custom solutions.

### Kord
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/kord-6513) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/beasty-blockchain/kord-smart-contract) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://kord.fly.dev/) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Lisk%20Builders%20Challenge:%20Round%20Three-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://lisk-builders-challenge-3.devfolio.co)

> "From notes to nodes"

![Solidity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Solidity-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Express.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Express.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Supabase](https://img.shields.io/badge/Supabase-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

The global music industry is currently failing its most vital stakeholders, the creators. Even though the global market reached nearly $30 billion in 2024, the underlying infrastructure for royalty distribution remains stuck in a slow and convoluted process. This systemic failure is reflected in widespread artist dissatisfaction, with a recent survey showing that 7 out of 10 creators are unhappy with current streaming royalty models. We see this failure everywhere, from major lawsuits like Limp Bizkit’s $200 million claim against Universal Music Group for unpaid royalties to local disputes, such as Indonesian singer Ari Lasso receiving only a fraction of his reported earnings. These cases highlight "technical and administrative errors" that consistently disadvantage the artist.

We have identified four critical root problems: lack of transparency, contractual ambiguity, heavy reliance on intermediaries, and opaque governance. Currently, artists have no way to verify if their royalties are calculated correctly or if their data is being tracked accurately by labels and Collective Management Organizations (CMOs). This dependence on centralized intermediaries often results in the "Black Box" problem, where an estimated $426 million in royalties remains unmatched and unclaimed due to poor metadata and inefficient tracking systems. For the many independent creators who now control nearly 47% of the global market, this translates to a permanent loss of income and a "liquidity crisis" characterized by months of waiting for earnings that are often underreported. 

Kord addresses these fundamental flaws by transforming traditional music copyright into immutable code. By leveraging a public blockchain ledger, Kord provides real-time auditability and eliminates the need for manual, centralized audits that often mask discrepancies. Through the use of smart contracts, we ensure that royalty splits are locked on-chain at the point of registration, enabling instant, automated payouts the moment a song is licensed or played. We are finally closing the gap between the music being played and the artist being paid, moving from a culture of delays to a new standard of immediate and transparent earnings.

**Challenges we ran into**

One of the main hurdles we faced was the technical complexity of combining traditional Web2 logins with decentralized wallet authentication. It was difficult to create a unified system that felt familiar to everyday artists while maintaining the security of the blockchain without confusing users who are new to Web3.

Designing the infrastructure and database also proved to be a major challenge. We had to decide which data needed the immutable security of the blockchain and which could stay in a traditional database to keep the platform fast and cost-effective. Mapping out the multi-sign confirmation flow for song registration was equally tough, as we had to ensure every rights holder could securely approve their ownership split.

Team **Beasty** -- [Cindy Wahyudi](https://github.com/Cindywahyudi), [HAFIIDH LUQMANUL HAKIM](https://github.com/hafidluqman50), [Eliska .](https://github.com/eliskavingky)

### Stako
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/stako-e4b0) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/Hunters-Lisk-Hackathon) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://stako.vercel.app/) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://www.loom.com/share/446492c45984429e87c8592ef43728a7) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Lisk%20Builders%20Challenge:%20Round%20Three-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://lisk-builders-challenge-3.devfolio.co)

> Tokenized Stock Protocol

![Solidity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Solidity-333333?style=flat-square) ![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

**The problem Stako solves**

Stako solves the problem of financial barriers and limited access to global stock markets for everyday investors, particularly in Southeast Asia. It bridges the gap between local currency (IDRX) and global assets through blockchain technology, making wealth creation accessible to everyone.

**Core Problems Addressed:**

**1. High Barriers to Entry** Traditional stock investing often requires high minimum deposits, complex brokerage account approvals, and significant capital to buy whole shares of expensive tech stocks. Stako eliminates this barrier by offering Fractional Ownership, allowing anyone to own pieces of high-value global companies (like Apple or Tesla) starting from just $1 worth of IDRX.

**2. Geographic & Currency Friction** For many investors (e.g., in Indonesia), accessing the US stock market involves expensive currency conversion fees, complex international wire transfers, and long settlement times. Stako solves this by integrating IDRX (Indonesian Rupiah Stablecoin) directly, enabling seamless swaps from local currency stability to global asset growth without the forex headache.

**3. Lack of Transparency & Ownership** In traditional finance, brokers hold the custody of assets, and users often have little visibility into the settlement process. Stako provides Self-Custody, giving users full ownership of their assets in their Web3 wallets. Every transaction is recorded on the Lisk Layer 2 blockchain, ensuring total transparency and audibility.

**4. Inefficient Settlement Systems** Traditional markets operate on T+2 settlement cycles and restricted trading hours. Stako leverages blockchain technology for Instant Settlement and enables users to interact with their portfolio 24/7, removing the latency and "waiting periods" associated with legacy banking.

**What People Can Use It For:**

**1. Micro-Investing & Wealth Building**: Users with limited capital can start building a diversified portfolio of global stocks immediately, investing small amounts regularly (DCA) without being penalized by high fees or minimums.

**2. Portfolio Diversification**: Investors can easily hedge against local economic volatility or inflation by holding tokenized assets pegged to the performance of the strongest global companies and ETFs.

**3. Cross-Border Asset Management**: Users can manage, transfer, or gift stock assets instantly within the Lisk ecosystem without the friction of cross-border banking regulations.

**4. DeFi Composability**: As tokenized assets, these stocks can potentially be used in wider DeFi applications (like collateral for loans) within the Lisk ecosystem, unlocking capital efficiency that traditional stocks cannot offer.

**How It Makes Tasks Easier and Safer:**

**- Easier**: Stako streamlines the investment process into a "Web3 native" experience. There are no lengthy paper forms or multi-day approval processes. Users simply Connect Wallet, Deposit IDRX, and Swap for stocks. The interface enables "One-Click" investing similar to a simple token swap, making the stock market as easy to access as a crypto exchange.
**- Safer**: Stako combines the best of both worlds: the security of blockchain and regulatory compliance.
**- Trust:** Assets are 100% backed by real-world reserves and audited, so the token value is always pegged to the real stock.
**- Control:** Non-custodial design means users do not rely on a centralized exchange to hold their funds; they hold the keys to their own assets.
**- Security:** Built on the Lisk L2, benefiting from Ethereum-grade security while keeping transaction costs negligible.

**Our Solution**
The Cross-Chain RWA Intent Engine enables users to buy tokenized stocks (like AAPLon) on Ethereum from Lisk L2 with just one click and users simply submit their intent with IDRX on Lisk, and the system automatically handles bridging via Chainlink CCIP, swapping to stock tokens, and depositing to a secure Vault on Ethereum, eliminating all the complexity of manual cross-chain operations

**Challenges we ran into**

**Challenge 1: Abstracting Option Vault Complexity**

**- Problem:** Thetanuts Finance v4 (our underlying protocol) is powerful but incredibly complex for retail users. Concepts like "Strike Price", "Expiry", and "Delta" are intimidating.
**- Solution:** We built a dedicated "Abstraction Layer" in our UI. Users simply see "APY" and "Risk Level". We moved all the derivative math to the backend/smart contract interactions.
**- Learning:** Great DeFi UX isn't about dumbing things down, it's about context. Users care about outcomes (Yield), not the plumbing (Greek letters).

**Challenge 2: Realistic AI Advisory**

**- Problem:** Most "DeFi Chatbots" prone to hallucinations or giving dangerous financial advice. We needed Nova to be helpful but safe.
**- Solution:** We prompt-engineered Nova specifically as a "Risk Assessor", not a "Financial Advisor". We fed it specific context about Vultara's vault mechanics so it explains how the yield is generated, rather than predicting future prices.
**- Learning:** Constraining an AI often makes it more useful. A specialized tool beats a general chatbot.

**Challenge 3: Mobile-First DeFi Interface**

**- Problem:** Most DeFi dashboards break on mobile. Tables overflow, charts get squished, and "Connect Wallet" flow is janky.
**- Solution:** We adopted a "Mobile-Obsessed" approach. We replaced traditional data tables with modular cards. We fixed iOS input zooming issues. We optimized touch targets for every button.
**- Learning:** The next billion users will access DeFi from a phone, not a desktop with 3 monitors. Mobile UX is non-negotiable.

**Challenge 4: Simulating Mainnet Conditions on Testnet**

**- Problem:** Real option premiums rely on active market makers, which don't exist on Lisk Sepolia testnet. The "Yield" would look like 0%.
**- Solution:** We created a simulation engine for the frontend demo. It pulls real historical data from ETH options markets to project realistic APY scenarios, clearly labeled as "Simulated Data" for transparency.
**- Learning:** Transparency is key. It's better to show realistic simulations than broken live data during a hackathon.

![Solidity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Solidity-333333?style=flat-square) ![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Masalah yang Diselesaikan

Proyek ini menyelesaikan masalah kurangnya kontrol dan transparansi pasien terhadap data kesehatannya sendiri.

Dengan sistem ini, pasien dapat menyimpan, melihat, dan mengelola riwayat kesehatan mereka secara mandiri dalam satu tempat yang aman. Data kesehatan dienkripsi dan hanya dapat diakses oleh pihak yang diberi izin oleh pasien, seperti dokter atau tenaga medis tertentu.

Solusi ini memudahkan pasien untuk:
- Melihat riwayat penyakit dan pemeriksaan kapan saja
- Memahami perkembangan kondisi kesehatannya
- Membagikan data kesehatan secara aman tanpa harus membawa dokumen fisik
- Menghindari kehilangan atau manipulasi data medis

Sementara itu, bagi dokter dan institusi kesehatan, sistem ini menyediakan akses data yang lebih aman, terverifikasi, dan terkontrol, tanpa harus menyimpan data sensitif dalam bentuk plaintext.

**Challenges we ran into**

Tantangan: Pasien Tidak Memiliki Akses dan Pemahaman atas Riwayat Kesehatannya

Masalah nyata yang ditemukan adalah banyak pasien tidak dapat melihat atau memahami riwayat penyakit dan data kesehatannya sendiri. Selama ini pasien hanya percaya bahwa rumah sakit menyimpan hasil pemeriksaan, tanpa benar-benar mengetahui isi, perkembangan, atau makna dari data tersebut. Akibatnya, pasien tidak bisa melakukan self-study terhadap kesehatannya dan sepenuhnya bergantung pada institusi.

Hal ini menjadi masalah karena data kesehatan adalah data personal yang sangat penting, namun kontrol dan visibilitasnya justru berada di luar tangan pemilik data itu sendiri. Pasien kehilangan transparansi, pemahaman, dan hak untuk mengelola informasi kesehatannya.

Solusi yang diterapkan dalam proyek ini adalah membuat sistem di mana data kesehatan dikelola langsung oleh pasien. Setiap data dienkripsi, dan hanya pasien yang memiliki kontrol penuh atas aksesnya. Dokter atau rumah sakit hanya dapat mengakses data tersebut jika diberikan izin melalui kode atau kunci enkripsi tertentu. Dengan pendekatan ini, pasien tetap menjadi pemilik data, sementara dokter berperan sebagai pihak yang diberi akses terbatas dan terkontrol.

**Winner Classification**

- Healthcare / HealthTech  
- Blockchain / Web3  
- Privacy & Security

> Tokenized startup equity with on-chain yield

![Solidity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Solidity-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![ZKPass](https://img.shields.io/badge/ZKPass-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Retail investors miss early-stage startup opportunities due to regulatory walls, high minimums, and lack of access — while founders struggle to raise capital and lose momentum waiting for funds to deploy.

fndr solves both:
- It tokenizes startup equity (ERC-1400), opening early-stage investing to a broader audience.
- It routes raised funds into DeFi-native ERC-4626 yield vaults — so capital earns while it waits, instead of sitting idle.
- Investors benefit from yield and liquidity via a secondary token marketplace.
- Founders raise smarter: with capital that grows, unlocks in tranches, and extends runway without dilution.
- zkPassport integration enables privacy-preserving KYC and eligibility verification — critical for regulatory-safe investing.
- Secondary marketplace allows trading startup tokens before exits, giving investors early liquidity and upside.

It’s not just faster fundraising — it’s fundraising that compounds.
fndr isn't just making startup investing faster. It's making it smarter, fairer, and yield-aware.


The Contract :
- StartupSecondaryMarket (0xF09216A363FC5D88E899aa92239B2eeB1913913B)
Peer-to-peer marketplace for trading startup equity tokens. Investors can list their tokens for sale after a 180-day holding period. The platform charges a 0.25% fee on all trades.

-   RoundFactory (0x482DB11F63cC06CD5Fb56d54C942450871775c6B)
Factory contract that allows verified founders to create new funding rounds. Each round deploys a new RoundManager contract with customizable parameters like target raise, equity percentage, and deadline.

-   FndrIdentity (0xDC987dF013d655c8eEb89ACA2c14BdcFeEee850a)
Decentralized identity contract using ZK-passport verification. Ensures all users (founders and investors) are verified real humans before participating in the platform, preventing sybil attacks and fraud.

-   MockVault (0xA24646C277Bd10AEb76e4086C6B6956aE2DB1321)
An ERC4626-compliant yield vault that generates 6% APY on deposited funds. When investors commit to a funding round, their funds are deposited here to earn yield while waiting for the round to close.

-   MockUSDC (0x96F14a42d612Ab1C69eF71E5Ee02c0267A9a45D3)
A test stablecoin (USDC) used for all platform transactions. Users can claim free testnet tokens via the airdrop function to participate in funding rounds and secondary market trading.

**Challenges we ran into**

Combining multiple smart contract standards (ERC-1400 for equity, ERC-4626 for yield) into a single seamless flow introduced complexity:
- Handling vesting, tranching, and milestone-based unlocks required modular and precise smart contract architecture.
- Ensuring DeFi vault safety and predictable yield while preserving founder withdrawal logic was challenging in early testing.
- Integrating zkPassport flows for investor and founder onboarding added a privacy layer that needed coordination with identity verification and eligibility access logic.
- AI systems for deal analysis needed secure access to on-chain and off-chain data — especially during the testnet phase.

Solutions:
- Built custom contracts to bridge vault yield and equity unlocks.
- Simulated end-to-end round flow on testnet: from onboarding → raise → yield → vest → exit.
- Streamlined ZK onboarding and AI input flow to work alongside token issuance and capital routing.

**Winner Classification**

fndr delivers across Innovation, Technical Execution, and Community Impact:
- Innovation: Unlocks a new asset class — early-stage startup equity that earns yield, is tradable, and accessible via zk-verified onboarding.
- Technical Execution: Combines ERC-1400, ERC-4626, AI agents, and ZK identity flows into one composable platform.
- Community Impact: Makes startup investing accessible to more people globally, while giving founders a smarter, capital-efficient way to build.
- The product experience is designed with composability and compliance in mind, aligning with Lisk's push toward real-world utility and modular design.

### BlockReceipt
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/blockreceipt-70b8) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://blockreceipt-kr-77.vercel.app/) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Lisk%20Builders%20Challenge:%20Round%20Three-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://lisk-builders-challenge-3.devfolio.co)

> BlockReceipt: Paper Fades. The Chain Remembers.

![Solidity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Solidity-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![MySQL](https://img.shields.io/badge/MySQL-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Vercel](https://img.shields.io/badge/Vercel-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

The Problem It Solves
1. Stopping the "Silent Killer" of Indonesian SMEs Corporate fraud is not just an annoyance; it is a systemic economic drain. In Indonesia alone, fraud costs the economy Rp 89 Trillion annually. For Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs), this is often fatal: 1 in 3 businesses fail within their first 5 years , with a significant portion of these failures traced directly to hidden purchasing fraud that erodes profitability.
2. Closing the "18-Month" Detection Gap Traditional auditing is reactive and slow. On average, internal fraud schemes operate for 18 months before they are discovered. By the time the fraud is caught, the damage is already done, costing businesses an average of Rp 500 Million per incident. Existing tools like Excel or centralized accounting software are vulnerable because data can be altered retroactively by bad actors.
3. From "Trust Me" to "Cryptographic Truth" BlockReceipt replaces manual trust with cryptographic verification.

- Tamper-Proof Records: We solve the problem of data manipulation. Once our AI extracts the data and the smart contract locks it , the record is immutable. A dishonest employee cannot go back and change a "10" to a "100" to embezzle the difference.
- Privacy-Preserving Verification: We solve the dilemma of transparency vs. privacy. Using ZK Proof Verification , companies can prove the validity of their transaction data to auditors or partners without exposing sensitive vendor agreements or trade secrets.
- Automated Compliance: We eliminate the bottleneck of manual verification. Smart contracts execute workflow approvals automatically based on pre-defined rules, ensuring that no transaction bypasses company policy.

In short: BlockReceipt transforms a receipt from a piece of paper into forensic evidence, reducing the fraud detection timeline from 18 months to minutes.

**Challenges we ran into**

1. The Paradox of Public Transparency vs. Corporate Privacy
The Hurdle: Our value proposition relies on the "Transparency" and "Immutability"  of the Lisk blockchain. However, our target customers (SMEs and Enterprises) cannot have their sensitive vendor agreements, pricing strategies, and purchase details exposed on a public block explorer. We hit a wall: How do we prove a transaction happened on-chain without doxxing our client's internal finances?

The Solution: We re-architected the data flow to separate Verification from Storage.


Off-Chain: The sensitive PDF and extracted data are encrypted and stored on IPFS.

On-Chain: We generate a cryptographic hash (Digital Fingerprint) of the data. The Lisk Smart Contract only stores this Hash, the Timestamp, and the Approver's Address.

Result: This allows auditors to verify the integrity of the receipt (by hashing the local file and comparing it to the on-chain record) without ever exposing the raw data to the public network.

2. "Garbage In, Immutable Garbage Out" (AI vs. Smart Contracts)
The Hurdle: Our AI OCR engine performs at "over 95% accuracy". While high, this leaves a 5% margin for error. In a standard app, you just edit the database. But in our model, we promised a "Smart Contract Lock" that "digitally locks critical data". If the AI misreads a 1 as a 7 and we write that to the blockchain immediately, we have created an immutable error, destroying user trust.

The Solution: We implemented a "Two-Phase Commit" pattern in our Smart Contract logic:


Phase 1 (Soft State): The AI extracts the data  and presents it to the user.


Phase 2 (Hard Lock): We require an explicit cryptographic signature from the authorized user (Collaborator/Manager ) to confirm the data is correct. Only after this signature does the smart contract execute the lock() function. This ensures that only verified, human-approved data becomes immutable.

3. UX Friction for Non-Web3 Natives
The Hurdle: Our target market is traditional businesses ("Non-VAT Companies," "SMEs"). They are used to Excel, not MetaMask. Forcing a wallet signature popup for every single receipt upload would destroy the user experience and increase "Switching Cost", which we claimed would be low.

The Solution: We utilized the efficiency of the Lisk L2 network to batch verify transactions where possible. For the "Professional" and "Enterprise" tiers , we designed the system to allow for session keys or delegated signing, where the user logs in securely (e.g., "Continue with Google" ), and the backend manages the blockchain interaction transparently, maintaining the "Seamless migration" promise.

**Winner Classification**

BlockReceipt fits squarely into the "Founder's Challenge: Real-World Venture" classification. While many hackathon entries are speculative DeFi protocols or consumer toys, BlockReceipt is a high-utility B2B SaaS designed to solve an immediate, tangible pain point in the Indonesian economy: the Rp 89 Trillion lost annually to corporate fraud.
We align with Lisk’s mission to "build the future" and focus on "high-growth markets" by leveraging Lisk’s L2 infrastructure to solve three specific barriers that have previously made blockchain unviable for corporate accounting:

1. Cost-to-Value Ratio: Using Ethereum Mainnet to verify a $50 receipt is financial suicide. Lisk’s near-zero gas fees allow us to hash and lock thousands of transaction records  without eroding the margins of our SME clients.
 
2. Privacy vs. Transparency: Corporations cannot put sensitive vendor data on a public explorer. We utilize ZK Proofs to verify data validity while keeping the actual payload encrypted on IPFS, using Lisk only for the immutable proof of existence. 
3. Real Revenue Model: Unlike projects relying on token speculation, we have a clear SaaS revenue model (Basic at $120/mo, Pro at $210/mo).
 
BlockReceipt isn't just "exploring" web3; we are building the operational layer for trustless commerce in Southeast Asia. We are not just submitting code; we are submitting a business ready for Mainnet launch in Q1 2025

> Fair, borderless hotel payments secured on-chain.

![Solidity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Solidity-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Blockchain](https://img.shields.io/badge/Blockchain-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Travel should be about adventure and discovery, not payment headaches and trust issues. Today's $10.9 trillion travel industry is built on broken systems that create friction for everyone.

For Travelers:
Hidden Fees: Lose 3-7% of your travel budget to foreign transaction fees and poor exchange rates

Payment Insecurity: Pay upfront with no guarantee, hotels can cancel last minute

Deposit Hassles: Credit card holds tie up your money for weeks after checkout

Refund Delays: Wait days or weeks for refunds through slow banking systems

For Hotels:
Fraud Risk: 36% of travel transactions are suspicious, hotels face costly chargebacks

Cash Flow Issues: Payments take days to clear, hurting business operations

Currency Complexity: Managing multiple currencies adds cost and risk

Trust Gaps: Guests can dispute legitimate charges after their stay

The "Crypto-Booking" Gap:
Some platforms accept crypto, but they don't solve the core trust problem:

Direct Payments Only: Your crypto goes straight to the hotel, no escrow protection

Centralized Refunds: Still rely on slow manual processes

No Smart Guarantees: Just traditional booking with different payment methods

How InnChain Transforms Travel
What People Can Use It For:
For Travelers:

Book Hotels Worldwide with escrow protection, your payment only releases after you check in

Pay with Stablecoins to avoid currency exchange losses

Get Instant Refunds when you cancel, no waiting for bank processing

Secure Deposits held in smart contracts, not on your credit card

Travel with Confidence knowing your accommodation is guaranteed

For Hotels:

Receive Guaranteed Payments, no more chargeback fraud

Get Instant Settlement in USDC upon guest check-in

Manage Deposits Automatically through smart contract logic

Reduce Fraud Risk with on-chain identity verification

Streamline Operations with automated payment handling

How It Makes Existing Tasks Easier & Safer:

Booking Becomes Trustless
Before: You trust a third-party platform to handle disputes

Now: Code handles everything, no middleman needed

Result: Bookings are guaranteed by mathematics, not promises

Payments Become Transparent
Before: Hidden fees, unclear exchange rates, surprise charges

Now: All costs visible upfront, payments tracked on-chain

Result: No financial surprises, you see every transaction

Refunds Become Instant
Before: Wait 5-10 business days for bank processing

Now: Smart contract executes refunds in seconds

Result: Your money returns to your wallet immediately

Deposits Become Fair
Before: Credit card holds that reduce your spending limit

Now: USDC locked in escrow, refunded automatically

Result: Fair system where both parties are protected

Cross-Border Payments Become Simple
Before: Multiple currency conversions at poor rates

Now: (Coming soon) Auto-swap stablecoins via DEX

Result: Pay in your currency, hotel gets theirs, no spread loss

Real-World Use Cases:
The International Traveler
"I'm traveling from Indonesia to Thailand. I pay in XIDR, the Thai hotel receives THBT instantly via auto-swap. No bank fees, no currency risk, and my booking is guaranteed."

The Boutique Hotel Owner
"I used to lose 5% to payment processing and fraud. Now I get USDC instantly when guests arrive, with zero chargeback risk. My cash flow is predictable and secure."

The Last-Minute Booker
"My plans changed unexpectedly. I canceled my booking 3 hours before check-in and got my full payment back immediately, no phone calls, no waiting."

The Budget-Conscious Traveler
"I saved $150 on a $2,000 trip by avoiding foreign transaction fees and getting better exchange rates through stablecoins."

The Security-Conscious Guest
"I travel for work with company funds. The smart contract escrow gives my finance team transparency and security they can audit on-chain."

The Core Innovation
We don't just accept crypto payments, we use blockchain to reengineer trust. Traditional booking platforms are intermediaries who take a cut. We're infrastructure that enables direct, protected transactions:

The Digital Handshake:
Traveler: "I'll pay when I get my room"

Hotel: "I'll provide the room when I get paid"

Smart Contract: "I'll hold the payment until both conditions are met"

This neutral third party (the code) ensures neither side can cheat the other, solving the fundamental trust problem that plagues online travel.

**Challenges we ran into**

Can we charge 1-3% fees (vs. traditional 15-30%) and still be viable for hotel management?
Hotels are used to high commissions but get massive customer volume in return
Our low fees must still generate enough revenue to sustain operations
Hospitality management companies need to see clear ROI from switching

We haven't fully solved this problem yet. The economics of low-fee decentralized platforms versus high-commission centralized marketplaces remains our biggest unsolved challenge. We're still exploring sustainable models that work for all parties.

[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/warung-loyalty-4cb7) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/bandungresearchai/warung-pass-points) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://warung-pass-points.vercel.app/) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Lisk%20Builders%20Challenge:%20Round%20Three-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://lisk-builders-challenge-3.devfolio.co)

> Kartu stempel digital sederhana untuk warung kopi

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

**Empowering Small Businesses with "Invisible" Web3 Tech
**
Traditional micro-businesses (Warungs) in Indonesia are losing customers to modern retail chains because they rely on outdated paper stamp cards. These cards are easily lost, hard to track, and frustrating for customers.

WarungPass levels the playing field. It is a digital loyalty platform that allows any small shop owner to launch their own rewards program in one click.

- For Merchants: No tech skills needed. They just scan a customer's QR code to give points.
- For Customers: One simple app for all their favorite local shops. No more bulky wallets.
- Why Lisk? We use the Lisk blockchain to make points transparent and permanent. Unlike centralized apps where points can vanish, WarungPass points are truly owned by the user on-chain, yet the experience feels exactly like a familiar Web2 app.

**Challenges we ran into**

1. Making Crypto "Invisible" for Non-Tech Users The biggest challenge was building for users who have never heard of "gas fees" or "private keys." A warung owner cannot deal with complex wallet pop-ups during a busy lunch rush.

- Solution:We implemented Account Abstraction (Paymasters). The app handles gas fees on the backend. Users simply click "Mint" or "Redeem," and the blockchain magic happens silently in the background.

2. Ensuring Instant Feedback (The "Kopi" Speed Test) Blockchain transactions take time to confirm, but buying a coffee takes seconds. If the app lags, the merchant won't use it.

- Solution:We built an Optimistic UI. When a point is scanned, the app updates the balance instantly on the screen while the Lisk smart contract processes the transaction in the background. This creates a snappy, zero-latency experience.

Ownership usually requires large upfront capital, involves trust issues (authenticity, custody, resale), and selling these assets can take a long time and carry high risk.

What people can use it for / how it makes tasks easier & safer
LUXY allows people to own fractions of luxury assets instead of buying them outright. By tokenizing luxury goods, users can invest with much smaller amounts, making luxury asset ownership more accessible. The platform also improves liquidity, since fractional ownership can be traded more easily than selling a whole physical item. In addition, using blockchain and smart contracts helps increase transparency, security, and trust, reducing risks related to fraud, unclear ownership, and manual verification. Overall, LUXY makes luxury investment more affordable, safer, and more efficient compared to traditional methods

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![C++](https://img.shields.io/badge/C++-333333?style=flat-square) ![React Native](https://img.shields.io/badge/React%20Native-333333?style=flat-square) ![Android NDK](https://img.shields.io/badge/Android%20NDK-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

# Why We Built This

Managing your money should feel like speaking to a trusted assistant—not wrestling with software *built by engineers for engineers*. **BitButler exists to make blockchain invisible.**

---

# The World We Refuse to Accept

Picture this: A mother in Jakarta wants to send money to her son studying abroad. She opens her banking app, navigates through seven screens, enters an IBAN she copied from WhatsApp, double-checks every digit with mounting anxiety, pays a $25 fee, and waits three business days. She does this because she has no other choice.

Now picture the crypto alternative: That same mother must first understand what a "wallet" is. Then memorize (or dangerously store) 24 random words. Then figure out gas fees. Then pray she didn't accidentally send funds to a contract address. Then wonder why her transaction is "pending" for twenty minutes.

**This is the state of finance in 2026. And it's absurd.**

3.9 billion people use mobile banking. Only 420 million use crypto. The technology that promised to democratize finance has instead built a higher wall—one made of jargon, complexity, and fear.

---

# What If It Didn't Have to Be This Way?

What if you could manage your entire financial life the same way Tony Stark manages his?

*"JARVIS, transfer $500 to the house account."*

No endless screens. No confirmation dialogs. No anxiety. Just you, your voice, and an AI that understands not just your words—but your intent.

---

# How BitButler Changes Everything

BitButler is not a wallet. It's not an app. It's not another tool you have to learn.

**BitButler is your personal financial AI—a super app that listens, understands, and acts.**

Speak naturally:
> *"Send 50 dollars to Mom."*
> *"What did I spend on food this month?"*
> *"Move half my savings into stablecoins."*

BitButler confirms your intent, then a quick biometric scan—Face ID or fingerprint—and it's done. Real security without the friction.

Under the hood, BitButler handles everything else:
- It knows who "Mom" is because you told it once, months ago
- It converts your intent into blockchain transactions with 99%+ accuracy
- It pays gas fees invisibly through smart paymasters—you never see them
- It batches operations to save you money you didn't know you were losing
- It executes on Lisk L2 with sub-second finality, so it feels instant

You don't need to understand Account Abstraction. You don't need to know what ERC-4337 means. You don't need to care about Layer 2 rollups.

**You just need to speak—and confirm with a glance.**

---

# Who Is This Really For?

**The Overwhelmed**
You've heard about crypto for years. You know it matters. But every time you try to learn, you hit a wall of complexity that makes you feel stupid. You're not stupid. The interfaces are. BitButler removes the interface entirely.

**The Time-Starved**
You're a professional with 47 tabs open and three meetings in the next two hours. You don't have time to navigate DeFi dashboards. You need to move money now, and you need it done in five seconds. BitButler: one sentence, one glance, done.

**The Underserved**
You live in a region where banking infrastructure is unreliable, fees are predatory, and cross-border transfers take a week. You deserve the same financial superpowers as someone in Singapore or Switzerland. BitButler doesn't care where you live.

**The Visually Impaired**
Most financial apps are accessibility nightmares—tiny text, complex navigation, zero screen-reader optimization. BitButler is voice-first. If you can speak and hear, you can use it.

**Your Parents**
They call you every time they need to do something on their phone. They're terrified of pressing the wrong button. They've heard about "Bitcoin scams" and want nothing to do with crypto. But they can have a conversation and use their fingerprint. And that's all BitButler needs.

---

## The Vision

In 2011, Siri made voice assistants mainstream. In 2016, Alexa brought them into our homes. In 2022, ChatGPT made AI conversational.

**In 2026, BitButler makes blockchain invisible.**

WeChat Pay onboarded 900 million users by making payments feel like sending a text message. M-Pesa transformed Kenya by making banking as simple as a phone call.

We're not building another wallet. We're not adding another app to your home screen.

**We're building the last financial interface you'll ever need—because the best interface is no interface at all.**

---

# The Bottom Line

People don't want crypto. They don't want blockchain. They don't want DeFi.

They want to send money to their kids. They want to save for retirement. They want to split the dinner bill without awkwardness. They want to feel in control of their financial lives.

**BitButler gives them exactly that—with nothing more than their voice and a fingerprint.**

*"Hey BitButler, send a hundred dollars to my daughter."*

*"Sending $100 to Sarah. Please confirm with Face ID."*

One glance. Done. Secure.

**Challenges we ran into**

# Challenges I Ran Into

## 1. The Passkey-to-Blockchain Translation Problem

**The Bug:** React Native's Passkey APIs return a P-256 (secp256r1) public key—but Ethereum and Lisk use secp256k1. These are fundamentally different elliptic curves. You cannot just "plug in" a FaceID credential to sign blockchain transactions.

**The Journey:** We spent two days down a rabbit hole trying to make `react-native-passkey` output secp256k1 keys. It's cryptographically impossible—the Secure Enclave hardware only supports P-256.

**The Solution:** We pivoted to ERC-4337 Account Abstraction with a WebAuthn validator. Instead of forcing the hardware to speak Ethereum's language, we deployed a Smart Account that understands both. The on-chain `ECDSAValidator` verifies P-256 signatures natively. The Secure Enclave stays happy, Ethereum stays happy, and the user never knows any of this is happening.

---

## 2. Lisk Sepolia's Missing ERC-4337 Infrastructure

**The Problem:** When we started building, Lisk Sepolia had no deployed ERC-4337 EntryPoint, no Bundler, and no Paymaster. Account Abstraction simply didn't exist on the network.

**The Panic:** Our entire architecture depended on AA. Without it, we'd have to fall back to seed phrases—the exact thing we were trying to kill.

**The Solution:** We used Pimlico's public Bundler which supports Lisk Sepolia, and configured `permissionless.js` to route UserOperations through it. For the EntryPoint, we verified that the canonical v0.7 deployment existed at `0x0000000071727De22E5E9d8BAf0edAc6f37da032`. Crisis averted.

---

## 3. The Viem + React Native Polyfill Nightmare

**The Error:** `ReferenceError: TextEncoder is not defined`

**The Context:** Viem is designed for Node.js and browsers. React Native is neither. It lacks `TextEncoder`, `crypto.getRandomValues`, and several other Web APIs that Viem assumes exist.

**The Fix:** We installed polyfills in a precise order at app entry:
```javascript
import 'react-native-get-random-values';
import 'fast-text-encoding';
```
These must load before any Viem import. One wrong import order and the entire app crashes on launch. We learned this the hard way—three times.

---

## 4. Voice Recognition Latency vs. Transaction Confirmation

**The UX Problem:** Speech-to-text takes 500ms–2s. Parsing intent takes 200ms. Biometric auth takes 300ms. Blockchain confirmation takes 1–5s. Stack these linearly and you get 7+ seconds of waiting—an eternity in UX terms.

**The Insight:** Users don't mind waiting if they feel progress. Silence is the enemy, not latency.

**The Solution:** We designed a multi-stage feedback loop:
1. **Listening** → waveform animation + haptic pulse
2. **Thinking** → "I heard: send 50 to mom" (instant text echo)
3. **Confirming** → Slide-to-confirm + biometric prompt (parallel)
4. **Executing** → Progress ring + transaction hash preview
5. **Done** → Success chime + confetti animation

Total perceived wait time dropped from 7s to ~3s—not because we made it faster, but because we made it feel alive.

---

## 5. The "Who Is Mom?" Contact Resolution Problem

**The Challenge:** When a user says "send 50 to Mom," we need to resolve "Mom" to a wallet address. But crypto has no universal contact book. ENS exists, but adoption is low. Phone contacts exist, but they don't have wallet addresses.

**The Workaround:** We built a local contact alias system stored in `expo-secure-store`. Users can say "Remember that Mom is 0x123..." once, and BitButler stores the mapping encrypted on-device. For the hackathon demo, we pre-populated "Mom" and "Sarah" as mock contacts. In production, this would sync with an on-chain social graph (Lens, Farcaster) or ENS reverse lookups.

---

## 6. Expo SDK 54 + React Native 0.81 Compatibility Hell

**The Symptom:** Random crashes, missing native modules, and build failures after upgrading Expo.

**The Cause:** Expo SDK 54 shipped with React Native 0.81, which introduced breaking changes to the native module system. Several dependencies (`react-native-passkey`, `react-native-reanimated`) hadn't updated yet.

**The Solution:** Pinned specific versions that played nice together, ran `expo prebuild --clean` to regenerate native projects, and prayed to the dependency gods. It works now. We don't touch it.

---

## 7. The Gasless UX Without a Funded Paymaster

**The Ideal:** Users speak, biometric confirms, transaction executes. No mention of "gas."

**The Reality:** Paymasters cost money. On testnet, there's no incentive for anyone to sponsor gas for strangers.

**The Compromise:** For the hackathon, we pre-funded a minimal sponsorship via Pimlico's testnet faucet. In production, the business model would require either:
- A freemium tier (first 10 gasless tx/month)
- A fee-on-transfer model (0.1% of transaction value)
- Enterprise sponsorship (merchants pay for their customers' gas)

[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/yify-finance-58f2) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://linkmix.co/49426238) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/30cY-ULdjzA) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Lisk%20Builders%20Challenge:%20Round%20Three-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://lisk-builders-challenge-3.devfolio.co)

> Loans Repaid by Yield—No Interest, No Liquidation

![Solidity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Solidity-333333?style=flat-square) ![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

**The Liquidity Trap in Productive Assets**
In the current DeFi landscape, billions of dollars are locked in productive assets like Voting Escrow NFTs (veNFTs) and Real World Assets (RWAs). Owners of these assets face a dilemma: they are "Asset Rich but Cash Poor." To access liquidity, they are often forced to sell their assets, losing both ownership and future passive income streams. Traditional lending protocols do not solve this because they require liquid tokens and carry high liquidation risks due to price volatility.

YiFy: Liquidity Without Liquidation

YiFy Finance solves this by allowing users to borrow against their yield-bearing assets (veNFTs & RWAs) without selling them. Our protocol introduces a novel "Self-Repaying Loan" mechanism.

**Key Benefits:**
1. Zero Interest Loans: Users can access capital cost-free.
2. No Monthly Payments: The loan is repaid automatically using the yield generated by the collateral.
3. Zero Liquidation Risk: Unlike traditional protocols that liquidate you when asset prices drop, YiFy relies on yield coverage. As long as the asset is productive, your collateral is safe from forced selling.
4. Unlocking Illiquid Value: We transform illiquid assets (like locked veAERO or Tokenized Property) into active, usable capital (USDC).

**Challenges we ran into**

Designing a Yield-Based Valuation Engine One of the biggest hurdles was creating a fair valuation model for illiquid assets like veNFTs. Unlike ERC-20 tokens, these NFTs don't have a simple spot price on Uniswap.

**How do we calculate LTV (Loan-to-Value) safely without a liquid market price?**
**The Solution: **We built a custom Valuation Engine that calculates value based on projected yield, lock duration, and historical APR data from Oracles (Pyth). This allows us to issue loans based on the asset's productivity rather than just its speculative price.

Simulation & Testing Complex Flows During the development of our TestFlow scripts on the Lisk Sepolia testnet, we encountered issues with the mock environment. Specifically, we faced ERC20InsufficientBalance errors where our Mock Reward Distributors ran out of funds during automated repayment simulations.

**The Fix: **We had to write a specific Foundry script to automate the minting and funding process for our protocol actors. This taught us the importance of rigorously simulating the "economic flow" of the protocol, not just the code logic, to ensure the self-repaying mechanism works flawlessly in a live environment.

**Winner Classification**

1. Unlocking Capital for Developing Economies SEA is a region with high crypto adoption but often lacks deep liquidity for real-world applications. By integrating Real World Assets (RWAs), YiFy allows business owners and property holders in SEA to tokenise their assets and access global liquidity without high interest rates. This empowers local builders to leverage blockchain for real economic growth.
2. Safe Entry to DeFi The "No Liquidation Risk" feature is crucial for the SEA market, where many users are cautious about the high volatility of crypto. YiFy provides a safer, more stable financial product that encourages broader adoption among non-speculative users.
3. Leveraging Lisk's Efficiency To make self-repaying loans viable for smaller assets (common in SEA), transaction costs must be negligible. Building on Lisk's efficient Layer 2 ensures that the auto-compounding and repayment transactions remain cost-effective, directly empowering users to maximize their yield.

### Crop Chain
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/crop-chain-1ce0) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/Nitya-003/CropChain) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Lisk%20Builders%20Challenge:%20Round%20Three-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://lisk-builders-challenge-3.devfolio.co)

> Connecting farms to forks

![Solidity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Solidity-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Hardhat](https://img.shields.io/badge/Hardhat-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

## The Problem It Solves

The modern agricultural supply chain is often a "black box." Between the moment a seed is planted and the moment the produce reaches a consumer's plate, data is frequently lost, altered, or obscured. **CropChain** addresses these critical pain points:

### 1. Lack of Transparency & "Greenwashing"
In traditional systems, consumers have no way to verify if "organic" or "locally sourced" labels are genuine.
* **The Solution:** By using **Ethereum/Polygon blockchain**, CropChain creates an immutable ledger. Once a farmer logs a harvest, that data cannot be tampered with by middlemen, ensuring 100% data integrity and building authentic trust.

### 2. Slow and Wasteful Food Recalls
When a foodborne illness outbreak occurs, it currently takes days or even weeks to trace a contaminated batch back to its source. This delay leads to massive food waste and public health risks.
* **The Solution:** With **Instant QR Code Tracking**, authorities can pinpoint the exact farm, batch number, and transport vehicle in seconds. This allows for "surgical" recalls—removing only the affected items instead of discarding entire regional stocks.

### 3. The Information "Black Hole"
Farmers often lose visibility of their products once they leave the farm gate, and retailers struggle to verify the storage conditions or transit times.
* **The Solution:** The **Multi-Role Interface** ensures a continuous "Chain of Custody":
    * **Farmers** provide proof of origin.
    * **Transporters** log hand-off points and timestamps.
    * **Retailers** verify the entire journey before accepting delivery.

### 4. Fragmented & Error-Prone Paperwork
Many supply chains still rely on manual logs and siloed databases, which are easy to lose and easy to falsify.
* **The Solution:** A **Unified Digital Ecosystem** (React + Node.js + Solidity) digitizes the entire workflow. It replaces messy paperwork with a simple, scan-and-go mobile experience that is synchronized across all stakeholders in real-time.

### 5. Preventing Fraud and Counterfeiting
High-value crops (like specialty coffee, honey, or saffron) are often diluted with cheaper alternatives during transit.
* **The Solution:** **Smart Contract Access Control** ensures that only authorized, verified actors can update a batch's status. If a product appears on a shelf without a matching, verified blockchain history, it is immediately flagged as a counterfeit.

---

### Summary of Impact

| Feature | Existing Method | CropChain Solution |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Data Security** | Centralized/Paper Logs | **Decentralized Blockchain** |
| **Traceability** | Manual Investigation (Days) | **Instant QR Scan (Seconds)** |
| **Verification** | Blind Trust | **Cryptographic Proof** |
| **Accessibility** | Siloed Databases | **Real-time Unified Dashboard** |

---

**Challenges we ran into**

## Challenges I Ran Into

Building a decentralized application (dApp) is never a straight line. **CropChain** pushed me to solve complex integration issues between traditional web technologies and the blockchain. Here are the specific hurdles I faced:

### 1. The 3-Day Troubleshooting: Smart Contract Event Syncing
The biggest hurdle was a persistent bug where the Frontend UI would not update after a transaction was confirmed on the blockchain.
* **The Issue:** I spent **3 days** troubleshooting why the `BatchCreated` events weren't being picked up by the backend listener. It turned out to be a mismatch between the **WebSocket provider** (Infura/Alchemy) and the local state management.
* **The Fix:** After deep-diving into documentation and community forums, I implemented a custom **polling mechanism** combined with `ethers.js` event listeners. I also added a **"Pending" state** in the UI to handle the lag between block mining and data availability.

### 2. Managing Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
Designing a system where only a "Transporter" could update the shipping status, but only a "Farmer" could create the batch, was tricky to implement securely.
* **The Challenge:** Ensuring that security wasn't just on the Frontend, but also strictly enforced in the **Solidity Smart Contract**.
* **The Fix:** I utilized the **OpenZeppelin AccessControl library**, creating specific `ROLES` (`FARMER_ROLE`, `TRANSPORTER_ROLE`). This ensured that even if someone bypassed the UI, the blockchain would reject unauthorized transactions.

### 3. Gas Fee Optimization
Every step of the supply chain requires a transaction. On a mainnet, these costs can add up quickly for a farmer.
* **The Challenge:** Reducing the "Gas Cost" of updating a crop's journey.
* **The Fix:** I optimized the Smart Contract by using `structs` and minimizing on-chain storage. I moved non-essential metadata (like crop photos and descriptions) to **MongoDB**, storing only the **Hash (CID)** on the blockchain to verify integrity without the high cost.

### 4. QR Code Scanning on Mobile Devices
Integrating a web-based QR scanner that worked consistently across different mobile browsers (iOS Safari vs. Android Chrome) was a major UX challenge.
* **The Fix:** I switched from a basic library to `html5-qrcode`, which provided better hardware access and more robust error handling for various camera resolutions.

---

> **Reflection:** The 3-day bug was a turning point for the project. It taught me that building on Web3 requires a different mental model for "Real-Time" data compared to traditional Web2 development.

![Solidity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Solidity-333333?style=flat-square) ![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![ethers.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/ethers.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

The "Trust Gap" in Community Coordination: Communities and relief organizations currently lack a reliable, portable way to verify the trustworthiness of strangers. In scenarios like disaster relief, employment, or local lending, "trust" is trapped in isolated databases or paper records that are easily lost, forged, or ignored by other institutions. This forces organizations to waste critical time manually vetting volunteers, while legitimate contributors struggle to prove their reliability to new employers or banks because their history is locked away in a "walled garden" they don't own.

The "Silo" Problem in Verification: Furthermore, existing reputation systems (like a specific NGO’s database) are not interoperable, meaning a volunteer's hard work in one area doesn't translate to value elsewhere. A local grocery store cannot easily give discounts to verified volunteers because they cannot integrate with complex, private NGO databases. This lack of a unified, open verification layer prevents the creation of a "community economy" where good deeds are instantly recognized and rewarded across different sectors, stifling local commerce and reducing the incentive for civic engagement

**Challenges we ran into**

Learning how to write smart contracts was a new experience for us, especially handling permissions regarding different levels or tiers of users. Hosting the smart contract was somewhat challenging too.

**Ethereum Track**

We use blockchain to verify whether a user completes a task as well as how  well they do it. Since what we are adding to the chain is immutable, it means that there is no way to change what is already recorded.

### ProofSense AI
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/mindmate-ai-fc66) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/MeenalSinha/ProofSense-AI) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://proofsense-ai-mnpgmcwfudb9uk3yrhv2f3.streamlit.app/) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/NTDWPsSAwnI) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-HackFiesta-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hackfiesta.devfolio.co)

> Trust through Transparency for LLM Outputs

![NumPy](https://img.shields.io/badge/NumPy-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Regex](https://img.shields.io/badge/Regex-333333?style=flat-square) ![Plotly](https://img.shields.io/badge/Plotly-333333?style=flat-square) ![Streamlit](https://img.shields.io/badge/Streamlit-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

## The Problem ProofSense AI Solves

Large Language Models (LLMs) generate fluent and confident answers, but they often **hallucinate facts**—producing statements that sound correct but are unsupported or misleading.

Today, users have **no practical way to understand why an AI answer should be trusted or questioned**. Most existing tools either:
- Treat AI outputs as black boxes, or  
- Attempt full fact-checking without transparency or explainability.

This creates serious risks when AI is used for:
- Research and education  
- Decision-making in finance, health, or policy  
- Developer tools and technical documentation  
- Content generation and analysis  

Blind trust in AI outputs can lead to **misinformation, flawed decisions, and erosion of trust in AI systems**.

### The Core Gap
There is no clear trust layer that explains:
- Which parts of an AI response are supported by evidence  
- Which claims are risky or unsupported  
- How reliable the overall AI-generated answer is  

### Why This Matters
Without visibility into reliability, users are forced to either:
- Trust AI blindly, or  
- Manually verify every claim, which defeats the purpose of using AI  

ProofSense AI addresses this gap by making AI outputs **inspectable, explainable, and safer to use**, without claiming absolute correctness.

**Challenges we ran into**

## Challenges I Ran Into

### 1. Defining “trust” without overclaiming correctness
One of the main challenges was clearly defining what the system measures. Early versions risked sounding like a fact-checker or a truth engine, which could lead to overclaiming. This was resolved by explicitly framing all outputs as **verifiability confidence based on evidence support**, not factual correctness, and reinforcing this language consistently in the UI, README, and explanations.

---

### 2. Designing an explainable scoring system
Another challenge was creating a scoring mechanism that was meaningful yet simple enough to explain to judges and users. Complex probabilistic or opaque metrics would reduce trust. This was addressed by using a transparent, weighted heuristic based on evidence overlap, number of sources, and average evidence quality, with clearly documented weights.

---

### 3. Claim segmentation from free-form text
Breaking AI-generated answers into clean, atomic claims was non-trivial, especially with compound sentences. Initial approaches either split too aggressively or missed meaningful sub-claims. This was improved through iterative refinement of sentence and conjunction-based splitting rules, along with minimum-length filtering to remove noise.

---

### 4. Avoiding misleading evidence retrieval
Using real web search or live data sources would introduce unpredictability and demo risk. However, a purely abstract explanation would feel weak. The balance was achieved by using a **clearly labeled prototype evidence store (simulated RAG)**, ensuring deterministic behavior while still demonstrating how real retrieval would work in production.

---

### 5. Balancing feature depth with demo clarity
There was a risk of adding too many metrics, charts, or domains, which could overwhelm users and judges. This was handled by prioritizing a small set of high-signal features (verifiability confidence, unsupported claims, risk levels) and deferring advanced ideas to a future roadmap instead of the core demo.

---

### 6. Ensuring environment and setup reliability
Hackathon demos often fail due to dependency or environment issues. Early setup attempts relied on ad-hoc installations. This was resolved by pinning safe dependency versions in `requirements.txt` and using a robust setup script that installs from the requirements file with clear fallbacks.

---

### 7. Maintaining consistent terminology across the project
Small inconsistencies in wording (for example, “trust score” vs “confidence score”) could create confusion or misinterpretation. This was addressed by standardizing terminology across the codebase, UI, and documentation to consistently use **verifiability confidence** and related terms.

---

These challenges shaped the final design of ProofSense AI and led to a more responsible, explainable, and demo-stable system.

Team **NeuroIgniter** -- [Meenal Sinha](https://github.com/MeenalSinha)
